Query.SQL: SELECTX(IDS-DB01) <XTAB 7;"2";"LIST";"CRLF";"F";"N";""> DISTINCT GenProcID FROM [dbo].[JobQueue] WHERE Ready2EXE = 'FROZEN' ORDER BY GENPROCID JOIN_ON GenProcID SELECTX(IDS-DB01) DISTINCT JobChainName FROM [dbo].[JobQueue] WHERE Ready2EXE = 'FROZEN' ORDER BY JOBCHAINNAME JOIN_ON GenProcID;JobChainName SELECTX(IDS-DB01) XDateInserted, TaskName, ParamIN, <DBLOOKUP(IDS-DB01,n/a,,DELL) "<OBJECT_TABLE>" "'<OBJECT_TABLE_NAME>'[Table Name], <DEFAULT>[Object Name]" "" "" "BasisObjectKey=XObjectKey">, BasisObjectKey, ErrorMessages, ComponentClass, JobChainName FROM [dbo].[JobQueue] WHERE Ready2EXE = 'FROZEN' ORDER BY XDATEINSERTED DESC;

SELECTX(IDS-DB01) <XTAB 7;"2";"LIST";"CRLF";"F";"N";""> DISTINCT GenProcID FROM [dbo].[JobQueue] WHERE Ready2EXE = 'FROZEN' ORDER BY GENPROCID JOIN_ON GenProcID SELECTX(IDS-DB01) DISTINCT JobChainName FROM [dbo].[JobQueue] WHERE Ready2EXE = 'FROZEN' ORDER BY JOBCHAINNAME JOIN_ON GenProcID;JobChainName SELECTX(IDS-DB01) XDateInserted, TaskName, ParamIN, <DBLOOKUP(IDS-DB01) "<OBJECT_TABLE>" "'<OBJECT_TABLE_NAME>'[Table Name], <DEFAULT>[Object Name]" "" "" "BasisObjectKey=XObjectKey">, BasisObjectKey, ErrorMessages, ComponentClass, JobChainName FROM [dbo].[JobQueue] WHERE Ready2EXE = 'FROZEN' ORDER BY XDATEINSERTED DESC;

SELECTX(IDS-DB01) <XTAB 7;"2";"LIST";"CRLF";"F";"N";""> DISTINCT GenProcID FROM [dbo].[JobQueue] WHERE Ready2EXE = 'FROZEN' ORDER BY GENPROCID JOIN_ON GenProcID SELECTX(IDS-DB01) DISTINCT JobChainName FROM [dbo].[JobQueue] WHERE Ready2EXE = 'FROZEN' ORDER BY JOBCHAINNAME JOIN_ON GenProcID;JobChainName SELECTX(IDS-DB01) XDateInserted, TaskName, ParamIN, <DBLOOKUP(IDS-DB01) "<OBJECT_TABLE>" "'<OBJECT_TABLE_NAME>'[Table Name], <DEFAULT>[Object Name]" "" "" "BasisObjectKey=XObjectKey">, BasisObjectKey, ErrorMessages, ComponentClass, JobChainName FROM [dbo].[JobQueue] WHERE Ready2EXE = 'FROZEN' ORDER BY XDATEINSERTED DESC;

WITH rpt AS ( select 'Job' As Obj, Name As ObjName, GenCondition As ObjScript from Job where not GenCondition is Null UNION select 'DialogScript' As Obj, ScriptName As ObjName, ScriptCode As ObjScript from DialogScript where not ScriptCode is Null UNION select 'DialogColumn' As Obj, UID_DialogTable + ' / ' + ColumnName As ObjName, Template As ObjScript from DialogColumn where not Template is Null UNION select 'DialogColumn' As Obj, UID_DialogTable + ' / ' + ColumnName As ObjName, FormatScript As ObjScript from DialogColumn where not FormatScript is Null UNION select 'JobParameter' As Obj, Name As ObjName, ValueTemplateDefault As ObjScript from JobParameter where not ValueTemplateDefault is Null UNION select 'DialogTable' As Obj, TableName As ObjName, OnSavingScript As ObjScript from DialogTable where not OnSavingScript is Null UNION select 'DialogTable' As Obj, TableName As ObjName, OnSavedScript from DialogTable where not OnSavedScript is Null UNION select 'DialogMethod' As Obj, MethodName As ObjName, MethodScript As ObjScript from DialogMethod where not MethodScript is Null UNION select 'DialogObject' As Obj, UID_DialogTable + ' / ' + ObjectName As ObjName, SelectScript As ObjScript from DialogObject where not SelectScript is Null UNION select 'DialogTree' As Obj, TreeNode As ObjName, StateScript As ObjScript from DialogTree where not StateScript is Null UNION select 'JobChain' As Obj, Name As ObjName, GenCondition As ObjScript from JobChain where not GenCondition is Null UNION select 'DPRTemplate' As Obj, DisplayName As ObjName, ScriptCode As ObjScript from DPRTemplate where not ScriptCode is Null UNION select 'JobRunParameter' As Obj, Name As ObjName, ValueTemplate As ObjScript from JobRunParameter where not ValueTemplate is Null ) SELECT Obj as "Table", ObjName as "Object", ObjScript as "Script" FROM rpt ORDER BY 1, 2, 3;

WITH v AS ( select 25 as wdt, 50 as uidlen, 'pro.cjib.minjus.nl' as root_domain, 10 as max_level ), GrpMembers (tak, UID_GroupDomain, UID_Group, GroupName, GroupFullName, GroupLevel, UID_MemberDomain, UID_Member, MemberName, MemberFullName, MemberLevel) AS ( -- root nodes with no children --SELECT -- 'root' as tak, -- gR.UID_ADSDomain as UID_GroupDomain, -- gR.UID_ADSGroup as UID_Group, -- gR.DistinguishedName AS GroupName, -- case when LEN(gR.cn) > v.wdt then -- cast('/' + substring(gR.cn,1,v.wdt-2) + '..' as varchar(2048)) -- else cast('/' + gR.cn as varchar(2048)) end as GroupFullName, -- 0 as GroupLevel, -- cast(null as varchar(38)) as UID_MemberDomain, -- cast(null as varchar(38)) as UID_Member, -- cast(null as varchar(38)) AS MemberName, -- cast(null as varchar(38)) AS MemberFullName, -- -1 as MemberLevel -- FROM v, ADSGroup gR -- INNER JOIN ADSDomain dR -- ON gR.UID_ADSDomain = dR.UID_ADSDomain -- WHERE 1=1 -- -- is not the child of one or more groups -- AND (not exists (select * from ADSGroupInADSGroup gggR where gggR.UID_ADSGroupParent = gR.UID_ADSGroup)) -- -- not a parent of another group -- AND (not exists (select * from ADSGroupInADSGroup gggR where gggR.UID_ADSGroupChild = gR.UID_ADSGroup)) -- AND dR.ADSDomainName = v.root_domain -- UNION ALL -- root nodes with children SELECT 'root' as tak, g0.UID_ADSDomain as UID_GroupDomain, g0.UID_ADSGroup as UID_Group, g0.DistinguishedName AS GroupName, case when LEN(g0.cn) > v.wdt then cast('/' + substring(g0.cn,1,v.wdt-2) + '..' as varchar(2048)) else cast('/' + g0.cn as varchar(2048)) end as GroupFullName, 0 as GroupLevel, gg0.UID_ADSDomain as UID_MemberDomain, gg0.UID_ADSGroup as UID_Member, gg0.DistinguishedName AS MemberName, case when LEN(g0.cn) > v.wdt then case when LEN(gg0.cn) > v.wdt then cast('/' + substring(g0.cn,1,v.wdt-2) + '..' + '/' + substring(gg0.cn,1,v.wdt-2) + '..' as varchar(2048)) else cast('/' + substring(g0.cn,1,v.wdt-2) + '..' + '/' + gg0.cn as varchar(2048)) end else case when LEN(gg0.cn) > v.wdt then cast('/' + g0.cn + '/' + substring(gg0.cn,1,v.wdt-2) + '..' as varchar(2048)) else cast('/' + g0.cn + '/' + gg0.cn as varchar(2048)) end end as MemberFullName, 1 as MemberLevel FROM v, ADSGroup g0 INNER JOIN ADSDomain d0 ON g0.UID_ADSDomain = d0.UID_ADSDomain INNER JOIN ADSGroupInADSGroup ggg0 on ggg0.UID_ADSGroupChild = g0.UID_ADSGroup -- is the child of one or more groups INNER JOIN ADSGroup gg0 on ggg0.UID_ADSGroupParent = gg0.UID_ADSGroup WHERE 1=1 -- not a parent of another group AND (not exists (select * from ADSGroupInADSGroup ggg0 where ggg0.UID_ADSGroupParent = g0.UID_ADSGroup)) --AND d0.ADSDomainName = v.root_domain UNION ALL -- nodes with parent and children SELECT 'node' as tak, gm1.UID_MemberDomain as UID_GroupDomain, gm1.UID_Member as UID_Group, gm1.MemberName AS GroupName, gm1.MemberFullName as GroupFullName, gm1.MemberLevel as GroupLevel, gg1.UID_ADSDomain as UID_MemberDomain, gg1.UID_ADSGroup as UID_Member, gg1.DistinguishedName AS MemberName, case when LEN(gg1.cn) > v.wdt then cast(gm1.MemberFullName + '/' + substring(gg1.cn,1,v.wdt-2) + '..' as varchar(2048)) else cast(gm1.MemberFullName + '/' + gg1.cn as varchar(2048)) end as MemberFullName, (gm1.MemberLevel + 1) as MemberLevel FROM v, GrpMembers gm1 -- has a parent INNER JOIN ADSGroup g1 ON gm1.UID_Member = g1.UID_ADSGroup -- has children INNER JOIN ADSGroupInADSGroup ggg1 ON ggg1.UID_ADSGroupChild = g1.UID_ADSGroup INNER JOIN ADSGroup gg1 on ggg1.UID_ADSGroupParent = gg1.UID_ADSGroup WHERE 1=1 AND gm1.MemberLevel < v.max_level UNION ALL -- leaf nodes without children SELECT 'leaf' as tak, gm2.UID_MemberDomain as UID_GroupDomain, gm2.UID_Member as UID_Group, gm2.MemberName AS GroupName, gm2.MemberFullName as GroupFullName, gm2.MemberLevel as GroupLevel, cast(null as varchar(38)) as UID_MemberDomain, cast(null as varchar(38)) as UID_Member, cast(null as varchar(38)) AS MemberName, cast(null as varchar(38)) AS MemberFullName, -1 as MemberLevel FROM v, GrpMembers gm2 INNER JOIN ADSGroup g2 ON gm2.UID_Member = g2.UID_ADSGroup -- has a parent -- has no children WHERE 1=1 AND (not exists (select * from ADSGroupInADSGroup ggg2 where ggg2.UID_ADSGroupChild = g2.UID_ADSGroup)) ), grps AS ( SELECT DISTINCT d.ADSDomainName As DomainName, GroupLevel as lev, GroupFullName as FullName, UID_Group As UID_ADSGroup, GroupName as DistinguishedName, tak FROM GrpMembers INNER JOIN ADSDomain d ON GrpMembers.UID_GroupDomain = d.UID_ADSDomain ), gaccts AS ( SELECT grps.DomainName, grps.lev, grps.FullName, grps.DistinguishedName, case when (ag.UID_ADSAccount is null) then 0 else case when (a.UID_Person is null) then 0 else 1 end end as pers_acct FROM grps LEFT OUTER JOIN ADSAccountInADSGroup ag ON grps.UID_ADSGroup = ag.UID_ADSGroup LEFT OUTER JOIN ADSAccount a ON a.UID_ADSAccount = ag.UID_ADSAccount ), group_hierarchy AS ( SELECT FullName, lev, DomainName, DistinguishedName, sum(pers_acct) as NumPersAccts FROM gaccts GROUP BY DistinguishedName, DomainName, FullName, lev ) SELECT FullName as "TREE: Full-path", lev as "<LEVEL>", DomainName as "Domain", DistinguishedName as "Group Distinguised-Name", NumPersAccts as "# AD Accounts" FROM group_hierarchy ORDER BY FullName;

gR.DistinguishedName AS GroupName, -- case when LEN(gR.cn) > v.wdt then -- cast('/' + substring(gR.cn,1,v.wdt-2) + '..' as varchar(2048)) -- else cast('/' + gR.cn as varchar(2048)) end as as varchar(2048)) end as GroupFullName, 0 as GroupLevel, gg0.UID_ADSDomain as UID_MemberDomain, gg0.UID_ADSGroup as UID_Member, gg0.DistinguishedName AS MemberName, case when LEN(g0.cn) > v.wdt then case when LEN(gg0.cn) > v.wdt then cast('/' + substring(g0.cn,1,v.wdt-2) + '..' + '/' + substring(gg0.cn,1,v.wdt-2) + '..' as varchar(2048)) else cast('/' + substring(g0.cn,1,v.wdt-2) + '..' + '/' + gg0.cn as varchar(2048)) end else case when LEN(gg0.cn) > v.wdt then cast('/' + g0.cn + '/' + substring(gg0.cn,1,v.wdt-2) + '..' as varchar(2048)) else cast('/' + g0.cn + '/' + gg0.cn as varchar(2048)) end end as MemberFullName, 1 as MemberLevel FROM v, ADSGroup g0 INNER JOIN ADSDomain d0 ON g0.UID_ADSDomain = d0.UID_ADSDomain INNER JOIN ADSGroupInADSGroup ggg0 on ggg0.UID_ADSGroupChild = g0.UID_ADSGroup -- is the child of one or more groups INNER JOIN ADSGroup gg0 on ggg0.UID_ADSGroupParent = gg0.UID_ADSGroup WHERE 1=1 -- not a parent of another group AND (not exists (select * from ADSGroupInADSGroup ggg0 where ggg0.UID_ADSGroupParent = g0.UID_ADSGroup)) AND d0.ADSDomainName = v.root_domain UNION ALL -- nodes with parent and children SELECT 'node' as tak, gm1.UID_MemberDomain as UID_GroupDomain, gm1.UID_Member as UID_Group, gm1.MemberName AS GroupName, gm1.MemberFullName as GroupFullName, gm1.MemberLevel as GroupLevel, gg1.UID_ADSDomain as UID_MemberDomain, gg1.UID_ADSGroup as UID_Member, gg1.DistinguishedName AS MemberName, case when LEN(gg1.cn) > v.wdt then cast(gm1.MemberFullName + '/' + substring(gg1.cn,1,v.wdt-2) + '..' as varchar(2048)) else cast(gm1.MemberFullName + '/' + gg1.cn as varchar(2048)) end as MemberFullName, (gm1.MemberLevel + 1) as MemberLevel FROM v, GrpMembers gm1 -- has a parent INNER JOIN ADSGroup g1 ON gm1.UID_Member = g1.UID_ADSGroup -- has children INNER JOIN ADSGroupInADSGroup ggg1 ON ggg1.UID_ADSGroupChild = g1.UID_ADSGroup INNER JOIN ADSGroup gg1 on ggg1.UID_ADSGroupParent = gg1.UID_ADSGroup WHERE 1=1 AND gm1.MemberLevel < v.max_level UNION ALL -- leaf nodes without children SELECT 'leaf' as tak, gm2.UID_MemberDomain as UID_GroupDomain, gm2.UID_Member as UID_Group, gm2.MemberName AS GroupName, gm2.MemberFullName as GroupFullName, gm2.MemberLevel as GroupLevel, cast(null as varchar(38)) as UID_MemberDomain, cast(null as varchar(38)) as UID_Member, cast(null as varchar(38)) AS MemberName, cast(null as varchar(38)) AS MemberFullName, -1 as MemberLevel FROM v, GrpMembers gm2 INNER JOIN ADSGroup g2 ON gm2.UID_Member = g2.UID_ADSGroup -- has a parent -- has no children WHERE 1=1 AND (not exists (select * from ADSGroupInADSGroup ggg2 where ggg2.UID_ADSGroupChild = gm2.UID_Group)) ), grps AS ( SELECT DISTINCT d.ADSDomainName As DomainName, GroupLevel as lev, GroupFullName as FullName, UID_Group As UID_ADSGroup, GroupName as DistinguishedName, tak FROM GrpMembers INNER JOIN ADSDomain d ON GrpMembers.UID_GroupDomain = d.UID_ADSDomain ), gaccts AS ( SELECT grps.DomainName, grps.lev, grps.FullName, grps.DistinguishedName, case when (ag.UID_ADSAccount is null) then 0 else case when (a.UID_Person is null) then 0 else 1 end end as pers_acct FROM grps LEFT DistinguishedName, sum(pers_acct) as NumPersAccts FROM gaccts GROUP BY DistinguishedName, DomainName, FullName, lev ) SELECT FullName as "TREE: Full-path", lev as "<LEVEL>", DomainName as "Domain", DistinguishedName as "Group Distinguised-Name", NumPersAccts as "# AD Accounts" FROM group_hierarchy ORDER BY FullName;

with ja as ( select p.CCC_PersonId, a.CCC_PriorityOrder, a.CCC_ContextId from dbo.Person p inner join dbo.LDAPAccount a on p.UID_Person = a.UID_Person ), multija as ( select CCC_PersonId, CCC_PriorityOrder, count(*) as NumJa from ja group by CCC_PersonId, CCC_PriorityOrder having count(*) > 1 ), dmultija as ( select distinct m.CCC_PersonId, p.InternalName from multija m inner join Person p on m.CCC_PersonId = p.CCC_PersonId ) selectx(1IM_PROD) CCC_PersonId, InternalName from dmultija order by 2 JOIN_ON CCC_PersonId selectx(1IM_PROD) CCC_ContextId, CCC_PriorityOrder, CCC_DateStartEffective, CCC_DateEndEffective, CCC_Status FROM LDAPAccount;

with ja as ( select p.CCC_PersonId, a.CCC_PriorityOrder, a.CCC_ContextId from dbo.Person p inner join dbo.LDAPAccount a on p.UID_Person = a.UID_Person ), multija as ( select CCC_PersonId, CCC_PriorityOrder, count(*) as NumJa from ja group by CCC_PersonId, CCC_PriorityOrder having count(*) > 1 ), dmultija as ( select distinct m.CCC_PersonId, p.InternalName from multija m inner join Person p on m.CCC_PersonId = p.CCC_PersonId ) selectx(1IM_PROD) CCC_PersonId, InternalName from dmultija order by 2 JOIN_ON CCC_PersonId selectx(1IM_PROD) CCC_ContextId, CCC_PriorityOrder, CCC_DateStartEffective, CCC_DateEndEffective, CCC_Status FROM LDAPAccount;

with v as ( select 'ATO' as domain ), pools as ( select cn, UID_ADSGroup from ADSGroup g where UID_ADSGroup in (select UID_ADSGroupChild from ADSGroupInADSGroup where UID_ADSGroupParent in (select UID_ADSGroup from ADSGroup where cn = 'G_Virtual Desktop Users')) ), accts as ( select p.cn as grp, p.UID_ADSGroup as uid, a.cn as acct from v, pools p inner join ADSAccountInADSGroup ag on p.UID_ADSGroup = ag.UID_ADSGroup inner join ADSAccount a on a.UID_ADSAccount = ag.UID_ADSAccount where p.cn like 'G_Desktop Pool ' + v.domain + '%' and not p.cn like '%TEST' ), cnts as ( select grp, uid, count(*) as 'NumAccts' from accts group by grp, uid ) selectx(1IM_PROD) cn from pools JOIN_ON UID_ADSGroup selectx(1IM_PROD) CanonicalName from ADSGroup;

with v as ( select 'ATO' as domain ), pools as ( select cn, UID_ADSGroup from ADSGroup g where UID_ADSGroup in (select UID_ADSGroupChild from ADSGroupInADSGroup where UID_ADSGroupParent in (select UID_ADSGroup from ADSGroup where cn = 'G_Virtual Desktop Users')) ), accts as ( select p.cn as grp, p.UID_ADSGroup as uid, a.cn as acct from v, pools p inner join ADSAccountInADSGroup ag on p.UID_ADSGroup = ag.UID_ADSGroup inner join ADSAccount a on a.UID_ADSAccount = ag.UID_ADSAccount where p.cn like 'G_Desktop Pool ' + v.domain + '%' and not p.cn like '%TEST' ), cnts as ( select grp, uid, count(*) as 'NumAccts' from accts group by grp, uid ) selectx(1IM_PROD) cn from pools JOIN_ON UID_ADSGroup selectx(1IM_PROD) SAMAccountName, cn, DisplayName, Description, Info from ADSGroup;

Query.Description: Persons with multi 1 or 2 or 3 or 4 priorities and Persons with no Active Job-Assignments
Query.SQL:
with ja as ( select p.CCC_PersonId, a.CCC_PriorityOrder, a.CCC_Status, a.CCC_ContextId from dbo.Person p inner join dbo.LDAPAccount a on p.UID_Person = a.UID_Person ), --select * from ja jatab as ( select CCC_PersonId, case when CCC_PriorityOrder = 1 then 1 else 0 end as prio_1, case when CCC_PriorityOrder = 2 then 1 else 0 end as prio_2, case when CCC_PriorityOrder = 3 then 1 else 0 end as prio_3, case when CCC_PriorityOrder = 4 then 1 else 0 end as prio_4, case when CCC_Status = 'Inactive' then 1 else 0 end as inact, case when CCC_Status = 'Active' then 1 else 0 end as act, case when CCC_Status = 'ActivePending' then 1 else 0 end as act_pend from ja ), tot as ( select distinct p.CCC_PersonId, p.InternalName, sum(prio_1) over(partition by j.CCC_PersonId) as prio_1, sum(prio_2) over(partition by j.CCC_PersonId) as prio_2, sum(prio_3) over(partition by j.CCC_PersonId) as prio_3, sum(prio_4) over(partition by j.CCC_PersonId) as prio_4, sum(inact) over(partition by j.CCC_PersonId) as inact, sum(act) over(partition by j.CCC_PersonId) as act, sum(act_pend) over(partition by j.CCC_PersonId) as act_pend from jatab j inner join Person p on j.CCC_PersonId = p.CCC_PersonId ) selectx(1IM_PROD) CCC_PersonId, InternalName from tot where (inact > 0 and act = 0 and act_pend = 0) or (prio_1 > 1 or prio_2 > 1 or prio_3 > 1 or prio_4 > 1) order by InternalName JOIN_ON CCC_PersonId selectx(1IM_PROD) CCC_ContextId, CCC_PriorityOrder, CCC_DateStartEffective, CCC_DateEndEffective, CCC_Status
FROM LDAPAccount ORDER BY CCC_DateStartEffective;

Query.SQL: with ja as ( select p.CCC_PersonId, a.CCC_PriorityOrder, a.CCC_Status, a.CCC_ContextId from dbo.Person p inner join dbo.LDAPAccount a on p.UID_Person = a.UID_Person ), --select * from ja jatab as ( select CCC_PersonId, case when CCC_PriorityOrder = 1 then 1 else 0 end as prio_1, case when CCC_PriorityOrder = 2 then 1 else 0 end as prio_2, case when CCC_PriorityOrder = 3 then 1 else 0 end as prio_3, case when CCC_PriorityOrder = 4 then 1 else 0 end as prio_4, case when CCC_Status = 'Inactive' then 1 else 0 end as inact, case when CCC_Status = 'Active' then 1 else 0 end as act, case when CCC_Status = 'ActivePending' then 1 else 0 end as act_pend from ja ), tot as ( select distinct p.CCC_PersonId, p.InternalName, p.ExitDate, p.IsInActive, sum(prio_1) over(partition by j.CCC_PersonId) as prio_1, sum(prio_2) over(partition by j.CCC_PersonId) as prio_2, sum(prio_3) over(partition by j.CCC_PersonId) as prio_3, sum(prio_4) over(partition by j.CCC_PersonId) as prio_4, sum(inact) over(partition by j.CCC_PersonId) as inact, sum(act) over(partition by j.CCC_PersonId) as act, sum(act_pend) over(partition by j.CCC_PersonId) as act_pend from jatab j inner join Person p on j.CCC_PersonId = p.CCC_PersonId ) selectx(1IM_PROD) CCC_PersonId, InternalName, ExitDate, IsInActive from tot where (inact > 0 and act = 0 and act_pend = 0) or (prio_1 > 1 or prio_2 > 1 or prio_3 > 1 or prio_4 > 1) order by InternalName JOIN_ON CCC_PersonId selectx(1IM_PROD) CCC_ContextId, CCC_PriorityOrder, CCC_DateStartEffective, CCC_DateEndEffective, CCC_Status FROM LDAPAccount ORDER BY CCC_DateStartEffective;

WITH v AS ( select 25 as wdt, 50 as uidlen, 10 as max_level ), Members As ( SELECT 1 as lev, rN.UID_ITShopOrg as UID_Org, rN.Ident_Org as Org, rN.ITShopInfo as OrgInfo, cast('/' + substring(rN.Ident_Org,1,v.wdt) as varchar(2048)) as FullName FROM v, ITShopOrg rN WHERE rN.UID_ParentITShopOrg is null UNION ALL SELECT (r1.lev + 1) as lev, rr1.UID_ITShopOrg as UID_Org, rr1.Ident_Org as Org, rr1.ITShopInfo as OrgInfo, cast(r1.FullName + '/' + substring(rr1.Ident_Org,1,v.wdt) as varchar(2048)) as FullName FROM v, Members r1 INNER JOIN ITShopOrg rr1 ON rr1.UID_ParentITShopOrg = r1.UID_Org ), WITH items AS ( SELECT m.OrgInfo as OrgInfo, m.FullName as FullName, m.lev as lev, m.Org Org, ac.Ident_AccProduct as Prod, ac.UID_AccProduct as UID_Prod FROM Members m LEFT OUTER JOIN AccProduct ac ON ac.UID_AccProduct = m.UID_AccProduct ) SELECTX(IDS_D1IM_8) OrgInfo as "Object Type", FullName as "TREE: Full-path", lev as "<LEVEL>", Org as "Object Name", Prod as "Service Item" FROM items ORDER BY FullName JOIN_ON UID_Prod=UID_AccProduct WITH ents AS ( SELECT XObjectKey, 'ADSGroup' As TabName, 'Active Directory groups' As TabDescr FROM ADSGroup WHERE Query.Description: P-Direct Org Eenheden vs PIMS Afdelingen
Query.SQL: WITH v AS ( select 25 as wdt, 50 as uidlen, 10 as max_level ), dept AS ( SELECT ac.ObjectID, ac.DepartmentName, ac.ShortName, ac.Remarks, ac.treelevel, ac.FullPath, ac.UID_Department, ac.UID_ParentDepartment FROM Department ac INNER JOIN OrgType t ON ac.UID_OrgType = t.UID_OrgType WHERE (t.Ident_OrgType = 'P-Direct OrganizatieEenheid' And not ac.ObjectID is null) or (ac.ObjectID = '99990000') ), Members As ( SELECT cast('no parent' as varchar(20)) as typ, 1 as lev, rN.UID_Department, rN.ObjectID, cast('/' + substring(rN.DepartmentName,1,v.wdt) as varchar(2048)) as FullName FROM v, dept rN WHERE rN.Remarks is null UNION ALL SELECT cast('missing parent' as varchar(20)) as typ, 1 as lev, rN.UID_Department, rN.ObjectID, cast('/' + substring(rN.DepartmentName,1,v.wdt) as varchar(2048)) as FullName FROM v, dept rN WHERE not (rN.Remarks is null) and not (exists (select * from dept dt where dt.ObjectID = rN.Remarks)) UNION ALL SELECT cast('with parent' as varchar(20)) as typ, (r1.lev + 1) as lev, rr1.UID_Department, rr1.ObjectID, cast(r1.FullName + '/' + substring(rr1.DepartmentName,1,v.wdt) as varchar(2048)) as FullName FROM v, Members r1 INNER JOIN dept rr1 ON rr1.Remarks = r1.ObjectID WHERE r1.lev < v.max_level ), items AS ( SELECT m.typ, m.FullName as FullName, m.lev as lev, ac.ObjectID, ac.DepartmentName, ac.ShortName, ac.Remarks, ac.treelevel, ac.FullPath, ac.UID_Department FROM Members m INNER JOIN Department ac ON ac.UID_Department = m.UID_Department ) SELECTX(IDS-D1iM_8) FullName as "TREE: Full-path", lev as "<LEVEL>", ObjectID as "Organisatie Eenheid Nummer", ShortName as "Organisatie Eenheid ID", DepartmentName as "Organisatie Eenheid" FROM items ORDER BY FullName JOIN_ON UID_Department=CCC_UID_New_Department SELECTX(IDS-D1iM_8) <NONE> FROM CCC_Department_Map JOIN_ON CCC_UID_Old_Department=UID_Department SELECTX(IDS-D1iM_8) DepartmentName as "PIMS Department", ObjectID as "PIMS AfdelingID" FROM Department;

SELECTX(IDS-D1IM_8,svcIDS_sql,,V7) PDirFullPath, PDirTreeLevel, PDirOrgEenheidsNummer, PDirOrgEenheidsAfk, PDirDepartmentName, PimsDepartmentName, PimsAfdelingID, PimsDirectieCode, PimsDirectieName, PimsDienstCode, PimsDienstName, PimsAfdelingCode, PimsAfdelingName, PimsSubAfdelingCode, PimsSubAfdelingName FROM dbo.CCC_PDir_PIMS_Departments ORDER BY PDirFullPath;

WITH pdir AS ( SELECT * FROM Department WHERE UID_OrgType in (select UID_OrgType from OrgType where Ident_OrgType = 'P-Direct OrganizatieEenheid') ), pims AS ( SELECT * FROM Department WHERE UID_OrgType in (select UID_OrgType from OrgType where Ident_OrgType = 'PIMS Afdeling') ), map AS ( SELECT pdir.FullPath as PDirFullPath, pdir.treelevel as PDirTreeLevel, pdir.ObjectID as PDirOrgEenheidsNummer, pdir.ShortName as PDirOrgEenheidsAfk, pdir.DepartmentName as PDirDepartmentName, REPLACE(pims.FullPath,'PIMS Departments(99990001)','') as PimsFullPath, pims.treelevel as PimsTreeLevel, pims.DepartmentName as PimsDepartmentName, pims.ObjectID As PimsAfdelingID, CASE WHEN LEN(pims.ObjectID) >= 4 THEN SUBSTRING(pims.ObjectID,1,4) ELSE '' END AS PimsDirectieCode, CASE WHEN LEN(pims.ObjectID) >= 9 THEN SUBSTRING(pims.ObjectID,6,4) ELSE '' END AS PimsDienstCode, CASE WHEN LEN(pims.ObjectID) >= 14 THEN SUBSTRING(pims.ObjectID,11,4) ELSE '' END AS PimsAfdelingCode, CASE WHEN LEN(pims.ObjectID) >= 19 THEN SUBSTRING(pims.ObjectID,16,4) ELSE '' END AS PimsSubAfdelingCode, pdir.UID_Department as UID_Pims_Department, pdir.UID_ParentDepartment as UID_Pims_ParentDepartment, pims.UID_Department as UID_PDir_Department, pims.UID_ParentDepartment as UID_PDir_ParentDepartment FROM pdir LEFT OUTER JOIN CCC_Department_Map map ON pdir.UID_Department = map.CCC_UID_New_Department LEFT OUTER JOIN pims ON pims.UID_Department = map.CCC_UID_Old_Department ), dirs AS ( SELECT map.PDirFullPath, map.PDirTreeLevel, map.PDirOrgEenheidsNummer, map.PDirOrgEenheidsAfk, map.PDirDepartmentName, map.PimsFullPath, map.PimsTreeLevel, map.PimsAfdelingID, map.PimsDepartmentName, map.PimsDirectieCode, directie.DepartmentName as PimsDirectieName, map.PimsDienstCode, dienst.DepartmentName as PimsDienstName, map.PimsAfdelingCode, afd.DepartmentName as PimsAfdelingName, map.PimsSubAfdelingCode, subafd.DepartmentName as PimsSubAfdelingName, UID_Pims_Department, UID_Pims_ParentDepartment, UID_PDir_Department, UID_PDir_ParentDepartment FROM map LEFT OUTER JOIN pims AS directie ON map.PimsDirectieCode = directie.ObjectID LEFT OUTER JOIN pims AS dienst ON map.PimsDirectieCode + '.' + map.PimsDienstCode = dienst.ObjectID LEFT OUTER JOIN pims AS afd ON map.PimsDirectieCode + '.' + map.PimsDienstCode + '.' + map.PimsAfdelingCode = afd.ObjectID LEFT OUTER JOIN pims AS subafd ON map.PimsDirectieCode + '.' + map.PimsDienstCode + '.' + map.PimsAfdelingCode + '.' + map.PimsSubAfdelingCode = subafd.ObjectID ) SELECTX(IDS-D1IM_8) PDirFullPath, PDirTreeLevel, PDirOrgEenheidsNummer, PDirOrgEenheidsAfk, PDirDepartmentName, PimsFullPath, PimsTreeLevel, PimsAfdelingID, PimsDepartmentName, PimsDirectieCode, PimsDirectieName, PimsDienstCode, PimsDienstName, PimsAfdelingCode, PimsAfdelingName, PimsSubAfdelingCode, PimsSubAfdelingName, UID_Pims_Department, UID_Pims_ParentDepartment, UID_PDir_Department, UID_PDir_ParentDepartment FROM dirs WHERE PDirTreeLevel > 0 ORDER BY PDirFullPath;

with rpt as ( select pop.DepartmentName as 'PopDepartmentName', org.FullPath as PopFullPath, org.DepartmentName as 'OrgDepartmentName', d.lev as 'lev', d.FullPath as 'Also Applies to Org' from Department pop inner join CCC_Population_Org po on po.CCC_UID_Population = pop.UID_Department inner join Department org on po.CCC_UID_Organisation = org.UID_Department cross apply [dbo].[Department_and_Subdepartments](org.UID_Department) d left outer join PersonInDepartment pd on d.UID_Department = pd.UID_Department ) selectx PopDepartmentName as "Populatie", PopFullPath as "FullPath", OrgDepartmentName as "Organisatie", lev as "Level", OrgFullPath as "Also Applies to Org" from rpt order by 1, 2, 5;

with rpt as ( select pop.DepartmentName as 'PopDepartmentName', org.FullPath as PopFullPath, org.DepartmentName as 'OrgDepartmentName', d.lev as 'lev', d.FullPath as 'OrgFullPath' from Department pop inner join CCC_Population_Org po on po.CCC_UID_Population = pop.UID_Department inner join Department org on po.CCC_UID_Organisation = org.UID_Department cross apply [dbo].[Department_and_Subdepartments](org.UID_Department) d left outer join PersonInDepartment pd on d.UID_Department = pd.UID_Department ) selectx PopDepartmentName as "Populatie", PopFullPath as "FullPath", OrgDepartmentName as "Organisatie", lev as "Level", OrgFullPath as "Also Applies to Org" from rpt order by 1, 2, 5;

with rpt as ( select pop.DepartmentName as 'Populatie', org.FullPath as 'OrgFullPath', d.FullPath as 'AlsoFullPath', p.LastName + ', ' + p.FirstName as 'Person' from Department pop inner join CCC_Population_Org po on po.CCC_UID_Population = pop.UID_Department inner join Department org on po.CCC_UID_Organisation = org.UID_Department cross apply [dbo].[Department_and_Subdepartments](org.UID_Department) d left outer join PersonInDepartment pd on d.UID_Department = pd.UID_Department left outer join Person p on pd.UID_Person = p.UID_Person where d.lev >= 0 --and not (p.UID_Person is null) ) select Populatie, OrgFullPath as "Organisatie", AlsoFullPath as "Also Applies to Org", Person from rpt order by 1, 2, 3, 4;

with rpt as ( select pop.DepartmentName as 'Populatie', org.FullPath as 'OrgFullPath', d.FullPath as 'AlsoFullPath', p.LastName + ', ' + p.FirstName as 'Person' from Department pop inner join CCC_Population_Org po on po.CCC_UID_Population = pop.UID_Department inner join Department org on po.CCC_UID_Organisation = org.UID_Department cross apply [dbo].[Department_and_Subdepartments](org.UID_Department) d left outer join PersonInDepartment pd on d.UID_Department = pd.UID_Department left outer join Person p on pd.UID_Person = p.UID_Person where d.lev >= 0 --and not (p.UID_Person is null) ) select Populatie, OrgFullPath as "Organisatie", AlsoFullPath as "Also Applies to Org", Person from rpt order by 1, 2, 3, 4;

WITH chain AS ( SELECT 'ADS_ADSAccount_Move_TerminalHome' as process_name ), adam AS ( SELECT FORMAT(ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY j.UID_Job), '0000#') AS row_num, j.Name, j.Description, j.UID_Job, j.UID_ErrorJob, j.UID_SuccessJob FROM chain, Job j INNER JOIN JobChain jc ON j.UID_JobChain = jc.UID_JobChain Where jc.Name = chain.process_name and not exists (select * from job j2 where j2.UID_SuccessJob = j.UID_Job Or j2.UID_ErrorJob = j.UID_Job) ), child AS ( SELECT adam.row_num + '.' + FORMAT(ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY j3.UID_Job), '0000#') AS row_num, j3.Name, j3.Description, j3.UID_Job, j3.UID_ErrorJob, j3.UID_SuccessJob FROM adam, Job j3 where adam.UID_SuccessJob = j3.UID_Job OR adam.UID_ErrorJob = j3.UID_Job ), grandchild AS ( SELECT child.row_num + '.' + FORMAT(ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY j4.UID_Job), '0000#') AS row_num, j4.Name, j4.Description, j4.UID_Job, j4.UID_ErrorJob, j4.UID_SuccessJob FROM child, Job j4 where child.UID_SuccessJob = j4.UID_Job OR child.UID_ErrorJob = j4.UID_Job ), tree AS ( SELECT row_num, Name, Description, UID_Job, UID_ErrorJob, UID_SuccessJob FROM adam UNION SELECT row_num, Name, Description, UID_Job, UID_ErrorJob, UID_SuccessJob FROM child UNION SELECT row_num, Name, Description, UID_Job, UID_ErrorJob, UID_SuccessJob FROM grandchild ), rpt AS ( SELECT t0.row_num As proc_id, t0.Name as proc_name, case when not succ.UID_Job is null AND not err.UID_JOB is null then succ.row_num + ',' + err.row_num when not succ.UID_Job is null AND err.UID_JOB is null then succ.row_num when succ.UID_Job is null AND not err.UID_JOB is null then err.row_num else '' end AS next_id, case when not succ.UID_Job is null AND not err.UID_JOB is null then 'OK,ERROR' when not succ.UID_Job is null AND err.UID_JOB is null then 'OK' when succ.UID_Job is null AND not err.UID_JOB is null then 'ERROR' else '' end AS line_lable, case when t0.row_num = '00001' then 'Begin' when not succ.UID_Job is null AND not err.UID_JOB is null then 'Beslissing' else 'Proces' end AS type_shape, t0.Description As descr FROM tree t0 LEFT OUTER JOIN tree succ ON t0.UID_SuccessJob = succ.UID_Job LEFT OUTER JOIN tree err ON t0.UID_ErrorJob = err.UID_Job ) SELECT proc_id as "Processtap-id", proc_name as "Beschrijving van processtap", next_id AS "Id van volgende stap", line_lable As "Label van verbindingslijn", type_shape As "Shapetype", descr As "Alternatieve bescrijving" FROM rpt ORDER BY proc_id;

WITH Chains AS ( select distinct JobChainName from JobQueue ), Roots As ( select j.JobChainName, j.StartAt, j.UID_Job from Chains c inner join JobQueue j on c.JobChainName=j.JobChainName where j.IsRootJob = 1 ), Children As ( select 0 as lev, 0 as typ, r.JobChainName, r.StartAt As ProcessStartAt, j2.UID_Job, j2.UID_JobError, j2.UID_JobSuccess from Roots r inner join JobQueue j2 on r.UID_Job = j2.UID_Job union all select c.lev + 1 as lev, 1 as typ, c.JobChainName, c.ProcessStartAt, j3.UID_Job, j3.UID_JobError, j3.UID_JobSuccess from Children c inner join JobQueue j3 on c.UID_JobSuccess = j3.UID_Job union all select c.lev + 1 as lev, 2 as typ, c.JobChainName, c.ProcessStartAt, j4.UID_Job, j4.UID_JobError, j4.UID_JobSuccess from Children c inner join JobQueue j4 on c.UID_JobError = j4.UID_Job ), ParmUIDs AS ( SELECT DISTINCT UID_Tree FROM JobTreeParamColl ), ParmParms AS ( SELECT UID_Tree, CONCAT_WS('~', '', LEN(jp.ParameterName), jp.ParameterName, LEN(jp.ParameterValue), jp.ParameterValue, 0, '') As Parms FROM JobTreeParamColl jp ), ParmList As ( SELECT UID_Tree, (SELECT SUB.Parms AS [text()] FROM ParmParms SUB WHERE SUB.UID_Tree = CAT.UID_Tree FOR XML PATH('')) AS Parms FROM ParmUIDs CAT ), JobList as ( select c.JobChainName, c.ProcessStartAt, c.lev, 1000 * c.lev + c.typ as SortOrder, j.TaskName, j.Ready2EXE, j.Queue, j.StartAt, j.ErrorMessages, j.GenProcID, j.ParamIN, CONCAT(pl.Parms, '~') as BlueParms, j.UID_Job, j.UID_Tree from Children c inner join JobQueue j on c.UID_Job = j.UID_Job left outer join ParmList pl on j.UID_Tree = pl.UID_Tree ), RPT AS ( SELECT j.JobChainName, j.ProcessStartAt, j.lev, j.TaskName, j.Ready2EXE, j.Queue, j.StartAt, j.ErrorMessages, j.GenProcID, j.ParamIN, REPLACE(j.BlueParms,'',CHAR(13)) as BlueParms, j.SortOrder FROM JobList j INNER JOIN JobQueue jj on j.UID_Job = jj.UID_Job ) SELECT JobChainName as "Job", ProcessStartAt as "Job Start Time", lev as "<LEVEL>", TaskName as "Task", Ready2EXE as "Execution Status", Queue as "Executing server", StartAt as "Start time", ErrorMessages as "Errors", GenProcID, ParamIN as "Parameters", BlueParms from RPT order by JobChainName, PROCESSSTARTAT, SORTORDER;

j4.UID_Job ), ParmUIDs AS ( SELECT DISTINCT UID_Tree FROM JobTreeParamColl ), ParmParms AS ( SELECT UID_Tree, CONCAT_WS('~', '', LEN(jp.ParameterName), jp.ParameterName, LEN(jp.ParameterValue), with rpt as ( --- all master identities select p.InternalName + ' (' + p.CentralAccount + ')' as naam, p.CentralAccount, p.IsInActive, p.UID_Person, (select count(*) from Person c where c.UID_PersonMasterIdentity = p.UID_Person) As NumSub from Person p where p.UID_PersonMasterIdentity is null and p.InternalName is not null and p.CentralAccount is not null -- and p.CentralAccount = 'NP162833' ), rpt2 as ( --- master identities w/ # sub-identities, ID is to let us pull top xxx from each #sub group select naam, CentralAccount, IsInActive, NumSub, UID_Person, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY NumSub ORDER BY naam) As ID from rpt where 1=1 or NumSub <> 1 ), rpt3 as ( select rpt2.NumSub as 'NumSub', rpt2.naam as 'MasterNaam', rpt2.CentralAccount as 'MasterLogin', rpt2.IsInActive as 'MasterIsInActive', s.CCC_DienstverbandVolgNr as 'SubIdentNum', d.DepartmentName as 'DepartmentName', aa.Ident_AERole as 'Ident_AERole', STUFF(( select ' | ' + m.InternalName + ' (' + m.CentralAccount + ')' as [text()] from PersonInAERole ap inner join Person m on ap.UID_Person = m.UID_Person where aa.UID_AERole = ap.UID_AERole FOR XML PATH('') ), 1, 3, '') As 'Managers', STUFF(( select ' | ' + s.Ident_AccProduct as [text()] from CCC_DepartmentHasAccProd sd inner join AccProduct s on sd.CCC_UID_AccProduct = s.UID_AccProduct where sd.CCC_UID_Department = d.UID_Department FOR XML PATH('') ), 1, 3, '') As 'ServiceItems' from rpt2 left outer join Person s on s.UID_PersonMasterIdentity = rpt2.UID_Person left outer join Department d on s.UID_Department = d.UID_Department left outer join AERole aa on aa.UID_AERole = d.UID_RulerContainer where (1=1 or ID <= 50) AND (1=1 OR exists ( -- department has products select * from CCC_DepartmentHasAccProd sd2 inner join AccProduct s2 on sd2.CCC_UID_AccProduct = s2.UID_AccProduct where sd2.CCC_UID_Department = d.UID_Department and s2.Ident_AccProduct = 'Test Multi-Request' )) -- rpt2.CentralAccount = 'NP127107' ) SELECTX(<SQL:NPV8>) NumSub as "Number of Sub-Identities", MasterNaam as "Master Identity", MasterLogin as "Master Login", MasterIsInActive as "Master Inactive", SubIdentNum as "Sub-Ident Volgnr", DepartmentName as "Department", Ident_AERole as "AE Role", Managers, ServiceItems As "Service Items" from rpt3 order by NumSub, MASTERNAAM, SUBIDENTNUM, DEPARTMENTNAME;

with RPT as ( select --dt.XObjectKey as ElementObjectKey, obj.ObjName As ObjName, tab_rel_stats.ElementName As RelElemName, obj.ObjName + '-' + tab_rel_stats.ElementName As ElementName, tab_rel_stats.ElementValue As ElementValue from ( select distinct CCC_stg_Table from CCC_stg_Stats ) sss cross apply ( select null As ElementObjectKey, 'ChgThreshold-' + Upper(Left(CCC_Metric,1)) + Lower(Substring(CCC_Metric,2,999)) As ElementName, RelValue as ElementValue from ( select stats.CCC_Metric, CASE WHEN limits.Value <= 0 THEN 1.0 ELSE Cast(stats.CCC_Count as Numeric) / Cast(limits.Value as Numeric) END as RelValue from ( select CCC_Metric, CCC_Count from CCC_stg_Stats where CCC_stg_Table = sss.CCC_stg_Table and CCC_Date = (select max(CCC_Date) from CCC_stg_Stats where CCC_stg_Table = sss.CCC_stg_Table) union select 'DELTA' As CCC_Metric, Sum(CCC_Count) As CCC_Count from CCC_stg_Stats where CCC_stg_Table = sss.CCC_stg_Table and CCC_Date = (select max(CCC_Date) from CCC_stg_Stats where CCC_stg_Table = sss.CCC_stg_Table) and CCC_Metric in ('NEW','CHANGED') ) stats inner join ( select Case ConfigParm When 'TransactionLimit' Then 'DELTA' When 'ErrorLimit' Then 'ERROR' When 'DeleteLimit' Then 'DELETED' End Metric, Value from DialogConfigParm where FullPath Like (select REPLACE(FullPath, '\targetObject', '%') from DialogConfigParm where ConfigParm = 'targetObject' And Value = sss.CCC_stg_Table And Enabled = 1) and ConfigParm in ('TransactionLimit','ErrorLimit','DeleteLimit') and Enabled = 1 ) limits on stats.CCC_Metric = limits.Metric ) rel_stats ) tab_rel_stats cross apply ( select Upper(Left(Value,1)) + Lower(Substring(Value,2,999)) as ObjName from DialogConfigParm where FullPath Like (select REPLACE(FullPath, '\targetObject', '%') from DialogConfigParm where ConfigParm = 'targetObject' And Value = sss.CCC_stg_Table And Enabled = 1) and ConfigParm Like 'STAGING%' and Enabled = 1 ) obj inner join DialogTable dt on dt.TableName = sss.CCC_stg_Table --where dt.TableName = 'CCC_stg_Person' ) selectx(<SQL:MyServer/OneIM>) ElementName as "Element Name", ElementValue as "Element Value" from RPT order by RPT.ObjName, with RPT as ( select --dt.XObjectKey as ElementObjectKey, obj.ObjName As ObjName, stats.CCC_Metric As StatElemName, obj.ObjName + '-Stats-' + Upper(Left(stats.CCC_Metric,1)) + Lower(Substring(stats.CCC_Metric,2,999)) As ElementName, stats.CCC_Count As ElementValue from ( select distinct CCC_stg_Table from CCC_stg_Stats ) sss cross apply ( select CCC_Metric, CCC_Count from CCC_stg_Stats where CCC_stg_Table = sss.CCC_stg_Table and CCC_Date = (select max(CCC_Date) from CCC_stg_Stats where CCC_stg_Table = sss.CCC_stg_Table) ) stats cross apply ( select Upper(Left(Value,1)) + Lower(Substring(Value,2,999)) as ObjName from DialogConfigParm where FullPath Like (select REPLACE(FullPath, '\targetObject', '%') from DialogConfigParm where ConfigParm = 'targetObject' And Value = sss.CCC_stg_Table And Enabled = 1) and ConfigParm Like 'STAGING%' and Enabled = 1 ) obj inner join DialogTable dt on dt.TableName = sss.CCC_stg_Table --where dt.TableName = 'CCC_stg_Person' ) selectx(<SQL:MyServer/OneIM>) ElementName as "Element Name", ElementValue as "Element Value" from RPT order by RPT.ObjName, RPT.STATELEMNAME;

with RPT as ( select obj.ObjName + '-' + tab_rel_stats.ElementName As ElementName, tab_rel_stats.CurrValue As CurrentValue, tab_rel_stats.MaxValue As MaxValue, tab_rel_stats.RelValue As RelativeValue from ( select distinct CCC_stg_Table from CCC_stg_Stats ) sss cross apply ( select null As ElementObjectKey, Upper(Left(CCC_Metric,1)) + Lower(Substring(CCC_Metric,2,999)) As ElementName, CurrValue, MaxValue, RelValue from ( select stats.CCC_Metric, limits.Value As MaxValue, Cast(stats.CCC_Count as Float) As CurrValue, CASE WHEN limits.Value <= 0 THEN 1.0 ELSE Cast(stats.CCC_Count as Float) / Cast(limits.Value as Float) END as RelValue from ( select CCC_Metric, CCC_Count from CCC_stg_Stats where CCC_stg_Table = sss.CCC_stg_Table and CCC_Date = (select max(CCC_Date) from CCC_stg_Stats where CCC_stg_Table = sss.CCC_stg_Table) union select 'DELTA' As CCC_Metric, Sum(CCC_Count) As CCC_Count from CCC_stg_Stats where CCC_stg_Table = sss.CCC_stg_Table and CCC_Date = (select max(CCC_Date) from CCC_stg_Stats where CCC_stg_Table = sss.CCC_stg_Table) and CCC_Metric in ('NEW','CHANGED') ) stats inner join ( select Case ConfigParm When 'TransactionLimit' Then 'DELTA' When 'ErrorLimit' Then 'ERROR' When 'DeleteLimit' Then 'DELETED' End Metric, Cast(IsNull(Value, -1) As Float) As Value from DialogConfigParm where FullPath Like (select REPLACE(FullPath, '\targetObject', '%') from DialogConfigParm where ConfigParm = 'targetObject' And Value = sss.CCC_stg_Table And Enabled = 1) and ConfigParm in ('TransactionLimit','ErrorLimit','DeleteLimit') and Enabled = 1 ) limits on stats.CCC_Metric = limits.Metric ) rel_stats ) tab_rel_stats cross apply ( select Upper(Left(Value,1)) + Lower(Substring(Value,2,999)) as ObjName from DialogConfigParm where FullPath Like (select REPLACE(FullPath, '\targetObject', '%') from DialogConfigParm where ConfigParm = 'targetObject' And Value = sss.CCC_stg_Table And Enabled = 1) and ConfigParm Like 'STAGING%' and Enabled = 1 ) obj inner join DialogTable dt on dt.TableName = sss.CCC_stg_Table ) selectx(<SQL:MyServer/OneIM>) ElementName as "Element Name", CurrentValue as "Current Value", MaxValue as "100% Value", RelativeValue as "Relative Value (0-1)" from RPT order by RPT.ObjName, RPT.RELELEMNAME;

with RPT as ( select obj.ObjName As ObjectName, obj.ObjName + '-' + tab_rel_stats.ElementName As ElementName, tab_rel_stats.CurrValue As CurrentValue, tab_rel_stats.MaxValue As MaxValue, tab_rel_stats.RelValue As RelativeValue from ( select distinct CCC_stg_Table from CCC_stg_Stats ) sss cross apply ( select null As ElementObjectKey, Upper(Left(CCC_Metric,1)) + Lower(Substring(CCC_Metric,2,999)) As ElementName, CurrValue, MaxValue, RelValue from ( select stats.CCC_Metric, limits.Value As MaxValue, Cast(stats.CCC_Count as Float) As CurrValue, CASE WHEN limits.Value <= 0 THEN 1.0 ELSE Cast(stats.CCC_Count as Float) / Cast(limits.Value as Float) END as RelValue from ( select CCC_Metric, CCC_Count from CCC_stg_Stats where CCC_stg_Table = sss.CCC_stg_Table and CCC_Date = (select max(CCC_Date) from CCC_stg_Stats where CCC_stg_Table = sss.CCC_stg_Table) union select 'DELTA' As CCC_Metric, Sum(CCC_Count) As CCC_Count from CCC_stg_Stats where CCC_stg_Table = sss.CCC_stg_Table and CCC_Date = (select max(CCC_Date) from CCC_stg_Stats where CCC_stg_Table = sss.CCC_stg_Table) and CCC_Metric in ('NEW','CHANGED') ) stats inner join ( select Case ConfigParm When 'TransactionLimit' Then 'DELTA' When 'ErrorLimit' Then 'ERROR' When 'DeleteLimit' Then 'DELETED' End Metric, Cast(IsNull(Value, -1) As Float) As Value from DialogConfigParm where FullPath Like (select REPLACE(FullPath, '\targetObject', '%') from DialogConfigParm where ConfigParm = 'targetObject' And Value = sss.CCC_stg_Table And Enabled = 1) and ConfigParm in ('TransactionLimit','ErrorLimit','DeleteLimit') and Enabled = 1 ) limits on stats.CCC_Metric = limits.Metric ) rel_stats ) tab_rel_stats cross apply ( select Upper(Left(Value,1)) + Lower(Substring(Value,2,999)) as ObjName from DialogConfigParm where FullPath Like (select REPLACE(FullPath, '\targetObject', '%') from DialogConfigParm where ConfigParm = 'targetObject' And Value = sss.CCC_stg_Table And Enabled = 1) and ConfigParm Like 'STAGING%' and Enabled = 1 ) obj inner join DialogTable dt on dt.TableName = sss.CCC_stg_Table ) selectx(<SQL:MyServer/OneIM>) ElementName as "Element Name", CurrentValue as "Current Value", MaxValue as "100% Value", RelativeValue as "Relative Value (0-1)" from RPT order by RPT.ObjectName, RPT.ELEMENTNAME;

Query.Description: All tables w/ process related words in the name of the table joined w/ ER queries that access each table
Query.SQL: WITH tabs AS ( SELECT SCh.NAME as SchemaName, T.NAME as TableName FROM SYS.TABLES T JOIN SYS.SCHEMAS SCh ON SCh.SCHEMA_ID = T.SCHEMA_ID JOIN (SELECT '%Job%' AS TblName UNION SELECT '%Queue%' AS TblName UNION SELECT '%Task%' AS TblName UNION SELECT '%Process%' As TblName UNION SELECT '%Event%' As TblName) tblsrc ON T.name LIKE tblsrc.tblname JOIN (SELECT '%' AS SchemaName) schemasrc ON SCh.name LIKE schemasrc.SchemaName ), tablist AS ( SELECT distinct tabs.TableName, dt.DisplayName FROM tabs LEFT OUTER JOIN DialogTable dt ON tabs.TableName = dt.TableName WHERE not tabs.TableName like 'CCC%' ) SELECTX TableName AS "Table", DisplayName AS "Description", <EXCEL "Table Query[SQL to fetch data from table]" "=VLOOKUP(\"dbo.\" & C#,QUERIES!$G$4:$M$61,3,FALSE)"> FROM tablist;

WITH RPT AS ( select [Table Name] as t1, [Table Description] as d1, [Related Table Name] as t2, [Related Table Description] as d2, [Relation Type] as rtyp from ( select t1.TableName as 'Table Name', t1.DisplayName as 'Table Description', child_t2.TableName as 'Related Table Name', child_t2.DisplayName as 'Related Table Description', 'CHILD' as 'Relation Type' from DialogTable t1 inner join DialogColumn c1 on t1.UID_DialogTable = c1.UID_DialogTable inner join QBMRelation r1 on r1.UID_ParentColumn = c1.UID_DialogColumn inner join DialogColumn child_c2 on r1.UID_ChildColumn = child_c2.UID_DialogColumn inner join DialogTable child_t2 on child_c2.UID_DialogTable = child_t2.UID_DialogTable UNION select t3.TableName as 'Table Name', t3.DisplayName as 'Table Description', par_t4.TableName as 'Related Table Name', par_t4.DisplayName as 'Related Table Description', 'PARENT' as 'Relation Type' from DialogTable t3 inner join DialogColumn c3 on t3.UID_DialogTable = c3.UID_DialogTable inner join QBMRelation r2 on r2.UID_ChildColumn = c3.UID_DialogColumn inner join DialogColumn par_c4 on r2.UID_ParentColumn = par_c4.UID_DialogColumn inner join DialogTable par_t4 on par_c4.UID_DialogTable = par_t4.UID_DialogTable UNION select t3.TableName as 'Table Name', t3.DisplayName as 'Table Description', null as 'Related Table Name', null as 'Related Table Description', 'ORPHAN' as 'Relation Type' from DialogTable t3 where not exists (select * from QBMRelation r3 inner join DialogColumn c5 on r3.UID_ChildColumn = c5.UID_DialogColumn or r3.UID_ChildColumn = c5.UID_DialogColumn inner join DialogTree t5 on c5.UID_DialogTable = t5.UID_DialogTree where t5.UID_DialogTable = t3.UID_DialogTable) ) rel ) SELECT t1 as "Table Name", d1 as "Table Description", t2 as "Related Table Name", d2 as "Related Table Description", rtyp as "Relation Type" FROM RPT ORDER BY 1, 5, 3;

c8 on r7.UID_ChildColumn = c8.UID_DialogColumn or r7.UID_ParentColumn = c8.UID_DialogColumn inner join DialogTree t8 on c8.UID_DialogTable = t8.UID_DialogTree where t8.UID_DialogTable = WITH RPT AS ( SELECT h.XDateInserted, h.JobChainName, stuff( (SELECT ' | ' + j.Name FROM JobChain jc inner join Job j on j.UID_JobChain = jc.UID_JobChain inner join JobTask t on j.UID_JobTask = t.UID_JobTask WHERE h.JobChainName = jc.Name And h.TaskName = t.TaskName ORDER BY j.Name FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE).value('.','varchar(max)'),1,3,'') AS 'JobName', h.TaskName, h.Queue, h.ParamIN, h.BasisObjectKey, h.ErrorMessages FROM [dbo].[JobHistory] h WHERE h.WasError = 1 UNION SELECT h.XDateInserted, h.JobChainName, stuff( (SELECT ' | ' + j.Name FROM JobChain jc inner join Job j on j.UID_JobChain = jc.UID_JobChain inner join JobTask t on j.UID_JobTask = t.UID_JobTask WHERE h.JobChainName = jc.Name And h.TaskName = t.TaskName ORDER BY j.Name FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE).value('.','varchar(max)'),1,3,'') AS 'JobName', h.TaskName, h.Queue, h.ParamIN, h.BasisObjectKey, h.ErrorMessages FROM [dbo].[JobQueue] h WHERE h.WasError = 1 ) SELECT XDateInserted As "Start Date", JobChainName As "Process Name", JobName As "Possible Process Tile Names (guesses)", TaskName As "Execution Task", Queue As "Job Queue", ParamIN As "Input Parameters", BasisObjectKey As "Object Key (for reference)", ErrorMessages As "Error Messages" FROM RPT ORDER BY XDateInserted DESC;

SELECTX(<SQL:IDS-DB01/D1IM_8>,svcIDS_sql,,V7) TaskName FROM dbo.JobTask ORDER BY TaskName JOIN_ON UID_JobTask SELECTX(<SQL:IDS-DB01/D1IM_8>,svcIDS_sql,,V7) DISTINCT <DBLOOKUP "dbo.JobChain" "Name" "" "" "UID_JobChain"> FROM dbo.Job ORDER BY UID_JobTask;

WITH RPT AS ( select p.InternalName, count(*) as cnt from Person p inner join UNSAccountB a on a.UID_Person = p.UID_Person where a.UID_UNSContainerB = (select UID_UNSContainerB from UNSContainerB where CanonicalName = 'JDE/USERS') group by p.InternalName having count(*) > 1 ) SELECTX(<SQL:IMCD>) InternalName As "Person", cnt as "Number of JDE User Accounts" FROM RPT ORDER BY cnt desc, INTERNALNAME;

WITH RPT AS ( select p.InternalName, CentralAccount, count(*) as cnt from Person p inner join UNSAccountB a on a.UID_Person = p.UID_Person where a.UID_UNSContainerB = (select UID_UNSContainerB from UNSContainerB where CanonicalName = 'JDE/USERS') group by p.InternalName having count(*) > 1 ) SELECTX(<SQL:IMCD>) InternalName As "Person", CentralAccount, cnt as "Number of JDE User Accounts" FROM RPT ORDER BY cnt desc, INTERNALNAME;

WITH RPT AS ( select p.InternalName, p.CentralAccount, count(*) as cnt from Person p inner join UNSAccountB a on a.UID_Person = p.UID_Person where a.UID_UNSContainerB = (select UID_UNSContainerB from UNSContainerB where CanonicalName = 'JDE/USERS') group by p.InternalName, p.CentralAccount having count(*) > 1 ) SELECTX(<SQL:IMCD>) InternalName As "Person", CentralAccount, cnt as "Number of JDE User Accounts" FROM RPT ORDER BY cnt desc, INTERNALNAME;

SELECTX(<SQL:IMCD>) <DEFAULT> AS "Employees Name", IsExternal, CentralAccount, CustomProperty08 AS "JDE AddressNumber (on the Person)", <DBLOOKUP "dbo.Department" "<DEFAULT>[Departments Name], ObjectID[Department Number]" "" "" "UID_Department">, <DBLOOKUP "dbo.Locality" "Ident_locality, <DBLOOKUP \"dbo.[DialogCountry]\" \"CountryName, Iso3166_2\" \"\" \"\" \"UID_DialogCountry\">" "" "" "UID_Locality">, <DBLOOKUP(<SQL:IMCD>) "dbo.UNSAccountB" "cn[JDE Address-Book Record]" "CanonicalName LIKE \"JDE/ADDR/*\"" "" "UID_Person">, <DBLOOKUP(<SQL:IMCD>) "dbo.UNSAccountB" "cn[JDE UserID]" "CanonicalName LIKE \"JDE/USERS/*\"" "" "UID_Person">, <EXCEL "Has JDE Objects" "=IF(AND(ISBLANK(L#);ISBLANK(M#));\"NO\";\"YES\")"> FROM dbo.Person WHERE InternalName LIKE '%TEST%' ORDER BY InternalName;

DISTINCT GenProcID FROM [dbo].[JobQueue] WHERE Ready2EXE = 'FROZEN' ORDER BY GenProcID JOIN_ON GenProcID SELECTX(<SQL:IMCD>) DISTINCT JobChainName FROM [dbo].[JobQueue] WHERE Ready2EXE = 'FROZEN' ORDER BY JobChainName JOIN_ON JobChainName;1.GenProcID=GenProcID SELECTX(<SQL:IMCD>) XDateInserted, TaskName, ParamIN, <DBLOOKUP "<OBJECT_TABLE>" "'<OBJECT_TABLE_NAME>'[Table Name], <DEFAULT>[Object Name]" "" "" "BasisObjectKey=XObjectKey">, BasisObjectKey, ErrorMessages, ComponentClass, JobChainName FROM [dbo].[JobQueue] WHERE Ready2EXE = 'FROZEN' ORDER BY XDateInserted DESC;

SELECTX(<SQL:IMCD>) DISTINCT GenProcID, OperationDate FROM dbo.DialogWatchOperation WHERE GenProcID IS NOT NULL AND OperationDate > {d '2022-03-10'} AND OperationDate < {d '2022-03-20'} ORDER BY OperationDate DESC JOIN_ON GenProcID SELECTX(<SQL:IMCD>) DisplayValue, OperationType, OperationLevel, ObjectKeyOfRow FROM dbo.DialogWatchOperation ORDER BY OperationDate DESC;

Query.Description: Per Shelf, for each aproval step, the E-Mail Templates
Query.SQL: SELECTX(<SQL:AWIAMSQL01.IMCD.NL/OneIM>,OneIM,,V7) <DEFAULT> AS "Shelf" FROM dbo.ITShopOrg WHERE ITShopInfo = 'BO | Shelf' ORDER BY FullPath JOIN_ON UID_ITShopOrg SELECTX(<SQL:AWIAMSQL01.IMCD.NL/OneIM>,OneIM,,V7) <NONE> FROM dbo.ITShopOrgHasPWODecisionMethod JOIN_ON UID_PWODecisionMethod SELECTX(<SQL:AWIAMSQL01.IMCD.NL/OneIM>,OneIM,,V7) <DEFAULT> AS "Approval Policy", UID_DialogRichMailAbort, UID_DialogRichMailExpiration, UID_DialogRichMailGrant, UID_DialogRichMailNoGrant, UID_DialogRichMailProlongate, UID_DialogRichMailUnsubscribe FROM dbo.PWODecisionMethod JOIN_ON UID_SubMethodOrderProduct=UID_PWODecisionSubMethod SELECTX(<SQL:AWIAMSQL01.IMCD.NL/OneIM>,OneIM,,V7) <DEFAULT> AS "Approval Workflow" FROM dbo.PWODecisionSubMethod JOIN_ON UID_PWODecisionSubMethod SELECTX(<SQL:AWIAMSQL01.IMCD.NL/OneIM>,OneIM,,V7) <DEFAULT> AS "Approval Step", <DBLOOKUP "dbo.[DialogRichMail]" "<DEFAULT>[Mail template escalation]" "" "" "UID_DialogRichMailEscalate=UID_DialogRichMail">, <DBLOOKUP "dbo.[DialogRichMail]" "<DEFAULT>[Mail template rejection]" "" "" "UID_DialogRichMailFromDelegat=UID_DialogRichMail">, <DBLOOKUP "dbo.[DialogRichMail]" "<DEFAULT>[Mail template approved]" "" "" "UID_DialogRichMailGrant=UID_DialogRichMail">, <DBLOOKUP "dbo.[DialogRichMail]" "<DEFAULT>[Mail template request]" "" "" "UID_DialogRichMailInsert=UID_DialogRichMail">, <DBLOOKUP "dbo.[DialogRichMail]" "<DEFAULT>[Mail template denied]" "" "" "UID_DialogRichMailNoGrant=UID_DialogRichMail">, <DBLOOKUP "dbo.[DialogRichMail]" "<DEFAULT>[Mail template reminder]" "" "" "UID_DialogRichMailReminder=UID_DialogRichMail">, <DBLOOKUP "dbo.[DialogRichMail]" "<DEFAULT>[Mail template delegation]" "" "" "UID_DialogRichMailToDelegat=UID_DialogRichMail"> FROM dbo.PWODecisionStep ORDER BY LevelNumber, SubLevelNumber;

with RPT as ( select aa.CanonicalName, aa.DisplayName, aa.CCC_JDE_AddressNumber, addr.DisplayName from UNSAccountB aa left outer join UNSAccountB addr on addr.ObjectGUID = aa.CCC_JDE_AddressNumber where aa.UID_UNSAccountB in ( select a.UID_UNSAccountB from Person p inner join UNSAccountB a on a.UID_Person = p.UID_Person where p.CustomProperty08 is null and a.CanonicalName like 'JDE/%') ) selectx(<SQL:IMCD>) DisplayName as "JDE User", CCC_JDE_AddressNumber as "Address-Number on User" from RPT;

with RPT as ( select aa.CanonicalName, aa.DisplayName as 'JDEUser', aa.CCC_JDE_AddressNumber, addr.DisplayName as 'AddressBook' from UNSAccountB aa left outer join UNSAccountB addr on addr.ObjectGUID = aa.CCC_JDE_AddressNumber where aa.UID_UNSAccountB in ( select a.UID_UNSAccountB from Person p inner join UNSAccountB a on a.UID_Person = p.UID_Person where p.CustomProperty08 is null and a.CanonicalName like 'JDE/%') ) selectx(<SQL:IMCD>) JDEUser as "JDE User", CCC_JDE_AddressNumber as "Address-Number on User" from RPT;

Query.Description: Persons with no JDE Address-Number match JDE Address-Entry on E-Mail Address
Query.SQL: with RPT as ( select p.CentralAccount, p.InternalName, a.CCC_NameEmployee, a.CCC_JDE_AddressNumber, p.DefaultEmailAddress, p.UID_Person, a.UID_UNSAccountB from Person p left outer join UNSAccountB a on p.DefaultEmailAddress = a.CCC_EMail where p.CustomProperty08 is null and a.CanonicalName like 'JDE/ADDR%' ) select CentralAccount as "Employee Login-Name on Person", InternalName as "Employee-Name on Person", CCC_NameEmployee as "Employee-Name on Address-Book Entry", CCC_JDE_AddressNumber as "Address-Number on Address-Book Entry", DefaultEmailAddress as "EMail Address Matched", UID_Person as "UID_Person", UID_UNSAccountB as "UID_UNSAccountB" from RPT order by InternalName;

with RPT as ( select wo.OperationDate as 'Change_Date', p.XDateInserted as 'Person_Created', p.InternalName, p.CentralAccount, a.cn as 'JDE_User', case when a.cn = p.CentralAccount then 'SAME' else case when a.cn is null then 'NO-JDE-LINKED' else 'DIFFERENT' end end as JdeMatches, -- 'JDE-User matches CentyrAcct', d.DepartmentName, p.CustomProperty08 as 'PersAddrBook' from DialogWatchProperty wp inner join DialogWatchOperation wo on wp.UID_DialogWatchOperation = wo.UID_DialogWatchOperation inner join Person p on wo.ObjectKeyOfRow = p.XObjectKey inner join PersonHasTSBAccountDef td on p.UID_Person = td.UID_Person and td.UID_TSBAccountDef in (select UID_TSBAccountDef from TSBAccountDef where Ident_TSBAccountDef = 'JDE Address Book Entry') inner join Department d on p.UID_Department = d.UID_Department left outer join UNSAccountB a on a.UID_Person = p.UID_Person and a.CanonicalName like 'JDE/USERS/%' where UID_DialogColumn in ( select UID_DialogColumn from DialogColumn where ColumnName = 'CentralAccount') --AND wo.OperationDate > '2022-10-26' ) select Change_Date as "Central Account Changed on Date", Person_Created as "Person Created on Date", InternalName as "Employee", CentralAccount, JDE_User as "JDE-User Assigned", JdeMatches as "JDE-User matched CentralAccount (currently)", DepartmentName as "Company", PersAddrBook as "JDE AddrNum on Person" from rpt order by Change_Date desc;

with RPT as ( select wo.OperationDate as 'Change_Date', p.XDateInserted as 'Person_Created', p.InternalName, p.CentralAccount, a.cn as 'JDE_User', case when a.cn = p.CentralAccount then 'SAME' else case when a.cn is null then 'NO-JDE-LINKED' else 'DIFFERENT' end end as JdeMatches, -- 'JDE-User matches CentyrAcct', case when a.XMarkedForDeletion & 1 = 1 then 'DISABLED BY MOVE' else case when a.XMarkedForDeletion & 1 = 0 AND a.XMarkedForDeletion > 0 then 'OUTSTANDING' else case when a.AccountDisabled = 1 then 'INACTIVE' else 'ACTIVE' end end end as JdeStatus, -- 'JDE-User matches CentyrAcct', d.DepartmentName, p.CustomProperty08 as 'PersAddrBook' from DialogWatchProperty wp inner join DialogWatchOperation wo on wp.UID_DialogWatchOperation = wo.UID_DialogWatchOperation inner join Person p on wo.ObjectKeyOfRow = p.XObjectKey inner join PersonHasTSBAccountDef td on p.UID_Person = td.UID_Person and td.UID_TSBAccountDef in (select UID_TSBAccountDef from TSBAccountDef where Ident_TSBAccountDef = 'JDE Address Book Entry') inner join Department d on p.UID_Department = d.UID_Department left outer join UNSAccountB a on a.UID_Person = p.UID_Person and a.CanonicalName like 'JDE/USERS/%' where UID_DialogColumn in ( select UID_DialogColumn from DialogColumn where ColumnName = 'CentralAccount') --AND wo.OperationDate > '2022-10-26' ) select Change_Date as "Central Account Changed on Date", Person_Created as "Person Created on Date", InternalName as "Employee", CentralAccount, JDE_User as "JDE-User Assigned", JdeMatches as "JDE-User matched CentralAccount (currently)", JdeStatus as "JDE-User Status", DepartmentName as "Company", PersAddrBook as "JDE AddrNum on Person" from rpt order by Change_Date desc;

WITH RPT AS ( SELECT pp.InternalName as pp_InternalName, pp.CentralAccount as pp_CentralAccount, case when pp.IsInActive = 1 or pp.XMarkedForDeletion > 0 then 'Inactive' else 'Active' end as emp_active, a.DisplayName as a_DisplayName, case when a.XMarkedForDeletion > 0 then 'Deleted' else case when a.AccountDisabled = 1 then 'Disabled' else 'Enabled' end end as a_enabled, case when a.UID_TSBAccountDef is null then 'Unmanaged' else case when adef.XObjectKey is null then 'NoAcctDef' else 'Managed' end end as a_managed, g.DisplayName as g_DisplayName, g.CanonicalName as g_CanonicalName, case when ug.XMarkedForDeletion > 0 then 'Outstanding' else 'Active' end as ug_active, es.Ident_ESet as es_Ident_ESet, es.DisplayName as es_DisplayName, es.Ident_AccProduct as es_Ident_AccProduct, case when es.XObjectKey is null then 'Missing Assignment' else 'Assignment Exists' end as es_exists, case when req.XObjectKey is null then 'Missing Request' else req.OrderReason end as autopwo, pp.UID_Person As pp_UID_Person, es.UID_ESet As es_UID_ESet FROM dbo.UNSGroupB g inner join UNSAccountBInUNSGroupB ug on g.UID_UNSGroupB = ug.UID_UNSGroupB AND g.CanonicalName like with rpt as ( select p.InternalName, p.CentralAccount, p.ApprovalState, p.XDateInserted as 'PersonInserted', a.XDateInserted as 'AccountInserted', guid.OperationDate as 'AccountCreated' from Person p left outer join ADSAccount a on a.UID_Person = p.UID_Person left outer join ( select o.ObjectKeyOfRow, o.OperationDate from DialogWatchOperation o inner join DialogWatchProperty p on p.UID_DialogWatchOperation = o.UID_DialogWatchOperation inner join DialogColumn c on p.UID_DialogColumn = c.UID_DialogColumn And c.ColumnName = 'ObjectGUID' ) guid on guid.ObjectKeyOfRow = a.XObjectKey where p.XDateInserted > '1-11-2022' ) select InternalName as "Employee", CentralAccount as "CentralAccount", PersonInserted as "Person Inserted On", AccountInserted as "Account Inserted On", AccountCreated as "Account Created in AD" from rpt order by PersonInserted desc;

WITH RPT AS ( SELECT pp.InternalName as pp_InternalName, pp.CentralAccount as pp_CentralAccount, case when pp.IsInActive = 1 or pp.XMarkedForDeletion > 0 then 'Inactive' else 'Active' end as emp_active FROM Person pp ) SELECT pp_CentralAccount as "Employee: CentralAccount", pp_InternalName as "Employee: Name", emp_active as "Employee: Active/Inactive" FROM RPT ORDER BY pp_CentralAccount;

WITH RPT AS ( SELECT pp.InternalName as pp_InternalName, pp.CentralAccount as pp_CentralAccount, case when pp.IsInActive = 1 or pp.XMarkedForDeletion > 0 then 'Inactive' else 'Active' end as emp_active, a.ObjectGUID as a_AccountName, a.DisplayName as a_DisplayName, --a.CCC_JDE_AddressNumber as a_AddressNum, case when a.XMarkedForDeletion > 0 then 'Deleted' else 'Active' end a_enabled, case when a.UID_TSBAccountDef is null then 'Unmanaged' else case when adef.XObjectKey is null then 'NoAcctDef' else 'Managed' end end as a_managed, (select count(*) from UNSAccountB aa where aa.CanonicalName like 'JDE/ADDR%' and aa.UID_Person = pp.UID_Person) As pp_Num_JDE_User, a.UID_UNSAccountB As a_UID_UNSAccountB, pp.UID_Person As pp_UID_Person FROM UNSAccountB a inner join Person pp on a.UID_Person = pp.UID_Person inner join Department d on pp.UID_Department = d.UID_Department left outer join ( select paf.XObjectKey, paf.UID_Person, paf.XIsInEffect, paf.XOrigin, paf.XMarkedForDeletion from TSBAccountDef af inner join PersonHasTSBAccountDef paf on af.UID_TSBAccountDef = paf.UID_TSBAccountDef where af.Ident_TSBAccountDef = 'JDE Address Book Entry' ) adef on adef.UID_Person = pp.UID_Person where 1=1 AND a.CanonicalName like 'JDE/ADDR%' ) SELECT pp_InternalName as "Employee: Name", pp_CentralAccount as "Employee: CentralAccount", emp_active as "Employee: Active/Inactive", pp_Num_JDE_User as "Employee: Num Addr Assigned", a_AccountName as "JDE-Addr: AddresBookNum", a_DisplayName as "JDE-Addr: DisplayName", a_managed as "JDE-Addr: Managed", pp_UID_Person As UID_Person, a_UID_UNSAccountB As UID_UNSAccountB FROM RPT ORDER BY pp_InternalName, A_ACCOUNTNAME;

WITH RPT AS ( SELECT pp.InternalName as pp_InternalName, pp.CentralAccount as pp_CentralAccount, case when pp.IsInActive = 1 or pp.XMarkedForDeletion > 0 then 'Inactive' else 'Active' end as emp_active, a.ObjectGUID as a_AccountName, a.DisplayName as a_DisplayName, a.CCC_JDE_AddressNumber as a_AddressNum, case when a.XMarkedForDeletion > 0 then case when a.AccountDisabled = 1 then 'Disabled+Deleted' else 'Enabled+Deleted' end else case when a.AccountDisabled = 1 then 'Disabled' else 'Enabled' end end as a_enabled, case when a.UID_TSBAccountDef is null then 'Unmanaged' else case when adef.XObjectKey is null then 'NoAcctDef' else 'Managed' end end as a_managed, (select count(*) from UNSAccountB aa where aa.CanonicalName like 'JDE/USERS%' and aa.UID_Person = pp.UID_Person) As pp_Num_JDE_User, a.UID_UNSAccountB As a_UID_UNSAccountB, pp.UID_Person As pp_UID_Person FROM UNSAccountB a inner join Person pp on a.UID_Person = pp.UID_Person inner join Department d on pp.UID_Department = d.UID_Department left outer join ( select paf.XObjectKey, paf.UID_Person, paf.XIsInEffect, paf.XOrigin, paf.XMarkedForDeletion from TSBAccountDef af inner join PersonHasTSBAccountDef paf on af.UID_TSBAccountDef = paf.UID_TSBAccountDef where af.Ident_TSBAccountDef = 'JDE Account Def' ) adef on adef.UID_Person = pp.UID_Person where 1=1 AND a.CanonicalName like 'JDE/USERS%' ) SELECT pp_InternalName as "Employee: Name", pp_CentralAccount as "Employee: CentralAccount", emp_active as "Employee: Active/Inactive", pp_Num_JDE_User as "Employee: Num JDE-User Accounts Assigned", a_AccountName as "JDE-User: AccountName", a_DisplayName as "JDE-User: DisplayName", a_AddressNum as "JDE-User: AddressBookNum", a_AccountName + '/' + a_enabled + '/' + a_managed as "Account/Enabled/Managed", pp_UID_Person As UID_Person, a_UID_UNSAccountB As UID_UNSAccountB FROM RPT ORDER BY pp_InternalName, A_DISPLAYNAME;

join ESet e on er.UID_ESet = e.UID_ESet ), env_esets AS ( -- ENV ESets select distinct e.* from envs r inner join ESetHasEntitlement er on er.Entitlement = r.XObjectKey inner join ESet e on er.UID_ESet = e.UID_ESet ), jde_adef AS ( -- JDE User Account-Def select * from TSBAccountDef where Ident_TSBAccountDef = 'JDE Account Def' ), env_requests AS ( -- All IT-Shop requests for JDE-Env's select pwo.* from env_esets e inner join AccProduct p on e.UID_AccProduct = p.UID_AccProduct inner join ITShopOrg o on o.UID_AccProduct = p.UID_AccProduct inner join PersonWantsOrg pwo on pwo.UID_Org = o.UID_ITShopOrg --And pwo.UID_PersonOrdered = pp.UID_Person ), role_requests AS ( select pwo.* from role_esets e inner join AccProduct p on e.UID_AccProduct = p.UID_AccProduct inner join ITShopOrg o on o.UID_AccProduct = p.UID_AccProduct inner join PersonWantsOrg pwo on pwo.UID_Org = o.UID_ITShopOrg --And pwo.UID_PersonOrdered = pp.UID_Person ), pers AS ( -- Employees in LIVE companies which have JDE-Users assigned select * from Person p WHERE p.UID_Department in (select UID_Department FROM Department WHERE (FullPath like N'IMCD\%') AND (ObjectID in (N'112', N'211', N'221', N'311', N'511', N'551', N'554', N'555', N'557', N'561', N'581', N'582', N'583', N'584', N'585', N'586', N'651', N'662', N'683', N'684', N'687', N'911', N'111', N'121', N'131', N'141', N'151', N'161', N'331', N'351', N'411', N'421', N'431', N'631', N'635', N'637', N'641', N'671', N'672', N'673', N'811',N'761', N'772', N'791', N'795', N'731', N'741', N'742', N'751', N'752', N'726', N'321', N'322', N'361', N'364', N'370', N'367', N'368', N'369', N'611', N'621', N'721', N'753'))) AND exists (select top 1 1 from UNSAccountB a where p.UID_Person = a.UID_Person AND a.CanonicalName like 'JDE/USER%' AND a.XMarkedForDeletion = 0) ), jde_users AS ( select * from UNSAccountB a where a.UID_Person in ( select UID_Person from pers ) AND a.CanonicalName like 'JDE/USER%' AND a.XMarkedForDeletion = 0 ), role_assignments AS ( select a.UID_Person, g.* from jde_users a inner join UNSAccountBInUNSGroupB ug on ug.UID_UNSAccountB = a.UID_UNSAccountB inner join UNSGroupB g on g.UID_UNSGroupB = ug.UID_UNSGroupB where ug.XMarkedForDeletion = 0 ), env_assignments AS ( select a.UID_Person, g.* from jde_users a inner join UNSAccountBInUNSGroupB1 ug on ug.UID_UNSAccountB = a.UID_UNSAccountB inner join UNSGroupB1 g on g.UID_UNSGroupB1 = ug.UID_UNSGroupB1 where ug.XMarkedForDeletion = 0 ), role_eset_assignments AS ( select phe.UID_Person, e.* from PersonHasESet phe inner join ESet e on phe.UID_ESet = e.UID_ESet where phe.UID_ESet in (select UID_ESet from role_esets) ), env_eset_assignments AS ( select phe.UID_Person, e.* from PersonHasESet phe inner join ESet e on phe.UID_ESet = e.UID_ESet where phe.UID_ESet in (select UID_ESet from env_esets) ), RPT AS ( select pp.InternalName as emp, pp.CentralAccount as emp_cent, case when pp.IsInActive = 1 or pp.XMarkedForDeletion > 0 then 'Disabled' else 'Active' end as emp_act, dd.DepartmentName as emp_comp, aa.cn as jde_user, case when aa.AccountDisabled = 1 or aa.XMarkedForDeletion > 0 then 'Disabled' else 'Enabled' end as jde_user_enab, case when aa.UID_TSBAccountDef is null then 'Unmanaged' else 'Managed' end as jde_user_man, (select count(*) from jde_users where pp.UID_Person = jde_users.UID_Person) As num_jde, (select count(*) from env_assignments where pp.UID_Person = env_assignments.UID_Person) As num_envs, (select count(*) from env_eset_assignments where pp.UID_Person = env_eset_assignments.UID_Person) As num_env_esets, (select count(*) from env_requests where pp.UID_Person = env_requests.UID_PersonOrdered) As num_env_reqs, (select count(*) from role_assignments where pp.UID_Person = role_assignments.UID_Person) As num_roles, (select count(*) from role_eset_assignments where pp.UID_Person = role_eset_assignments.UID_Person) As num_role_esets, (select count(*) from role_requests where pp.UID_Person = role_requests.UID_PersonOrdered) As num_role_reqs, case when exists(select top 1 1 from env_eset_assignments pphe where pphe.UID_Person = pp.UID_Person) then 'Yes' else 'No' end as has_env_esets, case when exists(select top 1 1 from role_eset_assignments pphe2 where pphe2.UID_Person = pp.UID_Person) then 'Yes' else 'No' end as has_role_esets, case when exists(select top 1 1 from env_requests ereq where ereq.UID_PersonOrdered = pp.UID_Person) then 'Yes' else 'No' end as has_env_reqs, case when exists(select top 1 1 from role_requests rreq where rreq.UID_PersonOrdered = pp.UID_Person) then 'Yes' else 'No' end as has_role_reqs, aa.CCC_NameEmployee from pers pp inner join Department dd on dd.UID_Department = pp.UID_Department inner join UNSAccountB aa on aa.UID_Person = pp.UID_Person AND aa.CanonicalName like 'JDE/USER%' AND aa.XMarkedForDeletion = 0 ) select emp as "Employee", emp_cent as "Employee: CentralAccount", emp_act as "Employee: Active", emp_comp as "Employee: Company", jde_user as "JDE-USER", jde_user_enab as "JDE-USER: Enabled", jde_user_man as "JDE-USER: Managed", num_jde As "Num JDE-Users Assigned", num_envs As "TotNum JDE-Env's", num_env_esets As "TotNum ENV E-Set Assignments", num_env_reqs As "TotNum ENV Requests", num_roles As "TotNum JDE-Roles", num_role_esets As "TotNum Role E-Set Assignments", num_role_reqs As "TotNum Role Requests", has_env_esets as "Has ENV ESet Assignments", has_role_esets as "Has Role ESet Assignments", has_env_reqs as "Has ENV Requests", has_role_reqs as "Has Role Requests", CCC_NameEmployee as has_env_esets, case when exists(select top 1 1 from role_eset_assignments pphe2 where pphe2.UID_Person = pp.UID_Person) then 'Yes' else 'No' end as has_role_esets, case when exists(select top 1 1 from env_requests ereq where ereq.UID_PersonOrdered = pp.UID_Person) then 'Yes' else 'No' end as has_env_reqs, case when exists(select top 1 1 from role_requests rreq where rreq.UID_PersonOrdered = pp.UID_Person) then 'Yes' else 'No' end as has_role_reqs, aa.CCC_NameEmployee from pers pp inner join Department dd on dd.UID_Department = pp.UID_Department inner join UNSAccountB aa on aa.UID_Person = pp.UID_Person AND aa.CanonicalName like 'JDE/USER%' AND aa.XMarkedForDeletion = 0 ) select emp as "Employee", emp_cent as "Employee: CentralAccount", emp_act as "Employee: Active", emp_comp as "Employee: Company", jde_user as "JDE-USER", jde_user_enab as "JDE-USER: Enabled", jde_user_man as "JDE-USER: Managed", num_jde As "Num JDE-Users Assigned", num_envs As "TotNum JDE-Env's", num_env_esets As "TotNum ENV E-Set Assignments", num_env_reqs As "TotNum ENV Requests", num_roles As "TotNum JDE-Roles", num_role_esets As "TotNum Role E-Set Assignments", num_role_reqs As "TotNum Role Requests", has_env_esets as "Has ENV ESet Assignments", has_role_esets as "Has Role ESet Assignments", has_env_reqs as "Has ENV Requests", has_role_reqs as "Has Role Requests", CCC_NameEmployee as "JDE-USER: Name Employee" from RPT ORDER BY emp;

WITH RPT AS ( SELECT pp.InternalName as pp_InternalName, pp.CentralAccount as pp_CentralAccount, case when pp.IsInActive = 1 or pp.XMarkedForDeletion > 0 then 'Inactive' else 'Active' end as emp_active, a.DisplayName as a_DisplayName, case when a.XMarkedForDeletion > 0 then 'Deleted' else case when a.AccountDisabled = 1 then 'Disabled' else 'Enabled' end end as a_enabled, case when a.UID_TSBAccountDef is null then 'Unmanaged' else case when adef.XObjectKey is null then 'NoAcctDef' else 'Managed' end end as a_managed, g.DisplayName as g_DisplayName, g.CanonicalName as g_CanonicalName, case when ug.XMarkedForDeletion > 0 then 'Outstanding' else 'Active' end as ug_active, es.Ident_ESet as es_Ident_ESet, es.DisplayName as es_DisplayName, es.Ident_AccProduct as es_Ident_AccProduct, case when es.XObjectKey is null then 'Missing Assignment' else 'Assignment Exists' end as es_exists, case when req.XObjectKey is null then 'Missing Request' else req.OrderReason end as autopwo, pp.UID_Person As pp_UID_Person, es.UID_ESet As es_UID_ESet FROM dbo.UNSGroupB g inner join UNSAccountBInUNSGroupB ug on g.UID_UNSGroupB = ug.UID_UNSGroupB AND g.CanonicalName like 'JDE/%' inner join UNSAccountB a on ug.UID_UNSAccountB = a.UID_UNSAccountB AND a.CanonicalName like 'JDE/USERS%' inner join Person pp on a.UID_Person = pp.UID_Person inner join Department d on pp.UID_Department = d.UID_Department left outer join ( select paf.XObjectKey, paf.UID_Person, paf.XIsInEffect, paf.XOrigin, paf.XMarkedForDeletion from TSBAccountDef af inner join PersonHasTSBAccountDef paf on af.UID_TSBAccountDef = paf.UID_TSBAccountDef where af.Ident_TSBAccountDef = 'JDE Account Def' ) adef on adef.UID_Person = pp.UID_Person left outer join ( -- has eset assignment for ug select ug3.XObjectKey, phe.UID_Person As phe_UID_Person, phe.XIsInEffect, phe.XOrigin, phe.XMarkedForDeletion, e3.Ident_ESet, e3.DisplayName, p3.Ident_AccProduct, e3.UID_ESet from UNSAccountBInUNSGroupB ug3 inner join UNSGroupB g3 on ug3.UID_UNSGroupB = g3.UID_UNSGroupB inner join ESetHasEntitlement eg3 on g3.XObjectKey=eg3.Entitlement inner join ESet e3 on eg3.UID_ESet = e3.UID_ESet inner join AccProduct p3 on e3.UID_AccProduct = p3.UID_AccProduct inner join ITShopOrg o3 on o3.UID_AccProduct = p3.UID_AccProduct left outer join PersonHasESet phe on phe.UID_ESet = e3.UID_ESet -- And phe.UID_Person = pp.UID_Person ) es on es.XObjectKey = ug.XObjectKey And es.phe_UID_Person = pp.UID_Person left outer join ( -- auto-request for ug select ug2.XObjectKey, pwo2.UID_PersonOrdered As pwo_UID_PersonOrdered, pwo2.OrderState, pwo2.OrderReason from UNSAccountBInUNSGroupB ug2 inner join UNSGroupB g2 on ug2.UID_UNSGroupB = g2.UID_UNSGroupB inner join ESetHasEntitlement eg2 on g2.XObjectKey=eg2.Entitlement inner join ESet e2 on eg2.UID_ESet = e2.UID_ESet inner join AccProduct p2 on e2.UID_AccProduct = p2.UID_AccProduct inner join ITShopOrg o2 on o2.UID_AccProduct = p2.UID_AccProduct left outer join PersonWantsOrg pwo2 on pwo2.UID_Org = o2.UID_ITShopOrg -- And pwo2.UID_PersonOrdered = pp.UID_Person ) req on req.XObjectKey = ug.XObjectKey And req.pwo_UID_PersonOrdered = pp.UID_Person where 1=1 AND ((a.ObjectGUID = pp.CentralAccount) OR (a.UID_TSBAccountDef is not null)) AND (d.FullPath like N'IMCD\%') AND (d.ObjectID in (N'112', N'211', N'221', N'311', N'511', N'551', N'554', N'555', N'557', N'561', N'581', N'582', N'583', N'584', N'585', N'586', N'651', N'662', N'683', N'684', N'687', N'911', N'111', N'121', N'131', N'141', N'151', N'161', N'331', N'351', N'411', N'421', N'431', N'631', N'635', N'637', N'641', N'671', N'672', N'673', N'811')) --AND adef.XObjectKey is null AND a.UID_TSBAccountDef is not null ) SELECT pp_InternalName as "Employee: Name", pp_CentralAccount as "Employee: CentralAccount", emp_active as "Employee: Active/Inactive", a_DisplayName as "JDE-User: DisplayName", a_enabled as "Account: Enabled/Disabled/Deleted", a_managed as "Account: Managed/Unmanaged/NoAcctDef", g_DisplayName as "JDE-Role: DisplayName", g_CanonicalName as "JDE-Role: CanonicalName", ug_active as "Role Assignment: Active/Outstanding", es_Ident_ESet as "ESET: Name", es_DisplayName as "ESET: DisplayName", es_Ident_AccProduct as "AccProduct: Name", es_exists as "ESET Assignment: Exists", autopwo as "Auto-PWO: Exists", pp_UID_Person As UID_Person, es_UID_ESet As UID_ESet FROM RPT ORDER BY pp_InternalName, G_CANONICALNAME;

with RPT as ( select o.OperationDate, a.UID_UNSAccountB, a.CanonicalName, c.ColumnName, p.ContentShort as 'OldUID' from DialogWatchProperty p inner join ( select * from DialogWatchOperation o2 where not exists ( select top 1 1 from DialogWatchProperty p2 inner join DialogColumn c2 on p2.UID_DialogColumn = c2.UID_DialogColumn where p2.UID_DialogWatchOperation = o2.UID_DialogWatchOperation and ((c2.ColumnName = 'CCC_CustomProperty01' and p2.ContentShort = 'one1') or (c2.ColumnName = 'CCC_CustomProperty01' and p2.ContentShort = 'two1') or (c2.ColumnName = 'CCC_CustomProperty02' and p2.ContentShort = 'two2') or (c2.ColumnName = 'CCC_CustomProperty01' and p2.ContentShort = 'three1') or (c2.ColumnName = 'CCC_CustomProperty02' and p2.ContentShort = 'three2') or (c2.ColumnName = 'CCC_CustomProperty03' and p2.ContentShort = 'three3') or (c2.ColumnName = 'CCC_CustomProperty04' and p2.ContentShort = 'three4') or (c2.ColumnName = 'CCC_PersonWantsOrg' and p2.ContentShort = '070f4757-1afd-4043-9cb4-d47fc40c5a70') or (c2.ColumnName = 'CCC_PersonWantsOrg' and p2.ContentShort = '7be5bf5d-0ac0-4cd7-8f06-e7f10da1ae51') or (c2.ColumnName = 'CCC_PersonWantsOrg' and p2.ContentShort = '19fb7699-b2f1-4c31-8d0f-5d49c274d0ad'))) ) o on o.UID_DialogWatchOperation = p.UID_DialogWatchOperation inner join UNSAccountB a on o.ObjectKeyOfRow = a.XObjectKey inner join DialogColumn c on p.UID_DialogColumn = c.UID_DialogColumn where p.UID_DialogColumn in ( select UID_DialogColumn from DialogColumn c2 where c2.ColumnName like 'CCC%' AND c2.UID_DialogTable = 'TSB-T-UNSAccountB' ) and o.OperationDate > '2023-03-05' ), RPT2 as ( select distinct UID_UNSAccountB, CanonicalName, (select top 1 OldUID from RPT r2 where r2.UID_UNSAccountB = r0.UID_UNSAccountB AND ColumnName = 'CCC_CustomBool01' order by OperationDate asc) as CCC_CustomBool01, (select top 1 OldUID from RPT r2 where r2.UID_UNSAccountB = r0.UID_UNSAccountB AND ColumnName = 'CCC_CustomBool02' order by OperationDate asc) as CCC_CustomBool02, (select top 1 OldUID from RPT r2 where r2.UID_UNSAccountB = r0.UID_UNSAccountB AND ColumnName = 'CCC_CustomBool03' order by OperationDate asc) as CCC_CustomBool03, (select top 1 OldUID from RPT r2 where r2.UID_UNSAccountB = r0.UID_UNSAccountB AND ColumnName = 'CCC_CustomBool04' order by OperationDate asc) as CCC_CustomBool04, (select top 1 OldUID from RPT r2 where r2.UID_UNSAccountB = r0.UID_UNSAccountB AND ColumnName = 'CCC_CustomBool05' order by OperationDate asc) as CCC_CustomBool05, (select top 1 OldUID from RPT r2 where r2.UID_UNSAccountB = r0.UID_UNSAccountB AND ColumnName = 'CCC_CustomBool06' order by OperationDate asc) as CCC_CustomBool06, (select top 1 OldUID from RPT r2 where r2.UID_UNSAccountB = r0.UID_UNSAccountB AND ColumnName = 'CCC_CustomBool07' order by OperationDate asc) as CCC_CustomBool07, (select top 1 OldUID from RPT r2 where r2.UID_UNSAccountB = r0.UID_UNSAccountB AND ColumnName = 'CCC_CustomProperty01' order by OperationDate asc) as CCC_CustomProperty01, (select top 1 OldUID from RPT r2 where r2.UID_UNSAccountB = r0.UID_UNSAccountB AND ColumnName = 'CCC_CustomProperty02' order by OperationDate asc) as CCC_CustomProperty02, (select top 1 OldUID from RPT r2 where r2.UID_UNSAccountB = r0.UID_UNSAccountB AND ColumnName = 'CCC_CustomProperty03' order by OperationDate asc) as CCC_CustomProperty03, (select top 1 OldUID from RPT r2 where r2.UID_UNSAccountB = r0.UID_UNSAccountB AND ColumnName = 'CCC_CustomProperty04' order by OperationDate asc) as CCC_CustomProperty04, (select top 1 OldUID from RPT r2 where r2.UID_UNSAccountB = r0.UID_UNSAccountB AND ColumnName = 'CCC_CustomProperty05' order by OperationDate asc) as CCC_CustomProperty05, (select top 1 OldUID from RPT r2 where r2.UID_UNSAccountB = r0.UID_UNSAccountB AND ColumnName = 'CCC_CustomProperty06' order by OperationDate asc) as CCC_CustomProperty06, (select top 1 OldUID from RPT r2 where r2.UID_UNSAccountB = r0.UID_UNSAccountB AND ColumnName = 'CCC_PersonWantsOrg' order by OperationDate asc) as CCC_PersonWantsOrg from RPT r0 ) select * from RPT2 order by CanonicalName;
