p.UID_DialogWatchOperation = o.UID_DialogWatchOperation inner join Person pp on pp.XObjectKey = o.ObjectKeyOfRow where p.UID_DialogColumn in ( select c.UID_DialogColumn from DialogColumn c inner join DialogTable t on c.UID_DialogTable = t.UID_DialogTable where (t.TableName = 'Person' And c.ColumnName = 'Phone')) union select o.OperationDate, o.OperationType, o.OperationUser, 'Person.PhoneMobile' as field, pp.CentralAccount as 'Object' from DialogWatchProperty p inner join DialogWatchOperation o on p.UID_DialogWatchOperation = o.UID_DialogWatchOperation inner join Person pp on pp.XObjectKey = o.ObjectKeyOfRow where p.UID_DialogColumn in ( select c.UID_DialogColumn from DialogColumn c inner join DialogTable t on c.UID_DialogTable = t.UID_DialogTable where (t.TableName = 'Person' And c.ColumnName = 'PhoneMobile')) union select o.OperationDate, o.OperationType, o.OperationUser, 'Account.TelephoneNumber' as field, aa.SAMAccountName as 'Object' from DialogWatchProperty p inner join DialogWatchOperation o on p.UID_DialogWatchOperation = o.UID_DialogWatchOperation inner join ADSAccount aa on aa.XObjectKey = o.ObjectKeyOfRow where p.UID_DialogColumn in ( select c.UID_DialogColumn from DialogColumn c inner join DialogTable t on c.UID_DialogTable = t.UID_DialogTable where (t.TableName = 'ADSAccount' And c.ColumnName = 'TelephoneNumber')) union select o.OperationDate, o.OperationType, o.OperationUser, 'Account.Mobile' as field, aa.SAMAccountName as 'Object' from DialogWatchProperty p inner join DialogWatchOperation o on p.UID_DialogWatchOperation = o.UID_DialogWatchOperation inner join ADSAccount aa on aa.XObjectKey = o.ObjectKeyOfRow where p.UID_DialogColumn in ( select c.UID_DialogColumn from DialogColumn c inner join DialogTable t on c.UID_DialogTable = t.UID_DialogTable where (t.TableName = 'ADSAccount' And c.ColumnName = 'Mobile')) ) select * from rpt where OperationDate > '2023-03-21 13:00' order by OperationDate desc;

with rpt as ( select o.OperationDate, o.OperationType, o.OperationUser, 'Person.Phone' as FieldName, pp.CentralAccount as 'ObjectID' from DialogWatchProperty p inner join DialogWatchOperation o on p.UID_DialogWatchOperation = o.UID_DialogWatchOperation inner join Person pp on pp.XObjectKey = o.ObjectKeyOfRow where p.UID_DialogColumn in ( select c.UID_DialogColumn from DialogColumn c inner join DialogTable t on c.UID_DialogTable = t.UID_DialogTable where (t.TableName = 'Person' And c.ColumnName = 'Phone')) union select o.OperationDate, o.OperationType, o.OperationUser, 'Person.PhoneMobile' as FieldName, pp.CentralAccount as 'ObjectID' from DialogWatchProperty p inner join DialogWatchOperation o on p.UID_DialogWatchOperation = o.UID_DialogWatchOperation inner join Person pp on pp.XObjectKey = o.ObjectKeyOfRow where p.UID_DialogColumn in ( select c.UID_DialogColumn from DialogColumn c inner join DialogTable t on c.UID_DialogTable = t.UID_DialogTable where (t.TableName = 'Person' And c.ColumnName = 'PhoneMobile')) union select o.OperationDate, o.OperationType, o.OperationUser, 'Account.TelephoneNumber' as FieldName, aa.SAMAccountName as 'ObjectID' from DialogWatchProperty p inner join DialogWatchOperation o on p.UID_DialogWatchOperation = o.UID_DialogWatchOperation inner join ADSAccount aa on aa.XObjectKey = o.ObjectKeyOfRow where p.UID_DialogColumn in ( select c.UID_DialogColumn from DialogColumn c inner join DialogTable t on c.UID_DialogTable = t.UID_DialogTable where (t.TableName = 'ADSAccount' And c.ColumnName = 'TelephoneNumber')) union select o.OperationDate, o.OperationType, o.OperationUser, 'Account.Mobile' as FieldName, aa.SAMAccountName as 'ObjectID' from DialogWatchProperty p inner join DialogWatchOperation o on p.UID_DialogWatchOperation = o.UID_DialogWatchOperation inner join ADSAccount aa on aa.XObjectKey = o.ObjectKeyOfRow where p.UID_DialogColumn in ( select c.UID_DialogColumn from DialogColumn c inner join DialogTable t on c.UID_DialogTable = t.UID_DialogTable where (t.TableName = 'ADSAccount' And c.ColumnName = 'Mobile')) ) select ObjectID As "Person/Account", FieldName As "Field", OperationDate, OperationType, OperationUser from rpt where OperationDate > '2023-03-21 13:00' order by ObjectID, OPERATIONDATE desc;

with emems as ( select p.InternalName, p.CentralAccount, ee.Ident_ESet, ee.UID_ESet, phe.UID_Person from PersonHasESet phe inner join Person p on phe.UID_Person = p.UID_Person inner join ESet ee on phe.UID_ESet = ee.UID_ESet where phe.UID_ESet in ( select UID_ESet from eset where UID_ESet in ( select e.UID_ESet from ESetHasEntitlement e inner join UNSGroupB1 g on e.Entitlement = g.XObjectKey where g.CanonicalName like 'JDE%' )) ), analys as ( select distinct case when exists (select * from emems em2 where em2.UID_Person = em.UID_Person and em2.Ident_ESet like 'JDE Environment%' ) AND NOT exists (select * from emems em2 where em2.UID_Person = em.UID_Person and em2.Ident_ESet not like 'JDE Environment%') then 'Only ENV Sys-Roles' when exists (select * from emems em2 where em2.UID_Person = em.UID_Person and em2.Ident_ESet like 'JDE Environment%' ) AND exists (select * from emems em2 where em2.UID_Person = em.UID_Person and em2.Ident_ESet not like 'JDE Environment%') then 'ENV and JDE-User Sys-Roles' when NOT exists (select * from emems em2 where em2.UID_Person = em.UID_Person and em2.Ident_ESet like 'JDE Environment%' ) AND exists (select * from emems em2 where em2.UID_Person = em.UID_Person and em2.Ident_ESet not like 'JDE Environment%') then 'Only JDE-User, no ENV sys-role' end as EnvCheck, InternalName, CentralAccount, UID_Person from emems em union select distinct 'Only JDE-ENVs, no Sys-Roles' as EnvCheck, p3.InternalName, p3.CentralAccount, UID_Person from Person p3 inner join UNSAccountB a3 on p3.UID_Person = a3.UID_Person AND a3.CanonicalName like 'JDE/%' inner join UNSAccountBInUNSGroupB1 ug on a3.UID_UNSAccountB = ug.UID_UNSAccountB where p3.UID_Person not in (select UID_Person from emems) ), rpt as ( select EnvCheck, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY EnvCheck ORDER BY InternalName) AS row_num, InternalName, CentralAccount, UID_Person from analys ) select EnvCheck, InternalName, CentralAccount, UID_Person from rpt where row_num <= 5 order by 1, 2;

with emems as ( select p.InternalName, p.CentralAccount, ee.Ident_ESet, ee.UID_ESet, phe.UID_Person from PersonHasESet phe inner join Person p on phe.UID_Person = p.UID_Person inner join ESet ee on phe.UID_ESet = ee.UID_ESet where phe.UID_ESet in ( select UID_ESet from eset where UID_ESet in ( select e.UID_ESet from ESetHasEntitlement e inner join UNSGroupB1 g on e.Entitlement = g.XObjectKey where g.CanonicalName like 'JDE%' )) ), analys as ( select distinct case when exists (select * from emems em2 where em2.UID_Person = em.UID_Person and em2.Ident_ESet like 'JDE Environment%' ) AND NOT exists (select * from emems em2 where em2.UID_Person = em.UID_Person and em2.Ident_ESet not like 'JDE Environment%') then 'Only ENV Sys-Roles' when exists (select * from emems em2 where em2.UID_Person = em.UID_Person and em2.Ident_ESet like 'JDE Environment%' ) AND exists (select * from emems em2 where em2.UID_Person = em.UID_Person and em2.Ident_ESet not like 'JDE Environment%') then 'ENV and JDE-User Sys-Roles' when NOT exists (select * from emems em2 where em2.UID_Person = em.UID_Person and em2.Ident_ESet like 'JDE Environment%' ) AND exists (select * from emems em2 where em2.UID_Person = em.UID_Person and em2.Ident_ESet not like 'JDE Environment%') then 'Only JDE-User, no ENV sys-role' end as EnvCheck, InternalName, CentralAccount, UID_Person from emems em union select distinct 'Only JDE-ENVs, no Sys-Roles' as EnvCheck, p3.InternalName, p3.CentralAccount, p3.UID_Person from Person p3 inner join UNSAccountB a3 on p3.UID_Person = a3.UID_Person AND a3.CanonicalName like 'JDE/%' inner join UNSAccountBInUNSGroupB1 ug on a3.UID_UNSAccountB = ug.UID_UNSAccountB where p3.UID_Person not in (select UID_Person from emems) ), rpt as ( select EnvCheck, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY EnvCheck ORDER BY InternalName) AS row_num, InternalName, CentralAccount, UID_Person from analys ) select EnvCheck, InternalName, CentralAccount, UID_Person from rpt where row_num <= 5 order by 1, 2;

Query.Description: For all Persons show JDE Account with XTab for Environment Assignments
Query.SQL:
SELECTX(<SQL:IMCD>) <XTAB 19;"1";"LIST";"CRLF";"F";"N";"">
<DEFAULT> AS "Employees Name", IsExternal, CentralAccount, CustomProperty08 AS "JDE AddressNumber (on the Person)", <DBLOOKUP "dbo.Department" "<DEFAULT>[Departments Name], ObjectID[Department Number]" "" "" "UID_Department">, <DBLOOKUP "dbo.Locality" "Ident_locality, <DBLOOKUP \"dbo.[DialogCountry]\" \"CountryName, Iso3166_2\" \"\" \"\" \"UID_DialogCountry\">" "" "" "UID_Locality"> FROM dbo.Person WHERE CustomProperty08 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY InternalName INNER_JOIN_ON UID_Person SELECTX(<SQL:IMCD>) cn AS "JDE User ID", CCC_NameEmployee, CCC_Company, CCC_Country, CCC_JDE_AddressNumber, <DBLOOKUP(<SQL:IMCD>) "dbo.UNSAccountBInUNSGroupB1" "<DBLOOKUP(<SQL:IMCD>) \"dbo.UNSGroupB1\" \"cn[Env ID], Description[Env Name], DisplayName[Environment]\" \"\" \"\" \"UID_UNSGroupB1\">" "" "" "UID_UNSAccountB"> FROM dbo.UNSAccountB WHERE UID_UNSContainerB = '2351f8ef-41cd-4253-b61c-4262a7633691';

SELECTX(<SQL:AWIAMSQL01.IMCD.NL/OneIM>,OneIM,,V7) CentralAccount, <DEFAULT> AS "Employees Name", IsInActive FROM dbo.Person JOIN_ON UID_Person SELECTX(<SQL:AWIAMSQL01.IMCD.NL/OneIM>,OneIM,,V7) cn, <DEFAULT> AS "User accounts Name", AccountDisabled FROM dbo.UNSAccountB WHERE CanonicalName LIKE 'JDE/USER%';

SELECTX(<SQL:IMCD>) CentralAccount, <DEFAULT> AS "Employees Name", IsInActive FROM dbo.Person ORDER BY CentralAccount JOIN_ON UID_Person SELECTX(<SQL:IMCD>) cn, <DEFAULT> AS "User accounts Name", AccountDisabled FROM dbo.UNSAccountB WHERE CanonicalName LIKE 'JDE/USER%';
SELECTX(<SQL:AWIAMSQL01.IMCD.NL/OneIM>,OneIM,,V7) <DBLOOKUP "dbo.[DialogTable]" "TableName" "" "" "UID_DialogTable">, Name, NoGenerate FROM dbo.JobChain ORDER BY UID_DialogTable, Name;
SELECTX(<SQL:IMCD_OTA>) <DBLOOKUP "dbo.[DialogTable]" "TableName" "" "" "UID_DialogTable">, Name, NoGenerate FROM dbo.JobChain ORDER BY UID_DialogTable, NAME;

SELECTX(<SQL:IMCD>) HIERARCHICAL(-1) <TREE field_name>, <LEVEL>, IsEnabledResulting, ConfigParm, Value, DisplayName, Description, FullPath, <DBLOOKUP "dbo.[QBMClrType]" "<DEFAULT>[Editor for generating values]" "" "" "UID_QBMClrTypeEditor=UID_QBMClrType"> FROM dbo.DialogConfigParm;
select DisplayName from DPRNameSpace where dbo.QBM_FCVGUIDToModuleOwner(UID_DPRNameSpace) in (select q.ModuleName from QBMModuleDef q where q.ModuleName <> 'CCC');

SELECTX(<SQL:AWIAMSQL01.IMCD.NL/OneIM>,OneIM,,V7) Reason, ProjectionStepDisplay, ObjectDisplay, ObjectIdentifier, ObjectState, SchemaTypeName, <DBLOOKUP(<SQL:IMCD>) "dbo.DPRJournalObject" "IsImport, Method, SequenceNumber, ObjectDisplay, ObjectIdentifier, ObjectState, SchemaTypeName" "" "" "UID_DPRJournalFailure"> FROM dbo.DPRJournalFailure JOIN_ON UID_DPRJournal SELECTX(<SQL:AWIAMSQL01.IMCD.NL/OneIM>,OneIM,,V7) TOP(200) CreationTime, ProjectionConfigDisplay, ProjectionContext, ProjectionStartInfoDisplay, ProjectionState, SystemVariableSetDisplay FROM dbo.DPRJournal;

SELECTX(<SQL:AWIAMSQL01.IMCD.NL/OneIM>,OneIM,,V7) TOP(200) ProjectionState, CreationTime, ProjectionConfigDisplay, ProjectionContext, ProjectionStartInfoDisplay, SystemVariableSetDisplay FROM dbo.DPRJournal ORDER BY CreationTime DESC INNER_JOIN_ON UID_DPRJournal SELECTX(<SQL:AWIAMSQL01.IMCD.NL/OneIM>,OneIM,,V7) Reason, ProjectionStepDisplay, ObjectDisplay, ObjectIdentifier, ObjectState, SchemaTypeName, <DBLOOKUP(<SQL:IMCD>) "dbo.DPRJournalObject" "IsImport, Method, SequenceNumber, ObjectDisplay, ObjectIdentifier, ObjectState, SchemaTypeName" "" "" "UID_DPRJournalFailure">, SchemaUid FROM dbo.DPRJournalFailure;

SELECTX(<SQL:IMCD>) ProjectionState, CreationTime, ProjectionConfigDisplay, ProjectionContext, ProjectionStartInfoDisplay, SystemVariableSetDisplay FROM dbo.DPRJournal ORDER BY CreationTime DESC INNER_JOIN_ON UID_DPRJournal SELECTX(<SQL:IMCD>) Reason, ProjectionStepDisplay, ObjectDisplay, ObjectIdentifier, ObjectState, SchemaTypeName, <DBLOOKUP(<SQL:IMCD>) "dbo.DPRJournalObject" "IsImport, Method, SequenceNumber, ObjectDisplay, ObjectIdentifier, ObjectState, SchemaTypeName" "" "" "UID_DPRJournalFailure">, <DBLOOKUP(<SQL:IMCD>) "dbo.DPRSchema" "<DBLOOKUP(<SQL:IMCD>) \"dbo.DPRShell\" \"DisplayName[Sync Project]\" \"\" \"\" \"UID_DPRShell\">" "" "" "SchemaUid=UID_DPRSchema"> FROM dbo.DPRJournalFailure;

SELECTX(<SQL:AWIAMSQL01.IMCD.NL/OneIM>,OneIM,,V7) TOP(10) <DBLOOKUP "dbo.[PersonWantsOrg]" "<DEFAULT>[Request procedure]" "" "" "UID_PersonWantsOrg">, LevelNumber, SubLevelNumber, <DBLOOKUP "dbo.[Person]" "<DEFAULT>[Approver]" "" "" "UID_PersonHead=UID_Person">, <DBLOOKUP "dbo.[Person]" "<DEFAULT>[Additional approver]" "" "" "UID_PersonAdditional=UID_Person"> FROM dbo.PWOHelperPWO;

SELECTX(<SQL:IMCD>) <DBLOOKUP "dbo.[PersonWantsOrg]" "<DEFAULT>[Request procedure]" "" "" "UID_PersonWantsOrg">, LevelNumber, SubLevelNumber, <DBLOOKUP "dbo.[Person]" "<DEFAULT>[Approver]" "" "" "UID_PersonHead=UID_Person">, <DBLOOKUP "dbo.[Person]" "<DEFAULT>[Additional approver]" "" "" "UID_PersonAdditional=UID_Person"> FROM dbo.PWOHelperPWO ORDER BY UID_PersonWantsOrg JOIN_ON UID_PersonWantsOrg SELECTX(<SQL:AWIAMSQL01.IMCD.NL/OneIM>,OneIM,,V7) OrderState FROM dbo.PersonWantsOrg;
SELECTX(<SQL:IMCD>) <DBLOOKUP(<SQL:IMCD>) "dbo.DPRJournal" "CreationTime">, Reason FROM dbo.DPRJournalFailure WHERE Reason LIKE '%The operation couldn''t be performed because object%';

SELECTX(<SQL:IDS-DB01/D1IM_8>,svcIDS_sql,,V7) HIERARCHICAL(-1) <TREE field_name>, '<LEVEL>', TreeCaption, <DBLOOKUP "dbo.[DialogTable]" "<DEFAULT>[Table]" "" "" "UID_DialogTable">, WhereClause, ListCaption, ListWhereClause, ListOrderBy FROM dbo.DialogTree INNER_JOIN_ON UID_DialogTree SELECTX(<SQL:IDS-DB01/D1IM_8>,svcIDS_sql,,V7) <NONE> FROM dbo.DialogTreeInDialogProduct INNER_JOIN_ON UID_DialogProduct SELECTX(<SQL:IDS-DB01/D1IM_8>,svcIDS_sql,,V7) <NONE> FROM dbo.QBMProduct WHERE Ident_Product = 'Manager';

SELECTX(<SQL:IDS-DB01/D1IM_8>,svcIDS_sql,,V7) HIERARCHICAL(-1) <TREE field_name>, '<LEVEL>', TreeCaption, <DBLOOKUP "dbo.[DialogTable]" "<DEFAULT>[Table]" "" "" "UID_DialogTable">, WhereClause, ListCaption, ListWhereClause, ListOrderBy, VarDefinition FROM dbo.DialogTree INNER_JOIN_ON UID_DialogTree SELECTX(<SQL:IDS-DB01/D1IM_8>,svcIDS_sql,,V7) <NONE> FROM dbo.DialogTreeInDialogProduct INNER_JOIN_ON UID_DialogProduct SELECTX(<SQL:IDS-DB01/D1IM_8>,svcIDS_sql,,V7) <NONE> FROM dbo.QBMProduct WHERE Ident_Product = 'Manager';

with jde_assign as ( select p.InternalName + ' (' + p.CentralAccount + ')' as Employee, p.UID_Person, e.Ident_ESet, phe.XIsInEffect, phe.XMarkedForDeletion, phe.XDateInserted from person p inner join PersonHasESet phe on p.UID_Person = phe.UID_Person inner join ESet e on phe.UID_ESet = e.UID_ESet inner join ESetType t on e.UID_ESetType = t.UID_ESetType where t.Ident_ESetType = 'JDE' ), pers as ( select distinct Employee, UID_Person from jde_assign ), rpt as ( select p.Employee, j.Ident_ESet, j.XDateInserted from pers p inner join jde_assign j on p.UID_Person = j.UID_Person where exists (select top 1 1 from jde_assign j1 where j1.UID_Person = p.UID_Person and j1.Ident_ESet like 'JDE Environment %') and exists (select top 1 1 from jde_assign j1 where j1.UID_Person = p.UID_Person and j1.Ident_ESet not like 'JDE Environment %') ) select Employee as "Employee", Ident_ESet as "System Role", XDateInserted as "Date Assigned" from rpt order by Employee, XDATEINSERTED desc, IDENT_ESET;

with jde_assign as ( select p.InternalName + ' (' + p.CentralAccount + ')' as Employee, p.UID_Person, e.Ident_ESet, phe.XIsInEffect, phe.XMarkedForDeletion, phe.XDateInserted from person p inner join PersonHasESet phe on p.UID_Person = phe.UID_Person inner join ESet e on phe.UID_ESet = e.UID_ESet inner join ESetType t on e.UID_ESetType = t.UID_ESetType where t.Ident_ESetType = 'JDE' ), pers as ( select distinct Employee, UID_Person from jde_assign ), rpt as ( select p.Employee, j.Ident_ESet, j.XDateInserted from pers p inner join jde_assign j on p.UID_Person = j.UID_Person where exists (select top 1 1 from jde_assign j1 where j1.UID_Person = p.UID_Person and j1.Ident_ESet like 'JDE Environment %') and exists (select top 1 1 from jde_assign j1 where j1.UID_Person = p.UID_Person and j1.Ident_ESet not like 'JDE Environment %') ) select Employee as "Employee", Ident_ESet as "System Role", XDateInserted as "Date Assigned" from rpt order by Employee, XDATEINSERTED desc, IDENT_ESET;

SELECTX(<SQL:AWIAMSQL01.IMCD.NL/OneIM>,OneIM,,V7) AccountDisabled, AccountName, cn, FirstName, LastName, ObjectGUID, <DBLOOKUP "dbo.[UNSContainerB]" "cn" "" "" "UID_UNSContainerB"> FROM dbo.UNSAccountB WHERE CanonicalName LIKE 'SafeNet/%' ORDER BY AccountName;

SELECTX(<SQL:IMCD>) AccountDisabled, AccountName, cn, FirstName, LastName, ObjectGUID, <DBLOOKUP "dbo.[UNSContainerB]" "cn" "" "" "UID_UNSContainerB"> FROM dbo.UNSAccountB WHERE CanonicalName LIKE 'SafeNet/%' ORDER BY AccountName;

SELECTX(<SQL:IMCD>) AccountDisabled, AccountName, cn, FirstName, LastName, ObjectGUID, <DBLOOKUP "dbo.[UNSContainerB]" "cn" "" "" "UID_UNSContainerB"> FROM dbo.UNSAccountB WHERE CanonicalName LIKE 'SafeNet/%' ORDER BY AccountName JOIN_ON UID_Person SELECTX(<SQL:AWIAMSQL01.IMCD.NL/OneIM>,OneIM,,V7) <DEFAULT> AS "Employees Name" FROM dbo.Person JOIN_ON UID_Locality SELECTX(<SQL:AWIAMSQL01.IMCD.NL/OneIM>,OneIM,,V7) FullPath FROM dbo.Locality JOIN_ON UID_Locality=UID_Org SELECTX(<SQL:AWIAMSQL01.IMCD.NL/OneIM>,OneIM,,V7) <DBLOOKUP(<SQL:IMCD>) "dbo.UNSContainerB" "cn, ObjectGUID" "" "" "ObjectKeyValue=XObjectKey"> FROM dbo.TSBITData;

SELECTX(<SQL:IMCD>) AccountDisabled, AccountName, cn, FirstName, LastName, ObjectGUID, <DBLOOKUP "dbo.[UNSContainerB]" "cn" "" "" "UID_UNSContainerB"> FROM dbo.UNSAccountB WHERE CanonicalName LIKE 'SafeNet/%' ORDER BY AccountName JOIN_ON UID_Person SELECTX(<SQL:AWIAMSQL01.IMCD.NL/OneIM>,OneIM,,V7) <DEFAULT> AS "Employees Name" FROM dbo.Person JOIN_ON UID_Locality SELECTX(<SQL:AWIAMSQL01.IMCD.NL/OneIM>,OneIM,,V7) FullPath FROM dbo.Locality JOIN_ON UID_Locality=UID_Org SELECTX(<SQL:AWIAMSQL01.IMCD.NL/OneIM>,OneIM,,V7) <DBLOOKUP(<SQL:IMCD>) "dbo.UNSContainerB" "cn, ObjectGUID" "" "" "ObjectKeyValue=XObjectKey"> FROM dbo.TSBITData WHERE ObjectKeyValue LIKE '%UNSContainerB%';

with rpt as ( select pp.InternalName, o.OperationDate, o.OperationUser, p.ContentShort, pp.CentralAccount from DialogWatchOperation o inner join DialogWatchProperty p on o.UID_DialogWatchOperation = p.UID_DialogWatchOperation inner join DialogColumn c on c.UID_DialogColumn = p.UID_DialogColumn inner join DialogTable t on c.UID_DialogTable = t.UID_DialogTable left outer join Person pp on o.ObjectKeyOfRow = pp.XObjectKey where t.TableName = 'Person' and c.ColumnName = 'CentralAccount' ) select InternalName as "Person", OperationDate as "Change Date", OperationUser as "Changed By", ContentShort as "Old Login", CentralAccount as "Current Login" from rpt order by InternalName, OPERATIONDATE desc;
select DisplayValue, OperationDate, OperationUser from DialogWatchOperation where ObjectKeyOfRow like '%<T>Person</T>%' and OperationType = 'D' order by OperationDate desc;
select InternalName, CentralAccount from person p where SUBSTRING(p.FirstName,1,2) = 'PE' and SUBSTRING(p.LastName,1,1) = 'T' order by 1 JOIN_ON UID_Department select DepartmentName from Department;

WITH RPT AS ( SELECT pp.InternalName as pp_InternalName, pp.CentralAccount as pp_CentralAccount, case when pp.IsInActive = 1 or pp.XMarkedForDeletion > 0 then 'Inactive' else 'Active' end as emp_active FROM Person pp ) SELECT pp_CentralAccount as "Employee: CentralAccount", pp_InternalName as "Employee: Name", emp_active as "Employee: Active/Inactive" FROM RPT ORDER BY pp_CentralAccount;

SELECTX(<SQL:AWIAMSQL01.IMCD.NL/OneIM>,OneIM,,V7) CCC_NameEmployee, CCC_JDE_AddressNumber, <DBLOOKUP "dbo.[Person]" "<DEFAULT>[Employee]" "" "" "UID_Person"> FROM dbo.UNSAccountB WHERE CCC_Company = '75300' ORDER BY CCC_NameEmployee JOIN_ON CCC_JDE_AddressNumber SELECTX(<SQL:AWIAMSQL01.IMCD.NL/OneIM>,OneIM,,V7) cn AS "JDE-User", <DBLOOKUP "dbo.[Person]" "<DEFAULT>[Employees Name]" "" "" "UID_Person"> FROM dbo.UNSAccountB WHERE CanonicalName LIKE 'JDE/User%';

SELECTX(<SQL:IMCD>) CCC_NameEmployee, CCC_JDE_AddressNumber, <DBLOOKUP "dbo.[Person]" "<DEFAULT>[Employee], CentralAccount" "" "" "UID_Person"> FROM dbo.UNSAccountB WHERE CCC_Company = '75300' ORDER BY CCC_NameEmployee JOIN_ON CCC_JDE_AddressNumber SELECTX(<SQL:IMCD>) cn AS "JDE-User", <DBLOOKUP "dbo.[Person]" "<DEFAULT>[Employees Name], CentralAccount, IsInActive" "" "" "UID_Person">, AccountDisabled FROM dbo.UNSAccountB WHERE CanonicalName LIKE 'JDE/User%';

SELECTX(<SQL:IMCD>) CCC_NameEmployee, CCC_JDE_AddressNumber, <DBLOOKUP "dbo.[Person]" "<DEFAULT>[Employee], CentralAccount" "" "" "UID_Person"> FROM dbo.UNSAccountB WHERE CCC_Company = '75300' AND CanonicalName LIKE 'JDE/Addr%' ORDER BY CCC_NameEmployee JOIN_ON CCC_JDE_AddressNumber SELECTX(<SQL:IMCD>) cn AS "JDE-User", <DBLOOKUP "dbo.[Person]" "<DEFAULT>[Employees Name], CentralAccount, IsInActive" "" "" "UID_Person">, AccountDisabled FROM dbo.UNSAccountB WHERE CanonicalName LIKE 'JDE/User%';

SELECTX(<SQL:AWIAMSQL01.IMCD.NL/OneIM>,OneIM,,V7) CCC_NameEmployee, CCC_JDE_AddressNumber, <DBLOOKUP "dbo.[Person]" "<DEFAULT>[Employee], CentralAccount, IsInActive" "" "" "UID_Person"> FROM dbo.UNSAccountB WHERE CCC_Company = '75300' AND CanonicalName LIKE 'JDE/Addr%' ORDER BY CCC_NameEmployee JOIN_ON CCC_JDE_AddressNumber SELECTX(<SQL:IMCD>) cn AS "JDE-User", <DBLOOKUP "dbo.[Person]" "<DEFAULT>[Employees Name], CentralAccount, IsInActive" "" "" "UID_Person">, AccountDisabled FROM dbo.UNSAccountB WHERE CanonicalName LIKE 'JDE/User%';

SELECTX(<SQL:IMCD>) TOP(20000) <XTAB 7;"2";"LIST";"CRLF";"F";"N";"">
DISTINCT GenProcID FROM [dbo].[JobQueue] WHERE Ready2EXE = 'FROZEN' ORDER BY GenProcID JOIN_ON GenProcID SELECTX(<SQL:IMCD>) DISTINCT JobChainName FROM [dbo].[JobQueue] WHERE Ready2EXE = 'FROZEN' ORDER BY JobChainName JOIN_ON JobChainName;1.GenProcID=GenProcID SELECTX(<SQL:IMCD>) XDateInserted, TaskName, ParamIN, <DBLOOKUP "<OBJECT_TABLE>" "'<OBJECT_TABLE_NAME>'[Table Name], <DEFAULT>[Object Name]" "" "" "BasisObjectKey=XObjectKey">, BasisObjectKey, ErrorMessages, ComponentClass, JobChainName FROM [dbo].[JobQueue] WHERE Ready2EXE = 'FROZEN' ORDER BY XDateInserted DESC;

SELECTX(<SQL:AWIAMSQL01.IMCD.NL/OneIM>,OneIM,,V7) <DEFAULT> AS "Job queue Name" FROM dbo.JobQueue INNER_JOIN_ON BasisObjectKey=XObjectKey SELECTX(<SQL:AWIAMSQL01.IMCD.NL/OneIM>,OneIM,,V7) <DEFAULT> AS "Start configurations Name" FROM dbo.DPRProjectionStartInfo;

SELECTX(<SQL:AWIAMSQL01.IMCD.NL/OneIM>,OneIM,,V7) Ready2EXE, StartAt, Queue, TaskName, ErrorMessages FROM dbo.JobQueue ORDER BY StartAt INNER_JOIN_ON BasisObjectKey=XObjectKey SELECTX(<SQL:AWIAMSQL01.IMCD.NL/OneIM>,OneIM,,V7) <DBLOOKUP "dbo.[DPRProjectionConfig]" "<DEFAULT>[Workflow]" "" "" "UID_DPRProjectionConfig">, <DBLOOKUP "dbo.[DPRShell]" "<DEFAULT>[Synchronization project]" "" "" "UID_DPRShell"> FROM dbo.DPRProjectionStartInfo;

SELECTX(<SQL:IMCD>) UTC_TO_LOCAL Ready2EXE, StartAt, Queue, TaskName, ErrorMessages FROM dbo.JobQueue ORDER BY StartAt INNER_JOIN_ON BasisObjectKey=XObjectKey SELECTX(<SQL:IMCD>) <DBLOOKUP "dbo.[DPRProjectionConfig]" "<DEFAULT>[Workflow]" "" "" "UID_DPRProjectionConfig">, <DBLOOKUP "dbo.[DPRShell]" "<DEFAULT>[Synchronization project]" "" "" "UID_DPRShell"> FROM dbo.DPRProjectionStartInfo;

SELECTX(<SQL:IDS-DB01/D1IM_8>,svcIDS_sql,,V7) <DEFAULT> AS "Departments Name" FROM dbo.Department ORDER BY DepartmentName JOIN_ON UID_PersonHead=UID_Person;OR;UID_PersonHeadSecond=UID_Person SELECTX(<SQL:IDS-DB01/D1IM_8>,svcIDS_sql,,V7) <DEFAULT> AS "Employees Name" FROM dbo.Person;

WITH sys_types AS ( select 'SYSTEM' As Owner, n.Ident_DPRNameSpace As SystemType, n.DisplayName as SyncProject from DPRNameSpace n where dbo.QBM_FCVGUIDToModuleOwner(n.UID_DPRNameSpace) in (select q.ModuleName from QBMModuleDef q where q.ModuleName <> 'CCC') AND n.Ident_DPRNameSpace <> 'OneIM' union select 'CCC' As Owner, SystemType, n.DisplayName as SyncProject from DPRNameSpace n inner join DPRSchema h on n.Ident_DPRNameSpace = h.SystemType where dbo.QBM_FCVGUIDToModuleOwner(n.UID_DPRNameSpace) = 'CCC' AND h.SystemType <> 'OneIM' union select 'SPEC' As Owner, SystemType, case SystemType when 'SCV' then 'CSV Connector' when 'DB' then 'Generic database connector' when 'Posh' then 'Windows Powershell Connector' else SystemType + ' Connector' end as SyncProject from DPRSchema where not SystemType in (select Ident_DPRNameSpace from DPRNameSpace) AND SystemType <> 'OneIM' union select 'ONEIM' As Owner, 'OneIM' As SystemType, 'One Identity Connector' as SyncProject ), projs AS ( --- also display sync types w/o projects select distinct n.Owner, n.SyncProject, s.DisplayName, s.Description, c.DisplayNameQualified from sys_types n left outer join DPRSchema h on n.SystemType = h.SystemType left outer join DPRSystemConnection c on c.UID_DPRSchema = h.UID_DPRSchema and c.Name <> 'MainConnection' left outer join DPRShell s on c.UID_DPRShell = s.UID_DPRShell ), norm_projs AS ( --- also display sync types w/o projects select n.Owner, n.SyncProject, s.DisplayName, s.Description, c.DisplayNameQualified from sys_types n left outer join DPRSchema h on n.SystemType = h.SystemType left outer join DPRSystemConnection c on c.UID_DPRSchema = h.UID_DPRSchema and c.Name <> 'MainConnection' left outer join DPRShell s on c.UID_DPRShell = s.UID_DPRShell where n.Owner = 'SYSTEM' or n.Owner = 'CCC' ), spec_projs AS ( select n.Owner, n.SyncProject, s.DisplayName, s.Description, c.DisplayNameQualified from sys_types n inner join DPRSchema h on h.SystemType = n.SystemType inner join DPRSystemConnection c on c.UID_DPRSchema = h.UID_DPRSchema and c.Name <> 'MainConnection' inner join DPRShell s on c.UID_DPRShell = s.UID_DPRShell where n.Owner = 'SPEC' ), oneim_projs As ( select n.Owner, n.SyncProject, s.DisplayName, s.Description, c.DisplayNameQualified from sys_types n inner join DPRSchema h on h.SystemType = n.SystemType inner join DPRSystemConnection c on c.UID_DPRSchema = h.UID_DPRSchema and c.Name <> 'MainConnection' inner join DPRShell s on c.UID_DPRShell = s.UID_DPRShell where exists (select top 1 1 from DPRSchema ss where ss.UID_DPRShell = h.UID_DPRShell and ss.SystemType = 'OneIM') AND not exists (select top 1 1 from DPRSchema ss where ss.UID_DPRShell = h.UID_DPRShell and ss.SystemType <> 'OneIM') ) select SyncProject, Owner, DisplayName, Description, DisplayNameQualified As Connection from projs order by 1, 3;

WITH sys_types AS ( select 'SYSTEM' As Owner, n.Ident_DPRNameSpace As SystemType, n.DisplayName as SyncProject from DPRNameSpace n where dbo.QBM_FCVGUIDToModuleOwner(n.UID_DPRNameSpace) in (select q.ModuleName from QBMModuleDef q where q.ModuleName <> 'CCC') AND n.Ident_DPRNameSpace <> 'OneIM' union select 'CCC' As Owner, SystemType, n.DisplayName as SyncProject from DPRNameSpace n inner join DPRSchema h on n.Ident_DPRNameSpace = h.SystemType where dbo.QBM_FCVGUIDToModuleOwner(n.UID_DPRNameSpace) = 'CCC' AND h.SystemType <> 'OneIM' union select 'SPEC' As Owner, SystemType, case SystemType when 'SCV' then 'CSV Connector' when 'DB' then 'Generic database connector' when 'Posh' then 'Windows Powershell Connector' else SystemType + ' Connector' end as SyncProject from DPRSchema where not SystemType in (select Ident_DPRNameSpace from DPRNameSpace) AND SystemType <> 'OneIM' union select 'ONEIM' As Owner, 'OneIM' As SystemType, 'One Identity Connector' as SyncProject ), projs AS ( --- also display sync types w/o projects select distinct n.Owner, n.SyncProject, s.DisplayName, s.Description, c.DisplayNameQualified, s.UID_DPRShell from sys_types n left outer join DPRSchema h on n.SystemType = h.SystemType left outer join DPRSystemConnection c on c.UID_DPRSchema = h.UID_DPRSchema and c.Name <> 'MainConnection' left outer join DPRShell s on c.UID_DPRShell = s.UID_DPRShell ), norm_projs AS ( --- also display sync types w/o projects select n.Owner, n.SyncProject, s.DisplayName, s.Description, c.DisplayNameQualified, s.UID_DPRShell from sys_types n left outer join DPRSchema h on n.SystemType = h.SystemType left outer join DPRSystemConnection c on c.UID_DPRSchema = h.UID_DPRSchema and c.Name <> 'MainConnection' left outer join DPRShell s on c.UID_DPRShell = s.UID_DPRShell where n.Owner = 'SYSTEM' or n.Owner = 'CCC' ), spec_projs AS ( select n.Owner, n.SyncProject, s.DisplayName, s.Description, c.DisplayNameQualified, s.UID_DPRShell from sys_types n inner join DPRSchema h on h.SystemType = n.SystemType inner join DPRSystemConnection c on c.UID_DPRSchema = h.UID_DPRSchema and c.Name <> 'MainConnection' inner join DPRShell s on c.UID_DPRShell = s.UID_DPRShell where n.Owner = 'SPEC' ), oneim_projs As ( select n.Owner, n.SyncProject, s.DisplayName, s.Description, c.DisplayNameQualified, s.UID_DPRShell from sys_types n inner join DPRSchema h on h.SystemType = n.SystemType inner join DPRSystemConnection c on c.UID_DPRSchema = h.UID_DPRSchema and c.Name <> 'MainConnection' inner join DPRShell s on c.UID_DPRShell = s.UID_DPRShell where exists (select top 1 1 from DPRSchema ss where ss.UID_DPRShell = h.UID_DPRShell and ss.SystemType = 'OneIM') AND not exists (select top 1 1 from DPRSchema ss where ss.UID_DPRShell = h.UID_DPRShell and ss.SystemType <> 'OneIM') ) select SyncProject, Owner, DisplayName, Description, DisplayNameQualified As Connection from projs order by 1, 3 JOIN_ON UID_DPRShell select DisplayName As StartUpConfig from DPRProjectionStartInfo;

with imps as ( select t.ImportSource, case when t.ImportSource is null then 'NONE' when v.KeyDisplay is NULL then t.ImportSource else v.KeyDisplay end as NameImportSource, (ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY ImportSource)) - 1 AS rn from ( select distinct ImportSource from Person ) t left outer join ( select KeyValue, KeyDisplay from QBMColumnLimitedValue where (UID_DialogColumn in (select UID_DialogColumn from DialogColumn where ColumnName = 'ImportSource' and UID_DialogTable = 'QER-T-Person')) ) v on t.ImportSource = v.KeyValue ), tests as ( select case when isnull(EntryDate,CONVERT(DATETIME, 0)) > SYSUTCDATETIME() then 'Future Joiner' when isnull(EntryDate,CONVERT(DATETIME, 0)) < '1900-01-02' then 'No Entry Date' else 'Entry Date in Past' end as StartDate, case when isnull(ExitDate,CONVERT(DATETIME, 0)) > SYSUTCDATETIME() then 'Contract will Expire' when isnull(ExitDate,CONVERT(DATETIME, 0)) < '1900-01-02' then 'Permanent Contract' else 'Contract has Ended' end as EndDate, case when IsInActive = 1 then 'Disabled' else 'Enabled' end as Active, (select NameImportSource from imps where imps.ImportSource = p.ImportSource) as NameImportSource, case when CCC_In_HR_Feed = 1 then 'Not in View' else 'In View' end as InView, (case when isnull(EntryDate,CONVERT(DATETIME, 0)) > SYSUTCDATETIME() then 2 when isnull(EntryDate,CONVERT(DATETIME, 0)) < '1900-01-02' then 0 else 1 end) + 2 * (case when isnull(ExitDate,CONVERT(DATETIME, 0)) > SYSUTCDATETIME() then 1 when isnull(ExitDate,CONVERT(DATETIME, 0)) < '1900-01-02' then 0 else 2 end) + 5 + isnull(IsInActive,0) + 6 + (select isnull(rn,0) from imps where (imps.ImportSource = p.ImportSource) or (imps.ImportSource is null AND p.ImportSource is null)) + 10 + isnull(CCC_In_HR_Feed,0) As TestCase, InternalName, UID_Person from Person p ), samples as ( select ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY TestCase ORDER BY InternalName) AS rn, StartDate, EndDate, Active, NameImportSource, InView, TestCase, InternalName, UID_Person from tests ), selection as ( select s.TestCase, s.StartDate, s.EndDate, s.Active, s.NameImportSource, s.InView, p.InternalName, p.CentralAccount, p.EntryDate, p.ExitDate, p.IsInActive, p.ImportSource, p.CCC_In_HR_Feed from samples s inner join Person p on s.UID_Person = p.UID_Person where s.rn <= 1 ) select * from selection order by TestCase;

isnull(EntryDate,CONVERT(DATETIME, 0)) < '1900-01-02' then 0 else 1 end) + 3 + (case when isnull(ExitDate,CONVERT(DATETIME, 0)) > SYSUTCDATETIME() then 1 when isnull(ExitDate,CONVERT(DATETIME, 0)) < '1900-01-02' then 0 else 2 end) + 5 + isnull(IsInActive,0) + 6 + (select isnull(rn,0) from imps where (imps.ImportSource = p.ImportSource) or (imps.ImportSource is null AND p.ImportSource is null)) + 10 + isnull(CCC_In_HR_Feed,0) As TestCase, InternalName, UID_Person from Person p ), samples as ( select ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY TestCase ORDER BY InternalName) AS rn, StartDate, EndDate, Active, NameImportSource, InView, TestCase, InternalName, UID_Person from tests ), selection as ( select s.TestCase, s.StartDate, s.EndDate, s.Active, s.NameImportSource, s.InView, p.InternalName, p.CentralAccount, p.EntryDate, p.ExitDate, p.IsInActive, p.ImportSource, p.CCC_In_HR_Feed from samples s inner join Person p on s.UID_Person = p.UID_Person where s.rn <= 1 ) select * from selection order by TestCase;

WITH sys_types AS ( select 'SYSTEM' As Owner, n.Ident_DPRNameSpace As SystemType, n.DisplayName as SyncProject from DPRNameSpace n where dbo.QBM_FCVGUIDToModuleOwner(n.UID_DPRNameSpace) in (select q.ModuleName from QBMModuleDef q where q.ModuleName <> 'CCC') AND n.Ident_DPRNameSpace <> 'OneIM' union select 'CCC' As Owner, SystemType, n.DisplayName as SyncProject from DPRNameSpace n inner join DPRSchema h on n.Ident_DPRNameSpace = h.SystemType where dbo.QBM_FCVGUIDToModuleOwner(n.UID_DPRNameSpace) = 'CCC' AND h.SystemType <> 'OneIM' union select 'SPEC' As Owner, SystemType, case SystemType when 'SCV' then 'CSV Connector' when 'DB' then 'Generic database connector' when 'Posh' then 'Windows Powershell Connector' else SystemType + ' Connector' end as SyncProject from DPRSchema where not SystemType in (select Ident_DPRNameSpace from DPRNameSpace) AND SystemType <> 'OneIM' union select 'ONEIM' As Owner, 'OneIM' As SystemType, 'One Identity Connector' as SyncProject ), projs AS ( --- also display sync types w/o projects select distinct n.Owner, n.SyncProject, s.DisplayName, s.Description, s.UID_DPRShell from sys_types n left outer join DPRSchema h on n.SystemType = h.SystemType left outer join DPRSystemConnection c on c.UID_DPRSchema = h.UID_DPRSchema and c.Name <> 'MainConnection' left outer join DPRShell s on c.UID_DPRShell = s.UID_DPRShell ), norm_projs AS ( --- also display sync types w/o projects select n.Owner, n.SyncProject, s.DisplayName, s.Description, s.UID_DPRShell from sys_types n left outer join DPRSchema h on n.SystemType = h.SystemType left outer join DPRSystemConnection c on c.UID_DPRSchema = h.UID_DPRSchema and c.Name <> 'MainConnection' left outer join DPRShell s on c.UID_DPRShell = s.UID_DPRShell where n.Owner = 'SYSTEM' or n.Owner = 'CCC' ), spec_projs AS ( select n.Owner, n.SyncProject, s.DisplayName, s.Description, s.UID_DPRShell from sys_types n inner join DPRSchema h on h.SystemType = n.SystemType inner join DPRSystemConnection c on c.UID_DPRSchema = h.UID_DPRSchema and c.Name <> 'MainConnection' inner join DPRShell s on c.UID_DPRShell = s.UID_DPRShell where n.Owner = 'SPEC' ), oneim_projs As ( select n.Owner, n.SyncProject, s.DisplayName, s.Description, s.UID_DPRShell from sys_types n inner join DPRSchema h on h.SystemType = n.SystemType inner join DPRSystemConnection c on c.UID_DPRSchema = h.UID_DPRSchema and c.Name <> 'MainConnection' inner join DPRShell s on c.UID_DPRShell = s.UID_DPRShell where exists (select top 1 1 from DPRSchema ss where ss.UID_DPRShell = h.UID_DPRShell and ss.SystemType = 'OneIM') AND not exists (select top 1 1 from DPRSchema ss where ss.UID_DPRShell = h.UID_DPRShell and ss.SystemType <> 'OneIM') ), proj_w_startup as ( select j.SyncProject, j.Owner, j.DisplayName, j.Description, s.DisplayName as StartupInfo from projs j left outer join DPRProjectionStartInfo s on j.UID_DPRShell = s.UID_DPRShell ) select SyncProject as "Sync Project Type", DisplayName as "Sync Project Name", Description as "Sync Project Description", StartupInfo as "Startup Info" from proj_w_startup order by 1, 3;

h on n.SystemType = h.SystemType left outer join DPRSystemConnection c on c.UID_DPRSchema = h.UID_DPRSchema and c.Name <> 'MainConnection' left outer join DPRShell s on c.UID_DPRShell = s.UID_DPRShell where n.Owner = 'SYSTEM' or n.Owner = 'CCC' ), spec_projs AS ( select n.Owner, n.SyncProject, s.DisplayName, s.Description, c.DisplayNameQualified, s.UID_DPRShell from sys_types n inner join DPRSchema h on h.SystemType = n.SystemType inner join DPRSystemConnection c on c.UID_DPRSchema = h.UID_DPRSchema and c.Name <> 'MainConnection' inner join DPRShell s on c.UID_DPRShell = s.UID_DPRShell where n.Owner = 'SPEC' ), oneim_projs As ( select n.Owner, n.SyncProject, s.DisplayName, s.Description, c.DisplayNameQualified, s.UID_DPRShell from sys_types n inner join DPRSchema h on h.SystemType = n.SystemType inner join DPRSystemConnection c on c.UID_DPRSchema = h.UID_DPRSchema and c.Name <> 'MainConnection' inner join DPRShell s on c.UID_DPRShell = s.UID_DPRShell where exists (select top 1 1 from DPRSchema ss where ss.UID_DPRShell = h.UID_DPRShell and ss.SystemType = 'OneIM') AND not exists (select top 1 1 from DPRSchema ss where ss.UID_DPRShell = h.UID_DPRShell and ss.SystemType <> 'OneIM') ), sinfo As ( select p.SyncProject, p.Owner, p.DisplayName, p.Description, p.DisplayNameQualified As Connection, s.DisplayName As StartupInfo, s.XObjectKey from projs p left outer join DPRProjectionStartInfo s on p.UID_DPRShell = s.UID_DPRShell ) select StartupInfo, SyncProject, DisplayName, Description, Connection, XObjectKey as StartupInfoXObjectKey from sinfo where StartupInfo is not null order by 1, 2, 3;

SELECTX(<SQL:ASW>) OperationDate, OperationType, DisplayValue, OperationUser FROM dbo.DialogWatchOperation WHERE ObjectKeyOfRow = (select XObjectKey from Person p where p.InternalName = 'Venus, Geoffrey') ORDER BY OperationDate DESC JOIN_ON UID_DialogWatchOperation SELECTX(<SQL:ASW>) <DBLOOKUP "dbo.[DialogColumn]" "ColumnName" "" "" "UID_DialogColumn">, ContentShort AS "Previous Value" FROM dbo.DialogWatchProperty ORDER BY UID_DialogColumn;

SELECTX(<SQL:ASW>) <DEFAULT> AS "Tables Name" FROM dbo.DialogTable INNER_JOIN_ON UID_DialogTable SELECTX(<SQL:ASW>) <DEFAULT> AS "Processes Name" FROM dbo.JobChain ORDER BY Name INNER_JOIN_ON UID_JobChain SELECTX(<SQL:ASW>) <DEFAULT> AS "Process steps Name", IsForHistory, LogMode, <DBLOOKUP "dbo.JobRunParameter" "ValueTemplate[Mail Template]" "Name EQ \"MailID\"" "" "UID_Job"> FROM dbo.Job ORDER BY Name INNER_JOIN_ON UID_JobTask SELECTX(<SQL:ASW>) <NONE> FROM dbo.JobTask INNER_JOIN_ON UID_JobComponent SELECTX(<SQL:ASW>) <NONE> FROM dbo.JobComponent WHERE ComponentAssembly = 'MailComponent';

Query.Description: Test Cases - Entry/Exit Date per Import Source
Query.SQL: with imps as ( select t.ImportSource, case when t.ImportSource is null then 'NONE' when v.KeyDisplay is NULL then t.ImportSource else v.KeyDisplay end as NameImportSource, (ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY ImportSource)) - 1 AS rn from ( select distinct ImportSource from Person ) t left outer join ( select KeyValue, KeyDisplay from QBMColumnLimitedValue where (UID_DialogColumn in (select UID_DialogColumn from DialogColumn where ColumnName = 'ImportSource' and UID_DialogTable = 'QER-T-Person')) ) v on t.ImportSource = v.KeyValue ), tests as ( select case when isnull(EntryDate,CONVERT(DATETIME, 0)) > SYSUTCDATETIME() then 'Future Joiner' when isnull(EntryDate,CONVERT(DATETIME, 0)) < '1900-01-02' then 'No Entry Date' else 'Entry Date in Past' end as StartDate, case when isnull(ExitDate,CONVERT(DATETIME, 0)) > SYSUTCDATETIME() then 'Contract will Expire' when isnull(ExitDate,CONVERT(DATETIME, 0)) < '1900-01-02' then 'Permanent Contract' else 'Contract has Ended' end as EndDate, case when IsInActive = 1 then 'Disabled' else 'Enabled' end as Active, (select NameImportSource from imps where imps.ImportSource = p.ImportSource) as NameImportSource, case when CCC_In_HR_Feed = 1 then 'Not in View' else 'In View' end as InView, (case when isnull(EntryDate,CONVERT(DATETIME, 0)) > SYSUTCDATETIME() then 2 when isnull(EntryDate,CONVERT(DATETIME, 0)) < '1900-01-02' then 0 else 1 end) + 3 + (case when isnull(ExitDate,CONVERT(DATETIME, 0)) > SYSUTCDATETIME() then 1 when isnull(ExitDate,CONVERT(DATETIME, 0)) < '1900-01-02' then 0 else 2 end) + 6 + isnull(IsInActive,0) + 7 + (select isnull(rn,0) from imps where (imps.ImportSource = p.ImportSource) or (imps.ImportSource is null AND p.ImportSource is null)) + 10 + isnull(CCC_In_HR_Feed,0) As TestCase, InternalName, UID_Person from Person p ), samples as ( select ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY TestCase ORDER BY InternalName) AS rn, StartDate, EndDate, Active, NameImportSource, InView, TestCase, InternalName, UID_Person from tests ), selection as ( select s.TestCase, s.StartDate, s.EndDate, s.Active, s.NameImportSource, s.InView, p.InternalName, p.CentralAccount, p.EntryDate, p.ExitDate, p.IsInActive, p.ImportSource, p.CCC_In_HR_Feed from samples s inner join Person p on s.UID_Person = p.UID_Person where s.rn <= 1 ) select * from selection order by TestCase;

SELECTX(<SQL:ASW_UAT>) <DEFAULT> AS "Job queue Name", XDateInserted, StartAt, Ready2EXE, IsRootJob, JobChainName, TaskName, <DBLOOKUP(<SQL:ASW_UAT>) "<OBJECT_TABLE>" "'<OBJECT_TABLE_NAME>'[Table Name], <DEFAULT>[Base object key]" "" "" "BasisObjectKey=XObjectKey">, ErrorMessages, UID_Tree, UID_Job, UID_JobError, UID_JobSuccess FROM dbo.JobQueue ORDER BY JobChainName, STARTAT DESC;

Query.Description: For all Persons show JDE Account with XTab for Environment Assignments
Query.SQL:
SELECTX(<SQL:IMCD>) <XTAB 19;"1";"LIST";"CRLF";"F";"N";"">
<DEFAULT> AS "Employees Name", IsExternal, CentralAccount, CustomProperty08 AS "JDE AddressNumber (on the Person)", <DBLOOKUP "dbo.Department" "<DEFAULT>[Departments Name], ObjectID[Department Number]" "" "" "UID_Department">, <DBLOOKUP "dbo.Locality" "Ident_locality, <DBLOOKUP \"dbo.[DialogCountry]\" \"CountryName, Iso3166_2\" \"\" \"\" \"UID_DialogCountry\">" "" "" "UID_Locality"> FROM dbo.Person WHERE CustomProperty08 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY InternalName INNER_JOIN_ON UID_Person SELECTX(<SQL:IMCD>) cn AS "JDE User ID", CCC_NameEmployee, CCC_Company, CCC_Country, CCC_JDE_AddressNumber, <DBLOOKUP(<SQL:IMCD>) "dbo.UNSAccountBInUNSGroupB1" "<DBLOOKUP(<SQL:IMCD>) \"dbo.UNSGroupB1\" \"cn[Env ID], Description[Env Name], DisplayName[Environment]\" \"\" \"\" \"UID_UNSGroupB1\">" "" "" "UID_UNSAccountB"> FROM dbo.UNSAccountB WHERE UID_UNSContainerB = '2351f8ef-41cd-4253-b61c-4262a7633691';

WITH RPT AS ( SELECT pp.InternalName as pp_InternalName, pp.CentralAccount as pp_CentralAccount, case when pp.IsInActive = 1 or pp.XMarkedForDeletion > 0 then 'Inactive' else 'Active' end as emp_active, a.ObjectGUID as a_AccountName, a.DisplayName as a_DisplayName, a.CCC_JDE_AddressNumber as a_AddressNum, case when a.XMarkedForDeletion > 0 then case when a.AccountDisabled = 1 then 'Disabled+Deleted' else 'Enabled+Deleted' end else case when a.AccountDisabled = 1 then 'Disabled' else 'Enabled' end end as a_enabled, case when a.UID_TSBAccountDef is null then 'Unmanaged' else case when adef.XObjectKey is null then 'NoAcctDef' else 'Managed' end end as a_managed, (select count(*) from UNSAccountB aa where aa.CanonicalName like 'JDE/USERS%' and aa.UID_Person = pp.UID_Person) As pp_Num_JDE_User, a.UID_UNSAccountB As a_UID_UNSAccountB, pp.UID_Person As pp_UID_Person FROM UNSAccountB a inner join Person pp on a.UID_Person = pp.UID_Person inner join Department d on pp.UID_Department = d.UID_Department left outer join ( select paf.XObjectKey, paf.UID_Person, paf.XIsInEffect, paf.XOrigin, paf.XMarkedForDeletion from TSBAccountDef af inner join PersonHasTSBAccountDef paf on af.UID_TSBAccountDef = paf.UID_TSBAccountDef where af.Ident_TSBAccountDef = 'JDE Account Def' ) adef on adef.UID_Person = pp.UID_Person where 1=1 AND a.CanonicalName like 'JDE/USERS%' UNION SELECT 'zzzzzz' as pp_InternalName, '' as pp_CentralAccount, '' as emp_active, a2.ObjectGUID as a_AccountName, a2.DisplayName as a_DisplayName, a2.CCC_JDE_AddressNumber as a_AddressNum, case when a2.XMarkedForDeletion > 0 then case when a2.AccountDisabled = 1 then 'Disabled+Deleted' else 'Enabled+Deleted' end else case when a2.AccountDisabled = 1 then 'Disabled' else 'Enabled' end end as a_enabled, case when a2.UID_TSBAccountDef is null then 'Unmanaged' else 'NoAcctDef' end as a_managed, 0 As pp_Num_JDE_User, a2.UID_UNSAccountB As a_UID_UNSAccountB, '' As pp_UID_Person FROM UNSAccountB a2 where 1=1 AND a2.CanonicalName like 'JDE/USERS%' AND a2.UID_Person is NULL ) SELECT pp_InternalName as "Employee: Name", pp_CentralAccount as "Employee: CentralAccount", emp_active as "Employee: Active/Inactive", pp_Num_JDE_User as "Employee: Num JDE-User Accounts Assigned", a_AccountName as "JDE-User: AccountName", a_DisplayName as "JDE-User: DisplayName", a_AddressNum as "JDE-User: AddressBookNum", a_AccountName + '/' + a_enabled + '/' + a_managed as "Account/Enabled/Managed", pp_UID_Person As UID_Person, a_UID_UNSAccountB As UID_UNSAccountB FROM RPT ORDER BY pp_InternalName, A_DISPLAYNAME;

with rpt as ( select p.InternalName + ' (' + p.CentralAccount + ')' As P_Name, p.IsInActive As P_Inactive, p.IsTemporaryDeactivated As P_TemporaryDeactivated, p.CCC_Retain_O365 As P_RetainO365, a.SAMAccountName As AD_Name, a.AccountDisabled As AD_Disabled, --a.XMarkedForDeletion As AD_XMarkedForDeletion, case when a.XMarkedForDeletion & dbo.QBM_FGIBitPatternXMarkedForDel('|OutStanding|', 0) > 0 then case when a.XMarkedForDeletion & dbo.QBM_FGIBitPatternXMarkedForDel('|Delay|', 0) > 0 then 'outstanding+def-del' else 'outstanding' end else case when a.XMarkedForDeletion & dbo.QBM_FGIBitPatternXMarkedForDel('|Delay|', 0) > 0 then 'def-del' else '' end end As AD_DeletionState, aa.DisplayName As AA_Name, aa.AccountDisabled As AA_Disabled, --aa.XMarkedForDeletion As AA_XMarkedForDeletion, case when aa.XMarkedForDeletion & dbo.QBM_FGIBitPatternXMarkedForDel('|OutStanding|', 0) > 0 then case when aa.XMarkedForDeletion & dbo.QBM_FGIBitPatternXMarkedForDel('|Delay|', 0) > 0 then 'outstanding+def-del' else 'outstanding' end else case when aa.XMarkedForDeletion & dbo.QBM_FGIBitPatternXMarkedForDel('|Delay|', 0) > 0 then 'def-del' else '' end end As AA_DeletionState, m.DisplayName As EX_Name, m.ArchiveState As EX_ArchiveState, m.RemoteRecipientType as EX_MailboxType, --m.XMarkedForDeletion As AA_XMarkedForDeletion, case when m.XMarkedForDeletion & dbo.QBM_FGIBitPatternXMarkedForDel('|OutStanding|', 0) > 0 then case when m.XMarkedForDeletion & dbo.QBM_FGIBitPatternXMarkedForDel('|Delay|', 0) > 0 then 'outstanding+def-del' else 'outstanding' end else case when m.XMarkedForDeletion & dbo.QBM_FGIBitPatternXMarkedForDel('|Delay|', 0) > 0 then 'def-del' else '' end end As EX_DeletionState, u.DisplayName As U_Name, --u.XMarkedForDeletion As AA_XMarkedForDeletion, case when u.XMarkedForDeletion & dbo.QBM_FGIBitPatternXMarkedForDel('|OutStanding|', 0) > 0 then case when u.XMarkedForDeletion & dbo.QBM_FGIBitPatternXMarkedForDel('|Delay|', 0) > 0 then 'outstanding+def-del' else 'outstanding' end else case when u.XMarkedForDeletion & dbo.QBM_FGIBitPatternXMarkedForDel('|Delay|', 0) > 0 then 'def-del' else '' end end As U_DeletionState from Person p left outer join ADSAccount a on a.UID_Person = p.UID_Person AND a.SAMAccountName = p.CentralAccount left outer join AADUser aa on aa.UID_Person = p.UID_Person AND aa.OnPremSid = a.ObjectSID left outer join EXHRemoteMailbox m on m.UID_Person = p.UID_Person left outer join O3EMailUser u on u.UID_Person = p.UID_Person where isnull(a.SAMAccountName,'') + isnull(aa.DisplayName, '') + isnull(m.DisplayName,'') + isnull(u.Name,'') <> '' ) select P_Name As "Person: Name", P_Inactive As "Person: Inactive", P_TemporaryDeactivated As "Person: TempDisabled", P_RetainO365 As "Person: RetainOffice", AD_Name As "AD-Acct: Name", AD_Disabled As "AD-Acct: Disabled", AD_DeletionState As "AD-Acct: Deletion-State", AA_Name As "Azure-Acct: Name", AA_Disabled As "Azure-Acct: Disabled", AA_DeletionState As "Azure-Acct: Deletion-State", EX_Name As "Exchg: Name", EX_ArchiveState As "Exchg: ArchiveState", EX_MailboxType As "Exchg: MailboxType", EX_DeletionState As "Exchg: Deletion-State", U_Name As "ExUser: Name", U_DeletionState As "ExUser: Deletion-State" from rpt where P_Inactive = 1 and P_RetainO365 = 1 order by 1;

SELECTX(<SQL:AWIAMSQL01.IMCD.NL/OneIM>,OneIM,,V7) <DEFAULT> AS "Employees Name", <DBLOOKUP(<SQL:IMCD>) "dbo.PersonHasESet" "XOrigin, <DBLOOKUP(<SQL:IMCD>) \"dbo.ESet\" \"UID_ESetType, Ident_ESet\" \"UID_ESetType EQ \\\"420d3c4e-88dc-43c4-9803-125a5873fa21\\\"\" \"\" \"UID_ESet\">"> FROM dbo.Person ORDER BY InternalName;

WITH rpt AS ( select o.OperationDate, o.OperationUser, case when a.UID_ADSAccount is not null then a.CanonicalName else pp.InternalName end as 'ObjectName', c.ColumnName, p.ContentShort from DialogWatchOperation o inner join DialogWatchProperty p on o.UID_DialogWatchOperation = p.UID_DialogWatchOperation inner join DialogColumn c on p.UID_DialogColumn = c.UID_DialogColumn left outer join ADSAccount a on o.ObjectKeyOfRow = a.XObjectKey AND a.CanonicalName = 'cenet.ict/Site Heteren/Users/Jeroen Ras' left outer join Person pp on o.ObjectKeyOfRow = pp.XObjectKey AND pp.InternalName = 'Ras, Jeroen' where (a.UID_ADSAccount is not null) or (pp.UID_Person is not null) ) select OperationDate As "Change Date", OperationUser as "ChangedBy", ObjectName as "Object Changed", ColumnName as "Column Name", ContentShort as "Previous Value" from RPT order by OperationDate desc, COLUMNNAME;

WITH rpt AS ( select o.OperationDate, o.OperationUser, case when a.UID_ADSAccount is not null then a.CanonicalName else pp.InternalName end as 'ObjectName', c.ColumnName, p.ContentShort from DialogWatchOperation o inner join DialogWatchProperty p on o.UID_DialogWatchOperation = p.UID_DialogWatchOperation inner join DialogColumn c on p.UID_DialogColumn = c.UID_DialogColumn left outer join ADSAccount a on o.ObjectKeyOfRow = a.XObjectKey AND a.CanonicalName = 'cenet.ict/Site Heteren/Users/Jeroen Ras' left outer join Person pp on o.ObjectKeyOfRow = pp.XObjectKey AND pp.InternalName = 'Ras, Jeroen' where (a.UID_ADSAccount is not null) or (pp.UID_Person is not null) ) select OperationDate As "Change Date", OperationUser as "ChangedBy", ObjectName as "Object Changed", ColumnName as "Column Name", ContentShort as "Previous Value" from RPT order by OperationDate desc, COLUMNNAME;

WITH RPT AS ( select o.OperationDate, o.OperationUser, pp.InternalName, pp.CentralAccount, pp.ImportSource, p.ContentShort from DialogWatchOperation o inner join DialogWatchProperty p on o.UID_DialogWatchOperation = p.UID_DialogWatchOperation inner join DialogColumn c on p.UID_DialogColumn = c.UID_DialogColumn And c.ColumnName = 'ImportSource' inner join Person pp on o.ObjectKeyOfRow = pp.XObjectKey ), RPT2 As ( select * from RPT r1 where (select count(*) from RPT r3 where r1.InternalName = r3.InternalName) > 1 ) select InternalName + ' (' + CentralAccount + ')' As "Employee", OperationDate As "Change Date", ImportSource As "Current Import Source", ContentShort as "Previous Value" from RPT2 order by InternalName, OPERATIONDATE desc;

WITH RPT AS ( select o.OperationDate, o.OperationUser, pp.InternalName, pp.CentralAccount, pp.ImportSource, p.ContentShort from DialogWatchOperation o inner join DialogWatchProperty p on o.UID_DialogWatchOperation = p.UID_DialogWatchOperation inner join DialogColumn c on p.UID_DialogColumn = c.UID_DialogColumn And c.ColumnName = 'ImportSource' inner join Person pp on o.ObjectKeyOfRow = pp.XObjectKey ), RPT2 As ( select * from RPT r1 where (select count(*) from RPT r3 where r1.InternalName = r3.InternalName) > 1 ) select InternalName + ' (' + CentralAccount + ')' As "Employee", OperationDate As "Change Date", ImportSource As "Current Import Source", ContentShort as "Previous Value" from RPT order by InternalName, OPERATIONDATE desc;

WITH sys_types AS ( select 'SYSTEM' As Owner, n.Ident_DPRNameSpace As SystemType, n.DisplayName as SyncProject from DPRNameSpace n where dbo.QBM_FCVGUIDToModuleOwner(n.UID_DPRNameSpace) in (select q.ModuleName from QBMModuleDef q where q.ModuleName <> 'CCC') AND n.Ident_DPRNameSpace <> 'OneIM' union select 'CCC' As Owner, SystemType, n.DisplayName as SyncProject from DPRNameSpace n inner join DPRSchema h on n.Ident_DPRNameSpace = h.SystemType where dbo.QBM_FCVGUIDToModuleOwner(n.UID_DPRNameSpace) = 'CCC' AND h.SystemType <> 'OneIM' union select 'SPEC' As Owner, SystemType, case SystemType when 'SCV' then 'CSV Connector' when 'DB' then 'Generic database connector' when 'Posh' then 'Windows Powershell Connector' else SystemType + ' Connector' end as SyncProject from DPRSchema where not SystemType in (select Ident_DPRNameSpace from DPRNameSpace) AND SystemType <> 'OneIM' union select 'ONEIM' As Owner, 'OneIM' As SystemType, 'One Identity Connector' as SyncProject ), projs AS ( --- also display sync types w/o projects select distinct n.Owner, n.SyncProject, s.DisplayName, s.Description, c.DisplayNameQualified, s.UID_DPRShell from sys_types n left outer join DPRSchema h on n.SystemType = h.SystemType left outer join DPRSystemConnection c on c.UID_DPRSchema = h.UID_DPRSchema and c.Name <> 'MainConnection' left outer join DPRShell s on c.UID_DPRShell = s.UID_DPRShell ), norm_projs AS ( --- also display sync types w/o projects select n.Owner, n.SyncProject, s.DisplayName, s.Description, c.DisplayNameQualified, s.UID_DPRShell from sys_types n left outer join DPRSchema h on n.SystemType = h.SystemType left outer join DPRSystemConnection c on c.UID_DPRSchema = h.UID_DPRSchema and c.Name <> 'MainConnection' left outer join DPRShell s on c.UID_DPRShell = s.UID_DPRShell where n.Owner = 'SYSTEM' or n.Owner = 'CCC' ), spec_projs AS ( select n.Owner, n.SyncProject, s.DisplayName, s.Description, c.DisplayNameQualified, s.UID_DPRShell from sys_types n inner join DPRSchema h on h.SystemType = n.SystemType inner join DPRSystemConnection c on c.UID_DPRSchema = h.UID_DPRSchema and c.Name <> 'MainConnection' inner join DPRShell s on c.UID_DPRShell = s.UID_DPRShell where n.Owner = 'SPEC' ), oneim_projs As ( select n.Owner, n.SyncProject, s.DisplayName, s.Description, c.DisplayNameQualified, s.UID_DPRShell from sys_types n inner join DPRSchema h on h.SystemType = n.SystemType inner join DPRSystemConnection c on c.UID_DPRSchema = h.UID_DPRSchema and c.Name <> 'MainConnection' inner join DPRShell s on c.UID_DPRShell = s.UID_DPRShell where exists (select top 1 1 from DPRSchema ss where ss.UID_DPRShell = h.UID_DPRShell and ss.SystemType = 'OneIM') AND not exists (select top 1 1 from DPRSchema ss where ss.UID_DPRShell = h.UID_DPRShell and ss.SystemType <> 'OneIM') ), sinfo As ( select p.SyncProject, p.Owner, p.DisplayName, p.Description, p.DisplayNameQualified As Connection, s.DisplayName As StartupInfo, s.XObjectKey from projs p left outer join DPRProjectionStartInfo s on p.UID_DPRShell = s.UID_DPRShell ) select StartupInfo, SyncProject, DisplayName, Description, Connection, XObjectKey as StartupInfoXObjectKey from sinfo where StartupInfo is not null order by 1, 2, 3;

norm_projs AS ( --- also display sync types w/o projects select n.Owner, n.SyncProject, s.DisplayName, s.Description, c.DisplayNameQualified, s.UID_DPRShell from sys_types n left outer join DPRSchema h on n.SystemType = h.SystemType left outer join DPRSystemConnection c on c.UID_DPRSchema = h.UID_DPRSchema and c.Name <> 'MainConnection' left outer join DPRShell s on c.UID_DPRShell = s.UID_DPRShell where n.Owner = 'SYSTEM' or n.Owner = 'CCC' ), spec_projs AS ( select n.Owner, n.SyncProject, s.DisplayName, s.Description, c.DisplayNameQualified, s.UID_DPRShell from sys_types n inner join DPRSchema h on h.SystemType = n.SystemType inner join DPRSystemConnection c on c.UID_DPRSchema = h.UID_DPRSchema and c.Name <> 'MainConnection' inner join DPRShell s on c.UID_DPRShell = s.UID_DPRShell where from DPRSchema ss where ss.UID_DPRShell = h.UID_DPRShell and ss.SystemType = 'OneIM') AND not exists (select top 1 1 from DPRSchema ss where ss.UID_DPRShell = h.UID_DPRShell and ss.SystemType <> with eset_grp As ( select e.UID_ESet, g.CanonicalName from eset e inner join ESetHasEntitlement et on e.UID_ESet = et.UID_ESet inner join UNSGroupB g on et.Entitlement = g.XObjectKey AND g.CanonicalName like 'JDE/%' union select e.UID_ESet, g.CanonicalName from eset e inner join ESetHasEntitlement et on e.UID_ESet = et.UID_ESet inner join UNSGroupB1 g on et.Entitlement = g.XObjectKey AND g.CanonicalName like 'JDE/%' ), RPT as ( select ac.XDateUpdated, ac.DisplayName, p.InternalName, p.CentralAccount, p.IsInActive, d.DepartmentName, e.Ident_ESet, stuff( (SELECT ' | ' + CanonicalName FROM eset_grp eg WHERE eg.UID_ESet = e.UID_ESet ORDER BY CanonicalName FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE).value('.', 'varchar(max)') ,1, 3, '') AS grp_list, ac.IsClosed, ac.IsGranted, isnull(pe.XIsInEffect, 0) PersHasESetIsInEffect FROM [OneIM].[dbo].[AttestationCase] ac inner join Person p left outer join Department d on p.UID_Department =d.UID_Department on ac.ObjectKey1 = p.XObjectKey inner join ESet e on ac.ObjectKey2 = e.XObjectKey left outer join PersonHasESet pe on pe.UID_Person = p.UID_Person and e.UID_ESet = pe.UID_ESet ) select XDateUpdated as "Attested On", DisplayName as "Attestation", InternalName as "Employee", CentralAccount as "Employee Central-Account", DepartmentName as "Employee Department", IsInactive as "Employee Disabled", Ident_ESet as "System Role", grp_list as "Groups", IsClosed as "Was Attested", IsGranted as "Granted (not canceled)", PersHasESetIsInEffect as "Person Has ESet is InEffect" from RPT order by XDateUpdated desc, INTERNALNAME;

with rpt as ( select p.InternalName + ' (' + p.CentralAccount + ')' as Employee, case when p.IsInActive = 1 then 'Disabled' else 'Enabled' end as EmployeeState, d.DepartmentName, e.Ident_ESet from PersonHasESet pe inner join Person p on p.UID_Person = pe.UID_Person left outer join Department d on p.UID_Department = d.UID_Department inner join ESet e on pe.UID_ESet = e.UID_ESet where pe.UID_ESet in (select UID_ESet from ESet e2 where exists (select top 1 1 from ESetHasEntitlement ee where e2.UID_ESet = ee.UID_ESet AND ee.Entitlement in (select XObjectKey from UNSGroupB1 where CanonicalName like 'JDE/%'))) ) select Employee, EmployeeState as "Employee Status", DepartmentName as "Company", Ident_ESet as "Enviromnent System Role" from rpt order by Employee, IDENT_ESET;

SELECTX(<SQL:IMCD>) <DEFAULT> AS "Employees Name", <DBLOOKUP "dbo.[BaseTree]" "<DEFAULT>[Company]" "" "" "UID_Department=UID_Org"> FROM Person ORDER BY InternalName INNER_JOIN_ON UID_Person with rpt as ( select e.Ident_ESet, p.UID_Person from PersonHasESet pe inner join Person p on p.UID_Person = pe.UID_Person left outer join Department d on p.UID_Department = d.UID_Department inner join ESet e on pe.UID_ESet = e.UID_ESet where pe.UID_ESet in (select UID_ESet from ESet e2 where exists (select top 1 1 from ESetHasEntitlement ee where e2.UID_ESet = ee.UID_ESet AND ee.Entitlement in (select XObjectKey from UNSGroupB1 where CanonicalName like 'JDE/%'))) ) selectx(<SQL:IMCD>) Ident_ESet as "Enviromnent System Role" from rpt order by Ident_ESet;

select InternalName as "Employee", CentralAccount from Person where isnull(ExitDate, '') = '' and IsInActive = 1 order by 1 JOIN_ON UID_Person=p.UID_Person WITH RPT AS ( select w.OperationDate, c.ColumnName, y.ContentShort as PreviousValue from Person p left outer join DialogWatchOperation w on w.ObjectKeyOfRow = p.XObjectKey left outer join DialogWatchProperty y on w.UID_DialogWatchOperation = y.UID_DialogWatchOperation left outer join DialogColumn c on y.UID_DialogColumn = c.UID_DialogColumn where <JOIN_FILTER> ) select OperationDate as "Change Date", ColumnName as "Column Name", ContentShort as "Previous Value" from RPT order by OperationDate desc, COLUMNNAME;

Query.SQL: select InternalName as "Employee", CentralAccount from Person where isnull(ExitDate, '') = '' and IsInActive = 1 order by 1 JOIN_ON UID_Person=p.UID_Person WITH RPT AS ( select w.OperationDate, c.ColumnName, y.ContentShort from Person p left outer join DialogWatchOperation w on w.ObjectKeyOfRow = p.XObjectKey left outer join DialogWatchProperty y on w.UID_DialogWatchOperation = y.UID_DialogWatchOperation left outer join DialogColumn c on y.UID_DialogColumn = c.UID_DialogColumn where <JOIN_FILTER> ) select OperationDate as "Change Date", ColumnName as "Column Name", ContentShort as "Previous Value" from RPT order by OperationDate desc, COLUMNNAME;

with RPT as ( select p.InternalName as pInternalName, p.ExitDate as pExitDate, a.SAMAccountName as aSAMAccountName, a.UserPrincipalName as aUserPrincipalName, case when a.AccountDisabled = 1 then 'True' else 'False' end as aAccountDisabled, c.CanonicalName as cCanonicalName, r.RecipientTypeDetails as rRecipientTypeDetails, o.RecipientTypeDetails as oRecipientTypeDetails, case when p.ExitDate > '2000-01-01' and a.AccountDisabled = 1 and c.CanonicalName like '%Shared Mailbox' and r.RecipientTypeDetails like '%SharedMailbox' and o.UID_O3EMailbox is null then 'OK' else 'BAD'end as MbxStatus from Person p left outer join ADSAccount a on a.UID_Person = p.UID_Person left outer join ADSContainer c on a.UID_ADSContainer = c.UID_ADSContainer left outer join EXHRemoteMailbox r on r.UID_Person = p.UID_Person left outer join O3EMailbox o on o.UID_Person = p.UID_Person where p.CCC_Retain_O365 = 1 and p.IsInActive = 1 ) select MbxStatus as "Conversion Status", pExitDate as "Leaving Date", pInternalName as "Disabled Employee", aSAMAccountName as "AD Account", aAccountDisabled as "AD Acccount Disabled", cCanonicalName as "AD Container", aUserPrincipalName as "UPN", rRecipientTypeDetails as "Remote Mailbox Type", oRecipientTypeDetails as "Online Mailbox Type" from RPT order by pExitDate desc;

with RPT as ( select p.InternalName as pInternalName, p.ExitDate as pExitDate, a.SAMAccountName as aSAMAccountName, a.UserPrincipalName as aUserPrincipalName, case when a.AccountDisabled = 1 then 'True' else 'False' end as aAccountDisabled, c.CanonicalName as cCanonicalName, r.DisplayName as rDisplayName, r.RecipientTypeDetails as rRecipientTypeDetails, o.RecipientTypeDetails as oRecipientTypeDetails, case when p.ExitDate > '2000-01-01' and a.AccountDisabled = 1 and c.CanonicalName like '%Shared Mailbox' and r.RecipientTypeDetails like '%SharedMailbox' and o.UID_O3EMailbox is null then 'OK' else 'BAD'end as MbxStatus from Person p left outer join ADSAccount a on a.UID_Person = p.UID_Person left outer join ADSContainer c on a.UID_ADSContainer = c.UID_ADSContainer left outer join EXHRemoteMailbox r on r.UID_Person = p.UID_Person left outer join O3EMailbox o on o.UID_Person = p.UID_Person where p.CCC_Retain_O365 = 1 and p.IsInActive = 1 ) select MbxStatus as "Conversion Status", pExitDate as "Leaving Date", pInternalName as "Disabled Employee", aSAMAccountName as "AD Account", aAccountDisabled as "AD Acccount Disabled", cCanonicalName as "AD Container", aUserPrincipalName as "UPN", rDisplayName as "Mailbox", rRecipientTypeDetails as "Remote Mailbox Type", oRecipientTypeDetails as "Online Mailbox Type" from RPT order by pExitDate desc;

with RPT as ( select p.InternalName as pInternalName, p.ExitDate as pExitDate, a.SAMAccountName as aSAMAccountName, aa.DisplayName as aaDisplayName, case when a.AccountDisabled = 1 then 'True' else 'False' end as aAccountDisabled, c.CanonicalName as cCanonicalName, r.DisplayName as rDisplayName, r.RecipientTypeDetails as rRecipientTypeDetails, o.RecipientTypeDetails as oRecipientTypeDetails, case when p.ExitDate > '2000-01-01' and a.AccountDisabled = 1 and c.CanonicalName like '%Shared Mailbox' and r.RecipientTypeDetails like '%SharedMailbox' and o.UID_O3EMailbox is null then 'OK' else 'BAD'end as MbxStatus from Person p left outer join ADSAccount a on a.UID_Person = p.UID_Person left outer join AADUser aa on aa.UID_Person = p.UID_Person left outer join ADSContainer c on a.UID_ADSContainer = c.UID_ADSContainer left outer join EXHRemoteMailbox r on r.UID_Person = p.UID_Person left outer join O3EMailbox o on o.UID_AADUser = aa.UID_AADUser where p.CCC_Retain_O365 = 1 and p.IsInActive = 1 ) select MbxStatus as "Conversion Status", pExitDate as "Leaving Date", pInternalName as "Disabled Employee", aSAMAccountName as "AD Account", aAccountDisabled as "AD Acccount Disabled", cCanonicalName as "AD Container", aaDisplayName as "Azure AD Account", rDisplayName as "Mailbox", rRecipientTypeDetails as "Remote Mailbox Type", oRecipientTypeDetails as "Online Mailbox Type" from RPT order by pExitDate desc;

with RPT as ( select p.InternalName as pInternalName, p.ExitDate as pExitDate, a.SAMAccountName as aSAMAccountName, aa.DisplayName as aaDisplayName, case when a.AccountDisabled = 1 then 'True' else 'False' end as aAccountDisabled, c.CanonicalName as cCanonicalName, r.DisplayName as rDisplayName, r.RecipientTypeDetails as rRecipientTypeDetails, o.RecipientTypeDetails as oRecipientTypeDetails, case when p.ExitDate > '2000-01-01' and a.AccountDisabled = 1 and c.CanonicalName like '%Shared Mailbox' and isnull(r.RecipientTypeDetails,'') like '%SharedMailbox' and isnull(o.RecipientTypeDetails,'') like '%SharedMailbox' then 'OK' else 'BAD'end as MbxStatus from Person p left outer join ADSAccount a on a.UID_Person = p.UID_Person left outer join AADUser aa on aa.UID_Person = p.UID_Person left outer join ADSContainer c on a.UID_ADSContainer = c.UID_ADSContainer left outer join EXHRemoteMailbox r on r.UID_Person = p.UID_Person left outer join O3EMailbox o on o.UID_AADUser = aa.UID_AADUser where p.CCC_Retain_O365 = 1 and p.IsInActive = 1 ) select MbxStatus as "Conversion Status", pExitDate as "Leaving Date", pInternalName as "Disabled Employee", aSAMAccountName as "AD Account", aAccountDisabled as "AD Acccount Disabled", cCanonicalName as "AD Container", aaDisplayName as "Azure AD Account", rDisplayName as "Mailbox", rRecipientTypeDetails as "Remote Mailbox Type", oRecipientTypeDetails as "Online Mailbox Type" from RPT order by pExitDate desc;

with rpt as ( select p.InternalName, p.IsInActive As Pers_Diabled, p.CustomProperty08 as Pers_JDE_Addr, a.ObjectGUID as JDE_User, a.AccountDisabled as JDE_User_Disabled, a.CCC_JDE_Disabled as JDE_User_Disabled_in_JDE, a.CCC_JDE_AddressNumber as JDE_User_Addr, case when a.AccountDisabled = 0 and a.CCC_JDE_Disabled = 0 then 'Enabled in 1IM and JDE' when a.AccountDisabled = 1 and a.CCC_JDE_Disabled = 1 then 'Disabled in 1IM and JDE' when a.AccountDisabled = 0 and a.CCC_JDE_Disabled = 1 then 'Enabled in 1IM - Disabled in JDE <<< Provisioning Error ?' when a.AccountDisabled = 1 and a.CCC_JDE_Disabled = 0 then 'Disabled in 1IM - Enabled in JDE <<< SECURITY RISK' end as JDE_Enabled_Status from UNSAccountB a inner join Person p on a.UID_Person = p.UID_Person where a.CanonicalName like 'JDE/USERS/%' ), rpt2 as ( select JDE_Enabled_Status As 'JDE Status Analysis', InternalName As 'Employee', Pers_Diabled as 'Employee - Disabled', Pers_JDE_Addr as 'Employee - JDE Address Book Number', JDE_User As 'JDE User', JDE_User_Disabled As 'JDE User Disabled', JDE_User_Disabled_in_JDE As 'JDE User Disabled in JDE', JDE_User_Addr As 'JDE Address Book Number' from rpt --order by 1, 4 ) select * from rpt2 where not ([JDE Status Analysis] like '% in 1IM and JDE') order by 1, 2, 5;

select p.InternalName, p.IsInActive As Pers_Diabled, p.CustomProperty08 as Pers_JDE_Addr, a.ObjectGUID as JDE_User, a.AccountDisabled as JDE_User_Disabled, a.CCC_JDE_Disabled as JDE_User_Disabled_in_JDE, a.CCC_JDE_AddressNumber as JDE_User_Addr from Person p inner join UNSAccountB a on p.UID_Person = a.UID_Person where p.CustomProperty08 <> a.CCC_JDE_AddressNumber and a.CanonicalName like 'JDE/USERS/%' and a.UID_TSBAccountDef is not null order by 1, 4;

WITH chgs AS ( select o.ObjectKeyOfRow AS ObjectKey, dc.Caption AS ColumnName, COUNT(*) AS cnt from [dbo].DialogWatchProperty d INNER JOIN [dbo].DialogWatchOperation o ON o.UID_DialogWatchOperation = d.UID_DialogWatchOperation INNER JOIN [dbo].[DialogColumn] dc ON d.UID_DialogColumn = dc.UID_DialogColumn INNER JOIN [dbo].[Person] a1 ON o.ObjectKeyOfRow = a1.XObjectKey WHERE d.UID_DialogColumn in (SELECT UID_DialogColumn FROM [dbo].[DialogColumn] c0 INNER JOIN DialogTable t0 ON c0.UID_DialogTable = t0.UID_DialogTable WHERE t0.TableName = 'Person' And (c0.ColumnName in ('CustomProperty08'))) -- AND a1.SAMAccountName in ('PonceletM','VochtenS','AldingerT') -- AND ((a1.CanonicalName like '%rabt%') or (a1.CanonicalName like '%rabp%') or (a1.CanonicalName like '%rabx%')) -- AND a1.CanonicalName in ('Wibowo, A (Ardi)','Widjaja, N (Nanny)','Darmaji, D (Didit)','Andridina, A (Abhimata)') -- AND o.OperationDate > '2016-11-04 18:00:00' GROUP BY o.ObjectKeyOfRow, dc.Caption ), accts AS ( SELECT distinct a.InternalName + ' (' + a.CentralAccount + ')' as Person, a.CustomProperty08 as CurrAddrNum, a.XObjectKey as XObjectKey FROM chgs c INNER JOIN [dbo].[Person] a ON c.ObjectKey = a.XObjectKey ) SELECT Person As "Identity", CurrAddrNum as "Current JDE Addr-Num", XObjectKey FROM accts ORDER BY PERSON JOIN_ON XObjectKey=aa.XObjectKey with rq as ( select aa.XObjectKey from [dbo].[Person] aa where <JOIN_FILTER> ), chg_records AS ( select dc2.Caption as COL, Row_Number() OVER (PARTITION BY dc2.Caption ORDER BY o2.OperationDate ASC) AS ROW_NUM, CASE (Row_Number() OVER (PARTITION BY dc2.Caption ORDER BY o2.OperationDate ASC)) WHEN 1 THEN 'Initial Value' ELSE 'Change' END AS CHG_TYPE, o2.OperationDate AS OPERATION_DATE, o2.OperationUser AS OPERATION_USER, CASE (Row_Number() OVER (PARTITION BY dc2.Caption ORDER BY o2.OperationDate ASC)) WHEN 1 THEN '---' ELSE cast(d2.ContentShort as nvarchar(1024)) END AS PREV_VAL, CASE (Row_Number() OVER (PARTITION BY dc2.Caption ORDER BY o2.OperationDate DESC)) WHEN 1 THEN CASE dc2.ColumnName WHEN 'CustomProperty08' THEN p2.CustomProperty08 -- WHEN 'RAB_ExpectedJobEndDate' THEN p2.RAB_ExpectedJobEndDate END ELSE cast((LAG(d2.ContentShort) OVER (PARTITION BY dc2.Caption ORDER BY o2.OperationDate DESC)) as nvarchar(1024)) END AS NEXT_VAL from rq, [dbo].DialogWatchProperty d2 INNER JOIN [dbo].DialogWatchOperation o2 ON o2.UID_DialogWatchOperation = d2.UID_DialogWatchOperation INNER JOIN [dbo].[Person] p2 ON o2.ObjectKeyOfRow = p2.XObjectKey INNER JOIN [dbo].[DialogColumn] dc2 ON d2.UID_DialogColumn = dc2.UID_DialogColumn WHERE d2.UID_DialogColumn in (SELECT UID_DialogColumn FROM [dbo].[DialogColumn] c0 INNER JOIN DialogTable t0 ON c0.UID_DialogTable = t0.UID_DialogTable WHERE t0.TableName = 'Person' And (c0.ColumnName in ('CustomProperty08'))) AND rq.XObjectKey = o2.ObjectKeyOfRow -- ORDER BY o2.OperationDate DESC ) SELECT COL AS "Column", CHG_TYPE AS "Type of Change", OPERATION_DATE AS "Change Date", OPERATION_USER AS "Changed By", PREV_VAL AS "Old Value", NEXT_VAL AS "New Value" FROM chg_records order BY COL, ROW_NUM DESC;

WITH chgs AS ( select o.ObjectKeyOfRow AS ObjectKey, dc.Caption AS ColumnName, COUNT(*) AS cnt from [dbo].DialogWatchProperty d INNER JOIN [dbo].DialogWatchOperation o ON o.UID_DialogWatchOperation = d.UID_DialogWatchOperation INNER JOIN [dbo].[DialogColumn] dc ON d.UID_DialogColumn = dc.UID_DialogColumn INNER JOIN [dbo].[Person] a1 ON o.ObjectKeyOfRow = a1.XObjectKey WHERE d.UID_DialogColumn in (SELECT UID_DialogColumn FROM [dbo].[DialogColumn] c0 INNER JOIN DialogTable t0 ON c0.UID_DialogTable = t0.UID_DialogTable WHERE t0.TableName = 'Person' And (c0.ColumnName in ('CustomProperty08'))) -- AND a1.SAMAccountName in ('PonceletM','VochtenS','AldingerT') -- AND ((a1.CanonicalName like '%rabt%') or (a1.CanonicalName like '%rabp%') or (a1.CanonicalName like '%rabx%')) -- AND a1.CanonicalName in ('Wibowo, A (Ardi)','Widjaja, N (Nanny)','Darmaji, D (Didit)','Andridina, A (Abhimata)') -- AND o.OperationDate > '2016-11-04 18:00:00' GROUP BY o.ObjectKeyOfRow, dc.Caption HAVING COUNT(*) > 2 ), accts AS ( SELECT distinct a.InternalName + ' (' + a.CentralAccount + ')' as Person, a.CustomProperty08 as CurrAddrNum, a.XObjectKey as XObjectKey FROM chgs c INNER JOIN [dbo].[Person] a ON c.ObjectKey = a.XObjectKey ) SELECT Person As "Identity", CurrAddrNum as "Current JDE Addr-Num", XObjectKey FROM accts ORDER BY PERSON JOIN_ON XObjectKey=aa.XObjectKey with rq as ( select aa.XObjectKey from [dbo].[Person] aa where <JOIN_FILTER> ), chg_records AS ( select dc2.Caption as COL, Row_Number() OVER (PARTITION BY dc2.Caption ORDER BY o2.OperationDate ASC) AS ROW_NUM, CASE (Row_Number() OVER (PARTITION BY dc2.Caption ORDER BY o2.OperationDate ASC)) WHEN 1 THEN 'Initial Value' ELSE 'Change' END AS CHG_TYPE, o2.OperationDate AS OPERATION_DATE, o2.OperationUser AS OPERATION_USER, CASE (Row_Number() OVER (PARTITION BY dc2.Caption ORDER BY o2.OperationDate ASC)) WHEN 1 THEN '---' ELSE cast(d2.ContentShort as nvarchar(1024)) END AS PREV_VAL, CASE (Row_Number() OVER (PARTITION BY dc2.Caption ORDER BY o2.OperationDate DESC)) WHEN 1 THEN CASE dc2.ColumnName WHEN 'CustomProperty08' THEN p2.CustomProperty08 -- WHEN 'RAB_ExpectedJobEndDate' THEN p2.RAB_ExpectedJobEndDate END ELSE cast((LAG(d2.ContentShort) OVER (PARTITION BY dc2.Caption ORDER BY o2.OperationDate DESC)) as nvarchar(1024)) END AS NEXT_VAL from rq, [dbo].DialogWatchProperty d2 INNER JOIN [dbo].DialogWatchOperation o2 ON o2.UID_DialogWatchOperation = d2.UID_DialogWatchOperation INNER JOIN [dbo].[Person] p2 ON o2.ObjectKeyOfRow = p2.XObjectKey INNER JOIN [dbo].[DialogColumn] dc2 ON d2.UID_DialogColumn = dc2.UID_DialogColumn WHERE d2.UID_DialogColumn in (SELECT UID_DialogColumn FROM [dbo].[DialogColumn] c0 INNER JOIN DialogTable t0 ON c0.UID_DialogTable = t0.UID_DialogTable WHERE t0.TableName = 'Person' And (c0.ColumnName in ('CustomProperty08'))) AND rq.XObjectKey = o2.ObjectKeyOfRow -- ORDER BY o2.OperationDate DESC ) SELECT COL AS "Column", CHG_TYPE AS "Type of Change", OPERATION_DATE AS "Change Date", OPERATION_USER AS "Changed By", PREV_VAL AS "Old Value", NEXT_VAL AS "New Value" FROM chg_records order BY COL, ROW_NUM DESC;

--- Session.Source.TryGetSingleValue("UNSAccountB", "UID_UNSAccountB", String.Format("UID_Person = '{0}' AND UID_UNSRootB = '{1}'", $UID_PersonOrdered$, values("uid_unsrootb")), values("uidUNSAccountB")) --- Session.Source.TryGetSingleValue("UNSGroupB", "UID_UNSGroupB", String.Format("DisplayName = '{0}' AND UID_UNSRootB = '{1}'", values("groupName"), values("uid_unsrootb")), values("uidUNSGroupB")) ) select Person, IsInActive As "Person Disabled", IsTemporaryDeactivated As "Person Temp-Disabled", OrderDate, DateActivated, OrderState, CustomProperty10 As "Group on PWO", AccountName, AccountDisabled, Grp, XIsInEffect, UID_PersonWantsOrg from sf_grp ug where ug.Acct is null OR ug.Grp is null Or XIsInEffect is Null Or XIsInEffect <> 1 order by Person, CUSTOMPROPERTY10, ORDERDATE DESC;

Query.Description: For all Salesforce PWO check for Acct Exists, Grp Exists, Assign Exists
Query.SQL:
WITH pwo AS ( select pwo0.DateActivated, pwo0.OrderDate, pwo0.OrderState, pwo0.DisplayOrg, pwo0.DisplayPersonOrdered, c.Ident_AccProduct, c.CCC_UID_UNSRootB, p.UID_Person As UID_Person, pwo0.CustomProperty10 As GroupName, c.CustomProperty01 As GroupType from PersonWantsOrg pwo0 inner join Person p on p.UID_Person = pwo0.UID_PersonOrdered inner join ITShopOrg o on pwo0.UID_Org = o.UID_ITShopOrg inner join AccProduct c on o.UID_AccProduct = c.UID_AccProduct inner join AccProductGroup pg on c.UID_AccProductGroup = pg.UID_AccProductGroup where (pg.Ident_AccProductGroup like 'Salesforce') AND isnull(pwo0.CustomProperty10,'') > '' ), sf_root as ( select Value As UID_UNSRootB from DialogConfigParm where FullPath = 'Custom\TargetSystems\Salesforce\UID_UNSRoot' ), sf_grp as ( select pwo.OrderDate, pwo.DateActivated, pwo.OrderState, pwo.DisplayOrg, pwo.DisplayPersonOrdered As Person, pwo.GroupName As CustomProperty10, pwo.GroupType, a.CanonicalName As Acct, a.AccountName, g.CanonicalName, g.cn As Grp, a.UID_UNSAccountB, g.UID_UNSGroupB, ug.XObjectKey As ug_XObjectKey,
case when p.XObjectKey is null then 'missing' when p.IsInActive <> 0 then case when p.IsTemporaryDeactivated <> 0 then 'inactive+temp-disabled' else 'inactive' end else case when p.IsTemporaryDeactivated <> 0 then 'temp-disabled' else 'active' end end As p_status,
case when a.XObjectKey is null then 'missing' when a.AccountDisabled <> 0 then case when a.XMarkedForDeletion & 2 > 0 then case when a.XMarkedForDeletion & 1 > 0 then 'disabled+outstanding+deleted' else 'disabled+outstanding' end else case when a.XMarkedForDeletion & 1 > 0 then 'disabled+deleted' else 'disabled' end end else case when a.XMarkedForDeletion & 2 > 0 then case when a.XMarkedForDeletion & 1 > 0 then 'enabled+outstanding+deleted' else 'enabled+outstanding' end else case when ug.XMarkedForDeletion & 1 > 0 then 'enabled+deleted' else 'enabled' end end end as a_status,
case when g.XObjectKey is null then 'missing' else case when g.XMarkedForDeletion & 2 > 0 then case when g.XMarkedForDeletion & 1 > 0 then 'outstanding+deleted' else 'outstanding' end else case when g.XMarkedForDeletion & 1 > 0 then 'deleted' else 'ok' end end end as g_status,
case when ug.XObjectKey is null then 'missing' when ug.XIsInEffect <> 1 then case when ug.XMarkedForDeletion & 2 > 0 then case when ug.XMarkedForDeletion & 1 > 0 then 'not-ineffect+outstanding+deleted' else 'not-ineffect+outstanding' end else case when ug.XMarkedForDeletion & 1 > 0 then 'not-ineffect+deleted' else 'not-ineffect' end end else case when ug.XMarkedForDeletion & 2 > 0 then case when ug.XMarkedForDeletion & 1 > 0 then 'ineffect+outstanding+deleted' else 'ineffect+outstanding' end else case when ug.XMarkedForDeletion & 1 > 0 then 'ineffect+deleted' else 'ineffect' end end end as ug_status from pwo inner join sf_root on 1=1 left outer join Person p on pwo.UID_Person = p.UID_Person left outer join UNSAccountB a on pwo.UID_Person = a.UID_Person AND a.UID_UNSRootB = sf_root.UID_UNSRootB left outer join UNSGroupB g on ((g.DisplayName = pwo.GroupName) Or (g.cn = pwo.GroupName)) AND (pwo.GroupType = g.GroupType) AND g.UID_UNSRootB = sf_root.UID_UNSRootB left outer join UNSAccountBHasUNSGroupB ug on ug.UID_UNSAccountB = a.UID_UNSAccountB AND ug.UID_UNSGroupB = g.UID_UNSGroupB --- values("groupName") = $CustomProperty10$ --- values("uid_unsrootb") = Connection.GetConfigParm("Custom\TargetSystems\Salesforce\UID_UNSRoot")
--- Session.Source.TryGetSingleValue("UNSAccountB", "UID_UNSAccountB", String.Format("UID_Person = '{0}' AND UID_UNSRootB = '{1}'", $UID_PersonOrdered$, values("uid_unsrootb")), values("uidUNSAccountB")) --- Session.Source.TryGetSingleValue("UNSGroupB", "UID_UNSGroupB", String.Format("DisplayName = '{0}' AND UID_UNSRootB = '{1}'", values("groupName"), values("uid_unsrootb")), values("uidUNSGroupB")) ) select Person As "Person", p_status As "Person Status", OrderDate As "Order Date", DateActivated As "Date Activated", OrderState As "Order State", DisplayOrg As "Product", AccountName As "Account", a_status As "Account Status", CustomProperty10 As "Group Name (pwo)", GroupType As "Group Type (AccProduct)", Grp As "Group (Group cn)", g_status As "Group Status", ug_status as "Assignment Status" from sf_grp where Acct is null OR Grp is null Or ug_XObjectKey is null order by Person, ORDERDATE desc;
