WITH chgs AS ( select o.ObjectKeyOfRow AS ObjectKey, dc.Caption AS ColumnName, COUNT(*) AS cnt from [dbo].DialogWatchProperty d INNER JOIN [dbo].DialogWatchOperation o ON o.UID_DialogWatchOperation = d.UID_DialogWatchOperation INNER JOIN [dbo].[DialogColumn] dc ON d.UID_DialogColumn = dc.UID_DialogColumn INNER JOIN [dbo].[Person] a1 ON o.ObjectKeyOfRow = a1.XObjectKey WHERE d.UID_DialogColumn in (SELECT UID_DialogColumn FROM [dbo].[DialogColumn] c0 INNER JOIN DialogTable t0 ON c0.UID_DialogTable = t0.UID_DialogTable WHERE t0.TableName = 'Person' And (c0.ColumnName in ('CustomProperty08'))) -- AND a1.SAMAccountName in ('PonceletM','VochtenS','AldingerT') -- AND ((a1.CanonicalName like '%rabt%') or (a1.CanonicalName like '%rabp%') or (a1.CanonicalName like '%rabx%')) -- AND a1.CanonicalName in ('Wibowo, A (Ardi)','Widjaja, N (Nanny)','Darmaji, D (Didit)','Andridina, A (Abhimata)') -- AND o.OperationDate > '2016-11-04 18:00:00' GROUP BY o.ObjectKeyOfRow, dc.Caption HAVING COUNT(*) > 2 ), accts AS ( SELECT distinct a.InternalName + ' (' + a.CentralAccount + ')' as Person, a.CustomProperty08 as CurrAddrNum, a.XObjectKey as XObjectKey FROM chgs c INNER JOIN [dbo].[Person] a ON c.ObjectKey = a.XObjectKey ) SELECT Person As "Identity", CurrAddrNum as "Current JDE Addr-Num", XObjectKey FROM accts ORDER BY PERSON JOIN_ON XObjectKey=aa.XObjectKey with rq as ( select aa.XObjectKey from [dbo].[Person] aa where <JOIN_FILTER> ), chg_records AS ( select dc2.Caption as COL, Row_Number() OVER (PARTITION BY dc2.Caption ORDER BY o2.OperationDate ASC) AS ROW_NUM, CASE (Row_Number() OVER (PARTITION BY dc2.Caption ORDER BY o2.OperationDate ASC)) WHEN 1 THEN 'Initial Value' ELSE 'Change' END AS CHG_TYPE, o2.OperationDate AS OPERATION_DATE, o2.OperationUser AS OPERATION_USER, CASE (Row_Number() OVER (PARTITION BY dc2.Caption ORDER BY o2.OperationDate ASC)) WHEN 1 THEN '---' ELSE cast(d2.ContentShort as nvarchar(1024)) END AS PREV_VAL, CASE (Row_Number() OVER (PARTITION BY dc2.Caption ORDER BY o2.OperationDate DESC)) WHEN 1 THEN CASE dc2.ColumnName WHEN 'CustomProperty08' THEN p2.CustomProperty08 -- WHEN 'RAB_ExpectedJobEndDate' THEN p2.RAB_ExpectedJobEndDate END ELSE cast((LAG(d2.ContentShort) OVER (PARTITION BY dc2.Caption ORDER BY o2.OperationDate DESC)) as nvarchar(1024)) END AS NEXT_VAL from rq, [dbo].DialogWatchProperty d2 INNER JOIN [dbo].DialogWatchOperation o2 ON o2.UID_DialogWatchOperation = d2.UID_DialogWatchOperation INNER JOIN [dbo].[Person] p2 ON o2.ObjectKeyOfRow = p2.XObjectKey INNER JOIN [dbo].[DialogColumn] dc2 ON d2.UID_DialogColumn = dc2.UID_DialogColumn WHERE d2.UID_DialogColumn in (SELECT UID_DialogColumn FROM [dbo].[DialogColumn] c0 INNER JOIN DialogTable t0 ON c0.UID_DialogTable = t0.UID_DialogTable WHERE t0.TableName = 'Person' And (c0.ColumnName in ('CustomProperty08'))) AND rq.XObjectKey = o2.ObjectKeyOfRow -- ORDER BY o2.OperationDate DESC ) SELECT COL AS "Column", CHG_TYPE AS "Type of Change", OPERATION_DATE AS "Change Date", OPERATION_USER AS "Changed By", PREV_VAL AS "Old Value", NEXT_VAL AS "New Value" FROM chg_records order BY COL, ROW_NUM DESC;

with rpt as ( select a.AccountName, g.cn, case when a.XMarkedForDeletion = 2 Or a.XMarkedForDeletion = 3 then 'outstanding' when a.XMarkedForDeletion = 1 then 'deleted' else 'ok' end As 'AccountStatus', case when g.XMarkedForDeletion = 2 Or g.XMarkedForDeletion = 3 then 'outstanding' when g.XMarkedForDeletion = 1 then 'deleted' else 'ok' end As 'GroupStatus', case when ag.XIsInEffect = 0 then 'not in effect' when ag.XMarkedForDeletion = 2 Or ag.XMarkedForDeletion = 3 then 'outstanding' when ag.XMarkedForDeletion = 1 then 'deleted' else 'ok' end As 'AssignStatus' from UNSAccountB a inner join UNSAccountBInUNSGroupB ag on a.UID_UNSAccountB = ag.UID_UNSAccountB inner join UNSGroupB g on ag.UID_UNSGroupB = g.UID_UNSGroupB where a.CanonicalName like 'JDE/USER%' ) select AccountName As "JDE User", cn As "Role", AccountStatus As "Account Status", GroupStatus As "Group Status", AssignStatus As "Assignment Status" from rpt order by 1, 2;

with rpt as ( select a.AccountName, g.cn, case when a.XMarkedForDeletion = 2 Or a.XMarkedForDeletion = 3 then 'outstanding' when a.XMarkedForDeletion = 1 then 'deleted' else 'ok' end As 'AccountStatus', case when g.UID_UNSGroupB is null then null when g.XMarkedForDeletion = 2 Or g.XMarkedForDeletion = 3 then 'outstanding' when g.XMarkedForDeletion = 1 then 'deleted' else 'ok' end As 'GroupStatus', case when ag.XObjectKey is null then null when ag.XIsInEffect = 0 then 'not in effect' when ag.XMarkedForDeletion = 2 Or ag.XMarkedForDeletion = 3 then 'outstanding' when ag.XMarkedForDeletion = 1 then 'deleted' else 'ok' end As 'AssignStatus', case when ag.XObjectKey is null then null when ag.XOrigin = 1 then 'direct' when ag.XOrigin = 2 or ag.XOrigin = 3 then 'indirect' else '??' end as 'TypeAssign' from UNSAccountB a left outer join UNSAccountBInUNSGroupB ag on a.UID_UNSAccountB = ag.UID_UNSAccountB left outer join UNSGroupB g on ag.UID_UNSGroupB = g.UID_UNSGroupB where a.CanonicalName like 'JDE/USER%' ) select AccountName As "JDE User", cn As "Role", AccountStatus As "Account Status", GroupStatus As "Group Status", AssignStatus As "Assignment Status", TypeAssign as "Type of Assignment" from rpt order by 1, 2;

with rpt as ( select a.AccountName, g.cn, case when a.XMarkedForDeletion = 2 Or a.XMarkedForDeletion = 3 then 'outstanding' when a.XMarkedForDeletion = 1 then 'deleted' else 'ok' end As 'AccountStatus', case when g.UID_UNSGroupB is null then null when g.XMarkedForDeletion = 2 Or g.XMarkedForDeletion = 3 then 'outstanding' when g.XMarkedForDeletion = 1 then 'deleted' else 'ok' end As 'GroupStatus', case when ag.XObjectKey is null then null when ag.XIsInEffect = 0 then 'not in effect' when ag.XMarkedForDeletion = 2 Or ag.XMarkedForDeletion = 3 then 'outstanding' when ag.XMarkedForDeletion = 1 then 'deleted' else 'ok' end As 'AssignStatus', case when ag.XObjectKey is null then null when ag.XOrigin = 1 then 'direct' when ag.XOrigin = 2 or ag.XOrigin = 3 then 'indirect' else '??' end as 'TypeAssign' from UNSAccountB a left outer join UNSAccountBInUNSGroupB ag on a.UID_UNSAccountB = ag.UID_UNSAccountB left outer join UNSGroupB g on ag.UID_UNSGroupB = g.UID_UNSGroupB where a.CanonicalName like 'JDE/USER%' ) select AccountName As "JDE User", cn As "Role", AccountStatus As "Account Status", GroupStatus As "Group Status", AssignStatus As "Assignment Status", TypeAssign as "Type of Assignment" from rpt order by 1, 2;

like '%rabp%') or (a1.CanonicalName like '%rabx%')) -- AND a1.CanonicalName in ('Wibowo, A (Ardi)','Widjaja, N (Nanny)','Darmaji, D (Didit)','Andridina, A (Abhimata)') -- AND o.OperationDate > '2016-11-04 18:00:00' GROUP BY o.ObjectKeyOfRow, dc.Caption HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ), accts AS ( SELECT distinct a.InternalName + ' (' + a.CentralAccount + ')' as Person, a.UID_DialogCountry as CurrCountryID, d.CountryName as CurrCountry, a.ExitDate as CurrExitDate, a.IsInActive as CurrIsInactive, a.ApprovalState as CurrApprovalState, a.Gender as CurrGender, a.XObjectKey as XObjectKey FROM chgs c INNER JOIN [dbo].[Person] a ON c.ObjectKey = a.XObjectKey LEFT OUTER JOIN DialogCountry d ON d.UID_DialogCountry = a.UID_DialogCountry ) SELECTX(<SQL:IMCD>) Person As "Identity", CurrCountry as "Current Country", CurrExitDate as "Current Exit Date", CurrIsInactive as "Current IsInactive", CurrApprovalState as "Current Approval State", CurrGender as "Current Gender", XObjectKey FROM accts ORDER BY Person JOIN_ON XObjectKey=aa.XObjectKey with rq as ( select aa.XObjectKey from [dbo].[Person] aa where <JOIN_FILTER> ), chg_records AS ( select dc2.Caption as COL, Row_Number() OVER (PARTITION BY dc2.Caption ORDER BY o2.OperationDate ASC) AS ROW_NUM, CASE (Row_Number() OVER (PARTITION BY dc2.Caption ORDER BY o2.OperationDate ASC)) WHEN 1 THEN 'Initial Value' ELSE 'Change' END AS CHG_TYPE, o2.OperationDate AS OPERATION_DATE, o2.OperationUser AS OPERATION_USER, CASE (Row_Number() OVER (PARTITION BY dc2.Caption ORDER BY o2.OperationDate ASC)) WHEN 1 THEN '---' ELSE CASE dc2.ColumnName WHEN 'UID_DialogCountry' THEN cast(dd.CountryName as nvarchar(1024)) ELSE cast(d2.ContentShort as nvarchar(1024)) END END AS PREV_VAL, CASE (Row_Number() OVER (PARTITION BY dc2.Caption ORDER BY o2.OperationDate DESC)) WHEN 1 THEN CASE dc2.ColumnName WHEN 'UID_DialogCountry' THEN cast(ddd.CountryName as nvarchar(1024)) WHEN 'ExitDate' THEN cast(p2.ExitDate as nvarchar(1024)) WHEN 'IsInActive' THEN cast(p2.IsInActive as nvarchar(1024)) WHEN 'ApprovalState' THEN cast(p2.ApprovalState as nvarchar(1024)) WHEN 'Gender' THEN cast(p2.Gender as nvarchar(1024)) END ELSE CASE dc2.ColumnName WHEN 'UID_DialogCountry' THEN cast((LAG(dd.CountryName) OVER (PARTITION BY dc2.Caption ORDER BY o2.OperationDate DESC)) as nvarchar(1024)) ELSE cast((LAG(d2.ContentShort) OVER (PARTITION BY dc2.Caption ORDER BY o2.OperationDate DESC)) as nvarchar(1024)) END END AS NEXT_VAL from rq, [dbo].DialogWatchProperty d2 LEFT OUTER JOIN DialogCountry dd ON d2.ContentShort = dd.UID_DialogCountry INNER JOIN [dbo].DialogWatchOperation o2 ON o2.UID_DialogWatchOperation = d2.UID_DialogWatchOperation INNER JOIN [dbo].[Person] p2 ON o2.ObjectKeyOfRow = p2.XObjectKey LEFT OUTER JOIN DialogCountry ddd ON p2.UID_DialogCountry = ddd.UID_DialogCountry INNER JOIN [dbo].[DialogColumn] dc2 ON d2.UID_DialogColumn = dc2.UID_DialogColumn WHERE d2.UID_DialogColumn in (SELECT UID_DialogColumn FROM [dbo].[DialogColumn] c INNER JOIN DialogTable t ON t.UID_DialogTable = c.UID_DialogTable WHERE t.TableName = 'Person' And (c.ColumnName in ('UID_DialogCountry','ExitDate','IsInActive','ApprovalState','Gender'))) AND rq.XObjectKey = o2.ObjectKeyOfRow -- ORDER BY o2.OperationDate DESC ) SELECTX(<SQL:IMCD>) COL AS "Column", CHG_TYPE AS "Type of Change", OPERATION_DATE AS "Change Date", OPERATION_USER AS "Changed By", PREV_VAL AS "Old Value", NEXT_VAL AS "New Value" FROM chg_records order BY COL, ROW_NUM DESC;

SELECTX(<SQL:PRDBNLIAMDB1.CENET.ICT/OneIM>,iamsa,,V7) SheetName, Caption FROM dbo.DialogSheet WHERE SheetName LIKE '%Overview' ORDER BY Caption JOIN_ON UID_DialogSheet SELECTX(<SQL:PRDBNLIAMDB1.CENET.ICT/OneIM>,iamsa,,V7) <NONE> FROM dbo.DialogTreeHasSheet JOIN_ON UID_DialogTree SELECTX(<SQL:PRDBNLIAMDB1.CENET.ICT/OneIM>,iamsa,,V7) TreeNode FROM dbo.DialogTree WHERE TreeNode LIKE '%' JOIN_ON UID_DialogTree=UID_DialogTreeParent SELECTX(<SQL:PRDBNLIAMDB1.CENET.ICT/OneIM>,iamsa,,V7) TreeNode AS "Bubble", TreeCaption, <DBLOOKUP "dbo.[DialogObject]" "DisplayName" "" "" "UID_DialogObject"> FROM dbo.DialogTree JOIN_ON UID_DialogTree SELECTX(<SQL:PRDBNLIAMDB1.CENET.ICT/OneIM>,iamsa,,V7) <NONE> FROM dbo.DialogGroupHasTree JOIN_ON UID_DialogGroup SELECTX(<SQL:PRDBNLIAMDB1.CENET.ICT/OneIM>,iamsa,,V7) GroupName FROM dbo.DialogGroup JOIN_ON UID_DialogGroup SELECTX(<SQL:PRDBNLIAMDB1.CENET.ICT/OneIM>,iamsa,,V7) <DBLOOKUP(<SQL:ASW>) "dbo.DialogUser" "UserName" "" "" "UID_DialogGroup"> FROM dbo.DialogUserInGroup;

with RPT as ( select c.FullPath, c.Value, r.UID_DialogRichMail FROM [OneIM].[dbo].[DialogConfigParm] c inner join DialogRichMail r on r.Ident_DialogRichMail = c.Value ) select FullPath As "Config Parm", Value As "Mail Template", UID_DialogRichMail from RPT order by FullPath;

Query.Description: All processes that send emal --- lookup on "EMail Templ in ConfigParms"
Query.SQL: SELECTX(<SQL:IMCD>) <DEFAULT> AS "Tables Name" FROM dbo.DialogTable INNER_JOIN_ON UID_DialogTable SELECTX(<SQL:IMCD>) <DEFAULT> AS "Processes Name" FROM dbo.JobChain ORDER BY Name INNER_JOIN_ON UID_JobChain SELECTX(<SQL:IMCD>) <DEFAULT> AS "Process steps Name", IsForHistory, PreCode, <DBLOOKUP(<SQL:IMCD>) "dbo.JobRunParameter" "Name, ValueTemplate" "(Name IN (\"Address\",\"MailID\"))" "ORDER BY Name" "UID_Job"> FROM dbo.Job ORDER BY Name INNER_JOIN_ON UID_JobTask SELECTX(<SQL:IMCD>) <NONE> FROM dbo.JobTask INNER_JOIN_ON UID_JobComponent SELECTX(<SQL:IMCD>) <NONE> FROM dbo.JobComponent WHERE ComponentAssembly = 'MailComponent';

WITH rpt AS ( SELECT o.Ident_Org, t.Ident_TSBAccountDef, r.WhereClause FROM [OneIM].[dbo].[DynamicGroup] r INNER JOIN Org o ON r.ObjectKeyBaseTree = o.XObjectKey inner join OrgHasTSBAccountDef ot ON o.UID_Org = ot.UID_Org inner join TSBAccountDef t On ot.UID_TSBAccountDef = t.UID_TSBAccountDef ) select Ident_Org as "Business Role", Ident_TSBAccountDef as "Account Def", WhereClause as "Where Clause" from RPT order by 1;

WITH RPT AS ( select p.XDateInserted, p.InternalName, p.PersonnelNumber, p.CustomProperty09, a.SAMAccountName, aa.UNSDisplay, m.MicrosoftOnlineServicesID from Person p left outer join ADSAccount a on a.UID_Person = p.UID_Person left outer join AADUser aa on aa.UID_Person = p.UID_Person left outer join O3EMailbox m on m.UID_AADUser = aa.UID_AADUser where --p.InternalName like 'ICI Paris%' AND p.IsInActive = 0 --AND (a.AccountDisabled = 0 OR a.UID_ADSAccount is null) p.CCC_BU_Code = 'BELICI' And p.ImportSource = 'MDEHQ_STORES' And p.IsInActive = 0 And IIF( ISNUMERIC(SUBSTRING(personnelnumber,LEN('STORE')+1,LEN(personnelnumber)-LEN('STORE')))=1, CONVERT(INT,SUBSTRING(personnelnumber,LEN('STORE')+1,LEN(personnelnumber)-LEN('STORE'))), 2147483647) < 9000 ) select XDateInserted As "Creation Date", InternalName As Store, PersonnelNumber as "Store Number", CustomProperty09 As "NO ACCOUNT", SAMAccountName As "AD Account", UNSDisplay As "Azure Account", MicrosoftOnlineServicesID as "Mailbox" from RPT order by XDateInserted;

WITH RPT AS ( select p.XDateInserted, p.InternalName, p.PersonnelNumber, p.CustomProperty09, p.CCC_BU_Code, p.ImportSource, p.IsInActive, a.SAMAccountName, aa.UNSDisplay, m.MicrosoftOnlineServicesID from Person p left outer join ADSAccount a on a.UID_Person = p.UID_Person left outer join AADUser aa on aa.UID_Person = p.UID_Person left outer join O3EMailbox m on m.UID_AADUser = aa.UID_AADUser where p.InternalName like 'ICI Paris%' --AND p.IsInActive = 0 --AND (a.AccountDisabled = 0 OR a.UID_ADSAccount is null) -- p.CCC_BU_Code = 'BELICI' And -- p.ImportSource = 'MDEHQ_STORES' And -- p.IsInActive = 0 And --IIF( -- ISNUMERIC(SUBSTRING(personnelnumber,LEN('STORE')+1,LEN(personnelnumber)-LEN('STORE')))=1, -- CONVERT(INT,SUBSTRING(personnelnumber,LEN('STORE')+1,LEN(personnelnumber)-LEN('STORE'))), -- 2147483647) < 9000 ) select XDateInserted As "Creation Date", InternalName As Store, PersonnelNumber as "Store Number", CustomProperty09 As "NO ACCOUNT", CCC_BU_Code As "BU Code", ImportSource As ImportSource, IsInActive As "Person Disabled", SAMAccountName As "AD Account", UNSDisplay As "Azure Account", MicrosoftOnlineServicesID as "Mailbox" from RPT order by XDateInserted;

UID_DialogProduct + '|' + UID_DialogSheet As ObjName FROM DialogProductHasSheet WHERE XObjectKey = c.ObjectKey UNION SELECT 'DialogScript' As TabName, ScriptName As ObjName FROM DialogScript WHERE TableName As ObjName FROM DialogTable WHERE XObjectKey = c.ObjectKey UNION SELECT 'DialogTableGroupRight' As TabName, UID_DialogTable + '|' + UID_DialogGroup As ObjName FROM DialogTableGroupRight WHERE XObjectKey = c.ObjectKey UNION SELECT 'DialogTree' As TabName, TreeCaption As ObjName FROM DialogTree WHERE XObjectKey = c.ObjectKey UNION SELECT 'DialogColumn' As TabName, UID_DialogProduct + '|' + UID_DialogTree As ObjName FROM DialogTreeInDialogProduct WHERE XObjectKey = c.ObjectKey UNION SELECT 'DialogTreeInDialogProduct' As TabName, Name As ObjName FROM DPRObjectOperation WHERE XObjectKey = c.ObjectKey UNION SELECT 'Job' As TabName, Name As ObjName FROM Job WHERE XObjectKey = c.ObjectKey UNION SELECT 'JobChain' As TabName, Name As ObjName FROM JobChain WHERE XObjectKey = c.ObjectKey UNION SELECT 'JobEventGen' As TabName, UID_JobChain + '|' + UID_QBMEvent As ObjName FROM JobEventGen WHERE XObjectKey = c.ObjectKey UNION SELECT 'JobRunParameter' As TabName, UID_Job + '|' + UID_JobParameter As ObjName FROM JobRunParameter WHERE XObjectKey = c.ObjectKey UNION SELECT 'QBMColumnLimitedValue' As TabName, UID_DialogColumn + '|' + UID_QBMColumnLimitedValue As ObjName FROM WITH muser AS ( -- managed JDE users select * from UNSAccountB where (CanonicalName like 'JDE/USERS/%' and UID_TSBAccountDef is not null) ), uuser AS ( -- unmanaged JDE users select * from UNSAccountB where (CanonicalName like 'JDE/USERS/%' and UID_TSBAccountDef is null) ), maddr AS ( -- managed JDE Addr select * from UNSAccountB where (CanonicalName like 'JDE/ADDR/%' and UID_TSBAccountDef is not null) ), uaddr AS ( -- unmanaged JDE Addr select * from UNSAccountB where (CanonicalName like 'JDE/ADDR/%' and UID_TSBAccountDef is null) ), pmusr AS ( -- person with managed jde user select -- managed jde-user (select top 1 ObjectGUID from muser where muser.UID_Person = p.UID_Person) as jde_user, -- addr book num on jde-user (select top 1 ObjectGUID from UNSAccountB aa where aa.UID_UNSAccountB in (select top 1 CCC_UID_AddressBookEntry from muser where muser.UID_Person = p.UID_Person)) as jde_user_addr, -- addr book num on person (select top 1 ObjectGUID from maddr where maddr.UID_Person = p.UID_Person) as maddr, CustomProperty08 as pers_addr, p.UID_Person as uid_pers, (select top 1 UID_UNSAccountB from muser where muser.UID_Person = p.UID_Person) as uid_user, (select top 1 aaa.UID_UNSAccountB from UNSAccountB aaa where aaa.UID_UNSAccountB in (select top 1 CCC_UID_AddressBookEntry from muser where muser.UID_Person = p.UID_Person)) as uid_addr from Person p where exists (select top 1 1 from muser a where p.UID_Person = a.UID_Person) ), pmaddr AS ( -- person no managed jde user, but has managed addr select -- managed addr-book (select top 1 ObjectGUID from maddr where maddr.UID_Person = p.UID_Person) as addr_addr, -- addr book num on person (select top 1 ObjectGUID from maddr where maddr.UID_Person = p.UID_Person) as maddr, CustomProperty08 as pers_addr, p.UID_Person as uid_pers, (select top 1 UID_UNSAccountB from maddr where maddr.UID_Person = p.UID_Person) as uid_addr from Person p where exists (select top 1 1 from maddr a where p.UID_Person = a.UID_Person) AND not exists (select top 1 1 from muser a where p.UID_Person = a.UID_Person) ), pmnone AS ( -- person no managed jde user, and no managed addr (could have a list of addr-nums) select -- managed addr-book --(select top 1 ObjectGUID from uaddr where uaddr.UID_Person = p.UID_Person) as addr_addr, stuff( (SELECT ' | ' + ObjectGUID FROM uaddr WHERE uaddr.UID_Person = p.UID_Person ORDER BY ObjectGUID DESC FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE).value('.', 'varchar(max)') ,1, 3, '') AS addr_addr, stuff( (SELECT ' | ' + case when AccountDisabled <> 0 then case when XMarkedForDeletion & 2 > 0 then case when XMarkedForDeletion & 1 > 0 then 'disabled+outstanding+deleted' else 'disabled+outstanding' end else case when XMarkedForDeletion & 1 > 0 then 'disabled+deleted' else 'disabled' end end else case when XMarkedForDeletion & 2 > 0 then case when XMarkedForDeletion & 1 > 0 then 'enabled+outstanding+deleted' else 'enabled+outstanding' end else 'enabled' end end as a_status FROM uaddr WHERE uaddr.UID_Person = p.UID_Person ORDER BY ObjectGUID DESC FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE).value('.', 'varchar(max)') ,1, 3, '') AS addr_stat, -- addr book num on person (select top 1 ObjectGUID from maddr where maddr.UID_Person = p.UID_Person) as maddr, CustomProperty08 as pers_addr, p.UID_Person as uid_pers, stuff( (SELECT ' | ' + UID_UNSAccountB FROM uaddr WHERE uaddr.UID_Person = p.UID_Person ORDER BY ObjectGUID DESC FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE).value('.', 'varchar(max)') ,1, 3, '') AS uid_addr from Person p where not exists (select top 1 1 from maddr a where p.UID_Person = a.UID_Person) AND not exists (select top 1 1 from muser a where p.UID_Person = a.UID_Person) AND exists (select top 1 1 from uaddr a where p.UID_Person = a.UID_Person) ), pers as ( select p.InternalName + ' (' + p.CentralAccount + ')' as pers, case when p.IsInActive = 1 then 'disabled' when p.IsTemporaryDeactivated = 1 then 'temp' else 'active' end as pers_stat, p.CustomProperty08 as pers_addr, d.DepartmentName as pers_comp, case when p.CCC_JDE_Addr_Allowed = 1 then 'yes' else 'no' end as jde_addr_allowed, p.UID_Person as uid_pers from Person p left outer join Department d on p.UID_Department = d.UID_Department ), acct as ( select case when a.AccountDisabled <> 0 then case when a.XMarkedForDeletion & 2 > 0 then case when a.XMarkedForDeletion & 1 > 0 then 'disabled+outstanding+deleted' else 'disabled+outstanding' end else case when a.XMarkedForDeletion & 1 > 0 then 'disabled+deleted' else 'disabled' end end else case when a.XMarkedForDeletion & 2 > 0 then case when a.XMarkedForDeletion & 1 > 0 then 'enabled+outstanding+deleted' else 'enabled+outstanding' end else 'enabled' end end as a_status, a.UID_UNSAccountB from UNSAccountB a ), RPT as ( --- person / managed jde-user / managed addr-book select 'Person Managed JDE-User' as pers_class, p1.pers, p1.pers_comp, p1.pers_stat, (select top 1 a_status from acct a where a.UID_UNSAccountB = u1.uid_user) as jde_usr_stat, (select top 1 a_status from acct a2 where a2.UID_UNSAccountB = u1.uid_addr) as addr_stat, u1.jde_user, u1.jde_user_addr, u1.maddr, p1.pers_addr, p1.jde_addr_allowed from pmusr u1 inner join pers p1 on u1.uid_pers = p1.uid_pers where isnull(u1.jde_user_addr,'') <> isnull(p1.pers_addr,'') OR (isnull(u1.maddr,'') <> isnull(p1.pers_addr,'') AND isnull(u1.maddr,'') > '') union select 'Person No Managed JDE-User, Managed Addr-Book' as pers_class, p2.pers, p2.pers_comp, p2.pers_stat, NULL as jde_usr_stat, (select top 1 a_status from acct a2 where a2.UID_UNSAccountB = u2.uid_addr) as addr_stat, NULL As jde_user, u2.addr_addr as jde_user_addr, u2.maddr, p2.pers_addr, p2.jde_addr_allowed from pmaddr u2 inner join pers p2 on u2.uid_pers = p2.uid_pers where isnull(u2.addr_addr,'') <> isnull(p2.pers_addr,'') OR (isnull(u2.maddr,'') <> isnull(p2.pers_addr,'') AND isnull(u2.maddr,'') > '') union select 'Person No Managed JDE-User, No Managed Addr-Book' as pers_class, p3.pers, p3.pers_comp, p3.pers_stat, NULL as jde_usr_stat, u3.addr_stat, NULL As jde_user, u3.addr_addr as jde_user_addr, u3.maddr, p3.pers_addr, p3.jde_addr_allowed from pmnone u3 inner join pers p3 on u3.uid_pers = p3.uid_pers where isnull(u3.addr_addr,'') <> isnull(p3.pers_addr,'') OR (isnull(u3.maddr,'') <> isnull(p3.pers_addr,'') AND isnull(u3.maddr,'') > '') ) select pers_class as "Person Class", pers as "Person", pers_comp as "Person Company", pers_stat as "Person Status", jde_usr_stat as "(managed) JDE-User Status", addr_stat as "(managed) Addr-Book Status", jde_user as "(managed) JDE-User", jde_user_addr as "(JDE-User) Address-Book Number", maddr as "Managed Addr-Book Number", pers_addr as "Person Addr-Book Number", jde_addr_allowed as "Person Address-Book Allowed" from RPT order by 1, 2;

WITH muser AS ( -- managed JDE users select * from UNSAccountB where (CanonicalName like 'JDE/USERS/%' and UID_TSBAccountDef is not null) ), uuser AS ( -- unmanaged JDE users select * from UNSAccountB where (CanonicalName like 'JDE/USERS/%' and UID_TSBAccountDef is null) ), maddr AS ( -- managed JDE Addr select * from UNSAccountB where (CanonicalName like 'JDE/ADDR/%' and UID_TSBAccountDef is not null) ), uaddr AS ( -- unmanaged JDE Addr select * from UNSAccountB where (CanonicalName like 'JDE/ADDR/%' and UID_TSBAccountDef is null) ), pmusr AS ( -- person with managed jde user select -- managed jde-user (select top 1 ObjectGUID from muser where muser.UID_Person = p.UID_Person) as jde_user, -- addr book num on jde-user (select top 1 ObjectGUID from UNSAccountB aa where aa.UID_UNSAccountB in (select top 1 CCC_UID_AddressBookEntry from muser where muser.UID_Person = p.UID_Person)) as jde_user_addr, -- addr book num on person (select top 1 ObjectGUID from maddr where maddr.UID_Person = p.UID_Person) as maddr, CustomProperty08 as pers_addr, p.UID_Person as uid_pers, (select top 1 UID_UNSAccountB from muser where muser.UID_Person = p.UID_Person) as uid_user, (select top 1 aaa.UID_UNSAccountB from UNSAccountB aaa where aaa.UID_UNSAccountB in (select top 1 CCC_UID_AddressBookEntry from muser where muser.UID_Person = p.UID_Person)) as uid_addr from Person p where exists (select top 1 1 from muser a where p.UID_Person = a.UID_Person) ), pmaddr AS ( -- person no managed jde user, but has managed addr select -- managed addr-book (select top 1 ObjectGUID from maddr where maddr.UID_Person = p.UID_Person) as addr_addr, -- addr book num on person (select top 1 ObjectGUID from maddr where maddr.UID_Person = p.UID_Person) as maddr, CustomProperty08 as pers_addr, p.UID_Person as uid_pers, (select top 1 UID_UNSAccountB from maddr where maddr.UID_Person = p.UID_Person) as uid_addr from Person p where exists (select top 1 1 from maddr a where p.UID_Person = a.UID_Person) AND not exists (select top 1 1 from muser a where p.UID_Person = a.UID_Person) ), pmnone AS ( -- person no managed jde user, and no managed addr (could have a list of addr-nums) select -- managed addr-book --(select top 1 ObjectGUID from uaddr where uaddr.UID_Person = p.UID_Person) as addr_addr, stuff( (SELECT ' | ' + ObjectGUID FROM uaddr WHERE uaddr.UID_Person = p.UID_Person ORDER BY ObjectGUID DESC FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE).value('.', 'varchar(max)') ,1, 3, '') AS addr_addr, stuff( (SELECT ' | ' + case when AccountDisabled <> 0 then case when XMarkedForDeletion & 2 > 0 then case when XMarkedForDeletion & 1 > 0 then 'disabled+outstanding+deleted' else 'disabled+outstanding' end else case when XMarkedForDeletion & 1 > 0 then 'disabled+deleted' else 'disabled' end end else case when XMarkedForDeletion & 2 > 0 then case when XMarkedForDeletion & 1 > 0 then 'enabled+outstanding+deleted' else 'enabled+outstanding' end else 'enabled' end end as a_status FROM uaddr WHERE uaddr.UID_Person = p.UID_Person ORDER BY ObjectGUID DESC FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE).value('.', 'varchar(max)') ,1, 3, '') AS addr_stat, -- addr book num on person (select top 1 ObjectGUID from maddr where maddr.UID_Person = p.UID_Person) as maddr, CustomProperty08 as pers_addr, p.UID_Person as uid_pers, stuff( (SELECT ' | ' + UID_UNSAccountB FROM uaddr WHERE uaddr.UID_Person = p.UID_Person ORDER BY ObjectGUID DESC FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE).value('.', 'varchar(max)') ,1, 3, '') AS uid_addr from Person p where not exists (select top 1 1 from maddr a where p.UID_Person = a.UID_Person) AND not exists (select top 1 1 from muser a where p.UID_Person = a.UID_Person) AND exists (select top 1 1 from uaddr a where p.UID_Person = a.UID_Person) ), pers as ( select p.InternalName + ' (' + p.CentralAccount + ')' as pers, case when p.IsInActive = 1 then 'disabled' when p.IsTemporaryDeactivated = 1 then 'temp' else 'active' end as pers_stat, p.CustomProperty08 as pers_addr, d.DepartmentName as pers_comp, case when p.CCC_JDE_Addr_Allowed = 1 then 'yes' else 'no' end as jde_addr_allowed, p.UID_Person as uid_pers from Person p left outer join Department d on p.UID_Department = d.UID_Department ), acct as ( select case when a.AccountDisabled <> 0 then case when a.XMarkedForDeletion & 2 > 0 then case when a.XMarkedForDeletion & 1 > 0 then 'disabled+outstanding+deleted' else 'disabled+outstanding' end else case when a.XMarkedForDeletion & 1 > 0 then 'disabled+deleted' else 'disabled' end end else case when a.XMarkedForDeletion & 2 > 0 then case when a.XMarkedForDeletion & 1 > 0 then 'enabled+outstanding+deleted' else 'enabled+outstanding' end else 'enabled' end end as a_status, a.UID_UNSAccountB from UNSAccountB a ), RPT as ( --- person / managed jde-user / managed addr-book select 'Person Managed JDE-User' as pers_class, p1.pers, p1.pers_comp, p1.pers_stat, (select top 1 a_status from acct a where a.UID_UNSAccountB = u1.uid_user) as jde_usr_stat, (select top 1 a_status from acct a2 where a2.UID_UNSAccountB = u1.uid_addr) as addr_stat, u1.jde_user, u1.jde_user_addr, u1.maddr, p1.pers_addr, p1.jde_addr_allowed from pmusr u1 inner join pers p1 on u1.uid_pers = p1.uid_pers where (isnull(u1.jde_user_addr,'') <> isnull(p1.pers_addr,'')) OR (isnull(u1.maddr,'') <> isnull(p1.pers_addr,'')) union select 'Person No Managed JDE-User, Managed Addr-Book' as pers_class, p2.pers, p2.pers_comp, p2.pers_stat, NULL as jde_usr_stat, (select top 1 a_status from acct a2 where a2.UID_UNSAccountB = u2.uid_addr) as addr_stat, NULL As jde_user, u2.addr_addr as jde_user_addr, u2.maddr, p2.pers_addr, p2.jde_addr_allowed from pmaddr u2 inner join pers p2 on u2.uid_pers = p2.uid_pers where isnull(u2.addr_addr,'') <> isnull(p2.pers_addr,'') union select 'Person No Managed JDE-User, No Managed Addr-Book' as pers_class, p3.pers, p3.pers_comp, p3.pers_stat, NULL as jde_usr_stat, u3.addr_stat, NULL As jde_user, u3.addr_addr as jde_user_addr, u3.maddr, p3.pers_addr, p3.jde_addr_allowed from pmnone u3 inner join pers p3 on u3.uid_pers = p3.uid_pers where (isnull(u3.addr_addr,'') <> isnull(p3.pers_addr,'')) OR ((isnull(u3.maddr,'') <> isnull(p3.pers_addr,'')) AND (isnull(u3.maddr,'') > '')) ) select pers_class as "Person Class", pers as "Person", pers_comp as "Person Company", pers_stat as "Person Status", jde_usr_stat as "(managed) JDE-User Status", addr_stat as "(managed) Addr-Book Status", jde_user as "(managed) JDE-User", jde_user_addr as "(JDE-User) Address-Book Number", maddr as "Managed Addr-Book Number", pers_addr as "Person Addr-Book Number", jde_addr_allowed as "Person Address-Book Allowed" from RPT order by 1, 2;

with rpt as ( select 'ok' as stat, CustomProperty03 as 'Department Type', (select count(*) from person pp where pp.CustomProperty03 = p.CustomProperty03) as 'Num Persons' from person p where exists (select top 1 1 from CCC_Department_Type d where p.CustomProperty03 = d.CCC_Department_Type) AND (p.IsInActive = 0) union select 'bad' as stat, CustomProperty03 as 'Department Type', (select count(*) from person pp where pp.CustomProperty03 = p.CustomProperty03) as 'Num Persons' from person p where not exists (select top 1 1 from CCC_Department_Type d where p.CustomProperty03 = d.CCC_Department_Type) AND (p.IsInActive = 0) ) select * from rpt order by 1, 2;

with rpt as ( select 'ok' as stat, CustomProperty03 as 'Department Type', (select count(*) from person pp where isnull(pp.CustomProperty03,'') = isnull(p.CustomProperty03,'')) as 'Num Persons' from person p where exists (select top 1 1 from CCC_Department_Type d where isnull(p.CustomProperty03,'') = isnull(d.CCC_Department_Type,'')) AND (p.IsInActive = 0) union select 'bad' as stat, CustomProperty03 as 'Department Type', (select count(*) from person pp where isnull(pp.CustomProperty03,'') = isnull(p.CustomProperty03,'')) as 'Num Persons' from person p where not exists (select top 1 1 from CCC_Department_Type d where isnull(p.CustomProperty03,'') = isnull(d.CCC_Department_Type,'')) AND (p.IsInActive = 0) ) select * from rpt order by 1, 2;

with rpt as ( select 'ok' as stat, CustomProperty03 as 'Department Type', (select count(*) from person pp where isnull(pp.CustomProperty03,'') = isnull(p.CustomProperty03,'')) as 'Num Persons' from person p where exists (select top 1 1 from CCC_Department_Type d where isnull(p.CustomProperty03,'') = isnull(d.CCC_Department_Type,'')) AND (p.IsInActive = 0) union select 'bad' as stat, CustomProperty03 as 'Department Type', (select count(*) from person pp where isnull(pp.CustomProperty03,'') = isnull(p.CustomProperty03,'')) as 'Num Persons' from person p where not exists (select top 1 1 from CCC_Department_Type d where isnull(p.CustomProperty03,'') = isnull(d.CCC_Department_Type,'')) AND (p.IsInActive = 0) ) select * from rpt order by 1, 2;

with stats as ( select distinct 'ok' as stat, CustomProperty03 from person p where exists (select top 1 1 from CCC_Department_Type d where isnull(p.CustomProperty03,'') = isnull(d.CCC_Department_Type,'')) AND (p.IsInActive = 0) union select distinct 'bad' as stat, CustomProperty03 from person p where not exists (select top 1 1 from CCC_Department_Type d where isnull(p.CustomProperty03,'') = isnull(d.CCC_Department_Type,'')) AND (p.IsInActive = 0) ), cnts as ( select s.stat, s.CustomProperty03, count(*) numpers from stats s inner join Person p on isnull(s.CustomProperty03,'') = isnull(p.CustomProperty03,'') where p.IsInActive = 0 group by s.stat, s.CustomProperty03 ) select stat as "Status", CustomProperty03 as "Department Type", numpers as "Num Persons" from cnts order by 1, 2;

with stats as ( select distinct 'ok' as stat, CustomProperty03 from person p where exists (select top 1 1 from CCC_Department_Type d where isnull(p.CustomProperty03,'') = isnull(d.CCC_Department_Type,'')) AND (p.IsInActive = 0) AND (isnull(p.Remarks,'') = 'HR Bulk updated on 29-10-2014') union select distinct 'bad' as stat, CustomProperty03 from person p where not exists (select top 1 1 from CCC_Department_Type d where isnull(p.CustomProperty03,'') = isnull(d.CCC_Department_Type,'')) AND (p.IsInActive = 0) AND (isnull(p.Remarks,'') = 'HR Bulk updated on 29-10-2014') ), cnts as ( select s.stat, s.CustomProperty03, count(*) numpers from stats s inner join Person p on isnull(s.CustomProperty03,'') = isnull(p.CustomProperty03,'') where p.IsInActive = 0 group by s.stat, s.CustomProperty03 ) select stat as "Status", CustomProperty03 as "Department Type", numpers as "Num Persons" from cnts order by 1, 2;

SELECTX(<SQL:AWIAMSQL01.IMCD.NL/OneIM>,OneIM,,V7) TOP(5000) DateHead, DecisionLevel, DecisionType, DisplayPersonHead, Ident_PWODecisionStep, IsDecisionBySystem, IsFromDelegation, IsToHideInHistory, OrderState, ReasonHead, UID_ITShopOrgFinal, UID_PersonHead, UID_PersonRelated, UID_PersonWantsOrg FROM dbo.PWODecisionHistory ORDER BY DateHead DESC;

with convU as ( select FORMAT(DateHead, 'yyyyMMdd') as yyyymmdd, FORMAT(DateHead, 'dd-MMM', 'en-US') as DateHead from PWODecisionHistory h where h.DecisionType Like 'Unsubscribe%' And ReasonHead = 'This Company-Transcending Requests has been cancelled due to replacement with Regional-Access.' --order by DateHead desc ), convA as ( select FORMAT(OrderDate, 'yyyyMMdd') as yyyymmdd, FORMAT(OrderDate, 'dd-MMM', 'en-US') as OrderDate from PersonWantsOrg h where --h.DecisionType Like 'Unsubscribe%' ReasonHead = 'This is an automatically created and approved request.' --order by DateHead desc ), rpt as ( select 'Unsubscribe' as Action, DateHead as OnDate, yyyymmdd as SortDate, Count(*) as NumRequests from convU group by DateHead, yyyymmdd union select 'Auto-Approve' as Action, OrderDate as OnDate, yyyymmdd as SortDate, Count(*) as NumRequests from convA group by OrderDate, yyyymmdd ) select Action, OnDate as "On Date", NumRequests as "Num Requests" from rpt order by SortDate desc;

with convU as ( select FORMAT(DateHead, 'yyyyMMdd') as yyyymmdd, FORMAT(DateHead, 'dd-MMM-yy', 'en-US') as DateHead from PWODecisionHistory h where h.DecisionType Like 'Unsubscribe%' And ReasonHead = 'This Company-Transcending Requests has been cancelled due to replacement with Regional-Access.' --order by DateHead desc ), convA as ( select FORMAT(OrderDate, 'yyyyMMdd') as yyyymmdd, FORMAT(OrderDate, 'dd-MMM-yy', 'en-US') as OrderDate from PersonWantsOrg h where --h.DecisionType Like 'Unsubscribe%' ReasonHead = 'This is an automatically created and approved request.' --order by DateHead desc ), rpt as ( select 'Unsubscribe' as Action, DateHead as OnDate, yyyymmdd as SortDate, Count(*) as NumRequests from convU group by DateHead, yyyymmdd union select 'Auto-Approve' as Action, OrderDate as OnDate, yyyymmdd as SortDate, Count(*) as NumRequests from convA group by OrderDate, yyyymmdd ) select Action, OnDate as "On Date", NumRequests as "Num Requests" from rpt order by SortDate desc;

with convU as ( select FORMAT(DateHead, 'yyyyMMdd') as yyyymmdd, FORMAT(DateHead, 'dd-MMM-yy', 'en-US') as DateHead from PWODecisionHistory h where h.DecisionType Like 'Unsubscribe%' And ReasonHead Like '% has been cancelled due to %' --order by DateHead desc ), convA as ( select FORMAT(OrderDate, 'yyyyMMdd') as yyyymmdd, FORMAT(OrderDate, 'dd-MMM-yy', 'en-US') as OrderDate from PersonWantsOrg h where --h.DecisionType Like 'Unsubscribe%' ReasonHead Like 'This is an automatically created and approved request%' --order by DateHead desc ), rpt as ( select 'Unsubscribe' as Action, DateHead as OnDate, yyyymmdd as SortDate, Count(*) as NumRequests from convU group by DateHead, yyyymmdd union select 'Auto-Approve' as Action, OrderDate as OnDate, yyyymmdd as SortDate, Count(*) as NumRequests from convA group by OrderDate, yyyymmdd ) select Action, OnDate as "On Date", NumRequests as "Num Requests" from rpt order by SortDate desc;

with rpt as ( select p.InternalName, a.CanonicalName, d.DepartmentName, a.Company from ADSAccount a inner join Person p on a.UID_Person = p.UID_Person inner join Department d on p.UID_Department = d.UID_Department where isnull(a.Company,'') <> isnull(d.DepartmentName,'') ) select DepartmentName as "Person Company", Company as "Account Company", InternalName as "Person", CanonicalName as "AD Account" from rpt order by DepartmentName, COMPANY;

SELECTX(<SQL:IMCD>) TOP(20000) OrderDate, DisplayOrg, UID_PersonWantsOrg FROM dbo.PersonWantsOrg ORDER BY OrderDate DESC JOIN_ON UID_PersonWantsOrg SELECTX(<SQL:IMCD>) DateHead, DecisionLevel, DecisionType, DisplayPersonHead, Ident_PWODecisionStep, IsDecisionBySystem, IsFromDelegation, IsToHideInHistory, OrderState, PWOPriority, ReasonHead, RulerLevel, <DBLOOKUP "dbo.[QERJustification]" "Ident_QERJustification" "" "" "UID_QERJustification"> FROM dbo.PWODecisionHistory ORDER BY DateHead DESC;

with rpt as ( select p.InternalName, a.CanonicalName, d.DepartmentName, a.Company from ADSAccount a inner join Person p on a.UID_Person = p.UID_Person inner join Department d on p.UID_Department = d.UID_Department where isnull(a.Company,'') <> isnull(d.DepartmentName,'') ) select DepartmentName as "Person Company", Company as "Account Company", InternalName as "Person", CanonicalName as "AD Account" from rpt order by DepartmentName, COMPANY;

select XDateInserted, XUserInserted, InternalName, CentralAccount, DefaultEmailAddress, ImportSource from Person order by XDateInserted desc;

with RPT as ( select td.Ident_TSBAccountDef as adef, p.InternalName + ' (' + p.CentralAccount + ')' as emp, case when p.XMarkedForDeletion > 0 then 'deleted' when p.IsInActive > 0 then 'inactive' when p.IsTemporaryDeactivated > 0 then 'temp' else 'active' end as empstat, d.Description as dept from TSBAccountDef td cross apply ( select UID_Person from TSB_VTSBAccountDefNoAccount tna where tna.UID_TSBAccountDef=td.UID_TSBAccountDef) na inner join Person p on p.UID_Person = na.uid_person left outer join Department d on p.UID_Department = d.UID_Department ) select adef as "Account Def", emp as "Employee", empstat as "Employee Status", dept as "Department" from RPT order by 2;

with RPT as ( select td.Ident_TSBAccountDef as adef, p.InternalName + ' (' + p.CentralAccount + ')' as emp, case when p.XMarkedForDeletion > 0 then 'deleted' when p.IsInActive > 0 then 'inactive' when p.IsTemporaryDeactivated > 0 then 'temp' else 'active' end as empstat, d.Description as dept, ptd.XObjectKey as pad from TSBAccountDef td cross apply ( select UID_Person from TSB_VTSBAccountDefNoAccount tna where tna.UID_TSBAccountDef=td.UID_TSBAccountDef) na inner join Person p on p.UID_Person = na.uid_person left outer join PersonHasTSBAccountDef ptd on td.UID_TSBAccountDef = ptd.UID_TSBAccountDef AND p.UID_Person = ptd.UID_Person left outer join Department d on p.UID_Department = d.UID_Department ) select adef as "Account Def", emp as "Employee", empstat as "Employee Status", dept as "Department", pad as "PersonHasAccountDef XObjectKey" from RPT order by 2;

with dates as ( select case when isnull(p.CentralAccount,'') = '' then p.InternalName else p.InternalName + ' (' + p.CentralAccount + ')' end as Employee, e.CCC_Employee_ID, case when exists ( select top 1 1 from CCC_STG_MDE_Assignments a where a.CCC_Employee_ID = e.CCC_Employee_ID and a.CCC_Contract_EndDate is null ) then NULL else ( select max(CONVERT(Date, a.CCC_Contract_EndDate, 105)) from CCC_STG_MDE_Assignments a where a.CCC_Employee_ID = e.CCC_Employee_ID ) end as Assignment_EndDate, e.CCC_Contract_EndDate as Staging_EndDate, p.ExitDate as Person_EndDate, p.CCC_End_Contract_Date as Old_EndDate from CCC_STG_MDE_Employees e inner join Person p on e.CCC_IAM_ObjectID = p.PersonnelNumber where e.CCC_IAM_ObjectType = 'KANTOOR' ), RPT as ( select Employee, FORMAT(Assignment_EndDate, 'dd-MM-yy HH:mm') as Assignment_EndDate, FORMAT(Staging_EndDate, 'dd-MM-yy HH:mm') as Staging_EndDate, FORMAT(Person_EndDate, 'dd-MM-yy HH:mm') as Person_EndDate, FORMAT(Old_EndDate, 'dd-MM-yy HH:mm') as Old_EndDate from dates where not(Assignment_EndDate = Staging_EndDate and Staging_EndDate = Person_EndDate and Person_EndDate = Old_EndDate) ) select Employee, Assignment_EndDate, Staging_EndDate, Person_EndDate, Old_EndDate from RPT order by Employee;

with RPT as ( select p.InternalName, am.CanonicalName as curr_man, dm.CanonicalName as des_man, case when isnull(a.ObjectKeyManager,'') <> isnull(dm.XObjectKey,'') then 'BAD' else 'GOOD' end as mgr_chk from ADSAccount a inner join Person p on a.UID_Person = p.UID_Person left outer join ADSAccount dm on p.CCC_Manager_UID_ADSAccount = dm.UID_ADSAccount left outer join ADSAccount am on a.ObjectKeyManager = am.XObjectKey where (a.UID_TSBAccountDef is not null) -- AND isnull(a.ObjectKeyManager,'') <> isnull(dm.XObjectKey,'') AND p.IsInActive = 0 and p.IsTemporaryDeactivated = 0 AND a.XMarkedForDeletion = 0 ) select InternalName as "Employee", curr_man as "Current Manager AD", des_man as "Desired Manager AD", mgr_chk as "AD Account Manager Check" from RPT order by 1;

with RPT as ( select top 5000 o.OperationDate, pp.InternalName as Employee, a.SAMAccountName as ADAccount, c.ColumnName, p.ContentShort as PreviousValue from DialogWatchOperation o inner join DialogWatchProperty p on o.UID_DialogWatchOperation = p.UID_DialogWatchOperation inner join DialogColumn c on p.UID_DialogColumn = c.UID_DialogColumn left outer join ADSAccount a on a.XObjectKey = o.ObjectKeyOfRow left outer join Person pp on pp.XObjectKey = o.ObjectKeyOfRow where c.ColumnName in ('CCC_Manager_UID_ADSAccount','ObjectKeyManager','PersonalTitle','Title') ) select OperationDate, Employee as "Employee Changed", ADAccount as "AD Account Changed", ColumnName as "Column Name", PreviousValue as "Previous Value" from RPT order by OperationDate desc;

with RPT as ( select o.OperationDate, pp.InternalName as Employee, a.SAMAccountName as ADAccount, c.ColumnName, p.ContentShort as PreviousValue, case when pp.uid_person is null then a.uid_person else pp.uid_person end as uid_person from DialogWatchOperation o inner join DialogWatchProperty p on o.UID_DialogWatchOperation = p.UID_DialogWatchOperation inner join DialogColumn c on p.UID_DialogColumn = c.UID_DialogColumn left outer join ADSAccount a on a.XObjectKey = o.ObjectKeyOfRow left outer join Person pp on pp.XObjectKey = o.ObjectKeyOfRow where c.ColumnName in ('CCC_Manager_UID_ADSAccount','ObjectKeyManager','PersonalTitle','Title') ) select InternalName from Person order by InternalName INNER_JOIN_ON UID_Person=uid_person select OperationDate, Employee as "Employee Changed", ADAccount as "AD Account Changed", ColumnName as "Column Name", PreviousValue as "Previous Value" from RPT order by OperationDate desc;

with chgs as ( select o.OperationDate, pp.InternalName as Employee, a.SAMAccountName as ADAccount, c.ColumnName, p.ContentShort as PreviousValue, case when pp.uid_person is null then a.uid_person else pp.uid_person end as uid_person from DialogWatchOperation o inner join DialogWatchProperty p on o.UID_DialogWatchOperation = p.UID_DialogWatchOperation inner join DialogColumn c on p.UID_DialogColumn = c.UID_DialogColumn left outer join ADSAccount a on a.XObjectKey = o.ObjectKeyOfRow left outer join Person pp on pp.XObjectKey = o.ObjectKeyOfRow where c.ColumnName in ('CCC_Manager_UID_ADSAccount','ObjectKeyManager','PersonalTitle','Title') ), RPT as ( select p0.InternalName, h.OperationDate, h.Employee, h.ADAccount, h.ColumnName, h.PreviousValue from Person p0 inner join chgs h on p0.UID_Person = h.uid_person ) select InternalName as Employee, OperationDate, Employee as "Employee Changed", ADAccount as "AD Account Changed", ColumnName as "Column Name", PreviousValue as "Previous Value" from RPT order by InternalName, OPERATIONDATE desc, COLUMNNAME;

with RPT as ( select p.InternalName, --dbo.QBM_FCVObjectkeyToElement('TableName',td.ObjectKeyTargetSystem), ta.TableName, a1.SAMAccountName, c.CanonicalName from PersonHasTSBAccountDef ptd inner join Person p on p.UID_Person = ptd.UID_Person inner join TSBAccountDef td on ptd.UID_TSBAccountDef = td.UID_TSBAccountDef inner join DialogTable ta on td.UID_DialogTableAccountType = ta.UID_DialogTable inner join ADSAccount a1 on a1.UID_TSBAccountDef = td.UID_TSBAccountDef and a1.UID_Person = p.UID_Person inner join ADSContainer c on c.UID_ADSContainer = a1.UID_ADSContainer --left outer join UNSAccountB a2 -- on a2.UID_TSBAccountDef = td.UID_TSBAccountDef and a2.UID_Person = p.UID_Person where c.UID_ADSContainer in (select UID_ADSContainer from ADSContainer where CanonicalName in (N'imcd.nl/IMCD/NLTST/Users', N'imcd.nl/IMCD/NLILX')) ) select InternalName as "Employee", --dbo.QBM_FCVObjectkeyToElement('TableName',td.ObjectKeyTargetSystem), ta.TableName, SAMAccountName as "AD Account", CanonicalName As "Container" from RPT order by CanonicalName, INTERNALNAME;

SELECTX(<SQL:PRDBNLIAMDB1.CENET.ICT/OneIM>,iamsa,,V7) <DBLOOKUP "dbo.[DialogTable]" "<DEFAULT>[Table]" "" "" "UID_DialogTable">, ColumnName, Caption, Template FROM dbo.DialogColumn WHERE (UID_DialogTable IN ('ADS-T-ADSAccount','TSB-T-UNSAccountB')) AND Template LIKE '%Person%' ORDER BY UID_DialogTable, ColumnName;

WITH RPT as ( select par.ColumnName As PersColumn, chld.ChildColumn, chld.ChildCaption from DialogColumn par cross apply ( select tt.TableName + '@' + cc.ColumnName as ChildColumn, cc.Caption as ChildCaption from DialogColumn cc inner join DialogTable tt on cc.UID_DialogTable = tt.UID_DialogTable where cc.UID_DialogColumn in ( select UID_DialogColumnSubscriber from DialogNotification where UID_DialogColumnSender = par.UID_DialogColumn ) and tt.TableName <> 'Person' ) chld where par.UID_DialogTable = (select UID_DialogTable from DialogTable where TableName = 'Person') ) select PersColumn as "Person Column", ChildColumn as "Target System Column", ChildCaption as "Target System Column Caption" from RPT order by 1, 2;

WITH RPT as ( select par.ColumnName As PersColumn, chld.ChildTable, chld.ChildColumn, chld.ChildCaption from DialogColumn par cross apply ( select tt.TableName as ChildTable, cc.ColumnName as ChildColumn, cc.Caption as ChildCaption from DialogColumn cc inner join DialogTable tt on cc.UID_DialogTable = tt.UID_DialogTable where cc.UID_DialogColumn in ( select UID_DialogColumnSubscriber from DialogNotification where UID_DialogColumnSender = par.UID_DialogColumn ) and tt.TableName <> 'Person' ) chld where par.UID_DialogTable = (select UID_DialogTable from DialogTable where TableName = 'Person') ) select PersColumn as "Person Column", ChildTable As "Target System Table", ChildColumn as "Target System Column", ChildCaption as "Target System Column Caption" from RPT order by 1, 2;

with RPT as ( select aa.CanonicalName as ADAccount, pp.InternalName as Employee, case when pp.IsInActive = 1 then 'Y' else 'N' end as EmpIsInactive, case when pp.IsTemporaryDeactivated = 1 then 'Y' else 'N' end as EmpIsTempInactive, isnull(wrongp.InternalName,'EMPTY') + ' => ' + isnull(goodp.InternalName,'EMPTY') as ManagerDiff from ( select a.ObjectKeyManager, m.XObjectKey, a.UID_ADSAccount from adsaccount a inner join Person p on p.UID_Person = a.UID_Person left outer join ADSAccount m on p.CCC_Manager_UID_ADSAccount = m.UID_ADSAccount where a.XMarkedForDeletion = 0 AND a.UID_TSBBehavior = 'TSB-FullManaged' ) r inner join ADSAccount aa on r.UID_ADSAccount = aa.UID_ADSAccount inner join Person pp on aa.UID_Person = pp.UID_Person left outer join ADSAccount wronga on r.ObjectKeyManager = wronga.XObjectKey left outer join ADSAccount gooda on r.XObjectKey = gooda.XObjectKey left outer join Person wrongp on wronga.UID_Person = wrongp.UID_Person left outer join Person goodp on gooda.UID_Person = goodp.UID_Person where isnull(r.ObjectKeyManager,'') <> isnull(r.XObjectKey,'') ) select ADAccount as "AD Account", Employee as "Employee", EmpIsInactive as "Inactive Employee", EmpIsTempInactive as "Temporary Inactive Employee", ManagerDiff as "Wrong Manager => Good Manager" from RPT order by 1;

with RPT as ( select aa.CanonicalName as ADAccount, pp.InternalName as Employee, case when pp.IsInActive = 1 then 'Y' else 'N' end as EmpIsInactive, case when pp.IsTemporaryDeactivated = 1 then 'Y' else 'N' end as EmpIsTempInactive, wrongp.InternalName as BadManager, goodp.InternalName as GoodManager, isnull(wrongp.InternalName,'EMPTY') + ' => ' + isnull(goodp.InternalName,'EMPTY') as ManagerDiff from ( select a.ObjectKeyManager, m.XObjectKey, a.UID_ADSAccount from adsaccount a inner join Person p on p.UID_Person = a.UID_Person left outer join ADSAccount m on p.CCC_Manager_UID_ADSAccount = m.UID_ADSAccount where a.XMarkedForDeletion = 0 AND a.UID_TSBBehavior = 'TSB-FullManaged' ) r inner join ADSAccount aa on r.UID_ADSAccount = aa.UID_ADSAccount inner join Person pp on aa.UID_Person = pp.UID_Person left outer join ADSAccount wronga on r.ObjectKeyManager = wronga.XObjectKey left outer join ADSAccount gooda on r.XObjectKey = gooda.XObjectKey left outer join Person wrongp on wronga.UID_Person = wrongp.UID_Person left outer join Person goodp on gooda.UID_Person = goodp.UID_Person where isnull(r.ObjectKeyManager,'') <> isnull(r.XObjectKey,'') ) select ADAccount as "AD Account", Employee as "Employee", EmpIsInactive as "Inactive Employee", EmpIsTempInactive as "Temporary Inactive Employee", BadManager as "Wrong Manager", GoodManager as "Good Manager" from RPT order by 1;

with RPT as ( select p.InternalName, p.IsInActive, p.IsTemporaryDeactivated, case when exists (select top 1 1 from PersonHasTSBAccountDef pd where pd.UID_Person = p.UID_Person and pd.UID_TSBAccountDef = a.UID_TSBAccountDef) then 1 else 0 end as PersonHasAcctDef, a.SAMAccountName, a.AccountDisabled, a.XMarkedForDeletion, c.CanonicalName, o.TargetDate, o.Description as DeferredDescription, p.UID_Person, a.UID_ADSAccount from ADSAccount a inner join Person p on a.UID_Person = p.UID_Person inner join ADSContainer c on a.UID_ADSContainer = c.UID_ADSContainer left outer join DialogDeferredOperation o on o.ObjectKey = a.XObjectKey where c.UID_ADSContainer in (select UID_ADSContainer from ADSContainer where CanonicalName like N'imcd.nl/IMCD/NLTST%' or CanonicalName like N'imcd.nl/IMCD/NLILX%') --and not a.UID_TSBAccountDef is null --and p.InternalName = 'TEST 350, Ceciles' ) select InternalName as "Employee", IsInActive as "Employee Inactive", IsTemporaryDeactivated as "Employee Temp Disabled", PersonHasAcctDef as "Employee has AcctDef", SAMAccountName as "AD Account", AccountDisabled as "AD Account Disabled", XMarkedForDeletion as "AD Account Deletion Flag", CanonicalName as "AD Account Container", TargetDate as "Deferred Operation Date", DeferredDescription as "Deferred Operation", UID_Person, UID_ADSAccount from RPT order by 1;

with RPT as ( select p.InternalName, p.IsInActive, p.IsTemporaryDeactivated, case when exists (select top 1 1 from PersonHasTSBAccountDef pd where pd.UID_Person = p.UID_Person and pd.UID_TSBAccountDef = a.UID_TSBAccountDef) then 1 else 0 end as PersonHasAcctDef, a.SAMAccountName, a.AccountDisabled, a.XMarkedForDeletion, c.CanonicalName, o.TargetDate, o.Description as DeferredDescription, p.UID_Person, a.UID_ADSAccount from ADSAccount a inner join Person p on a.UID_Person = p.UID_Person inner join ADSContainer c on a.UID_ADSContainer = c.UID_ADSContainer left outer join DialogDeferredOperation o on o.ObjectKey = a.XObjectKey where c.UID_ADSContainer in (select UID_ADSContainer from ADSContainer where CanonicalName like N'imcd.nl/IMCD/NLTST%' or CanonicalName like N'imcd.nl/IMCD/NLILX%') --and not a.UID_TSBAccountDef is null --and p.InternalName = 'TEST 350, Ceciles' ) select InternalName as "Employee", IsInActive as "Employee Inactive", IsTemporaryDeactivated as "Employee Temp Disabled", PersonHasAcctDef as "Employee has AcctDef", SAMAccountName as "AD Account", AccountDisabled as "AD Account Disabled", XMarkedForDeletion as "AD Account Deletion Flag", CanonicalName as "AD Account Container", TargetDate as "Deferred Operation Date", DeferredDescription as "Deferred Operation", UID_Person, UID_ADSAccount from RPT order by 1;

with RPT as ( select p.InternalName, p.IsInActive, p.IsTemporaryDeactivated, case when exists (select top 1 1 from PersonHasTSBAccountDef pd where pd.UID_Person = p.UID_Person and pd.UID_TSBAccountDef = a.UID_TSBAccountDef) then 1 else 0 end as PersonHasAcctDef, a.SAMAccountName, a.AccountDisabled, a.XMarkedForDeletion, c.CanonicalName, p.ExitDate, a.AccountExpires, o.TargetDate, o.Description as DeferredDescription, p.UID_Person, a.UID_ADSAccount from ADSAccount a inner join Person p on a.UID_Person = p.UID_Person inner join ADSContainer c on a.UID_ADSContainer = c.UID_ADSContainer left outer join DialogDeferredOperation o on o.ObjectKey = a.XObjectKey where c.UID_ADSContainer in (select UID_ADSContainer from ADSContainer where CanonicalName like N'%/Shared Mailbox' or CanonicalName like N'%/Disabled') ---CanonicalName like N'imcd.nl/IMCD/NLTST%' or ---CanonicalName like N'imcd.nl/IMCD/NLILX%') --and not a.UID_TSBAccountDef is null --and p.InternalName = 'TEST 350, Ceciles' ) select InternalName as "Employee", IsInActive as "Employee Inactive", IsTemporaryDeactivated as "Employee Temp Disabled", PersonHasAcctDef as "Employee has AcctDef", SAMAccountName as "AD Account", AccountDisabled as "AD Account Disabled", XMarkedForDeletion as "AD Account Deletion Flag", CanonicalName as "AD Account Container", ExitDate as "Employee Leave Date", AccountExpires as "AD Account Expire Date", TargetDate as "Deferred Operation Date", DeferredDescription as "Deferred Operation", UID_Person, UID_ADSAccount from RPT order by 1;

SELECTX(<SQL:PRDBNLIAMDB1.CENET.ICT/OneIM>,iamsa,,V7) CCC_Employee_ID, CCC_HRBP_Source, CCC_HRBP_SourceNumber, CCC_IAM_HRBPManager_ID, CCC_Employee_SourceNumber, CCC_Employee_Source, CCC_Manager1_SourceNumber, CCC_Manager1_Source, CCC_IAM_Manager1_ID, CCC_Manager2_SourceNumber, CCC_Manager2_Source, CCC_IAM_Manager2_ID, CCC_Contract_EndDate, CCC_IsExternal FROM dbo.CCC_STG_MDE_Employees ORDER BY CCC_Employee_ID;

with RPT as ( select aa.CanonicalName as ADAccount, pp.InternalName as Employee, case when pp.IsInActive = 1 then 'Y' else 'N' end as EmpIsInactive, case when pp.IsTemporaryDeactivated = 1 then 'Y' else 'N' end as EmpIsTempInactive, wrongp.InternalName as BadManager, goodp.InternalName as GoodManager, case when IsNull(smp.InternalName,'') > '' then smp.InternalName else case when pp.ImportSource = 'MDEHQ' then 'MANAGER of DEPT' when pp.ImportSource = 'MDERT' then 'MANAGER of LOCALITY' else null end end as StgManager, isnull(wrongp.InternalName,'EMPTY') + ' => ' + isnull(goodp.InternalName,'EMPTY') as ManagerDiff from ( select a.ObjectKeyManager, -- Manager's AD Account on AD Account (wrong) m.XObjectKey, -- AD-Account -> Person -> Manager's AD Account (good) a.UID_ADSAccount from adsaccount a inner join Person p on p.UID_Person = a.UID_Person left outer join ADSAccount m on p.CCC_Manager_UID_ADSAccount = m.UID_ADSAccount where a.XMarkedForDeletion = 0 AND a.UID_TSBBehavior = 'TSB-FullManaged' ) r inner join ADSAccount aa on r.UID_ADSAccount = aa.UID_ADSAccount inner join Person pp on aa.UID_Person = pp.UID_Person left outer join ADSAccount wronga on r.ObjectKeyManager = wronga.XObjectKey left outer join ADSAccount gooda on r.XObjectKey = gooda.XObjectKey left outer join Person wrongp on wronga.UID_Person = wrongp.UID_Person left outer join Person goodp on gooda.UID_Person = goodp.UID_Person left outer join CCC_STG_MDE_Employees s on pp.PersonnelNumber = s.CCC_IAM_ObjectID left outer join Person smp on s.CCC_IAM_Manager1_ID = smp.PersonnelNumber where isnull(r.ObjectKeyManager,'') <> isnull(r.XObjectKey,'') ) select ADAccount as "AD Account", Employee as "Employee", EmpIsInactive as "Inactive Employee", EmpIsTempInactive as "Temporary Inactive Employee", StgManager As "Staging Manager", GoodManager as "Good Manager (on Person)", BadManager as "Wrong Manager (in AD)" from RPT order by 1;

with RPT as ( select CCC_Employee_ID, e.CCC_IAM_ObjectID, p.InternalName, case when CCC_IAM_ObjectType = 'PENSIOEN' then (Select Top 1 CONVERT(Date, CCC_Contract_StartDate, 105) from CCC_STG_MDE_Assignments a where a.CCC_Employee_ID = e.CCC_Employee_ID) else (Select Top 1 CONVERT(Date, CCC_Contract_EndDate, 105) from CCC_STG_MDE_Assignments a where a.CCC_Contract_EndDate is not null and a.CCC_Employee_ID = e.CCC_Employee_ID) end as Staging_ExitDate, CONVERT(Date, p.ExitDate, 105) as Person_ExitDate from CCC_STG_MDE_Employees e left outer join Person p on e.CCC_IAM_ObjectID = p.PersonnelNumber ) select CCC_Employee_ID, CCC_IAM_ObjectID, InternalName, Staging_ExitDate, Person_ExitDate from RPT where isnull(Staging_ExitDate,'') <> isnull(Person_ExitDate,'') order by Person_ExitDate;

WITH RPT as ( select pp.PersonnelNumber, pp.InternalName, pp.ExitDate, aa.CCC_Contract_EndDate from Person pp left outer join CCC_STG_MDE_Employees ee on isnull(ee.CCC_IAM_ObjectID,'') = isnull(pp.PersonnelNumber,'') left outer join CCC_STG_MDE_Assignments aa on isnull(ee.CCC_Employee_ID,'') = isnull(aa.CCC_Employee_ID,'') where ExitDate is not null and isnull(PersonnelNumber,'') > '' AND exists ( select top 1 1 from CCC_STG_MDE_Employees e where isnull(e.CCC_IAM_ObjectID,'') > '' AND PersonnelNumber = e.CCC_IAM_ObjectID and exists ( select top 1 1 from CCC_STG_MDE_Assignments a where isnull(a.CCC_Employee_ID,'') > '' AND e.CCC_Employee_ID = a.CCC_Employee_ID AND isnull(a.CCC_Contract_EndDate , '') = '' ) ) ) select PersonnelNumber, InternalName, ExitDate, CCC_Contract_EndDate from RPT order by 1;

WITH RPT as ( select pp.PersonnelNumber, pp.InternalName, pp.ExitDate, aa.CCC_Contract_EndDate, ee.UID_CCC_STG_MDE_Employees, ee.CCC_Status from Person pp left outer join CCC_STG_MDE_Employees ee on isnull(ee.CCC_IAM_ObjectID,'') = isnull(pp.PersonnelNumber,'') left outer join CCC_STG_MDE_Assignments aa on isnull(ee.CCC_Employee_ID,'') = isnull(aa.CCC_Employee_ID,'') where ExitDate is not null and isnull(PersonnelNumber,'') > '' AND exists ( select top 1 1 from CCC_STG_MDE_Employees e where isnull(e.CCC_IAM_ObjectID,'') > '' AND PersonnelNumber = e.CCC_IAM_ObjectID and exists ( select top 1 1 from CCC_STG_MDE_Assignments a where isnull(a.CCC_Employee_ID,'') > '' AND e.CCC_Employee_ID = a.CCC_Employee_ID AND isnull(a.CCC_Contract_EndDate , '') = '' ) ) ) select PersonnelNumber As "Person PersonnelNumber", InternalName As "Person", ExitDate As "Person ExitDate", CCC_Contract_EndDate As "Assignment EndDate", UID_CCC_STG_MDE_Employees, CCC_Status as "STG_MDE_Employees Status" from RPT order by 1;

WITH RPT as ( select pp.PersonnelNumber, pp.InternalName, pp.ExitDate, aa.CCC_Contract_EndDate, ee.UID_CCC_STG_MDE_Employees, ee.CCC_Status from Person pp left outer join CCC_STG_MDE_Employees ee on isnull(ee.CCC_IAM_ObjectID,'') = isnull(pp.PersonnelNumber,'') left outer join CCC_STG_MDE_Assignments aa on isnull(ee.CCC_Employee_ID,'') = isnull(aa.CCC_Employee_ID,'') where ExitDate is not null and isnull(PersonnelNumber,'') > '' AND exists ( select top 1 1 from CCC_STG_MDE_Employees e where isnull(e.CCC_IAM_ObjectID,'') > '' AND PersonnelNumber = e.CCC_IAM_ObjectID and exists ( select top 1 1 from CCC_STG_MDE_Assignments a where isnull(a.CCC_Employee_ID,'') > '' AND e.CCC_Employee_ID = a.CCC_Employee_ID AND isnull(a.CCC_Contract_EndDate , '') = '' ) ) ) select PersonnelNumber As "Person PersonnelNumber", InternalName As "Person", ExitDate As "Person ExitDate", CCC_Contract_EndDate As "Assignment EndDate", UID_CCC_STG_MDE_Employees, CCC_Status as "STG_MDE_Employees Status" from RPT order by 1;

WITH RPT as ( select pp.PersonnelNumber, pp.InternalName, pp.ExitDate, ee.CCC_Contract_EndDate As Emp_Contract_EndDate, aa.CCC_Contract_EndDate As Assign_Contract_EndDate, ee.UID_CCC_STG_MDE_Employees, ee.CCC_Status from Person pp left outer join CCC_STG_MDE_Employees ee on isnull(ee.CCC_IAM_ObjectID,'') = isnull(pp.PersonnelNumber,'') left outer join CCC_STG_MDE_Assignments aa on isnull(ee.CCC_Employee_ID,'') = isnull(aa.CCC_Employee_ID,'') where ExitDate is not null and isnull(PersonnelNumber,'') > '' AND exists ( select top 1 1 from CCC_STG_MDE_Employees e where isnull(e.CCC_IAM_ObjectID,'') > '' AND PersonnelNumber = e.CCC_IAM_ObjectID and exists ( select top 1 1 from CCC_STG_MDE_Assignments a where isnull(a.CCC_Employee_ID,'') > '' AND e.CCC_Employee_ID = a.CCC_Employee_ID AND isnull(a.CCC_Contract_EndDate , '') = '' ) ) ) select PersonnelNumber As "Person PersonnelNumber", InternalName As "Person", ExitDate As "Person ExitDate", Emp_Contract_EndDate As "MDE Employee EndDate", Assign_Contract_EndDate As "Assignment EndDate", UID_CCC_STG_MDE_Employees, CCC_Status as "STG_MDE_Employees Status" from RPT order by 1;

WITH RPT as ( select pp.PersonnelNumber, pp.InternalName, pp.ExitDate, ee.CCC_Contract_EndDate As Emp_Contract_EndDate, aa.CCC_Contract_EndDate As Assign_Contract_EndDate, ee.UID_CCC_STG_MDE_Employees, ee.CCC_Status from Person pp left outer join CCC_STG_MDE_Employees ee on isnull(ee.CCC_IAM_ObjectID,'') = isnull(pp.PersonnelNumber,'') left outer join CCC_STG_MDE_Assignments aa on isnull(ee.CCC_Employee_ID,'') = isnull(aa.CCC_Employee_ID,'') where ExitDate is not null and isnull(PersonnelNumber,'') > '' AND exists ( select top 1 1 from CCC_STG_MDE_Employees e where isnull(e.CCC_IAM_ObjectID,'') > '' AND PersonnelNumber = e.CCC_IAM_ObjectID and exists ( select top 1 1 from CCC_STG_MDE_Assignments a where isnull(a.CCC_Employee_ID,'') > '' AND e.CCC_Employee_ID = a.CCC_Employee_ID AND isnull(a.CCC_Contract_EndDate , '') = '' ) ) ) select PersonnelNumber As "Person PersonnelNumber", InternalName As "Person", ExitDate As "Person ExitDate", Emp_Contract_EndDate As "MDE Employee EndDate", Assign_Contract_EndDate As "Assignment EndDate", UID_CCC_STG_MDE_Employees, CCC_Status as "STG_MDE_Employees Status" from RPT order by 1;

with pchg as ( select pp.UID_Person, min(o.OperationDate) as FirstChgDate from DialogWatchOperation o inner join Person pp on o.ObjectKeyOfRow = pp.XObjectKey inner join DialogWatchProperty p on p.UID_DialogWatchOperation = o.UID_DialogWatchOperation inner join DialogColumn c on p.UID_DialogColumn = c.UID_DialogColumn inner join DialogTable t on c.UID_DialogTable = t.UID_DialogTable where c.ColumnName = 'UID_Department' and t.TableName = 'Person' group by pp.UID_Person ), RPT as ( select pp.InternalName + ' (' + pp.CentralAccount + ')' as Employee, o.OperationDate As ChangeDate, dbo.QBM_FCVObjectkeyToElement('TableName',o.ObjectKeyOfRow) as ChangedObject, o.DisplayValue As ChangedObjectName, t.TableName + '@' + c.ColumnName As FieldName from pchg inner join Person pp on pchg.UID_Person = pp.UID_Person inner join DialogWatchOperation o on o.ObjectKeyOfRow like '%' + pchg.UID_Person + '%' and o.OperationDate >= pchg.FirstChgDate left outer join DialogWatchProperty p on p.UID_DialogWatchOperation = o.UID_DialogWatchOperation left outer join DialogColumn c on p.UID_DialogColumn = c.UID_DialogColumn left outer join DialogTable t on c.UID_DialogTable = t.UID_DialogTable ) select ChangeDate as "Change Date", Employee as "Employee", ChangedObject as "Changed Object", ChangedObjectName as "Changed Object Name", FieldName as "Changed Field" from RPT order by ChangeDate desc, 2, 3, 4, 5;

WITH chgs AS ( select o.ObjectKeyOfRow AS ObjectKey, dc.Caption AS ColumnName --, COUNT(*) AS cnt from [dbo].DialogWatchProperty d INNER JOIN [dbo].DialogWatchOperation o ON o.UID_DialogWatchOperation = d.UID_DialogWatchOperation INNER JOIN [dbo].[DialogColumn] dc ON d.UID_DialogColumn = dc.UID_DialogColumn INNER JOIN [dbo].[Person] a1 ON o.ObjectKeyOfRow = a1.XObjectKey WHERE d.UID_DialogColumn in (SELECT UID_DialogColumn FROM [dbo].[DialogColumn] c INNER JOIN DialogTable t ON t.UID_DialogTable = c.UID_DialogTable WHERE t.TableName = 'Person' And (c.ColumnName in ('UID_Department'))) -- AND a1.SAMAccountName in ('PonceletM','VochtenS','AldingerT') -- AND ((a1.CanonicalName like '%rabt%') or (a1.CanonicalName like '%rabp%') or (a1.CanonicalName like '%rabx%')) -- AND a1.CanonicalName in ('Wibowo, A (Ardi)','Widjaja, N (Nanny)','Darmaji, D (Didit)','Andridina, A (Abhimata)') -- AND o.OperationDate > '2016-11-04 18:00:00' --GROUP BY o.ObjectKeyOfRow, dc.Caption --HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ), accts AS ( SELECT distinct a.InternalName + ' (' + a.CentralAccount + ')' as Person, a.UID_Department as CurrDepartmentID, d.DepartmentName as CurrDepartment, a.XObjectKey as XObjectKey FROM chgs c INNER JOIN [dbo].[Person] a ON c.ObjectKey = a.XObjectKey LEFT OUTER JOIN Department d ON d.UID_Department = a.UID_Department ) SELECTX(<SQL:IMCD>) Person As "Identity", CurrDepartment as "Current Department", XObjectKey FROM accts ORDER BY Person JOIN_ON XObjectKey=aa.XObjectKey with rq as ( select aa.XObjectKey from [dbo].[Person] aa where <JOIN_FILTER> ), chg_records AS ( select dc2.Caption as COL, Row_Number() OVER (PARTITION BY dc2.Caption ORDER BY o2.OperationDate ASC) AS ROW_NUM, CASE (Row_Number() OVER (PARTITION BY dc2.Caption ORDER BY o2.OperationDate ASC)) WHEN 1 THEN 'Initial Value' ELSE 'Change' END AS CHG_TYPE, o2.OperationDate AS OPERATION_DATE, o2.OperationUser AS OPERATION_USER, CASE (Row_Number() OVER (PARTITION BY dc2.Caption ORDER BY o2.OperationDate ASC)) WHEN 1 THEN '---' ELSE cast(dd.DepartmentName as nvarchar(1024)) END AS PREV_VAL, CASE (Row_Number() OVER (PARTITION BY dc2.Caption ORDER BY o2.OperationDate DESC)) WHEN 1 THEN CASE dc2.ColumnName WHEN 'UID_Department' THEN ddd.DepartmentName -- WHEN 'RAB_ExpectedJobEndDate' THEN p2.RAB_ExpectedJobEndDate END ELSE cast((LAG(dd.DepartmentName) OVER (PARTITION BY dc2.Caption ORDER BY o2.OperationDate DESC)) as nvarchar(1024)) END AS NEXT_VAL from rq, [dbo].DialogWatchProperty d2 LEFT OUTER JOIN Department dd ON d2.ContentShort = dd.UID_Department INNER JOIN [dbo].DialogWatchOperation o2 ON o2.UID_DialogWatchOperation = d2.UID_DialogWatchOperation INNER JOIN [dbo].[Person] p2 ON o2.ObjectKeyOfRow = p2.XObjectKey LEFT OUTER JOIN Department ddd ON p2.UID_Department = ddd.UID_Department INNER JOIN [dbo].[DialogColumn] dc2 ON d2.UID_DialogColumn = dc2.UID_DialogColumn WHERE d2.UID_DialogColumn in (SELECT UID_DialogColumn FROM [dbo].[DialogColumn] c INNER JOIN DialogTable t ON t.UID_DialogTable = c.UID_DialogTable WHERE t.TableName = 'Person' And (c.ColumnName in ('UID_Department'))) AND rq.XObjectKey = o2.ObjectKeyOfRow -- ORDER BY o2.OperationDate DESC ) SELECTX(<SQL:IMCD>) COL AS "Column", CHG_TYPE AS "Type of Change", OPERATION_DATE AS "Change Date", OPERATION_USER AS "Changed By", PREV_VAL AS "Old Value", NEXT_VAL AS "New Value" FROM chg_records order BY COL, ROW_NUM DESC;

WITH chgs AS ( select o.ObjectKeyOfRow AS ObjectKey, dc.Caption AS ColumnName, COUNT(*) AS cnt from [dbo].DialogWatchProperty d INNER JOIN [dbo].DialogWatchOperation o ON o.UID_DialogWatchOperation = d.UID_DialogWatchOperation INNER JOIN [dbo].[DialogColumn] dc ON d.UID_DialogColumn = dc.UID_DialogColumn INNER JOIN [dbo].[Person] a1 ON o.ObjectKeyOfRow = a1.XObjectKey WHERE d.UID_DialogColumn in INNER JOIN [dbo].[Person] a ON c.ObjectKey = a.XObjectKey LEFT OUTER JOIN Department d ON d.UID_Department = a.UID_Department ) SELECTX(<SQL:IMCD>) Person As "Identity", CurrDepartment as "Current Department", XObjectKey FROM accts ORDER BY Person JOIN_ON XObjectKey=aa.XObjectKey with rq as ( select aa.XObjectKey from [dbo].[Person] aa where <JOIN_FILTER> ), chg_records AS ( select dc2.Caption as COL, Row_Number() OVER (PARTITION BY dc2.Caption ORDER BY o2.OperationDate ASC) AS ROW_NUM, CASE (Row_Number() OVER (PARTITION BY dc2.Caption ORDER BY o2.OperationDate ASC)) WHEN 1 THEN 'Initial Value' ELSE 'Change' END AS CHG_TYPE, o2.OperationDate AS OPERATION_DATE, o2.OperationUser AS OPERATION_USER, CASE (Row_Number() OVER (PARTITION BY dc2.Caption ORDER BY o2.OperationDate ASC)) WHEN 1 THEN '---' ELSE cast(dd.DepartmentName as nvarchar(1024)) END AS PREV_VAL, CASE (Row_Number() OVER (PARTITION BY dc2.Caption ORDER BY o2.OperationDate DESC)) WHEN 1 THEN CASE dc2.ColumnName WHEN 'UID_Department' THEN ddd.DepartmentName -- WHEN 'RAB_ExpectedJobEndDate' THEN p2.RAB_ExpectedJobEndDate END ELSE cast((LAG(dd.DepartmentName) OVER (PARTITION BY dc2.Caption ORDER BY o2.OperationDate DESC)) as nvarchar(1024)) END AS NEXT_VAL from rq, [dbo].DialogWatchProperty d2 LEFT OUTER JOIN Department dd ON d2.ContentShort = dd.UID_Department INNER JOIN [dbo].DialogWatchOperation o2 ON o2.UID_DialogWatchOperation = d2.UID_DialogWatchOperation INNER JOIN [dbo].[Person] p2 ON o2.ObjectKeyOfRow = p2.XObjectKey LEFT OUTER JOIN Department ddd ON p2.UID_Department = ddd.UID_Department INNER JOIN [dbo].[DialogColumn] dc2 ON d2.UID_DialogColumn = dc2.UID_DialogColumn WHERE d2.UID_DialogColumn in (SELECT UID_DialogColumn FROM [dbo].[DialogColumn] c INNER JOIN DialogTable t ON t.UID_DialogTable = c.UID_DialogTable WHERE t.TableName = 'Person' And (c.ColumnName in ('UID_Department'))) AND rq.XObjectKey = o2.ObjectKeyOfRow -- ORDER BY o2.OperationDate DESC ) SELECTX(<SQL:IMCD>) COL AS "Column", CHG_TYPE AS "Type of Change", OPERATION_DATE AS "Change Date", OPERATION_USER AS "Changed By", PREV_VAL AS "Old Value", NEXT_VAL AS "New Value" FROM chg_records order BY COL, ROW_NUM DESC;

with RPT as ( select o.OperationDate, pp.InternalName + ' (' + pp.CentralAccount + ')' as Employee, d.DepartmentName as 'CurrentDepartment', dold.DepartmentName as 'PrevDepartment' from DialogWatchOperation o inner join Person pp on o.ObjectKeyOfRow = pp.XObjectKey left outer join Department d on d.UID_Department = pp.UID_Department inner join DialogWatchProperty p on p.UID_DialogWatchOperation = o.UID_DialogWatchOperation left outer join Department dold on p.ContentShort = dold.UID_Department inner join DialogColumn c on p.UID_DialogColumn = c.UID_DialogColumn inner join DialogTable t on c.UID_DialogTable = t.UID_DialogTable where c.ColumnName = 'UID_Department' and t.TableName = 'Person' and o.OperationType = 'U' ) select OperationDate as "Change Date", Employee, CurrentDepartment as "Current Dept", PrevDepartment as "Dept before Change" from RPT order by OperationDate desc;

with containers as ( select dbo.QBM_FCVObjectkeyToElement('TableName',b.XObjectKey) as tname, i.UID_org, c.ObjectGUID as SafeNetContainer, c.UID_UNSContainerB FROM [OneIM].[dbo].[TSBITData] i inner join UNSContainerB c on c.XObjectKey = i.ObjectKeyValue inner join UNSRootB r on c.UID_UNSRootB = r.UID_UNSRootB left outer join BaseTree b on i.UID_Org = b.UID_Org where r.Ident_UNSRoot = 'SafeNet' ), cont_lookup as ( select cc.tname as DeptLoc, case tname when 'Locality' then (select l.Ident_locality from Locality l where l.UID_Locality = cc.UID_Org) when 'Department' then (select d.DepartmentName from Department d where d.UID_Department = cc.UID_Org) else null end as NameDeptLoc, cc.UID_Org, cc.SafeNetContainer, cc.UID_UNSContainerB from containers cc ), safenet_chk as ( select p2.InternalName, p2.CentralAccount, p2.IsInActive, p2.IsTemporaryDeactivated, a2.CanonicalName, a2.AccountDisabled, a2.XMarkedForDeletion, c2.ObjectGUID as CurrentContainer, Stuff(( SELECT ',' + cast(cc3.SafeNetContainer as varchar(max)) FROM cont_lookup cc3 WHERE cc3.UID_Org = p2.UID_Locality and cc3.DeptLoc = 'Locality' FOR XML PATH('') ), 1, 1, '') as LocContainer, (select UID_UNSContainerB from cont_lookup cc4 where cc4.UID_Org = p2.UID_Locality and cc4.DeptLoc = 'Locality') as UID_UNSContainerB, Stuff(( SELECT ',' + cast(cc4.SafeNetContainer as varchar(max)) FROM cont_lookup cc4 WHERE cc4.UID_Org = p2.UID_Department and cc4.DeptLoc = 'Department' FOR XML PATH('') ), 1, 1, '') as DepContainer from UNSAccountB a2 inner join Person p2 on a2.UID_Person = p2.UID_Person inner join UNSRootB r2 on a2.UID_UNSRootB = r2.UID_UNSRootB left outer join UNSContainerB c2 on a2.UID_UNSContainerB = c2.UID_UNSContainerB where r2.Ident_UNSRoot = 'SafeNet' ), RPT as ( select InternalName, CentralAccount, case IsInActive when 1 then 'Yes' else 'No' end as EmpDisabled, case IsTemporaryDeactivated when 1 then 'Yes' else 'No' end as EmpTempDisabled, CanonicalName, case AccountDisabled when 1 then 'Yes' else 'No' end as AcctDisabled, XMarkedForDeletion as SafeNetDeleted, case when XMarkedForDeletion > 0 then 'Yes' else 'No' end as AcctDeleted, CurrentContainer, LocContainer, UID_UNSContainerB as LocContainerUID from safenet_chk where isnull(CurrentContainer,'') <> isnull(LocContainer,'') ) select InternalName As "Employee", CentralAccount As "Employee: CentralAccount", EmpDisabled As "Employee: is Disabled", EmpTempDisabled As "Employee: is Temp-Disabled", CanonicalName As "SafeNet Account: CanonicalName", AcctDisabled As "SafeNet Account: is Disabled", AcctDeleted As "SafeNet Account: is Deleted", CurrentContainer As "SafeNet Account: Current Container", LocContainer As "Location: Container", LocContainerUID As "Location: UID_UNSContainerB" from RPT order by InternalName;

with RPT as ( select p.InternalName as 'Employee', case when p.IsInActive = 1 then 'Inactive' when p.IsTemporaryDeactivated = 1 then 'Temp Inactive' else 'Active' end as 'PersonStatus', a.ObjectGUID as 'JDEUser', a.CCC_JDE_AddressNumber, case when isnull(a.CCC_JDE_AddressNumber,'') = isnull(p.CustomProperty08,'') then a.CCC_JDE_AddressNumber else a.CCC_JDE_AddressNumber + ' (P = ' + p.CustomProperty08 + ')' end as AddrNum, p.CustomProperty08, l.Description as 'Location', case when a.AccountDisabled = 0 then 'Enabled in 1IM, Disabled in JDE [should be enabled]' else 'Disabled in 1IM, Enabled in JDE [enabled outside of 1IM]' end as StatusMissmatch from UNSAccountB a inner join Person p on a.UID_Person = p.UID_Person left outer join Locality l on p.UID_Locality = l.UID_Locality where a.CanonicalName like 'JDE/USERS/%' and a.AccountDisabled <> a.CCC_JDE_Disabled ) select Employee, Location as "Émployee Location", PersonStatus as "Employee Status", JDEUser as "JDE User", AddrNum as "Address Book Number", StatusMissmatch as "Status Missmatch" from RPT order by 1;

with RPT as ( select p.InternalName as 'Employee', case when p.IsInActive = 1 then 'Inactive' when p.IsTemporaryDeactivated = 1 then 'Temp Inactive' else 'Active' end as 'PersonStatus', a.ObjectGUID as 'JDEUser', a.CCC_JDE_AddressNumber, case when isnull(a.CCC_JDE_AddressNumber,'') = isnull(p.CustomProperty08,'') then a.CCC_JDE_AddressNumber else a.CCC_JDE_AddressNumber + ' (P = ' + p.CustomProperty08 + ')' end as AddrNum, p.CustomProperty08, l.Description as 'Location', case when a.AccountDisabled = 0 then 'Enabled in 1IM, Disabled in JDE [should be enabled]' else 'Disabled in 1IM, Enabled in JDE [enabled outside of 1IM]' end as StatusMissmatch, case when a.UID_TSBBehavior = 'TSB-FullManaged' then 'Full-Managed' else 'Linked' end as 'ManageLevel' from UNSAccountB a inner join Person p on a.UID_Person = p.UID_Person left outer join Locality l on p.UID_Locality = l.UID_Locality where a.CanonicalName like 'JDE/USERS/%' and a.AccountDisabled <> a.CCC_JDE_Disabled and a.UID_Person is not null ) select Employee, Location as "Émployee Location", PersonStatus as "Employee Status", JDEUser as "JDE User", AddrNum as "Address Book Number", ManageLevel as "Manage Level", StatusMissmatch as "Status Missmatch" from RPT order by 1;

with RPT as ( select p.InternalName as 'Employee', case when p.IsInActive = 1 then 'Inactive' when p.IsTemporaryDeactivated = 1 then 'Temp Inactive' else 'Active' end as 'PersonStatus', a.ObjectGUID as 'JDEUser', a.CCC_JDE_AddressNumber, case when isnull(a.CCC_JDE_AddressNumber,'') = isnull(p.CustomProperty08,'') then a.CCC_JDE_AddressNumber else a.CCC_JDE_AddressNumber + ' (P = ' + p.CustomProperty08 + ')' end as AddrNum, p.CustomProperty08, l.Description as 'Location', d.Description as 'Company', case when a.AccountDisabled = 0 then 'Enabled in 1IM, Disabled in JDE [should be enabled]' else 'Disabled in 1IM, Enabled in JDE [enabled outside of 1IM]' end as StatusMissmatch, case when a.UID_TSBBehavior = 'TSB-FullManaged' then 'Full-Managed' else 'Linked' end as 'ManageLevel' from UNSAccountB a inner join Person p on a.UID_Person = p.UID_Person left outer join Locality l on p.UID_Locality = l.UID_Locality left outer join Department d on p.UID_Department = d.UID_Department where a.CanonicalName like 'JDE/USERS/%' and a.AccountDisabled <> a.CCC_JDE_Disabled and a.UID_Person is not null ) select Employee, Company as "Employee Company", PersonStatus as "Employee Status", JDEUser as "JDE User", AddrNum as "Address Book Number", ManageLevel as "Manage Level", StatusMissmatch as "Status Missmatch" from RPT order by 1;

with def_roles as ( select u.UID_CSMUser, u.AccountName, u.CustomString01, g.DisplayName from CSMUser u inner join CSMUserInGroup ug on u.UID_CSMUser = ug.UID_CSMUser inner join CSMGroup g on ug.UID_CSMGroup = g.UID_CSMGroup where u.UID_CSMRoot = 'd891b578-3adf-4e18-8279-502069685b2d' and g.DisplayName like 'PROD_FR%' ), RPT as ( select uu.AccountName, uu.CustomString01, (select STRING_AGG(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(MAX), ISNULL(rr.DisplayName, '<none>')), ' | ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY rr.DisplayName) from def_roles rr where rr.UID_CSMUser = uu.UID_CSMUser) as prod_roles from CSMUser uu where UID_CSMRoot = 'd891b578-3adf-4e18-8279-502069685b2d' ) select AccountName as "Snowflake Account", CustomString01 as "Default Role", prod_roles as "Current PR Role(s)" from RPT order by 1;
