WITH RPT as ( select u.AccountName, u.CustomString02, u.CustomString01, STRING_AGG(g.DisplayName, ', ') WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY g.DisplayName) as ProdRoles from CSMUser u inner join CSMRoot r on u.UID_CSMRoot = r.UID_CSMRoot left outer join CSMUserInGroup ug on u.UID_CSMUser = ug.UID_CSMUser left outer join CSMGroup g on ug.UID_CSMGroup = g.UID_CSMGroup where g.DisplayName = 'PROD_SYSADMIN' or g.DisplayName like 'PROD_FR%' group by u.AccountName, u.CustomString02, u.CustomString01 ) select AccountName as "Snowflake User", CustomString02 as "Default Warehouse", CustomString01 as "Default Role", ProdRoles as "PROD Roles" from RPT where isnull(CustomString01,'') <> isnull(ProdRoles,'') order by 1;

WITH RPT as ( select u.AccountName, u.CustomString02, u.CustomString01, STRING_AGG(g.DisplayName, ', ') WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY g.DisplayName) as ProdRoles from CSMUser u inner join CSMRoot r on u.UID_CSMRoot = r.UID_CSMRoot left outer join CSMUserInGroup ug on u.UID_CSMUser = ug.UID_CSMUser left outer join CSMGroup g on ug.UID_CSMGroup = g.UID_CSMGroup where g.DisplayName = 'PROD_SYSADMIN' or g.DisplayName like 'PROD_FR%' group by u.AccountName, u.CustomString02, u.CustomString01 ) select AccountName as "Snowflake User", CustomString02 as "Default Warehouse", CustomString01 as "Default Role", ProdRoles as "PROD Roles" from RPT order by 1;

WITH RPT as ( select u.AccountName, u.CustomString02, u.CustomString01, STRING_AGG(g.DisplayName, ', ') WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY g.DisplayName) as ProdRoles from CSMUser u left outer join CSMUserInGroup ug on u.UID_CSMUser = ug.UID_CSMUser left outer join CSMGroup g on ug.UID_CSMGroup = g.UID_CSMGroup where g.DisplayName = 'PROD_SYSADMIN' or g.DisplayName like 'PROD_FR%' group by u.AccountName, u.CustomString02, u.CustomString01 ) select AccountName as "Snowflake User", CustomString02 as "Default Warehouse", CustomString01 as "Default Role", ProdRoles as "PROD Roles" from RPT order by 1;

WITH RPT as ( select u.AccountName, u.CustomString02, u.CustomString01, STRING_AGG(g.DisplayName, ', ') WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY g.DisplayName) as ProdRoles from CSMUser u left outer join CSMUserInGroup ug on u.UID_CSMUser = ug.UID_CSMUser left outer join CSMGroup g on ug.UID_CSMGroup = g.UID_CSMGroup AND (g.DisplayName = 'PROD_SYSADMIN' or g.DisplayName like 'PROD_FR%') group by u.AccountName, u.CustomString02, u.CustomString01 ) select AccountName as "Snowflake User", CustomString02 as "Default Warehouse", CustomString01 as "Default Role", ProdRoles as "PROD Roles" from RPT where isnull(CustomString01,'') <> isnull(ProdRoles,'') order by 1;

WITH RPT as ( select u.AccountName, u.CustomString02, u.CustomString01, STRING_AGG(g.DisplayName, ', ') WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY g.DisplayName) as ProdRoles from CSMUser u left outer join CSMUserInGroup ug on u.UID_CSMUser = ug.UID_CSMUser left outer join CSMGroup g on ug.UID_CSMGroup = g.UID_CSMGroup AND (g.DisplayName = 'PROD_SYSADMIN' or g.DisplayName like 'PROD_FR%') group by u.AccountName, u.CustomString02, u.CustomString01 ) select AccountName as "Snowflake User", CustomString02 as "Default Warehouse", CustomString01 as "Default Role", ProdRoles as "PROD Roles" from RPT order by 1;

SELECTX(<SQL:IMCD_OTA>) Operation, IsProcessed, <DBLOOKUP(<SQL:IMCD_OTA>) "<OBJECT_TABLE>" "'<OBJECT_TABLE_NAME>'[Table Name], <DEFAULT>[Object]" "" "" "ObjectKeyElement=XObjectKey">, XMarkedForDeletion, UID_QBMPendingChange FROM dbo.QBMPendingChange ORDER BY XDateInserted DESC JOIN_ON UID_QBMPendingChange SELECTX(<SQL:IMCD_OTA>) CreationDate, Operation, IsProcessed, DiffStore, XMarkedForDeletion, UID_QBMPendingChange, UID_QBMPendingChangeDetail FROM dbo.QBMPendingChangeDetail ORDER BY XDateInserted DESC;

SELECTX(<SQL:IMCD>) Operation, IsProcessed, <DBLOOKUP(<SQL:IMCD>) "<OBJECT_TABLE>" "'<OBJECT_TABLE_NAME>'[Table Name], <DEFAULT>[Object]" "" "" "ObjectKeyElement=XObjectKey">, XMarkedForDeletion, UID_QBMPendingChange FROM dbo.QBMPendingChange ORDER BY XDateInserted DESC JOIN_ON UID_QBMPendingChange SELECTX(<SQL:IMCD>) CreationDate, Operation, IsProcessed, DiffStore, XMarkedForDeletion, UID_QBMPendingChange, UID_QBMPendingChangeDetail FROM dbo.QBMPendingChangeDetail ORDER BY XDateInserted DESC;

SELECTX(<SQL:IMCD>) Operation, IsProcessed, <DBLOOKUP(<SQL:IMCD>) "<OBJECT_TABLE>" "'<OBJECT_TABLE_NAME>'[Table Name], <DEFAULT>[Object]" "" "" "ObjectKeyElement=XObjectKey">, XMarkedForDeletion, UID_QBMPendingChange FROM dbo.QBMPendingChange ORDER BY XDateInserted DESC JOIN_ON UID_QBMPendingChange SELECTX(<SQL:IMCD>) CreationDate, Operation, IsProcessed, DiffStore, XMarkedForDeletion, UID_QBMPendingChange, UID_QBMPendingChangeDetail FROM dbo.QBMPendingChangeDetail ORDER BY XDateInserted DESC;

SELECTX(<SQL:IMCD>) Operation, IsProcessed, <DBLOOKUP(<SQL:IMCD>) "<OBJECT_TABLE>" "'<OBJECT_TABLE_NAME>'[Table Name], <DEFAULT>[Object]" "" "" "ObjectKeyElement=XObjectKey">, XMarkedForDeletion, UID_QBMPendingChange FROM dbo.QBMPendingChange ORDER BY XDateInserted DESC JOIN_ON UID_QBMPendingChange SELECTX(<SQL:IMCD>) CreationDate, Operation, IsProcessed, DiffStore, XMarkedForDeletion, UID_QBMPendingChange, UID_QBMPendingChangeDetail FROM dbo.QBMPendingChangeDetail ORDER BY XDateInserted DESC;
SELECTX(<SQL:AWIAMSQL01.IMCD.NL/OneIM>,OneIM,,V7) TargetDate, DisplayValue, Description FROM dbo.DialogDeferredOperation WHERE Operation = 'Update' ORDER BY TargetDate;

SELECTX(<SQL:IMCD>) TargetDate, DisplayValue, Description FROM dbo.DialogDeferredOperation WHERE Operation = 'Update' ORDER BY TargetDate JOIN_ON ObjectKey=XObjectKey SELECTX(<SQL:AWIAMSQL01.IMCD.NL/OneIM>,OneIM,,V7) CanonicalName, AccountDisabled FROM dbo.ADSAccount JOIN_ON UID_Person SELECTX(<SQL:AWIAMSQL01.IMCD.NL/OneIM>,OneIM,,V7) InternalName, IsInActive, IsTemporaryDeactivated FROM dbo.Person;

with rpt as ( select o.OperationDate, a.AccountName, a.CanonicalName, o.OperationUser from DialogWatchProperty p inner join DialogWatchOperation o on p.UID_DialogWatchOperation = o.UID_DialogWatchOperation inner join UNSAccountB a on a.XObjectKey = o.ObjectKeyOfRow where p.UID_DialogColumn = ( select UID_DialogColumn from DialogColumn c inner join DialogTable t on c.UID_DialogTable = t.UID_DialogTable where c.ColumnName = 'CCC_CustomProperty02' and t.TableName = 'UNSAccountB') and a.CanonicalName like 'Salesforce_PS%' and o.OperationType = 'U' ) select * from RPT order by 1 desc;

with exits as ( select CONVERT(VARCHAR(5), p.ExitDate, 108) as ExitTime, c.CountryName, c.AVGUTCOffset from Person p left outer join Locality l on p.UID_Locality = l.UID_Locality left outer join DialogCountry c on l.UID_DialogCountry = c.UID_DialogCountry where p.ExitDate is not null ), RPT as ( select ExitTime, CountryName, count(*) as NumEmployees from exits group by ExitTime, CountryName ) select ExitTime as "ExitTime in UTC", CountryName, NumEmployees as "Count of Persons" from RPT order by 1, 2;

with rpt as ( select o.OperationDate, pp.InternalName + ' (' + pp.CentralAccount + ')' as Employee, o.OperationUser, p.ContentShort as OldDate, pp.ExitDate as CurrentDate from DialogWatchOperation o inner join Person pp on o.ObjectKeyOfRow = pp.XObjectKey inner join DialogWatchProperty p on o.UID_DialogWatchOperation = p.UID_DialogWatchOperation inner join DialogColumn c on p.UID_DialogColumn = c.UID_DialogColumn where c.ColumnName = 'ExitDate' and o.OperationDate > '2024-12-31 23:59:59' ) select OperationDate as "Change Date", Employee, OperationUser as "Changed By", OldDate as "Previous Exit-Date", CurrentDate as "Current ExitDate" from rpt order by OperationDate desc;

with rpt as ( select p.InternalName + ' (' + p.CentralAccount + ')' as 'PersName', pm.InternalName + ' (' + pm.CentralAccount + ')' as 'Manager', r.XDateInserted as 'CancelledRun', r2.XDateInserted as 'NewRun' from AttestationCase a inner join AttestationRun r on a.UID_AttestationRun = r.UID_AttestationRun inner join Person p on a.ObjectKeyBase = p.XObjectKey left outer join Person pm on pm.UID_Person = p.UID_PersonHead left outer join AttestationCase a2 on a2.ObjectKeyBase = p.XObjectKey and a2.UID_AttestationCase <> a.UID_AttestationCase inner join AttestationRun r2 on a2.UID_AttestationRun = r2.UID_AttestationRun where (isnull(a.DisplayName,'') = '' or a.IsUnderConstruction = 1) and ((r2.XDateInserted is null) or (r.XDateInserted < r2.XDateInserted)) ) select PersName as Employee, Manager as Manager, CancelledRun as "Cancelled Run", NewRun as "New Run" from rpt order by CancelledRun desc, PERSNAME, NEWRUN;

with rpt as ( select o.OperationDate, pp.InternalName + ' (' + pp.CentralAccount + ')' as Employee, o.OperationUser, xx.Manager as Manager, p.ContentShort as OldDate, pp.ExitDate as CurrentDate from DialogWatchOperation o inner join Person pp on o.ObjectKeyOfRow = pp.XObjectKey outer apply ( select top 1 pm.InternalName + ' (' + pm.CentralAccount + ')' as Manager from person pm left outer join DialogUser u on pm.UID_DialogUser = u.UID_DialogUser where o.OperationUser = pm.DefaultEmailAddress or u.UserName = o.OperationUser ) xx inner join DialogWatchProperty p on o.UID_DialogWatchOperation = p.UID_DialogWatchOperation inner join DialogColumn c on p.UID_DialogColumn = c.UID_DialogColumn where c.ColumnName = 'ExitDate' and o.OperationDate > '2024-12-31 23:59:59' ) select OperationDate as "Change Date", Employee, OperationUser as "Changed By", Manager as "Changed By Person", OldDate as "Previous Exit-Date", CurrentDate as "Current ExitDate" from rpt order by OperationDate desc;

with companies_in_regions as ( select CCC_ID, CCC_DisplayName from CCC_IMCDCompanies where CCC_UID_Region is not null ) select CCC_ID as "Company ID", CCC_DisplayName as "Country" from companies_in_regions order by 1;

with rpt as ( select o.OperationDate, pp.InternalName + ' (' + pp.CentralAccount + ')' as Employee, o.OperationUser, xx.Manager as Manager, case when p.ContentShort = 1 then 'Yes' else 'No' end as OldInactive, case when pp.IsInactive = 1 then 'Yes' else 'No' end as CurrentInactive from DialogWatchOperation o inner join Person pp on o.ObjectKeyOfRow = pp.XObjectKey outer apply ( select top 1 pm.InternalName + ' (' + pm.CentralAccount + ')' as Manager from person pm left outer join DialogUser u on pm.UID_DialogUser = u.UID_DialogUser where o.OperationUser = pm.DefaultEmailAddress or u.UserName = o.OperationUser ) xx inner join DialogWatchProperty p on o.UID_DialogWatchOperation = p.UID_DialogWatchOperation inner join DialogColumn c on p.UID_DialogColumn = c.UID_DialogColumn where c.ColumnName = 'IsInactive' and o.OperationDate > '2024-12-31 23:59:59' ) select OperationDate as "Change Date", Employee, OperationUser as "Changed By", Manager as "Changed By Person", OldInactive as "Was Previously Disabled", CurrentInactive as "Is Currently Disabled" from rpt order by OperationDate desc;

SELECTX([IMCD Support 2025],n/a) [OperationDate__Change Date], Employee__Employee, [OperationUser__Changed By], [Manager__Changed By Person], [OldDate__Previous Exit-Date], [CurrentDate__Current ExitDate] FROM Exit_Date_Changes_2 ORDER BY [#] JOIN_ON Employee__Employee SELECTX([IMCD Support 2025],n/a) [OperationDate__Change Date], [OldInactive__Was Previously Disabled], [CurrentInactive__Is Currently Disabled] FROM Inactive_Changes;

SELECTX([IMCD Support 2025]) [OperationDate__Change Date], Employee__Employee, [OperationUser__Changed By], [OldInactive__Was Previously Disabled], [CurrentInactive__Is Currently Disabled] FROM Inactive_Changes WHERE [OldInactive__Was Previously Disabled] = 'No' AND [CurrentInactive__Is Currently Disabled] = 'Yes' ORDER BY [OPERATIONDATE__CHANGE DATE] DESC JOIN_ON Employee__Employee SELECTX([IMCD Support 2025]) [OperationDate__Change Date], [OperationUser__Changed By], [Manager__Changed By Person], [OldDate__Previous Exit-Date], [CurrentDate__Current ExitDate] FROM Exit_Date_Changes_2 ORDER BY [OPERATIONDATE__CHANGE DATE] DESC;

SELECTX([IMCD Support 2025]) [OperationDate__Change Date], Employee__Employee, [OperationUser__Changed By], [OldInactive__Was Previously Disabled], [CurrentInactive__Is Currently Disabled] FROM Inactive_Changes WHERE [OldInactive__Was Previously Disabled] = 'No' AND [CurrentInactive__Is Currently Disabled] = 'Yes' ORDER BY [OPERATIONDATE__CHANGE DATE] DESC JOIN_ON Employee__Employee SELECTX([IMCD Support 2025]) [OperationDate__Change Date], [OperationUser__Changed By], [Manager__Changed By Person], [OldDate__Previous Exit-Date], [CurrentDate__Current ExitDate] FROM Exit_Date_Changes_2 ORDER BY [OPERATIONDATE__CHANGE DATE] DESC;

SELECTX([IMCD Support 2025]) [OperationDate__Change Date], Employee__Employee, [OperationUser__Changed By], [OldInactive__Was Previously Disabled], [CurrentInactive__Is Currently Disabled] FROM Inactive_Changes WHERE [OldInactive__Was Previously Disabled] = 'No' AND [CurrentInactive__Is Currently Disabled] = 'Yes' ORDER BY [OPERATIONDATE__CHANGE DATE] DESC JOIN_ON Employee__Employee SELECTX([IMCD Support 2025]) [OperationDate__Change Date], [OperationUser__Changed By], [Manager__Changed By Person], [OldDate__Previous Exit-Date], [CurrentDate__Current ExitDate] FROM Exit_Date_Changes_2 ORDER BY [OPERATIONDATE__CHANGE DATE] DESC;

SELECTX([IMCD Support 2025]) [OperationDate], Employee, [OperationUser], [OldInactive], [CurrentInactive] FROM Inactive_Changes WHERE [OldInactive] = 'No' AND [CurrentInactive] = 'Yes' ORDER BY [OPERATIONDATE] DESC JOIN_ON Employee SELECTX([IMCD Support 2025]) [OperationDate], [OperationUser], [Manager], [OldDate], [CurrentDate] FROM Exit_Date_Changes_2 ORDER BY [OPERATIONDATE] DESC;

SELECTX([IMCD Support 2025]) [OperationDate], Employee, [OperationUser], [OldInactive], [CurrentInactive] FROM Inactive_Changes WHERE OldInactive = 'No' AND CurrentInactive = 'Yes' ORDER BY OPERATIONDATE DESC JOIN_ON Employee SELECTX([IMCD Support 2025]) [OperationDate], [OperationUser], [Manager], [OldDate], [CurrentDate] FROM Exit_Date_Changes_2 ORDER BY OPERATIONDATE DESC;

Query.Query: Serv Items for SafeNet AD Grps

Query.SQL: with RPT as ( select p.InternalName, g.cn, o.Ident_Org from Person p inner join ADSAccount a on p.UID_Person = a.UID_Person inner join ADSAccountInADSGroup ug on a.UID_ADSAccount = ug.UID_ADSAccount inner join ADSGroup g on ug.UID_ADSGroup = g.UID_ADSGroup left outer join OrgHasADSGroup og on og.UID_ADSGroup = g.UID_ADSGroup left outer join Org o on og.UID_Org = o.UID_Org where g.CanonicalName like '%AAGRP-SafeNET%' ) select top 1000 InternalName as "Employee", cn as "Safenet AD Group", Ident_Org as "Buiness Role" from RPT order by 1, 2, 3;

SELECTX([Pers ADS AAD],n/a) [Account Owner], Disabled, Status FROM Person_ADS_AAD WHERE Table = 'Person' ORDER BY [Account Owner] JOIN_ON [Account Owner] SELECTX([Pers ADS AAD],n/a) Disabled, Status FROM Person_ADS_AAD WHERE Table = 'ADSAccount' JOIN_ON 1.[Account Owner]=[Account Owner] SELECTX([Pers ADS AAD],n/a) Disabled, Status FROM Person_ADS_AAD WHERE Table = 'AADUser';

SELECTX(<SQL:AWIAMSQL01.IMCD.NL/OneIM>,OneIM,,V7) PersEmployee, PersCentralAccount, PersEMail, PersDisabled FROM dbo.CCC_JDE_Accounts WHERE PersCountry = 'China' ORDER BY PersEmployee JOIN_ON UID_Person SELECTX(<SQL:AWIAMSQL01.IMCD.NL/OneIM>,OneIM,,V7) AddrBookAddrBookNum, AddrBookEMail, AddrBookCompany, AddrBookCountry, AddrBookDisplayName FROM dbo.CCC_JDE_Accounts JOIN_ON 1.UID_Person=UID_Person SELECTX(<SQL:AWIAMSQL01.IMCD.NL/OneIM>,OneIM,,V7) JdeUserAccountName, JdeUseDisplayName, JdeUserAddrBookNum, JdeUserDisabled FROM dbo.CCC_JDE_Accounts;

Query.Description: All China Persons with JDE-Addr Book Entries and JDE-Users (assigned to Person)
Query.SQL: SELECTX(<SQL:IMCD>) PersEmployee, PersCentralAccount, PersEMail, PersDisabled, <DBLOOKUP "dbo.CCC_JDE_Accounts" "AddrBookAddrBookNum, AddrBookEMail, AddrBookCompany, AddrBookCountry, AddrBookDisplayName" "" "ORDER BY AddrBookAddrBookNum" "UID_Person">, <DBLOOKUP(<SQL:IMCD>) "dbo.CCC_JDE_Accounts" "JdeUserAccountName, JdeUseDisplayName, JdeUserAddrBookNum, JdeUserDisabled" "" "ORDER BY JdeUserAccountName" "UID_Person"> FROM dbo.CCC_JDE_Accounts WHERE PersCountry = 'China' ORDER BY PersEmployee;

Query.Description: All China Persons with JDE-Addr Book Entries and JDE-Users (assigned to Person)
Query.SQL: SELECTX(<SQL:IMCD>) PersEmployee, PersCentralAccount, PersEMail, PersDisabled, <DBLOOKUP "dbo.CCC_JDE_Accounts" "AddrBookAddrBookNum, AddrBookEMail, AddrBookCompany, AddrBookCountry, AddrBookDisplayName" "" "ORDER BY AddrBookAddrBookNum" "UID_Person">, <DBLOOKUP(<SQL:IMCD>) "dbo.CCC_JDE_Accounts" "JdeUserAccountName, JdeUseDisplayName, JdeUserAddrBookNum, JdeUserDisabled" "" "ORDER BY JdeUserAccountName" "UID_Person"> FROM dbo.CCC_JDE_Accounts WHERE PersCountry = 'China' ORDER BY PersEmployee;

Query.Description: All China Persons with JDE-Addr Book Entries and JDE-Users (assigned to Person)
Query.SQL: SELECTX(<SQL:AWIAMSQL01.IMCD.NL/OneIM>,OneIM,,V7) PersEmployee, PersCentralAccount, PersEMail, PersDisabled, PersPrimAddrNum, <DBLOOKUP "dbo.CCC_JDE_Accounts" "AddrBookAddrBookNum, AddrBookEMail, AddrBookCompany, AddrBookCountry, AddrBookDisplayName" "" "ORDER BY AddrBookAddrBookNum" "UID_Person">, <DBLOOKUP(<SQL:IMCD>) "dbo.CCC_JDE_Accounts" "JdeUserAccountName, JdeUseDisplayName, JdeUserAddrBookNum, JdeUserDisabled" "" "ORDER BY JdeUserAccountName" "UID_Person">, UID_Person FROM dbo.CCC_JDE_Accounts WHERE PersCountry = 'China' ORDER BY PersEmployee;

SELECTX(<SQL:IMCD>) DISTINCT PersEmployee, PersCentralAccount, PersEMail, PersDisabled, PersPrimAddrNum, <DBLOOKUP "dbo.CCC_JDE_Accounts" "AddrBookAddrBookNum, AddrBookEMail, AddrBookCompany, AddrBookCountry, AddrBookDisplayName" "" "ORDER BY AddrBookAddrBookNum" "UID_Person">, <DBLOOKUP "dbo.CCC_JDE_Accounts" "JdeUserAccountName, JdeUseDisplayName, JdeUserAddrBookNum, JdeUserDisabled" "" "ORDER BY JdeUserAccountName" "UID_Person">, UID_Person FROM dbo.CCC_JDE_Accounts WHERE PersCountry = 'China' ORDER BY PersEmployee;

SELECTX(<SQL:AWIAMSQL01.IMCD.NL/OneIM>,OneIM,,V7) DISTINCT PersEmployee, PersCentralAccount, PersEMail, PersDisabled, PersPrimAddrNum, <DBLOOKUP "dbo.CCC_JDE_Accounts" "AddrBookAddrBookNum, AddrBookEMail, AddrBookCompany, AddrBookCountry, AddrBookDisplayName" "" "ORDER BY AddrBookAddrBookNum" "UID_Person">, <DBLOOKUP "dbo.CCC_JDE_Accounts" "JdeUserAccountName, JdeUseDisplayName, JdeUserAddrBookNum, JdeUserDisabled" "" "ORDER BY JdeUserAccountName" "UID_Person">, UID_Person FROM dbo.CCC_JDE_Accounts WHERE PersCountry = 'China' ORDER BY PersEmployee;

Query.Description: Exit Dates for Employees created or updated after Upgrade
Query.SQL: with RPT as ( select c.CountryName, p.InternalName, p.ExitDate, c.AVGUTCOffset from Person p left outer join DialogCountry c on p.UID_DialogCountry = c.UID_DialogCountry where p.exitdate is not null And (p.XDateInserted > '2025-09-24' or p.XDateUpdated > '2025-09-24') ) select CountryName as "Country", InternalName as "Employee", ExitDate as "ExitDate", AVGUTCOffset as "Avg UTC Offset" from RPT order by AVGUTCOffset, COUNTRYNAME;

SELECTX(<SQL:AWIAMSQL01.IMCD.NL/OneIM>,OneIM,,V7) ShortName, Ident_DialogTimeZone, <DBLOOKUP(<SQL:IMCD>) "dbo.DialogCountryHasTimeZone" "<DBLOOKUP(<SQL:IMCD>) \"dbo.DialogCountry\" \"CountryName\" \"\" \"ORDER BY CountryName\" \"UID_DialogCountry\">" "" "" "UID_DialogTimeZone"> FROM dbo.DialogTimeZone ORDER BY UTCOffset;

Query.Description: Exit Dates for Employees created or updated after Upgrade
Query.SQL: with RPT as ( select c.CountryName, p.InternalName, p.ExitDate, c.AVGUTCOffset from Person p left outer join DialogCountry c on p.UID_DialogCountry = c.UID_DialogCountry where p.exitdate is not null And (p.XDateInserted > '2025-09-24' or p.XDateUpdated > '2025-09-24') ) select CountryName as "Country", InternalName as "Employee", ExitDate as "ExitDate", AVGUTCOffset as "Avg UTC Offset" from RPT order by AVGUTCOffset, COUNTRYNAME;

SELECTX(<SQL:IMCD>) DISTINCT PersEmployee, PersCentralAccount, PersEMail, PersDisabled, PersPrimAddrNum, <DBLOOKUP "dbo.CCC_JDE_Accounts" "AddrBookAddrBookNum, AddrBookEMail, AddrBookCompany, AddrBookCountry, AddrBookDisplayName" "" "ORDER BY AddrBookAddrBookNum" "UID_Person">, <DBLOOKUP "dbo.CCC_JDE_Accounts" "JdeUserAccountName, JdeUseDisplayName, JdeUserAddrBookNum, JdeUserDisabled" "" "ORDER BY JdeUserAccountName" "UID_Person">, UID_Person FROM dbo.CCC_JDE_Accounts WHERE PersCountry = 'China' ORDER BY PersEmployee;

WITH RPT AS ( SELECT Person.CentralAccount AS CentralAccount_Person, AADUser.DisplayName AS DisplayName_EntrID, DialogCountry.Iso3166_2 AS EntraID_Countrycode, DialogCountry.CountryName AS EntraID_Country, DialogCountry_Person.Iso3166_2 AS Person_Countrycode, DialogCountry_Person.CountryName AS Person_Country, Person.IsInActive FROM DialogCountry AS DialogCountry_Person INNER JOIN Person ON DialogCountry_Person.UID_DialogCountry = Person.UID_DialogCountry INNER JOIN AADUser INNER JOIN DialogCountry ON AADUser.UID_DialogCountryUsage = DialogCountry.UID_DialogCountry ON Person.UID_Person = AADUser.UID_Person AND Person.UID_DialogCountry <> AADUser.UID_DialogCountryUsage ) SELECT CentralAccount_Person as "Person CentralAccount", DisplayName_EntrID as "EntraID Account", EntraID_Countrycode as "EntraID Country-Code", EntraID_Country as "EntraID Country", Person_Countrycode as "Person Country-Code", Person_Country as "Person Country", IsInActive as "Person is InActive" FROM RPT ORDER BY CentralAccount_Person;

Query.Description: UsageLocation on AADUser vs Country on the Person
Query.SQL: WITH RPT AS ( SELECT Person.CentralAccount AS CentralAccount_Person, AADUser.DisplayName AS DisplayName_EntrID, DialogCountry.Iso3166_2 AS EntraID_Countrycode, DialogCountry.CountryName AS EntraID_Country, DialogCountry_Person.Iso3166_2 AS Person_Countrycode, DialogCountry_Person.CountryName AS Person_Country, Person.IsInActive FROM DialogCountry AS DialogCountry_Person INNER JOIN Person ON DialogCountry_Person.UID_DialogCountry = Person.UID_DialogCountry INNER JOIN AADUser INNER JOIN DialogCountry ON AADUser.UID_DialogCountryUsage = DialogCountry.UID_DialogCountry ON Person.UID_Person = AADUser.UID_Person AND Person.UID_DialogCountry <> AADUser.UID_DialogCountryUsage ) SELECT CentralAccount_Person as "Person CentralAccount", DisplayName_EntrID as "EntraID Account", EntraID_Countrycode as "EntraID Country-Code", EntraID_Country as "EntraID Country", Person_Countrycode as "Person Country-Code", Person_Country as "Person Country", IsInActive as "Person is InActive" FROM RPT ORDER BY CentralAccount_Person;

Query.Description: UsageLocation on AADUser vs Country on the Person
Query.SQL: WITH RPT AS ( SELECT Person.CentralAccount AS CentralAccount_Person, Person.DefaultEmailAddress, AADUser.DisplayName AS DisplayName_EntrID, AADUser.UserPrincipalName as UPN_EntraID, DialogCountry.Iso3166_2 AS EntraID_Countrycode, DialogCountry.CountryName AS EntraID_Country, DialogCountry_Person.Iso3166_2 AS Person_Countrycode, DialogCountry_Person.CountryName AS Person_Country, Person.IsInActive FROM DialogCountry AS DialogCountry_Person LEFT OUTER JOIN Person ON DialogCountry_Person.UID_DialogCountry = Person.UID_DialogCountry INNER JOIN AADUser ON Person.UID_Person = AADUser.UID_Person LEFT OUTER JOIN DialogCountry ON AADUser.UID_DialogCountryUsage = DialogCountry.UID_DialogCountry WHERE isnull(Person.UID_DialogCountry,'') <> isnull(AADUser.UID_DialogCountryUsage,'') ) SELECT CentralAccount_Person as "Person CentralAccount", DefaultEmailAddress as "Person EMail", DisplayName_EntrID as "EntraID Account", UPN_EntraID as "EntraID UPN", EntraID_Countrycode as "EntraID Country-Code", EntraID_Country as "EntraID Country", Person_Countrycode as "Person Country-Code", Person_Country as "Person Country", IsInActive as "Person is InActive" FROM RPT ORDER BY CentralAccount_Person;

with RPT as ( SELECT InternalName, CentralAccount, DefaultEmailAddress, IsInActive, CustomProperty08, UID_Person FROM Person p inner join DialogCountry c on p.UID_DialogCountry = c.UID_DialogCountry WHERE NOT exists ( select top 1 1 from CCC_JDE_Accounts j where p.UID_Person = j.UID_Person) AND c.CountryName = 'China' ) select InternalName as "Employee: Full Name", CentralAccount as "Employee: Central Account Name", DefaultEmailAddress as "Employee: Default EMail", IsInActive as "Employee: Disabled permanently", CustomProperty08 as "Employee: Primary AddrBookNum" from RPT ORDER BY InternalName;

SELECTX(<SQL:AWIAMSQL01.IMCD.NL/OneIM>,OneIM,,V7) ObjectGUID AS "AddrBookAddrBookNum", DisplayName AS "AddrBookDisplayName", CCC_EMail AS "AddrBookEMail", CCC_Company AS "AddrBookCompany", CCC_Country AS "AddrBookCountry", UID_UNSAccountB FROM dbo.UNSAccountB WHERE CanonicalName LIKE 'JDE/ADDR/%' AND UID_Person IS NULL ORDER BY DisplayName;

Query.Description: China Persons no JDE Addressbook Number on Person
Query.SQL: with RPT as ( SELECT InternalName, FirstName, LastName, CentralAccount, DefaultEmailAddress, IsInActive, CustomProperty08, UID_Person FROM Person p inner join DialogCountry c on p.UID_DialogCountry = c.UID_DialogCountry WHERE NOT exists ( select top 1 1 from CCC_JDE_Accounts j where p.UID_Person = j.UID_Person) AND c.CountryName = 'China' ) select InternalName as "Employee: Full Name", FirstName as "Employee: First Name", LastName as "Employee: Last Name", CentralAccount as "Employee: Central Account Name", DefaultEmailAddress as "Employee: Default EMail", IsInActive as "Employee: Disabled permanently", CustomProperty08 as "Employee: Primary AddrBookNum" from RPT ORDER BY InternalName;

SELECT ObjectGUID AS "AddrBookAddrBookNum", DisplayName AS "AddrBookDisplayName", FirstName AS "AddrBookFirstName", LastName AS "AddrBookLastName", CCC_EMail AS "AddrBookEMail", CCC_Company AS "AddrBookCompany", CCC_Country AS "AddrBookCountry", UID_UNSAccountB FROM dbo.UNSAccountB b WHERE CanonicalName LIKE 'JDE/ADDR/%' AND UID_Person IS NULL ORDER BY DisplayName;

SELECTX(<SQL:IMCD_OTA>) TOP(500) <DEFAULT> AS "Request procedures Name" FROM dbo.PersonWantsOrg WHERE OrderState = 'Unsubscribed' ORDER BY XDateUpdated DESC JOIN_ON UID_PersonWantsOrg SELECTX(<SQL:IMCD_OTA>) Ident_PWODecisionStep, DateHead, DecisionLevel, DecisionType, OrderState, DisplayPersonHead, IsDecisionBySystem, IsFromDelegation, IsToHideInHistory, ReasonHead, RulerLevel, <DBLOOKUP "dbo.[Person]" "<DEFAULT>[Approver]" "" "" "UID_PersonHead=UID_Person">, <DBLOOKUP "dbo.[Person]" "<DEFAULT>[Additional approver]" "" "" "UID_PersonRelated=UID_Person"> FROM dbo.PWODecisionHistory ORDER BY XDateInserted;

SELECTX([IMCD Support 2025],n/a) [InternalName__Employee: Full Name], [FirstName__Employee: First Name], [LastName__Employee: Last Name], [CentralAccount__Employee: Central Account Name], [DefaultEmailAddress__Employee: Default EMail], [IsInActive__Employee: Disabled permanently], [CustomProperty08__Employee: Primary AddrBookNum] FROM China_NO_JDE ORDER BY [InternalName__Employee: Full Name] JOIN_ON "*%[FirstName__Employee: First Name]%*"=~DisplayName__AddrBookDisplayName;OR;"*%[LastName__Employee: Last Name]%*"=~DisplayName__AddrBookDisplayName SELECTX([IMCD Support 2025],n/a) DisplayName__AddrBookDisplayName, ObjectGUID__AddrBookAddrBookNum, CCC_EMail__AddrBookEMail, CCC_Country__AddrBookCountry, [UID_UNSAccountB__User account] FROM JDE_Addr_Book_Orphans;

SELECTX([IMCD Support 2025]) [InternalName__Employee: Full Name], [FirstName__Employee: First Name], [LastName__Employee: Last Name], [CentralAccount__Employee: Central Account Name], [DefaultEmailAddress__Employee: Default EMail], [IsInActive__Employee: Disabled permanently], [CustomProperty08__Employee: Primary AddrBookNum] FROM China_NO_JDE ORDER BY [INTERNALNAME__EMPLOYEE: FULL NAME] JOIN_ON "*%[FirstName__Employee: First Name]%*"=~DisplayName__AddrBookDisplayName;OR;"*%[LastName__Employee: Last Name]%*"=~DisplayName__AddrBookDisplayName SELECTX([IMCD Support 2025]) DisplayName__AddrBookDisplayName, ObjectGUID__AddrBookAddrBookNum, CCC_EMail__AddrBookEMail, CCC_Country__AddrBookCountry, [UID_UNSAccountB__User account] FROM JDE_Addr_Book_Orphans ORDER BY DisplayName__AddrBookDisplayName;

WITH RPT as ( select u.AccountName, u.CustomString02, u.CustomString01, STRING_AGG(g.DisplayName, ', ') WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY g.DisplayName) as ProdRoles from CSMUser u left outer join CSMUserInGroup ug on u.UID_CSMUser = ug.UID_CSMUser left outer join CSMGroup g on ug.UID_CSMGroup = g.UID_CSMGroup AND (g.DisplayName = 'PROD_SYSADMIN' or g.DisplayName like 'PROD_FR%') group by u.AccountName, u.CustomString02, u.CustomString01 ) select AccountName as "Snowflake User", CustomString02 as "Default Warehouse", CustomString01 as "Default Role", ProdRoles as "PROD Roles" from RPT where isnull(CustomString01,'') <> isnull(ProdRoles,'') order by 1;

WITH RPT as ( select u.AccountName, u.CustomString02, u.CustomString01, STRING_AGG(g.DisplayName, ', ') WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY g.DisplayName) as ProdRoles from CSMUser u left outer join CSMUserInGroup ug on u.UID_CSMUser = ug.UID_CSMUser left outer join CSMGroup g on ug.UID_CSMGroup = g.UID_CSMGroup AND (g.DisplayName = 'PROD_SYSADMIN' or g.DisplayName like 'PROD_FR%') group by u.AccountName, u.CustomString02, u.CustomString01 ) select AccountName as "Snowflake User", CustomString02 as "Default Warehouse", CustomString01 as "Default Role", ProdRoles as "PROD Roles" from RPT where isnull(CustomString01,'') <> isnull(ProdRoles,'') Or isnull(u.CustomString02,'') = '' order by 1;

WITH RPT as ( select u.AccountName, u.CustomString02, u.CustomString01, STRING_AGG(g.DisplayName, ', ') WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY g.DisplayName) as ProdRoles from CSMUser u left outer join CSMUserInGroup ug on u.UID_CSMUser = ug.UID_CSMUser left outer join CSMGroup g on ug.UID_CSMGroup = g.UID_CSMGroup AND (g.DisplayName = 'PROD_SYSADMIN' or g.DisplayName like 'PROD_FR%') group by u.AccountName, u.CustomString02, u.CustomString01 ) select AccountName as "Snowflake User", CustomString02 as "Default Warehouse", CustomString01 as "Default Role", ProdRoles as "PROD Roles" from RPT where isnull(CustomString01,'') <> isnull(ProdRoles,'') Or isnull(CustomString02,'') = '' order by 1;

Query.Description: UsageLocation on AADUser vs Country on the Person
Query.SQL: WITH RPT AS ( SELECT Person.CentralAccount AS CentralAccount_Person, Person.DefaultEmailAddress, AADUser.DisplayName AS DisplayName_EntrID, AADUser.UserPrincipalName as UPN_EntraID, DialogCountry.Iso3166_2 AS EntraID_Countrycode, DialogCountry.CountryName AS EntraID_Country, DialogCountry_Person.Iso3166_2 AS Person_Countrycode, DialogCountry_Person.CountryName AS Person_Country, Person.IsInActive FROM DialogCountry AS DialogCountry_Person LEFT OUTER JOIN Person ON DialogCountry_Person.UID_DialogCountry = Person.UID_DialogCountry INNER JOIN AADUser ON Person.UID_Person = AADUser.UID_Person LEFT OUTER JOIN DialogCountry ON AADUser.UID_DialogCountryUsage = DialogCountry.UID_DialogCountry WHERE isnull(Person.UID_DialogCountry,'') <> isnull(AADUser.UID_DialogCountryUsage,'') ) SELECT CentralAccount_Person as "Person CentralAccount", DefaultEmailAddress as "Person EMail", DisplayName_EntrID as "EntraID Account", UPN_EntraID as "EntraID UPN", EntraID_Countrycode as "EntraID Country-Code", EntraID_Country as "EntraID Country", Person_Countrycode as "Person Country-Code", Person_Country as "Person Country", IsInActive as "Person is InActive" FROM RPT ORDER BY CentralAccount_Person;

select a.Mail, MailNickName, GivenName, Surname, CompanyName, Country, Department, JobTitle from AADUser where UserPrincipalName in (select UserPrincipalName from AADUser group by UserPrincipalName having count(*) > 1) order by 4, 3;

SELECTX Mail, MailNickName, GivenName, Surname, CompanyName, Country, Department, JobTitle, <DBLOOKUP(<SQL:ASW>) "dbo.Person" "<DEFAULT>[Person]" "" "" "UID_Person">, <DBLOOKUP(<SQL:ASW>) "dbo.ADSAccount" "CanonicalName[AD Account], SAMAccountName" "" "" "OnPremSid=ObjectSID"> FROM dbo.AADUser WHERE (UserPrincipalName IN (select UserPrincipalName from AADUser group by UserPrincipalName having count(*) > 1)) ORDER BY 4, 3;

SELECTX Mail, MailNickName, GivenName, Surname, CompanyName, Country, Department, JobTitle, <DBLOOKUP(<SQL:ASW>) "dbo.Person" "<DEFAULT>[Person]" "" "" "UID_Person">, <DBLOOKUP(<SQL:ASW>) "dbo.ADSAccount" "CanonicalName[AD Account], SAMAccountName" "" "" "OnPremSid=ObjectSID"> FROM dbo.AADUser WHERE (UserPrincipalName IN (select UserPrincipalName from AADUser group by UserPrincipalName having count(*) > 1)) ORDER BY 4, 3;

WITH RPT As ( SELECT Mail, MailNickName, GivenName, Surname, CompanyName, Country, Department, JobTitle, UID_AADUser FROM dbo.AADUser WHERE (UserPrincipalName IN (select UserPrincipalName from AADUser group by UserPrincipalName having count(*) > 1)) ) SELECTX <NONE> FROM RPT JOIN_ON UID_AADUser SELECTX Mail, MailNickName, GivenName, Surname, CompanyName, Country, Department, JobTitle, <DBLOOKUP(<SQL:ASW>) "dbo.Person" "<DEFAULT>[Person]" "" "" "UID_Person">, <DBLOOKUP(<SQL:ASW>) "dbo.ADSAccount" "CanonicalName[AD Account], SAMAccountName" "" "" "OnPremSid=ObjectSID"> FROM db.AADUser ORDER BY 4, 3;

WITH RPT As ( SELECT Mail, MailNickName, GivenName, Surname, CompanyName, Country, Department, JobTitle, UID_AADUser FROM dbo.AADUser WHERE (UserPrincipalName IN (select UserPrincipalName from AADUser group by UserPrincipalName having count(*) > 1)) ) SELECTX <NONE> FROM RPT JOIN_ON UID_AADUser SELECTX Mail, MailNickName, GivenName, Surname, CompanyName, Country, Department, JobTitle, <DBLOOKUP(<SQL:ASW>) "dbo.Person" "<DEFAULT>[Person]" "" "" "UID_Person">, <DBLOOKUP(<SQL:ASW>) "dbo.ADSAccount" "CanonicalName[AD Account], SAMAccountName" "" "" "OnPremSid=ObjectSID"> FROM dbo.AADUser ORDER BY 4, 3;

SELECTX([IMCD Support 2025],n/a) UserPrincipalName, CompanyName, Country FROM AAD_Country_Cleared___16DEC25 JOIN_ON UserPrincipalName SELECTX(<SQL:AWIAMSQL41.IMCD.NL/OneIMTest>,OneIM,,V7) DisplayName, Mail, <DBLOOKUP "dbo.[DialogCountry]" "Iso3166_2, CountryName" "" "" "UID_DialogCountryUsage=UID_DialogCountry">, UID_DialogCountryUsage FROM dbo.AADUser;

SELECTX(<SQL:PRDBNLIAMDB1.CENET.ICT/OneIM>,iamsa,,V7) TOP(1000) StartAt, EndedAt, ParamIN FROM dbo.JobHistory WHERE JobChainName = 'DPR_DPRProjectionStartInfo_Run_Synchronization' ORDER BY XDateInserted DESC;
SELECTX(<SQL:PRDBNLIAMDB1.CENET.ICT/OneIM>,iamsa,,V7) DisplayName, Description, Name, UID_DPRProjectionStartInfo FROM dbo.DPRProjectionStartInfo ORDER BY DisplayName;

SELECTX(<SQL:ASW>) DisplayName, <DBLOOKUP(<SQL:ASW>) "dbo.DPRShell" "DisplayName, Description, Name" "" "" "UID_DPRShell">, UID_DPRProjectionStartInfo FROM dbo.DPRProjectionStartInfo ORDER BY DisplayName;

SELECTX(<SQL:ASW>) TOP(1000) StartAt, EndedAt, ParamIN FROM dbo.JobHistory WHERE JobChainName = 'DPR_DPRProjectionStartInfo_Run_Synchronization' AND ParamIN LIKE '%CCC-A5FC3EFF24FFD6459D91F0F44BC778A2%' AND IsRootJob = -1 ORDER BY XDateInserted DESC;

SELECTX(<SQL:PRDBNLIAMDB1.CENET.ICT/OneIM>,iamsa,,V7) TOP(1000) StartAt, EndedAt, ParamIN, WasError FROM dbo.JobHistory WHERE JobChainName = 'DPR_DPRProjectionStartInfo_Run_Synchronization' AND ParamIN LIKE '%CCC-A5FC3EFF24FFD6459D91F0F44BC778A2%' AND IsRootJob = -1 ORDER BY XDateInserted DESC;

SELECTX(<SQL:PRDBNLIAMDB1.CENET.ICT/OneIM>,iamsa,,V7) TOP(1000) StartAt, EndedAt, ParamIN, WasError FROM dbo.JobHistory WHERE JobChainName = 'DPR_DPRProjectionStartInfo_Run_Synchronization' AND ParamIN LIKE '%CCC-A5FC3EFF24FFD6459D91F0F44BC778A2%' AND IsRootJob = -1 ORDER BY XDateInserted DESC;

SELECTX(<SQL:PRDBNLIAMDB1.CENET.ICT/OneIM>,iamsa,,V7) CreationTime, CompletionTime FROM dbo.DPRJournal WHERE UID_DPRProjectionStartInfo = 'CCC-A5FC3EFF24FFD6459D91F0F44BC778A2' ORDER BY CreationTime DESC JOIN_ON UID_DPRJournal SELECTX(<SQL:PRDBNLIAMDB1.CENET.ICT/OneIM>,iamsa,,V7) Reason FROM dbo.DPRJournalFailure;

WITH exh_chgs AS ( select p.XObjectKey AS ObjectKey, dc.Caption AS ColumnName from [dbo].DialogWatchProperty d INNER JOIN [dbo].DialogWatchOperation o ON o.UID_DialogWatchOperation = d.UID_DialogWatchOperation INNER JOIN [dbo].[DialogColumn] dc ON d.UID_DialogColumn = dc.UID_DialogColumn INNER JOIN [dbo].[EXHRemoteMailbox] m on m.XObjectKey = o.ObjectKeyOfRow INNER JOIN [dbo].[Person] p ON m.UID_Person = p.UID_Person WHERE d.UID_DialogColumn in (SELECT UID_DialogColumn FROM [dbo].[DialogColumn] c0 INNER JOIN DialogTable t0 ON c0.UID_DialogTable = t0.UID_DialogTable WHERE (t0.TableName = 'EXHRemoteMailbox' And (c0.ColumnName in ('RecipientTypeDetails')))) ), o3_chgs AS ( select p.XObjectKey AS ObjectKey, dc.Caption AS ColumnName from [dbo].DialogWatchProperty d INNER JOIN [dbo].DialogWatchOperation o ON o.UID_DialogWatchOperation = d.UID_DialogWatchOperation INNER JOIN [dbo].[DialogColumn] dc ON d.UID_DialogColumn = dc.UID_DialogColumn INNER JOIN [dbo].[O3EMailbox] m on m.XObjectKey = o.ObjectKeyOfRow INNER JOIN [dbo].[Person] p ON m.UID_Person = p.UID_Person WHERE d.UID_DialogColumn in (SELECT UID_DialogColumn FROM [dbo].[DialogColumn] c0 INNER JOIN DialogTable t0 ON c0.UID_DialogTable = t0.UID_DialogTable WHERE (t0.TableName = 'O3EMailbox' And (c0.ColumnName in ('RecipientTypeDetails')))) ), chgs AS ( SELECT ObjectKey, ColumnName from exh_chgs UNION SELECT ObjectKey, ColumnName from o3_chgs ), pers AS ( SELECT p.InternalName as Employee, e.RecipientTypeDetails as CurrentExchgRemote, o.RecipientTypeDetails as CurrentO3Mailbox, p.XObjectKey FROM Person p left outer join EXHRemoteMailbox e on p.UID_Person = e.UID_Person left outer join O3EMailbox o on p.UID_Person = o.UID_Person WHERE p.XObjectKey in (select ObjectKey from chgs) ) SELECT Employee As "Identity", CurrentExchgRemote as "Current Remote Mailbox Type", CurrentO3Mailbox as "Current Online Mailbox Type" FROM pers ORDER BY Employee JOIN_ON XObjectKey=aa.XObjectKey with rq as ( select aa.XObjectKey from [dbo].[Person] aa where <JOIN_FILTER> ), exh_chgs AS ( select o.OperationDate, o.OperationUser, 'EXHRemoteMailbox' as 'ChangedObject', d.ContentShort as 'PreviousValue' from [dbo].DialogWatchProperty d INNER JOIN [dbo].DialogWatchOperation o ON o.UID_DialogWatchOperation = d.UID_DialogWatchOperation INNER JOIN [dbo].[DialogColumn] dc ON d.UID_DialogColumn = dc.UID_DialogColumn INNER JOIN [dbo].[EXHRemoteMailbox] m on m.XObjectKey = o.ObjectKeyOfRow INNER JOIN [dbo].[Person] p ON m.UID_Person = p.UID_Person INNER JOIN rq ON p.XObjectKey = rq.XObjectKey WHERE d.UID_DialogColumn in (SELECT UID_DialogColumn FROM [dbo].[DialogColumn] c0 INNER JOIN DialogTable t0 ON c0.UID_DialogTable = t0.UID_DialogTable WHERE (t0.TableName = 'EXHRemoteMailbox' And (c0.ColumnName in ('RecipientTypeDetails')))) ), o3_chgs AS ( select o.OperationDate, o.OperationUser, 'O3EMailbox' as 'ChangedObject', d.ContentShort as 'PreviousValue' from [dbo].DialogWatchProperty d INNER JOIN [dbo].DialogWatchOperation o ON o.UID_DialogWatchOperation = d.UID_DialogWatchOperation INNER JOIN [dbo].[DialogColumn] dc ON d.UID_DialogColumn = dc.UID_DialogColumn INNER JOIN [dbo].[O3EMailbox] m on m.XObjectKey = o.ObjectKeyOfRow INNER JOIN [dbo].[Person] p ON m.UID_Person = p.UID_Person INNER JOIN rq ON p.XObjectKey = rq.XObjectKey WHERE d.UID_DialogColumn in (SELECT UID_DialogColumn FROM [dbo].[DialogColumn] c0 INNER JOIN DialogTable t0 ON c0.UID_DialogTable = t0.UID_DialogTable WHERE (t0.TableName = 'O3EMailbox' And (c0.ColumnName in ('RecipientTypeDetails')))) ), chgs as ( SELECT OperationDate, OperationUser, ChangedObject, PreviousValue FROM exh_chgs UNION SELECT OperationDate, OperationUser, ChangedObject, PreviousValue FROM o3_chgs ) SELECT OperationDate AS "Change Date", OperationUser AS "Changed By", ChangedObject AS "Changed Object", PreviousValue AS "Previous Value" FROM chgs order BY OperationDate DESC, CHANGEDOBJECT;

SELECTX(<SQL:MyServer/OneIM>,sa,,V7) ColumnName, Caption, <DBLOOKUP(<SQL:TK-ONT>) "dbo.DialogMultiLanguage" "EntryValue[Translation]" "UID_DialogCulture EQ \"QBM-CULT-nl-NL\"" "" "Caption=EntryKey">, ColumnGroup, IsFilterDesignerEnabled FROM dbo.DialogColumn WHERE UID_DialogTable = 'QER-T-Person' ORDER BY ColumnName;
select XDateUpdated, FileName, Description, CustomCode, Configuration from DialogAEDS where CustomCode like '%VI_Employee_MasterData_Attributes%';

select XDateUpdated, FileName, Description, CustomCode, Configuration from DialogAEDS where CustomCode like '%VI_Employee_MasterData_Attributes%' OR CustomCode like '%%CCC_accessBereikbaarheidsGids%%' OR Configuration like '%VI_Employee_MasterData_Attributes%' OR Configuration like '%%CCC_accessBereikbaarheidsGids%%';

with RPT as ( select j.CompletionTime, a.DisplayName, a.UserPrincipalName, a.CompanyName, a.Country, y.PropertyName, y.NewValueShort, y.OldValueShort, a.UID_DialogCountryUsage, a.UID_AADUser from DPRJournal j inner join DPRJournalObject o on o.UID_DPRJournal = j.UID_DPRJournal inner join DPRJournalProperty y on o.UID_DPRJournalObject = y.UID_DPRJournalObject inner join AADUser a on j.CausingEntityKey = a.XObjectKey where j.CompletionTime > '2025-12-16 12:00' And j.CompletionTime < '2025-12-16 18:00' ) select CompletionTime "AdHoc Projection Time", UserPrincipalName "AADUer: UPN", CompanyName "AADUser: Company", Country "AADUser: Country", PropertyName "Column Changed", NewValueShort "New Value", OldValueShort "Old Value", UID_DialogCountryUsage, UID_AADUser from RPT order by DisplayName, PROPERTYNAME;

with RPT as ( select j.CompletionTime, a.DisplayName, a.UserPrincipalName, a.CompanyName, a.Country, case when c.UID_DialogCountry is null then c2.Iso3166_2 else c.Iso3166_2 end as Iso3166_2, y.PropertyName, y.NewValueShort, y.OldValueShort, a.UID_DialogCountryUsage, a.UID_AADUser from DPRJournal j inner join DPRJournalObject o on o.UID_DPRJournal = j.UID_DPRJournal inner join DPRJournalProperty y on o.UID_DPRJournalObject = y.UID_DPRJournalObject inner join AADUser a on j.CausingEntityKey = a.XObjectKey left outer join Person p on a.UID_Person = p.UID_Person left outer join DialogCountry c on p.UID_DialogCountry = c.UID_DialogCountry left outer join DialogCountry c2 on a.UID_DialogCountryUsage = c2.UID_DialogCountry where j.CompletionTime > '2025-12-16 12:00' And j.CompletionTime < '2025-12-16 18:00' -- UID_Country As String = $FK(UID_Person).UID_DialogCountry$ -- Country = $FK(UID_Person).FK(UID_DialogCountry).CountryName$ -- CompanyName = Value = $FK(UID_Person).CompanyMember$ ) select CompletionTime "AdHoc Projection Time", UserPrincipalName "AADUer: UPN", CompanyName "AADUser: Company", Country "AADUser: Country", PropertyName "Column Changed", NewValueShort "New Value", OldValueShort "Old Value", Iso3166_2 "Current CountryUsage", UID_DialogCountryUsage, UID_AADUser from RPT order by DisplayName, PROPERTYNAME;

with RPT as ( select j.CompletionTime, a.DisplayName, a.UserPrincipalName, a.CompanyName, a.Country, case when c.UID_DialogCountry is null then c2.Iso3166_2 else c.Iso3166_2 end as Iso3166_2, y.PropertyName, y.NewValueShort, y.OldValueShort, a.UID_DialogCountryUsage, a.UID_AADUser from DPRJournal j inner join DPRJournalObject o on o.UID_DPRJournal = j.UID_DPRJournal inner join DPRJournalProperty y on o.UID_DPRJournalObject = y.UID_DPRJournalObject inner join AADUser a on j.CausingEntityKey = a.XObjectKey left outer join Person p on a.UID_Person = p.UID_Person left outer join DialogCountry c on p.UID_DialogCountry = c.UID_DialogCountry left outer join DialogCountry c2 on a.UID_DialogCountryUsage = c2.UID_DialogCountry where j.CompletionTime > '2025-12-16 12:00' And j.CompletionTime < '2025-12-16 18:00' -- UID_Country As String = $FK(UID_Person).UID_DialogCountry$ -- Country = $FK(UID_Person).FK(UID_DialogCountry).CountryName$ -- CompanyName = Value = $FK(UID_Person).CompanyMember$ ) select CompletionTime As "AdHoc Projection Time", UserPrincipalName As "AADUer: UPN", CompanyName As "AADUser: Company", Country As "AADUser: Country", PropertyName As "Column Changed", NewValueShort As "New Value", OldValueShort As "Old Value", Iso3166_2 As "Current CountryUsage", UID_DialogCountryUsage, UID_AADUser from RPT order by DisplayName, PROPERTYNAME;

with RPT as ( select o.OperationDate, a.CanonicalName, a.AccountDisabled, a.XMarkedForDeletion, p.ContentShort FROM [OneIM].[dbo].[DialogWatchOperation] o inner join ADSAccount a on o.ObjectKeyOfRow = a.XObjectKey left outer join Person pp on a.UID_Person = pp.UID_Person inner join DialogWatchProperty p on p.UID_DialogWatchOperation = o.UID_DialogWatchOperation inner join DialogColumn c on p.UID_DialogColumn = c.UID_DialogColumn inner join DialogTable t on t.UID_DialogTable = c.UID_DialogTable where t.TableName = 'ADSAccount' and c.ColumnName = 'XMarkedForDeletion' and a.UID_Person is null or pp.IsInActive = 1 and a.XMarkedForDeletion > 0 ) select OperationDate as "Deleted on", CanonicalName as "AD Account", AccountDisabled as "AD Account: is dsabled", XMarkedForDeletion as "AD Account: XMarkedForDeletion", ContentShort as "AD Account: Previous XMarkedForDeletion" from RPT order by OperationDate;

with RPT as ( select o.OperationDate, a.CanonicalName, a.AccountDisabled, a.XMarkedForDeletion, p.ContentShort, a.XObjectKey FROM [OneIM].[dbo].[DialogWatchOperation] o inner join ADSAccount a on o.ObjectKeyOfRow = a.XObjectKey left outer join Person pp on a.UID_Person = pp.UID_Person inner join DialogWatchProperty p on p.UID_DialogWatchOperation = o.UID_DialogWatchOperation inner join DialogColumn c on p.UID_DialogColumn = c.UID_DialogColumn inner join DialogTable t on t.UID_DialogTable = c.UID_DialogTable where t.TableName = 'ADSAccount' and c.ColumnName = 'XMarkedForDeletion' and a.UID_Person is null or pp.IsInActive = 1 and a.XMarkedForDeletion > 0 ) select OperationDate as "Deleted on", CanonicalName as "AD Account", AccountDisabled as "AD Account: is dsabled", XMarkedForDeletion as "AD Account: XMarkedForDeletion", ContentShort as "AD Account: Previous XMarkedForDeletion" from RPT order by OperationDate JOIN_ON XObjectKey=ObjectKey select TargetDate as "Deferred Delete Date", DisplayValue as "Deferred Delete Account", Description as "Deferred Operation" from dbo.DialogDeferredOperation where Operation = 'Delete';

SELECTX(<SQL:PRDBNLIAMDB1.CENET.ICT/OneIM>,iamsa,,V7) CanonicalName FROM dbo.ADSAccount WHERE AccountDisabled = -1 AND UID_TSBBehavior = 'TSB-FullManaged' ORDER BY CanonicalName JOIN_ON UID_Person SELECTX(<SQL:PRDBNLIAMDB1.CENET.ICT/OneIM>,iamsa,,V7) InternalName, CentralAccount, ImportSource, ExitDate, IsInActive, IsTemporaryDeactivated FROM dbo.Person;

SELECTX(<SQL:PRDBNLIAMDB1.CENET.ICT/OneIM>,iamsa,,V7) CanonicalName FROM dbo.ADSAccount WHERE AccountDisabled <> 0 AND UID_TSBBehavior = 'TSB-FullManaged' ORDER BY CanonicalName JOIN_ON UID_Person SELECTX(<SQL:PRDBNLIAMDB1.CENET.ICT/OneIM>,iamsa,,V7) InternalName, CentralAccount, ImportSource, ExitDate, IsInActive, IsTemporaryDeactivated FROM dbo.Person;

SELECTX(<SQL:ASW>) CanonicalName, XMarkedForDeletion FROM dbo.ADSAccount WHERE AccountDisabled <> 0 AND UID_TSBBehavior = 'TSB-FullManaged' ORDER BY CanonicalName JOIN_ON UID_Person SELECTX(<SQL:ASW>) InternalName, CentralAccount, ImportSource, ExitDate, IsInActive, IsTemporaryDeactivated FROM dbo.Person;

SELECTX(<SQL:PRDBNLIAMDB1.CENET.ICT/OneIM>,iamsa,,V7) CanonicalName, XMarkedForDeletion FROM dbo.ADSAccount WHERE AccountDisabled <> 0 AND UID_TSBBehavior = 'TSB-FullManaged' ORDER BY CanonicalName JOIN_ON UID_Person SELECTX(<SQL:ASW>) InternalName, CentralAccount, ImportSource, ExitDate, IsInActive, IsTemporaryDeactivated FROM dbo.Person JOIN_ON 1.CanonicalName=[CanonicalName__AD Account] SELECTX([AS Watson VI],n/a) [OperationDate__Deleted on], [AccountDisabled__AD Account: is dsabled], [ContentShort__AD Account: Previous XMarkedForDeletion], [TargetDate__Deferred Delete Date], [DisplayValue__Deferred Delete Account], [Description__Deferred Operation] FROM AD_XMarkedForDeletion;

SELECT UID_Department, CCC_functienaamOperationeel, CCC_voornamen, CCC_geboortenaam, CCC_prefixName, CCC_voorletters, BirthDate, Gender, CCC_countryName, CCC_geboorteplaats, CCC_nationality FROM Person WHERE CCC_idCheckOK = 0;

SELECT UID_Department, CCC_functienaamOperationeel, CCC_voornamen, CCC_geboortenaam, CCC_prefixName, CCC_voorletters, BirthDate, Gender, CCC_countryName, CCC_geboorteplaats, CCC_nationality FROM Person WHERE CCC_idCheckOK = 0;

SELECT UID_Department, CCC_functienaamOperationeel, CCC_voornamen, CCC_geboortenaam, CCC_prefixName, CCC_voorletters, BirthDate, Gender, CCC_countryName, CCC_geboorteplaats, CCC_nationality FROM Person WHERE CCC_idCheckOK = 0 ORDER BY XDateUpdated desc;

SELECTX <DEFAULT>, CCC_functienaamOperationeel, <DBLOOKUP(<SQL:TK-ONT>) "dbo.Department" "<DEFAULT>[Departments Name]" "" "" "UID_Department">, CCC_voornamen, CCC_geboortenaam, CCC_prefixName, CCC_voorletters, BirthDate, Gender, CCC_countryName, CCC_geboorteplaats, CCC_nationality, UID_Department FROM dbo.Person WHERE CCC_idCheckOK = 0 ORDER BY XDateUpdated DESC;
select FileName, Description, ObjectType, CustomCode, XDateInserted, XUserUpdated from dbo.DialogAEDS where XDateUpdated > '2019-01-01';

with RPT as ( select p.InternalName, p.IsInActive, p.IsTemporaryDeactivated, c.ColumnName, o.OperationDate as 'Attrib Changed On', p.ExitDate as 'Current Value', t.ContentShort as 'Previous Value' from Person p inner join EXHRemoteMailbox m on p.UID_Person = m.UID_Person left outer join DialogWatchOperation o on p.XObjectKey=o.ObjectKeyOfRow inner join DialogWatchProperty t on t.UID_DialogWatchOperation = o.UID_DialogWatchOperation inner join DialogColumn c on t.UID_DialogColumn = c.UID_DialogColumn and c.ColumnName = 'ExitDate' inner join DialogTable n on c.UID_DialogTable = n.UID_DialogTable and n.TableName = 'Person' where m.CanonicalName like '%shared%' UNION select p.InternalName, p.IsInActive, p.IsTemporaryDeactivated, c.ColumnName, o.OperationDate as 'Attrib Changed On', p.CCC_Retain_O365 as 'Current Value', t.ContentShort as 'Previous Value' from Person p inner join EXHRemoteMailbox m on p.UID_Person = m.UID_Person left outer join DialogWatchOperation o on p.XObjectKey=o.ObjectKeyOfRow inner join DialogWatchProperty t on t.UID_DialogWatchOperation = o.UID_DialogWatchOperation inner join DialogColumn c on t.UID_DialogColumn = c.UID_DialogColumn and c.ColumnName = 'CCC_Retain_O365' inner join DialogTable n on c.UID_DialogTable = n.UID_DialogTable and n.TableName = 'Person' where m.CanonicalName like '%shared%' ) select * from RPT order by InternalName, 'Attrib Changed On' desc;

with RPT as ( select p.InternalName, p.IsInActive, p.IsTemporaryDeactivated, c.ColumnName, o.OperationDate as 'Attrib Changed On', format(p.ExitDate, 'yyyy-MM-dd') as 'Current Value', SUBSTRING(t.ContentShort,1,10) as 'Previous Value' from Person p inner join EXHRemoteMailbox m on p.UID_Person = m.UID_Person left outer join DialogWatchOperation o on p.XObjectKey=o.ObjectKeyOfRow inner join DialogWatchProperty t on t.UID_DialogWatchOperation = o.UID_DialogWatchOperation inner join DialogColumn c on t.UID_DialogColumn = c.UID_DialogColumn and c.ColumnName = 'ExitDate' inner join DialogTable n on c.UID_DialogTable = n.UID_DialogTable and n.TableName = 'Person' where m.CanonicalName like '%shared%' UNION select p.InternalName, p.IsInActive, p.IsTemporaryDeactivated, c.ColumnName, o.OperationDate as 'Attrib Changed On', case when p.CCC_Retain_O365 > 0 then 'true' else 'false' end as 'Current Value', case when t.ContentShort > 0 then 'true' else 'false' end as 'Previous Value' from Person p inner join EXHRemoteMailbox m on p.UID_Person = m.UID_Person left outer join DialogWatchOperation o on p.XObjectKey=o.ObjectKeyOfRow inner join DialogWatchProperty t on t.UID_DialogWatchOperation = o.UID_DialogWatchOperation inner join DialogColumn c on t.UID_DialogColumn = c.UID_DialogColumn and c.ColumnName = 'CCC_Retain_O365' inner join DialogTable n on c.UID_DialogTable = n.UID_DialogTable and n.TableName = 'Person' where m.CanonicalName like '%shared%' ) select * from RPT order by InternalName, 'Attrib Changed On' desc;

SELECTX(<SQL:TK-ONT>) CCC_voornamen, CCC_geboortenaam, CCC_prefixName, CCC_voorletters, BirthDate, Gender, CCC_countryName, CCC_geboorteplaats, CCC_nationality, <DBLOOKUP "dbo.[BaseTree]" "<DEFAULT>[Primary department]" "" "" "UID_Department=UID_Org"> FROM dbo.Person ORDER BY InternalName INNER_JOIN_ON UID_Person=UID_PersonMasterIdentity SELECTX(<SQL:TK-ONT>) CCC_voornamen, CCC_geboortenaam, CCC_prefixName, CCC_voorletters, BirthDate, Gender, CCC_countryName, CCC_geboorteplaats, CCC_nationality, <DBLOOKUP "dbo.[BaseTree]" "<DEFAULT>[Primary department]" "" "" "UID_Department=UID_Org"> FROM dbo.Person;

SELECTX(<SQL:MyServer/OneIM>,sa,,V7) CCC_voornamen, CCC_geboortenaam, CCC_prefixName, CCC_voorletters, BirthDate, Gender, CCC_countryName, CCC_geboorteplaats, CCC_nationality, <DBLOOKUP "dbo.Department" "<DEFAULT>[Departments Name]" "" "" "UID_Department">, UID_Person AS "UID_Person" FROM dbo.Person WHERE (UID_Person IN (select UID_Person from Person p0 where (exists (select top 1 1 from Person p2 where p2.UID_PersonMasterIdentity = p0.UID_Person)) OR (p0.UID_PersonMasterIdentity is NULL))) ORDER BY InternalName JOIN_ON UID_Person=UID_PersonMasterIdentity SELECTX(<SQL:MyServer/OneIM>,sa,,V7) CCC_voornamen, CCC_geboortenaam, CCC_prefixName, CCC_voorletters, BirthDate, Gender, CCC_countryName, CCC_geboorteplaats, CCC_nationality, <DBLOOKUP "dbo.Department" "<DEFAULT>[Departments Name]" "" "" "UID_Department">, UID_Person AS "UID_Person" FROM dbo.Person;

WITH EmployeeHierarchy AS ( -- Root employees = no manager SELECT m.UID_PersonHead, m.UID_Person, 0 AS Level, FORMAT(ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY m.InternalName),'000') AS ID FROM Person m WHERE (m.UID_PersonHead is null AND exists (select top 1 1 from Person c1 where c1.UID_PersonHead = m.UID_Person)) --and (m.UID_PersonMasterIdentity is null) UNION ALL -- Recursive: join employees to their manager SELECT c.UID_PersonHead, c.UID_Person, eh.Level + 1 AS Level, eh.ID + '.' + FORMAT(ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY c.InternalName),'000') AS ID FROM Person c INNER JOIN EmployeeHierarchy eh ON c.UID_PersonHead = eh.UID_Person WHERE (eh.Level < 10) -- and -- stop deeper than level 10 --(c.UID_PersonMasterIdentity is null) ), maxlev As ( select max(level) as maxlev from EmployeeHierarchy ), RPT As ( SELECT ID + REPLICATE('.000', ((select maxlev from maxlev) - ee.Level)) as ID, ee.Level, REPLICATE(' ', (ee.Level + 1) * 4) + '+- ' + pppp.InternalName AS IndentedName, (select top 1 CentralAccount from dbo.QER_FTPersonsAreMe(ee.UID_Person) mmm inner join Person mmmm on mmm.UID_Person = mmmm.UID_Person and isnull(mmmm.CentralAccount,'') > '' order by mmmm.XDateInserted desc) as CentralAccount, pppp.DefaultEmailAddress, pppp.UID_Person FROM EmployeeHierarchy ee inner join Person pp on ee.UID_Person = pp.UID_Person cross apply ( --fetch master identity select me.UID_Person from dbo.QER_FTPersonsAreMe(pp.UID_Person) me where me.UID_PersonMasterIdentity is null ) ppp inner join Person pppp on pppp.UID_Person = ppp.UID_Person ) SELECT ID As "#", Level, IndentedName as "Employee Hierachy", CentralAccount, DefaultEmailAddress as "EMail Address", UID_Person FROM RPT ORDER BY ID;

Query.Description: DateTime AD Account was Disabled >>> no UID_Person
Query.SQL: with rpt as ( select a.CanonicalName, o.OperationDate from DialogWatchOperation o inner join DialogWatchProperty p on o.UID_DialogWatchOperation = p.UID_DialogWatchOperation inner join DialogColumn c on p.UID_DialogColumn = c.UID_DialogColumn inner join ADSAccount a on o.ObjectKeyOfRow = a.XObjectKey where a.AccountDisabled = 1 and a.UID_Person is null and c.ColumnName = 'AccountDisabled' and p.ContentShort = 0 ) select * from rpt order by 1;

with rpt as ( select a.CanonicalName, o.OperationDate, p.ContentShort, pp.InternalName, pp.CentralAccount, pp.ExitDate, pp.IsInActive, pp.ImportSource from DialogWatchOperation o inner join DialogWatchProperty p on o.UID_DialogWatchOperation = p.UID_DialogWatchOperation inner join DialogColumn c on p.UID_DialogColumn = c.UID_DialogColumn inner join ADSAccount a on o.ObjectKeyOfRow = a.XObjectKey left outer join Person pp on pp.UID_Person = p.ContentShort where a.AccountDisabled = 1 and a.UID_Person is null and c.ColumnName = 'UID_Person' and isnull(p.ContentShort,'') > 0 ) select * from rpt order by 1;

with rpt as ( select a.CanonicalName, o.OperationDate, p.ContentShort, pp.InternalName, pp.CentralAccount, pp.ExitDate, pp.IsInActive, pp.ImportSource from DialogWatchOperation o inner join DialogWatchProperty p on o.UID_DialogWatchOperation = p.UID_DialogWatchOperation inner join DialogColumn c on p.UID_DialogColumn = c.UID_DialogColumn inner join ADSAccount a on o.ObjectKeyOfRow = a.XObjectKey left outer join Person pp on pp.UID_Person = p.ContentShort where a.AccountDisabled = 1 and a.UID_Person is null and c.ColumnName = 'UID_Person' and isnull(p.ContentShort,'') > '' ) select * from rpt order by 1;

with rpt as ( select p.InternalName, a.CanonicalName, case when a.CanonicalName like '%/Shared Mailbox/%' then 'Shared Mailbox' when a.CanonicalName like '%/Disabled/%' then 'Disabled' else 'Other' end as AdContainer, a.AccountDisabled, p.IsInActive, a.XMarkedForDeletion, isnull(p.ExitDate,CONVERT(date, '9999-12-31')) as ExitDate, (case when a.CanonicalName like '%/Shared Mailbox/%' then 2 when a.CanonicalName like '%/Disabled/%' then 1 else 0 end) + (case when a.AccountDisabled > 0 then 4 else 0 end) + (case when p.IsInActive > 0 then 8 else 0 end) + (case when a.XMarkedForDeletion > 0 then 16 else 0 end) as CaseNum from Person p inner join Department d on p.UID_Department = d.UID_Department inner join ADSAccount a on a.UID_Person = p.UID_Person ), rpt2 as ( select InternalName, CanonicalName, AdContainer, AccountDisabled, IsInActive, XMarkedForDeletion, ExitDate, CaseNum, ROW_NUMBER() over (partition by CaseNum order by ExitDate) rn from rpt -- format(CaseNum,'000') + '.' + format(rn,'0000') as id, InternalName, CanonicalName, AdContainer, ExitDate, AccountDisabled, IsInActive, XMarkedForDeletion ) select CaseNum, rn, InternalName, CanonicalName, AdContainer, ExitDate, AccountDisabled, IsInActive, XMarkedForDeletion from rpt2 where rn <= 3 order by CaseNum, RN;

with rpt as ( select p.InternalName, a.CanonicalName, case when a.CanonicalName like '%/Shared Mailbox/%' then 'Shared Mailbox' when a.CanonicalName like '%/Disabled/%' then 'Disabled' else 'Other' end as AdContainer, a.AccountDisabled, p.IsInActive, a.XMarkedForDeletion, isnull(p.ExitDate,CONVERT(date, '9999-12-31')) as ExitDate, (case when a.CanonicalName like '%/Shared Mailbox/%' then 2 when a.CanonicalName like '%/Disabled/%' then 1 else 0 end) + (case when a.AccountDisabled > 0 then 4 else 0 end) + (case when p.IsInActive > 0 then 8 else 0 end) + (case when a.XMarkedForDeletion > 0 then 16 else 0 end) as CaseNum from Person p inner join Department d on p.UID_Department = d.UID_Department inner join ADSAccount a on a.UID_Person = p.UID_Person ), rpt2 as ( select InternalName, CanonicalName, AdContainer, AccountDisabled, IsInActive, XMarkedForDeletion, ExitDate, CaseNum, ROW_NUMBER() over (partition by CaseNum order by ExitDate) rn from rpt -- format(CaseNum,'000') + '.' + format(rn,'0000') as id, InternalName, CanonicalName, AdContainer, ExitDate, AccountDisabled, IsInActive, XMarkedForDeletion ) select CaseNum, rn, InternalName, CanonicalName, AdContainer, ExitDate, AccountDisabled, IsInActive, XMarkedForDeletion from rpt2 where rn <= 3 order by CaseNum, RN;

WITH EmployeeHierarchy AS ( -- Root employees = no manager SELECT m.UID_PersonHead, m.UID_Person, 0 AS Level, FORMAT(ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY m.InternalName),'000') AS ID FROM Person m WHERE (m.UID_PersonHead is null AND exists (select top 1 1 from Person c1 where c1.UID_PersonHead = m.UID_Person)) --and (m.UID_PersonMasterIdentity is null) UNION ALL -- Recursive: join employees to their manager SELECT c.UID_PersonHead, c.UID_Person, eh.Level + 1 AS Level, eh.ID + '.' + FORMAT(ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY c.InternalName),'000') AS ID FROM Person c INNER JOIN EmployeeHierarchy eh ON c.UID_PersonHead = eh.UID_Person WHERE (eh.Level < 10) -- and -- stop deeper than level 10 --(c.UID_PersonMasterIdentity is null) ), maxlev As ( select max(level) as maxlev from EmployeeHierarchy ), RPT As ( SELECT ID + REPLICATE('.000', ((select maxlev from maxlev) - ee.Level)) as ID, ee.Level, REPLICATE(' ', (ee.Level + 1) * 4) + '+- ' + pppp.InternalName AS IndentedName, (select top 1 CentralAccount from dbo.QER_FTPersonsAreMe(ee.UID_Person) mmm inner join Person mmmm on mmm.UID_Person = mmmm.UID_Person and isnull(mmmm.CentralAccount,'') > '' order by mmmm.XDateInserted desc) as CentralAccount, pppp.DefaultEmailAddress, pppp.UID_Person FROM EmployeeHierarchy ee inner join Person pp on ee.UID_Person = pp.UID_Person cross apply ( --fetch master identity select me.UID_Person from dbo.QER_FTPersonsAreMe(pp.UID_Person) me where me.UID_PersonMasterIdentity is null ) ppp inner join Person pppp on pppp.UID_Person = ppp.UID_Person ) SELECT ID As "#", Level, IndentedName as "Employee Hierachy", CentralAccount, DefaultEmailAddress as "EMail Address", UID_Person FROM RPT ORDER BY ID;

with containers as ( select dbo.QBM_FCVObjectkeyToElement('TableName',b.XObjectKey) as tname, i.UID_org, c.ObjectGUID as SafeNetContainer, c.UID_UNSContainerB FROM [OneIM].[dbo].[TSBITData] i inner join UNSContainerB c on c.XObjectKey = i.ObjectKeyValue inner join UNSRootB r on c.UID_UNSRootB = r.UID_UNSRootB left outer join BaseTree b on i.UID_Org = b.UID_Org where r.Ident_UNSRoot = 'SafeNet' ), cont_lookup as ( select cc.tname as DeptLoc, case tname when 'Locality' then (select l.Ident_locality from Locality l where l.UID_Locality = cc.UID_Org) when 'Department' then (select d.DepartmentName from Department d where d.UID_Department = cc.UID_Org) else null end as NameDeptLoc, cc.UID_Org, cc.SafeNetContainer, cc.UID_UNSContainerB from containers cc ), safenet_chk as ( select p2.InternalName, p2.CentralAccount, p2.IsInActive, p2.IsTemporaryDeactivated, a2.CanonicalName, a2.AccountDisabled, a2.XMarkedForDeletion, c2.ObjectGUID as CurrentContainer, Stuff(( SELECT ',' + cast(cc3.SafeNetContainer as varchar(max)) FROM cont_lookup cc3 WHERE cc3.UID_Org = p2.UID_Locality and cc3.DeptLoc = 'Locality' FOR XML PATH('') ), 1, 1, '') as LocContainer, (select UID_UNSContainerB from cont_lookup cc4 where cc4.UID_Org = p2.UID_Locality and cc4.DeptLoc = 'Locality') as UID_UNSContainerB, Stuff(( SELECT ',' + cast(cc4.SafeNetContainer as varchar(max)) FROM cont_lookup cc4 WHERE cc4.UID_Org = p2.UID_Department and cc4.DeptLoc = 'Department' FOR XML PATH('') ), 1, 1, '') as DepContainer from UNSAccountB a2 inner join Person p2 on a2.UID_Person = p2.UID_Person inner join UNSRootB r2 on a2.UID_UNSRootB = r2.UID_UNSRootB left outer join UNSContainerB c2 on a2.UID_UNSContainerB = c2.UID_UNSContainerB where r2.Ident_UNSRoot = 'SafeNet' ), RPT as ( select InternalName, CentralAccount, case IsInActive when 1 then 'Yes' else 'No' end as EmpDisabled, case IsTemporaryDeactivated when 1 then 'Yes' else 'No' end as EmpTempDisabled, CanonicalName, case AccountDisabled when 1 then 'Yes' else 'No' end as AcctDisabled, XMarkedForDeletion as SafeNetDeleted, case when XMarkedForDeletion > 0 then 'Yes' else 'No' end as AcctDeleted, CurrentContainer, LocContainer, UID_UNSContainerB as LocContainerUID from safenet_chk where isnull(CurrentContainer,'') <> isnull(LocContainer,'') ) select InternalName As "Employee", CentralAccount As "Employee: CentralAccount", EmpDisabled As "Employee: is Disabled", EmpTempDisabled As "Employee: is Temp-Disabled", CanonicalName As "SafeNet Account: CanonicalName", AcctDisabled As "SafeNet Account: is Disabled", AcctDeleted As "SafeNet Account: is Deleted", CurrentContainer As "SafeNet Account: Current Container", LocContainer As "Location: Container", LocContainerUID As "Location: UID_UNSContainerB" from RPT order by InternalName;
SELECTX(<SQL:AWIAMSQL01.IMCD.NL/OneIM>,OneIM,,V7) Ident_UNSRoot, DisplayName, AlternatePropertyCaptions FROM dbo.UNSRootB ORDER BY Ident_UNSRoot;

with rpt as ( select o.OperationDate, pp.InternalName + ' (' + pp.CentralAccount + ')' as Employee, o.OperationUser, xx.Manager as Manager, p.ContentShort as OldDate, pp.ExitDate as CurrentDate from DialogWatchOperation o inner join Person pp on o.ObjectKeyOfRow = pp.XObjectKey outer apply ( select top 1 pm.InternalName + ' (' + pm.CentralAccount + ')' as Manager from person pm left outer join DialogUser u on pm.UID_DialogUser = u.UID_DialogUser where o.OperationUser = pm.DefaultEmailAddress or u.UserName = o.OperationUser ) xx inner join DialogWatchProperty p on o.UID_DialogWatchOperation = p.UID_DialogWatchOperation inner join DialogColumn c on p.UID_DialogColumn = c.UID_DialogColumn where c.ColumnName = 'ExitDate' and o.OperationDate > '2025-06-30 23:59:59' ) select OperationDate as "Change Date", --Employee, --OperationUser as "Changed By", --Manager as "Changed By Person", OldDate as "Previous Exit-Date", CurrentDate as "Current ExitDate" from rpt order by OperationDate desc;

with rpt as ( select o.OperationDate, pp.InternalName + ' (' + pp.CentralAccount + ')' as Employee, o.OperationUser, xx.Manager as Manager, p.ContentShort as OldDate, pp.ExitDate as CurrentDate from DialogWatchOperation o inner join Person pp on o.ObjectKeyOfRow = pp.XObjectKey outer apply ( select top 1 pm.InternalName + ' (' + pm.CentralAccount + ')' as Manager from person pm left outer join DialogUser u on pm.UID_DialogUser = u.UID_DialogUser where o.OperationUser = pm.DefaultEmailAddress or u.UserName = o.OperationUser ) xx inner join DialogWatchProperty p on o.UID_DialogWatchOperation = p.UID_DialogWatchOperation inner join DialogColumn c on p.UID_DialogColumn = c.UID_DialogColumn where c.ColumnName = 'ExitDate' and o.OperationDate > '2025-06-30 23:59:59' ) select OperationDate as "Change Date", --Employee, --OperationUser as "Changed By", --Manager as "Changed By Person", OldDate as "Previous Exit-Date", CurrentDate as "Current ExitDate" from rpt order by OperationDate desc;

with rpt as ( select o.OperationDate, pp.InternalName + ' (' + pp.CentralAccount + ')' as Employee, cc.CountryName, o.OperationUser, xx.Manager as Manager, p.ContentShort as OldDate, pp.ExitDate as CurrentDate from DialogWatchOperation o inner join Person pp on o.ObjectKeyOfRow = pp.XObjectKey left outer join Locality ll on pp.UID_Locality = ll.UID_Locality left outer join DialogCountry cc on ll.UID_DialogCountry = cc.UID_DialogCountry outer apply ( select top 1 pm.InternalName + ' (' + pm.CentralAccount + ')' as Manager from person pm left outer join DialogUser u on pm.UID_DialogUser = u.UID_DialogUser where o.OperationUser = pm.DefaultEmailAddress or u.UserName = o.OperationUser ) xx inner join DialogWatchProperty p on o.UID_DialogWatchOperation = p.UID_DialogWatchOperation inner join DialogColumn c on p.UID_DialogColumn = c.UID_DialogColumn where c.ColumnName = 'ExitDate' and o.OperationDate > '2025-06-30 23:59:59' ) select OperationDate as "Change Date", CountryName as "Employees Location", --Employee, --OperationUser as "Changed By", --Manager as "Changed By Person", OldDate as "Previous Exit-Date", CurrentDate as "Current ExitDate" from rpt order by OperationDate desc;

SELECTX(<SQL:AWIAMSQL41.IMCD.NL/OneIMTest>,OneIM,,V7) TOP(10000) <DEFAULT> AS "Request procedures Name" FROM dbo.PersonWantsOrg WHERE (OrderState LIKE_IN ('%Aborted%','%Dismissed%','%Unsubscribed%')) ORDER BY XDateUpdated DESC JOIN_ON UID_PersonWantsOrg SELECTX(<SQL:AWIAMSQL41.IMCD.NL/OneIMTest>,OneIM,,V7) Ident_PWODecisionStep, DateHead, DecisionLevel, DecisionType, OrderState, DisplayPersonHead, IsDecisionBySystem, IsFromDelegation, IsToHideInHistory, ReasonHead, RulerLevel, <DBLOOKUP "dbo.[Person]" "<DEFAULT>[Approver]" "" "" "UID_PersonHead=UID_Person">, <DBLOOKUP "dbo.[Person]" "<DEFAULT>[Additional approver]" "" "" "UID_PersonRelated=UID_Person"> FROM dbo.PWODecisionHistory ORDER BY XDateInserted;

WITH ad_info as ( select p.InternalName + ' (' + p.CentralAccount + ')' as Employee, a.UserPrincipalName, p.IsInActive, p.IsTemporaryDeactivated, p.CCC_Retain_O365, case when exists (select top 1 1 from DialogDeferredOperation oo where oo.ObjectKey = a.XObjectKey and oo.TargetDate > GETUTCDATE() and oo.Operation = 'Update') then 1 else 0 end as HasDeferredDeletion, case when p.ExitDate is null or p.ExitDate > GETUTCDATE() then 0 else DATEDIFF(day, p.ExitDate, GETUTCDATE()) end As OffboardedDaysAgo, c.CanonicalName as CurrentAdContainer, cc.CanonicalName as DesiredAdContainer from Person p inner join ADSAccount a --on a.UID_Person = p.UID_Person AND a.UID_TSBBehavior = 'TSB-FullManaged' on a.UID_ADSAccount = p.CCC_UID_ADSAccount inner join ADSContainer c on a.UID_ADSContainer = c.UID_ADSContainer left outer join Locality l on p.UID_Locality = l.UID_Locality left outer join TSBITData t on p.UID_Locality = t.UID_Org left outer join ADSContainer cc on t.ObjectKeyValue = cc.XObjectKey where (cc.UID_ADSContainer is not null) or (t.UID_Org is null) ), rpt as ( select Employee, UserPrincipalName, IsInActive, IsTemporaryDeactivated, CCC_Retain_O365, OffboardedDaysAgo, HasDeferredDeletion, CurrentAdContainer, case when DesiredAdContainer is null then '???' else case when IsInActive = 1 then case when CCC_Retain_O365 = 1 And HasDeferredDeletion = 1 then LEFT(DesiredAdContainer, LEN(DesiredAdContainer) - CHARINDEX('/', REVERSE(DesiredAdContainer))) + '/Exchange/Shared Mailbox' else LEFT(DesiredAdContainer, LEN(DesiredAdContainer) - CHARINDEX('/', REVERSE(DesiredAdContainer))) + '/Disabled' end else DesiredAdContainer end end as DesiredAdContainer from ad_info ) select Employee, UserPrincipalName as "Employee Login", IsInActive as "Employee Permanently Disabled", IsTemporaryDeactivated as "Employee Temporarily Disabled", CCC_Retain_O365 as "Convert to Shared Mailbox", OffboardedDaysAgo as "Offboarded Days Ago", HasDeferredDeletion as "Has Deferred Move Operation", CurrentAdContainer as "Current AD-Container", DesiredAdContainer as "Desired AD-Container" from rpt where 1=1 --AND CCC_Retain_O365 = 1 and OffboardedDaysAgo <= 90 AND CurrentAdContainer <> DesiredAdContainer order by Employee;

with RPT as ( select a.AccountName, a.CanonicalName As AccountFullName, g.CanonicalName as GroupFullName, g.XDateInserted as GroupInserted, a.UID_UNSAccountB, g.UID_UNSGroupB, ug.XObjectKey as AssignmentObjKey from UNSAccountBHasUNSGroupB ug inner join UNSAccountB a on ug.UID_UNSAccountB = a.UID_UNSAccountB inner join UNSGroupB g on ug.UID_UNSGroupB = g.UID_UNSGroupB where g.CanonicalName in ( select CanonicalName --, count(*) from UNSGroupB where CanonicalName like 'Salesforce_PS/%' group by CanonicalName having count(*) > 1) ) select AccountName as "Salesforce Account Name", AccountFullName as "Salesforce Account Distinguished Name", GroupFullName as "Salesforce Group Distinguished Name", GroupInserted as "Group Created On", UID_UNSGroupB as UID_UNSGroupB, AssignmentObjKey as "Assignment XObjectKey" from RPT order by GroupFullName, GROUPINSERTED;

with RPT as ( select a.AccountName, a.CanonicalName As AccountFullName, g.CanonicalName as GroupFullName, g.XDateInserted as GroupInserted, a.UID_UNSAccountB, g.UID_UNSGroupB, ug.XObjectKey as AssignmentObjKey from UNSAccountBHasUNSGroupB ug inner join UNSAccountB a on ug.UID_UNSAccountB = a.UID_UNSAccountB inner join UNSGroupB g on ug.UID_UNSGroupB = g.UID_UNSGroupB where g.CanonicalName in ( select CanonicalName --, count(*) from UNSGroupB where CanonicalName like 'Salesforce_PS/%' group by CanonicalName having count(*) > 1) ) select GroupFullName as "Salesforce Group Distinguished Name", GroupInserted as "Group Created On", UID_UNSGroupB as UID_UNSGroupB, AccountName as "Salesforce Account Name", AccountFullName as "Salesforce Account Distinguished Name", AssignmentObjKey as "Assignment XObjectKey" from RPT order by GroupFullName, GROUPINSERTED, ACCOUNTNAME;

with RPT as ( select a.AccountName, a.CanonicalName As AccountFullName, g.CanonicalName as GroupFullName, g.XDateInserted as GroupInserted, a.UID_UNSAccountB, g.UID_UNSGroupB, ug.XObjectKey as AssignmentObjKey, g.CanonicalName + UID_UNSGroupB as GroupID from UNSAccountBHasUNSGroupB ug inner join UNSAccountB a on ug.UID_UNSAccountB = a.UID_UNSAccountB inner join UNSGroupB g on ug.UID_UNSGroupB = g.UID_UNSGroupB where g.CanonicalName in ( select CanonicalName --, count(*) from UNSGroupB where CanonicalName like 'Salesforce_PS/%' group by CanonicalName having count(*) > 1) ) select GroupFullName as "Salesforce Group Distinguished Name", GroupInserted as "Group Created On", UID_UNSGroupB as UID_UNSGroupB, AccountName as "Salesforce Account Name", AccountFullName as "Salesforce Account Distinguished Name", AssignmentObjKey as "Assignment XObjectKey" from RPT order by GroupID, ACCOUNTNAME;

with RPT as ( select a.AccountName, a.CanonicalName As AccountFullName, g.CanonicalName as GroupFullName, g.XDateInserted as GroupInserted, a.UID_UNSAccountB, g.UID_UNSGroupB, ug.XObjectKey as AssignmentObjKey, (g.CanonicalName + UID_UNSGroupB) as GroupID from UNSAccountBHasUNSGroupB ug inner join UNSAccountB a on ug.UID_UNSAccountB = a.UID_UNSAccountB inner join UNSGroupB g on ug.UID_UNSGroupB = g.UID_UNSGroupB where g.CanonicalName in ( select CanonicalName --, count(*) from UNSGroupB where CanonicalName like 'Salesforce_PS/%' group by CanonicalName having count(*) > 1) ) select GroupFullName as "Salesforce Group Distinguished Name", GroupInserted as "Group Created On", UID_UNSGroupB as UID_UNSGroupB, AccountName as "Salesforce Account Name", AccountFullName as "Salesforce Account Distinguished Name", AssignmentObjKey as "Assignment XObjectKey" from RPT order by GroupID, ACCOUNTNAME;

with RPT as ( select a.AccountName, a.CanonicalName As AccountFullName, g.CanonicalName as GroupFullName, g.XDateInserted as GroupInserted, a.UID_UNSAccountB, g.UID_UNSGroupB, ug.XObjectKey as AssignmentObjKey, (g.CanonicalName + g.UID_UNSGroupB) as GroupID from UNSAccountBHasUNSGroupB ug inner join UNSAccountB a on ug.UID_UNSAccountB = a.UID_UNSAccountB inner join UNSGroupB g on ug.UID_UNSGroupB = g.UID_UNSGroupB where g.CanonicalName in ( select CanonicalName --, count(*) from UNSGroupB where CanonicalName like 'Salesforce_PS/%' group by CanonicalName having count(*) > 1) ) select GroupFullName as "Salesforce Group Distinguished Name", GroupInserted as "Group Created On", UID_UNSGroupB as UID_UNSGroupB, AccountName as "Salesforce Account Name", AccountFullName as "Salesforce Account Distinguished Name", AssignmentObjKey as "Assignment XObjectKey" from RPT order by GroupID, ACCOUNTNAME;

WITH ad_info as ( select p.InternalName + ' (' + p.CentralAccount + ')' as Employee, a.UserPrincipalName, p.IsInActive, p.IsTemporaryDeactivated, p.CCC_Retain_O365, case when exists (select top 1 1 from DialogDeferredOperation oo where oo.ObjectKey = a.XObjectKey and oo.TargetDate > GETUTCDATE() and oo.Operation = 'Update') then 1 else 0 end as HasDeferredDeletion, case when p.ExitDate is null or p.ExitDate > GETUTCDATE() then 0 else DATEDIFF(day, p.ExitDate, GETUTCDATE()) end As OffboardedDaysAgo, c.CanonicalName as CurrentAdContainer, cc.CanonicalName as DesiredAdContainer from Person p inner join ADSAccount a --on a.UID_Person = p.UID_Person AND a.UID_TSBBehavior = 'TSB-FullManaged' on a.UID_ADSAccount = p.CCC_UID_ADSAccount inner join ADSContainer c on a.UID_ADSContainer = c.UID_ADSContainer left outer join Locality l on p.UID_Locality = l.UID_Locality left outer join TSBITData t on p.UID_Locality = t.UID_Org left outer join ADSContainer cc on t.ObjectKeyValue = cc.XObjectKey where (cc.UID_ADSContainer is not null) or (t.UID_Org is null) ), rpt as ( select Employee, UserPrincipalName, IsInActive, IsTemporaryDeactivated, CCC_Retain_O365, OffboardedDaysAgo, HasDeferredDeletion, CurrentAdContainer, case when DesiredAdContainer is null then '???' else case when IsInActive = 1 then case when CCC_Retain_O365 = 1 And HasDeferredDeletion = 1 then LEFT(DesiredAdContainer, LEN(DesiredAdContainer) - CHARINDEX('/', REVERSE(DesiredAdContainer))) + '/Exchange/Shared Mailbox' else LEFT(DesiredAdContainer, LEN(DesiredAdContainer) - CHARINDEX('/', REVERSE(DesiredAdContainer))) + '/Disabled' end else DesiredAdContainer end end as DesiredAdContainer from ad_info ) select Employee, UserPrincipalName as "Employee Login", IsInActive as "Employee Permanently Disabled", IsTemporaryDeactivated as "Employee Temporarily Disabled", CCC_Retain_O365 as "Convert to Shared Mailbox", OffboardedDaysAgo as "Offboarded Days Ago", HasDeferredDeletion as "Has Deferred Move Operation", CurrentAdContainer as "Current AD-Container", DesiredAdContainer as "Desired AD-Container" from rpt where 1=1 --AND CCC_Retain_O365 = 1 and OffboardedDaysAgo <= 90 AND CurrentAdContainer <> DesiredAdContainer order by Employee;
