with containers as ( select dbo.QBM_FCVObjectkeyToElement('TableName',b.XObjectKey) as tname, i.UID_org, c.ObjectGUID as SafeNetContainer, c.UID_UNSContainerB FROM [OneIM].[dbo].[TSBITData] i inner join UNSContainerB c on c.XObjectKey = i.ObjectKeyValue inner join UNSRootB r on c.UID_UNSRootB = r.UID_UNSRootB left outer join BaseTree b on i.UID_Org = b.UID_Org where r.Ident_UNSRoot = 'SafeNet' ), cont_lookup as ( select cc.tname as DeptLoc, case tname when 'Locality' then (select l.Ident_locality from Locality l where l.UID_Locality = cc.UID_Org) when 'Department' then (select d.DepartmentName from Department d where d.UID_Department = cc.UID_Org) else null end as NameDeptLoc, cc.UID_Org, cc.SafeNetContainer, cc.UID_UNSContainerB from containers cc ), safenet_chk as ( select p2.InternalName, p2.CentralAccount, p2.IsInActive, p2.IsTemporaryDeactivated, a2.CanonicalName, a2.AccountDisabled, a2.XMarkedForDeletion, c2.ObjectGUID as CurrentContainer, Stuff(( SELECT ',' + cast(cc3.SafeNetContainer as varchar(max)) FROM cont_lookup cc3 WHERE cc3.UID_Org = p2.UID_Locality and cc3.DeptLoc = 'Locality' FOR XML PATH('') ), 1, 1, '') as LocContainer, (select UID_UNSContainerB from cont_lookup cc4 where cc4.UID_Org = p2.UID_Locality and cc4.DeptLoc = 'Locality') as UID_UNSContainerB, Stuff(( SELECT ',' + cast(cc4.SafeNetContainer as varchar(max)) FROM cont_lookup cc4 WHERE cc4.UID_Org = p2.UID_Department and cc4.DeptLoc = 'Department' FOR XML PATH('') ), 1, 1, '') as DepContainer from UNSAccountB a2 inner join Person p2 on a2.UID_Person = p2.UID_Person inner join UNSRootB r2 on a2.UID_UNSRootB = r2.UID_UNSRootB left outer join UNSContainerB c2 on a2.UID_UNSContainerB = c2.UID_UNSContainerB where r2.Ident_UNSRoot = 'SafeNet' ), RPT as ( select InternalName, CentralAccount, case IsInActive when 1 then 'Yes' else 'No' end as EmpDisabled, case IsTemporaryDeactivated when 1 then 'Yes' else 'No' end as EmpTempDisabled, CanonicalName, case AccountDisabled when 1 then 'Yes' else 'No' end as AcctDisabled, XMarkedForDeletion as SafeNetDeleted, case when XMarkedForDeletion > 0 then 'Yes' else 'No' end as AcctDeleted, CurrentContainer, LocContainer, UID_UNSContainerB as LocContainerUID from safenet_chk where isnull(CurrentContainer,'') <> isnull(LocContainer,'') ) select InternalName As "Employee", CentralAccount As "Employee: CentralAccount", EmpDisabled As "Employee: is Disabled", EmpTempDisabled As "Employee: is Temp-Disabled", CanonicalName As "SafeNet Account: CanonicalName", AcctDisabled As "SafeNet Account: is Disabled", AcctDeleted As "SafeNet Account: is Deleted", CurrentContainer As "SafeNet Account: Current Container", LocContainer As "Location: Container", LocContainerUID As "Location: UID_UNSContainerB" from RPT order by InternalName;

select CCC_TargetSystem, CCC_AccountName, ccc_event, CCC_ObjectTable, (select count(*) from DialogWatchOperation o where o.GenProcID = e.CCC_GenProcID) from CCCTicket_Event e order by CCC_TargetSystem, CCC_ACCOUNTNAME, CCC_TIMESTAMP desc;

with RPT as ( select a.AccountName, a.CanonicalName As AccountFullName, g.CanonicalName as GroupFullName, g.XDateInserted as GroupInserted, a.UID_UNSAccountB, g.UID_UNSGroupB, ug.XObjectKey as AssignmentObjKey, (g.CanonicalName + g.UID_UNSGroupB) as GroupID from UNSAccountBHasUNSGroupB ug inner join UNSAccountB a on ug.UID_UNSAccountB = a.UID_UNSAccountB inner join UNSGroupB g on ug.UID_UNSGroupB = g.UID_UNSGroupB where g.CanonicalName in ( select CanonicalName --, count(*) from UNSGroupB where CanonicalName like 'Salesforce_PS/%' group by CanonicalName having count(*) > 1) ) select GroupFullName as "Salesforce Group Distinguished Name", GroupInserted as "Group Created On", UID_UNSGroupB as UID_UNSGroupB, AccountName as "Salesforce Account Name", AccountFullName as "Salesforce Account Distinguished Name", AssignmentObjKey as "Assignment XObjectKey" from RPT order by GroupID, ACCOUNTNAME;

with rpt as ( SELECT [PersCentralAccount] ,[PersCompany] ,[PersCountry] ,[PersCountryCode] ,[PersDisabled] ,[PersEMail] ,[PersEmployee] ,[PersExternal] ,[PersPrimAddrNum] ,p.CCC_JDE_Addr_Allowed as PersJdeAddrAllowed ,[AddrBookAddrBookNum] ,[AddrBookCompany] ,[AddrBookCountry] ,[AddrBookDisplayName] ,[AddrBookEMail] ,aa.UID_TSBBehavior as AddrBookManageLevel ,[JdeUseDisplayName] ,[JdeUserAccountName] ,[JdeUserAddrBookNum] ,[JdeUserDisabled] ,[ReportRowNum] ,[UID_AddrBook] ,[UID_JdeUser] ,a.[UID_Person] ,[XObjectKeyPers] FROM [OneIM].[dbo].[CCC_JDE_Accounts] a left outer join Person p on a.UID_Person = p.UID_Person left outer join UNSAccountB aa on aa.UID_UNSAccountB = a.UID_AddrBook where PersCountry like '%China%' ) select * from rpt order by PersCentralAccount, ADDRBOOKADDRBOOKNUM;

WITH ad_info as ( select p.InternalName + ' (' + p.CentralAccount + ')' as Employee, a.UserPrincipalName, p.IsInActive, p.IsTemporaryDeactivated, p.CCC_Retain_O365, case when exists (select top 1 1 from DialogDeferredOperation oo where oo.ObjectKey = a.XObjectKey and oo.TargetDate > GETUTCDATE() and oo.Operation = 'Update') then 1 else 0 end as HasDeferredDeletion, case when p.ExitDate is null or p.ExitDate > GETUTCDATE() then 0 else DATEDIFF(day, p.ExitDate, GETUTCDATE()) end As OffboardedDaysAgo, c.CanonicalName as CurrentAdContainer, cc.CanonicalName as DesiredAdContainer from Person p inner join ADSAccount a on a.UID_Person = p.UID_Person AND a.UID_TSBBehavior = 'TSB-FullManaged' --on a.UID_ADSAccount = p.CCC_UID_ADSAccount inner join ADSContainer c on a.UID_ADSContainer = c.UID_ADSContainer left outer join Locality l on p.UID_Locality = l.UID_Locality left outer join TSBITData t on p.UID_Locality = t.UID_Org left outer join ADSContainer cc on t.ObjectKeyValue = cc.XObjectKey where (cc.UID_ADSContainer is not null) or (t.UID_Org is null) ), rpt as ( select Employee, UserPrincipalName, IsInActive, IsTemporaryDeactivated, CCC_Retain_O365, OffboardedDaysAgo, HasDeferredDeletion, CurrentAdContainer, case when DesiredAdContainer is null then '???' else case when IsInActive = 1 then case when CCC_Retain_O365 = 1 And HasDeferredDeletion = 1 then LEFT(DesiredAdContainer, LEN(DesiredAdContainer) - with RPT as ( select distinct p.InternalName + ' (' + p.CentralAccount + ')' as Employee, p.IsInActive, p.IsTemporaryDeactivated, a.AccountName, a.AccountDisabled, a.CCC_SalesforceDisabled ---, d.Ident_TSBAccountDef from Person p inner join UNSAccountB a on p.UID_Person = a.UID_Person left outer join PersonHasTSBAccountDef pd on pd.UID_Person = p.UID_Person left outer join TSBAccountDef d on pd.UID_TSBAccountDef = d.UID_TSBAccountDef AND Ident_TSBAccountDef = 'Salesforce Account Def' where a.CanonicalName like 'Salesforce_PS/%' AND d.UID_TSBAccountDef is null ) select Employee, IsInActive as "Employee: permanently deactivated", IsTemporaryDeactivated as "Employee: temporarily deactivated", AccountName as "Salesforce Account", AccountDisabled as "Salesforce Account: disabled in One Identity", CCC_SalesforceDisabled as "Salesforce Account: disabled in Salesforce" from RPT order by 1;

with RPT as ( select p.InternalName, p.CentralAccount, p.IsInActive, p.IsTemporaryDeactivated, a.CanonicalName, a.AccountDisabled, a.XMarkedForDeletion from Person p inner join ADSAccount a on a.UID_Person = p.UID_Person where p.CCC_UID_ADSAccount is null ) select InternalName as "Employee", CentralAccount as "Employee: Central Account", IsInActive as "Employee: Permanently Disabled", IsTemporaryDeactivated as "Employee: Temporarily Disabled", CanonicalName as "AD Account", AccountDisabled as "AD Account: Disabled", XMarkedForDeletion as "AD Account: Marked for Deletion" from RPT order by 1;

with RPT as ( select p.InternalName, p.CentralAccount, p.IsInActive, p.IsTemporaryDeactivated, c.AccountName, c.AccountDisabled, c.UID_TSBBehavior, c.XMarkedForDeletion from Person p inner join CSMUser c on p.UID_Person = c.UID_Person or (isnull(p.DefaultEmailAddress,'') = isnull(c.EmailAddress,'') and isnull(c.EmailAddress,'') <> '') where p.UID_Person in ( select p.UID_Person --.InternalName, p.CentralAccount, count(*) --c.AccountName from Person p inner join CSMUser c on p.UID_Person = c.UID_Person or (isnull(p.DefaultEmailAddress,'') = isnull(c.EmailAddress,'') and isnull(c.EmailAddress,'') <> '') where c.DistinguishedName like '%/TRAINING/' group by p.UID_Person having count(*) > 1 ) AND c.DistinguishedName like '%/TRAINING/' ) select InternalName as "Employee", CentralAccount as "Employee: Central Account", IsInActive as "Employee: Permanently Disabled", IsTemporaryDeactivated as "Employee: Temporarily Disabled", AccountName as "Cornerstone Account", AccountDisabled as "Cornerstone Account: Disabled", UID_TSBBehavior as "Cornerstone Account: Manage Level", XMarkedForDeletion as "Cornerstone Account: Marked for Deletion" from RPT order by InternalName, ACCOUNTNAME;

with RPT as ( select p.InternalName, p.CentralAccount, p.IsInActive, p.IsTemporaryDeactivated, c.AccountName, c.AccountDisabled, c.UID_TSBBehavior, c.XMarkedForDeletion from Person p inner join CSMUser c on p.UID_Person = c.UID_Person or (isnull(p.DefaultEmailAddress,'') = isnull(c.EmailAddress,'') and isnull(c.EmailAddress,'') <> '') where p.UID_Person in ( select p.UID_Person --.InternalName, p.CentralAccount, count(*) --c.AccountName from Person p inner join CSMUser c on p.UID_Person = c.UID_Person or (isnull(p.DefaultEmailAddress,'') = isnull(c.EmailAddress,'') and isnull(c.EmailAddress,'') <> '') where c.DistinguishedName like '%/TRAINING/' group by p.UID_Person having count(*) > 1 ) AND c.DistinguishedName like '%/TRAINING/' ) select InternalName as "Employee", CentralAccount as "Employee: Central Account", IsInActive as "Employee: Permanently Disabled", IsTemporaryDeactivated as "Employee: Temporarily Disabled", AccountName as "Cornerstone Account", AccountDisabled as "Cornerstone Account: Disabled", UID_TSBBehavior as "Cornerstone Account: Manage Level", XMarkedForDeletion as "Cornerstone Account: Marked for Deletion" from RPT order by InternalName, ACCOUNTNAME;

with containers as ( select dbo.QBM_FCVObjectkeyToElement('TableName',b.XObjectKey) as tname, i.UID_org, c.ObjectGUID as SafeNetContainer, c.UID_UNSContainerB FROM [OneIM].[dbo].[TSBITData] i inner join UNSContainerB c on c.XObjectKey = i.ObjectKeyValue inner join UNSRootB r on c.UID_UNSRootB = r.UID_UNSRootB left outer join BaseTree b on i.UID_Org = b.UID_Org where r.Ident_UNSRoot = 'SafeNet' ), cont_lookup as ( select cc.tname as DeptLoc, case tname when 'Locality' then (select l.Ident_locality from Locality l where l.UID_Locality = cc.UID_Org) when 'Department' then (select d.DepartmentName from Department d where d.UID_Department = cc.UID_Org) else null end as NameDeptLoc, cc.UID_Org, cc.SafeNetContainer, cc.UID_UNSContainerB from containers cc ), safenet_chk as ( select p2.InternalName, p2.CentralAccount, p2.IsInActive, p2.IsTemporaryDeactivated, a2.CanonicalName, a2.AccountDisabled, a2.XMarkedForDeletion, c2.ObjectGUID as CurrentContainer, Stuff(( SELECT ',' + cast(cc3.SafeNetContainer as varchar(max)) FROM cont_lookup cc3 WHERE cc3.UID_Org = p2.UID_Locality and cc3.DeptLoc = 'Locality' FOR XML PATH('') ), 1, 1, '') as LocContainer, (select UID_UNSContainerB from cont_lookup cc4 where cc4.UID_Org = p2.UID_Locality and cc4.DeptLoc = 'Locality') as UID_UNSContainerB, Stuff(( SELECT ',' + cast(cc4.SafeNetContainer as varchar(max)) FROM cont_lookup cc4 WHERE cc4.UID_Org = p2.UID_Department and cc4.DeptLoc = 'Department' FOR XML PATH('') ), 1, 1, '') as DepContainer from UNSAccountB a2 inner join Person p2 on a2.UID_Person = p2.UID_Person inner join UNSRootB r2 on a2.UID_UNSRootB = r2.UID_UNSRootB left outer join UNSContainerB c2 on a2.UID_UNSContainerB = c2.UID_UNSContainerB where r2.Ident_UNSRoot = 'SafeNet' ), RPT as ( select InternalName, CentralAccount, case IsInActive when 1 then 'Yes' else 'No' end as EmpDisabled, case IsTemporaryDeactivated when 1 then 'Yes' else 'No' end as EmpTempDisabled, CanonicalName, case AccountDisabled when 1 then 'Yes' else 'No' end as AcctDisabled, XMarkedForDeletion as SafeNetDeleted, case when XMarkedForDeletion > 0 then 'Yes' else 'No' end as AcctDeleted, CurrentContainer, LocContainer, UID_UNSContainerB as LocContainerUID from safenet_chk where isnull(CurrentContainer,'') <> isnull(LocContainer,'') ) select InternalName As "Employee", CentralAccount As "Employee: CentralAccount", EmpDisabled As "Employee: is Disabled", EmpTempDisabled As "Employee: is Temp-Disabled", CanonicalName As "SafeNet Account: CanonicalName", AcctDisabled As "SafeNet Account: is Disabled", AcctDeleted As "SafeNet Account: is Deleted", CurrentContainer As "SafeNet Account: Current Container", LocContainer As "Location: Container", LocContainerUID As "Location: UID_UNSContainerB" from RPT order by InternalName;

WITH ad_info as ( select p.InternalName + ' (' + p.CentralAccount + ')' as Employee, a.UserPrincipalName, a.XMarkedForDeletion, p.IsInActive, p.IsTemporaryDeactivated, p.CCC_Retain_O365, case when exists (select top 1 1 from DialogDeferredOperation oo where oo.ObjectKey = a.XObjectKey and oo.TargetDate > GETUTCDATE() and oo.Operation = 'Update') then 1 else 0 end as HasDeferredMove, case when p.ExitDate is null or p.ExitDate > GETUTCDATE() then 0 else DATEDIFF(day, p.ExitDate, GETUTCDATE()) end As OffboardedDaysAgo, c.CanonicalName as CurrentAdContainer, cc.CanonicalName as DesiredAdContainer from Person p inner join ADSAccount a --on a.UID_Person = p.UID_Person AND a.UID_TSBBehavior = 'TSB-FullManaged' on a.UID_ADSAccount = p.CCC_UID_ADSAccount inner join ADSContainer c on a.UID_ADSContainer = c.UID_ADSContainer left outer join Locality l on p.UID_Locality = l.UID_Locality left outer join TSBITData t on p.UID_Locality = t.UID_Org left outer join ADSContainer cc on t.ObjectKeyValue = cc.XObjectKey where (cc.UID_ADSContainer is not null) or (t.UID_Org is null) UNION select p2.InternalName + ' (' + p2.CentralAccount + ')' as Employee, a2.UserPrincipalName, a2.XMarkedForDeletion, p2.IsInActive, p2.IsTemporaryDeactivated, p2.CCC_Retain_O365, case when exists (select top 1 1 from DialogDeferredOperation oo where oo.ObjectKey = a2.XObjectKey and oo.TargetDate > GETUTCDATE() and oo.Operation = 'Update') then 1 else 0 end as HasDeferredMove, case when p2.ExitDate is null or p2.ExitDate > GETUTCDATE() then 0 else DATEDIFF(day, p2.ExitDate, GETUTCDATE()) end As OffboardedDaysAgo, null as CurrentAdContainer, cc2.CanonicalName as DesiredAdContainer from Person p2 inner join ADSAccount a2 --on a.UID_Person = p.UID_Person AND a.UID_TSBBehavior = 'TSB-FullManaged' on a2.UID_ADSAccount = p2.CCC_UID_ADSAccount left outer join Locality l2 on p2.UID_Locality = l2.UID_Locality left outer join TSBITData t2 on p2.UID_Locality = t2.UID_Org left outer join ADSContainer cc2 on t2.ObjectKeyValue = cc2.XObjectKey where (a2.UID_ADSContainer is null) ), rpt as ( select Employee, UserPrincipalName, IsInActive, IsTemporaryDeactivated, CCC_Retain_O365, OffboardedDaysAgo, XMarkedForDeletion, HasDeferredMove, CurrentAdContainer, case when DesiredAdContainer is null then '???' else case when IsInActive = 1 then case when CCC_Retain_O365 = 1 And HasDeferredMove = 1 then LEFT(DesiredAdContainer, LEN(DesiredAdContainer) - CHARINDEX('/', REVERSE(DesiredAdContainer))) + '/Exchange/Shared Mailbox' else LEFT(DesiredAdContainer, LEN(DesiredAdContainer) - CHARINDEX('/', REVERSE(DesiredAdContainer))) + '/Disabled' end else DesiredAdContainer end end as DesiredAdContainer from ad_info ) --select XMarkedForDeletion, count(*) as NumberOfAccounts --from rpt --where 1=1 -- AND CurrentAdContainer <> DesiredAdContainer -- AND IsInActive = 1 -- AND CurrentAdContainer like '%/Users' --group by XMarkedForDeletion;
select Employee, UserPrincipalName as "Employee Login", IsInActive as "Employee Permanently Disabled", IsTemporaryDeactivated as "Employee Temporarily Disabled", XMarkedForDeletion as "AD Account Marked for Deletion", CCC_Retain_O365 as "Convert to Shared Mailbox", OffboardedDaysAgo as "Offboarded Days Ago", HasDeferredMove as "Has Deferred Move Operation", CurrentAdContainer as "Current AD-Container", DesiredAdContainer as "Desired AD-Container" from rpt where 1=1 --AND CCC_Retain_O365 = 1 and OffboardedDaysAgo <= 90 AND isnull(CurrentAdContainer,'') <> isnull(DesiredAdContainer,'') --AND IsInActive = 1 --AND CurrentAdContainer like '%/Users' --AND XMarkedForDeletion = 0 order by Employee;

WITH ad_info as ( select p.InternalName + ' (' + p.CentralAccount + ')' as Employee, a.UserPrincipalName, a.XMarkedForDeletion, p.IsInActive, p.IsTemporaryDeactivated, p.CCC_Retain_O365, case when exists (select top 1 1 from DialogDeferredOperation oo where oo.ObjectKey = a.XObjectKey and oo.TargetDate > GETUTCDATE() and oo.Operation = 'Update') then 1 else 0 end as HasDeferredMove, case when p.ExitDate is null or p.ExitDate > GETUTCDATE() then 0 else DATEDIFF(day, p.ExitDate, GETUTCDATE()) end As OffboardedDaysAgo, c.CanonicalName as CurrentAdContainer, cc.CanonicalName as DesiredAdContainer from Person p inner join ADSAccount a --on a.UID_Person = p.UID_Person AND a.UID_TSBBehavior = 'TSB-FullManaged' on a.UID_ADSAccount = p.CCC_UID_ADSAccount inner join ADSContainer c on a.UID_ADSContainer = c.UID_ADSContainer left outer join Locality l on p.UID_Locality = l.UID_Locality left outer join TSBITData t on p.UID_Locality = t.UID_Org left outer join ADSContainer cc on t.ObjectKeyValue = cc.XObjectKey where ((cc.UID_ADSContainer is not null) or (t.UID_Org is null)) AND (a.UID_ADSContainer is not null) UNION select p2.InternalName + ' (' + p2.CentralAccount + ')' as Employee, a2.UserPrincipalName, a2.XMarkedForDeletion, p2.IsInActive, p2.IsTemporaryDeactivated, p2.CCC_Retain_O365, case when exists (select top 1 1 from DialogDeferredOperation oo where oo.ObjectKey = a2.XObjectKey and oo.TargetDate > GETUTCDATE() and oo.Operation = 'Update') then 1 else 0 end as HasDeferredMove, case when p2.ExitDate is null or p2.ExitDate > GETUTCDATE() then 0 else DATEDIFF(day, p2.ExitDate, GETUTCDATE()) end As OffboardedDaysAgo, null as CurrentAdContainer, cc2.CanonicalName as DesiredAdContainer from Person p2 inner join ADSAccount a2 --on a.UID_Person = p.UID_Person AND a.UID_TSBBehavior = 'TSB-FullManaged' on a2.UID_ADSAccount = p2.CCC_UID_ADSAccount left outer join Locality l2 on p2.UID_Locality = l2.UID_Locality left outer join TSBITData t2 on p2.UID_Locality = t2.UID_Org left outer join ADSContainer cc2 on t2.ObjectKeyValue = cc2.XObjectKey where (a2.UID_ADSContainer is null) ), rpt as ( select Employee, UserPrincipalName, IsInActive, IsTemporaryDeactivated, CCC_Retain_O365, OffboardedDaysAgo, XMarkedForDeletion, HasDeferredMove, CurrentAdContainer, case when DesiredAdContainer is null then '???' else case when IsInActive = 1 then case when CCC_Retain_O365 = 1 And HasDeferredMove = 1 then LEFT(DesiredAdContainer, LEN(DesiredAdContainer) - CHARINDEX('/', REVERSE(DesiredAdContainer))) + '/Exchange/Shared Mailbox' else LEFT(DesiredAdContainer, LEN(DesiredAdContainer) - CHARINDEX('/', REVERSE(DesiredAdContainer))) + '/Disabled' end else DesiredAdContainer end end as DesiredAdContainer from ad_info ) --select XMarkedForDeletion, count(*) as NumberOfAccounts --from rpt --where 1=1 -- AND CurrentAdContainer <> DesiredAdContainer -- AND IsInActive = 1 -- AND CurrentAdContainer like '%/Users' --group by XMarkedForDeletion;
select Employee, UserPrincipalName as "Employee Login", IsInActive as "Employee Permanently Disabled", IsTemporaryDeactivated as "Employee Temporarily Disabled", XMarkedForDeletion as "AD Account Marked for Deletion", CCC_Retain_O365 as "Convert to Shared Mailbox", OffboardedDaysAgo as "Offboarded Days Ago", HasDeferredMove as "Has Deferred Move Operation", CurrentAdContainer as "Current AD-Container", DesiredAdContainer as "Desired AD-Container" from rpt where 1=1 --AND CCC_Retain_O365 = 1 and OffboardedDaysAgo <= 90 AND isnull(CurrentAdContainer,'') <> isnull(DesiredAdContainer,'') --AND IsInActive = 1 --AND CurrentAdContainer like '%/Users' --AND XMarkedForDeletion = 0 order by Employee;
SELECTX(<SQL:AWIAMSQL01.IMCD.NL/OneIM>,OneIM,,V7) <DEFAULT> AS "Identities Name", DefaultEmailAddress FROM dbo.Person;

with rpt as ( select CCC_TargetSystem, CCC_AccountName, p.InternalName, p.IsInActive, p.IsTemporaryDeactivated from CCCTicket_Event e left outer join Person p on p.UID_Person = e.CCC_UID_Person where not exists (select top 1 1 from UNSAccountB a where e.CCC_XObjectKey = a.XObjectKey) ) select CCC_TargetSystem as "Target System", CCC_AccountName as "Account", InternalName as "Employee", IsInActive as "Employee Disabled", IsTemporaryDeactivated as "Employee Temp Disabled" from rpt order by 1, 2, 3;

with rpt as ( select CCC_TargetSystem, CCC_AccountName, p.InternalName, p.IsInActive, p.IsTemporaryDeactivated from CCCTicket_Event e left outer join Person p on p.UID_Person = e.CCC_UID_Person where not exists (select top 1 1 from UNSAccountB a where e.CCC_XObjectKey = a.XObjectKey) ) select CCC_TargetSystem as "Target System", CCC_AccountName as "Account", InternalName as "Employee", IsInActive as "Employee Disabled", IsTemporaryDeactivated as "Employee Temp Disabled" from rpt order by 1, 2, 3;

with rpt as ( select CCC_TargetSystem, CCC_AccountName, p.InternalName, p.IsInActive, p.IsTemporaryDeactivated, e.CCC_TimeStamp, e.UID_CCCTicket_Event from CCCTicket_Event e left outer join Person p on p.UID_Person = e.CCC_UID_Person where not exists (select top 1 1 from UNSAccountB a where e.CCC_XObjectKey = a.XObjectKey) ) select CCC_TargetSystem as "Target System", CCC_AccountName as "Account", InternalName as "Employee", IsInActive as "Employee Disabled", IsTemporaryDeactivated as "Employee Temp Disabled", CCC_TimeStamp as "Event Timestamp", UID_CCCTicket_Event from rpt order by 1, 2, 3;

%

' ) select OrderDate as "Order Date", DisplayPersonOrdered as "Requestee", DisplayOrg as "Requested Product", UID_PersonWantsOrg from rpt order by OrderDate;

with rpt as ( select o.OrderDate, o.DisplayPersonOrdered, o.DisplayOrg, o.UID_PersonWantsOrg from PersonWantsOrg o where not exists (select top 1 1 from QERReuse q where o.ObjectKeyFinal = q.XObjectKey) and isnull(o.ObjectKeyFinal,'') like 'QERReuse

%

' ) select OrderDate as "Order Date", DisplayPersonOrdered as "Requestee", DisplayOrg as "Requested Product", UID_PersonWantsOrg from rpt order by OrderDate;

with rpt as ( select o.OrderDate, o.DisplayPersonOrdered, o.DisplayOrg, o.UID_PersonWantsOrg from PersonWantsOrg o where not exists (select top 1 1 from QERReuse q where o.ObjectKeyFinal = q.XObjectKey) and isnull(o.ObjectKeyFinal,'') like 'QERReuse

%

' ) select OrderDate as "Order Date", DisplayPersonOrdered as "Requestee", DisplayOrg as "Requested Product", UID_PersonWantsOrg from rpt order by OrderDate;

with rpt as ( select CCC_TargetSystem, CCC_AccountName, p.InternalName, p.IsInActive, p.IsTemporaryDeactivated, e.CCC_TimeStamp, e.UID_CCCTicket_Event from CCCTicket_Event e left outer join Person p on p.UID_Person = e.CCC_UID_Person where not exists (select top 1 1 from UNSAccountB a where e.CCC_XObjectKey = a.XObjectKey) ) select CCC_TargetSystem as "Target System", CCC_AccountName as "Account", InternalName as "Employee", IsInActive as "Employee Disabled", IsTemporaryDeactivated as "Employee Temp Disabled", CCC_TimeStamp as "Event Timestamp", UID_CCCTicket_Event from rpt order by 1, 2, 3;

with rpt as ( select e.CCC_ObjectTable, e.CCC_Event, e.CCC_AccountName, e.CCC_TimeStamp, o.OperationDate, o.OperationLevel, dbo.QBM_FCVObjectkeyToElement('TableName', o.ObjectKeyOfRow) as ObjectKeyOfRow from ( select CCC_ObjectTable, CCC_Event, UID_CCCTicket_Event, XDateInserted, Row_Number() OVER (PARTITION BY CCC_ObjectTable, CCC_Event ORDER BY XDateInserted DESC) AS ROW_NUM from CCCTicket_Event where isnull(CCC_GenProcID,'') > '' ) x inner join CCCTicket_Event e on x.UID_CCCTicket_Event = e.UID_CCCTicket_Event inner join DialogWatchOperation o on e.CCC_GenProcID = o.GenProcID where o.OperationLevel = 0 and x.ROW_NUM <= 20 ) select CCC_ObjectTable as "Event Object-Table", CCC_Event as "EVENT", CCC_AccountName as "Event Account-Name", CCC_TimeStamp as "Event TimeStamp", OperationDate as "GenProcID Date", ObjectKeyOfRow as "GenProcID Table" from rpt order by CCC_ObjectTable, CCC_EVENT, CCC_TIMESTAMP desc, OPERATIONDATE desc;

with rpt as ( select e.CCC_ObjectTable, e.CCC_Event, e.CCC_AccountName, e.CCC_TimeStamp, o.OperationDate, o.OperationLevel, dbo.QBM_FCVObjectkeyToElement('TableName', o.ObjectKeyOfRow) as ObjectKeyOfRow from ( select CCC_ObjectTable, CCC_Event, UID_CCCTicket_Event, XDateInserted, Row_Number() OVER (PARTITION BY CCC_ObjectTable, CCC_Event ORDER BY XDateInserted DESC) AS ROW_NUM from CCCTicket_Event where isnull(CCC_GenProcID,'') > '' ) x inner join CCCTicket_Event e on x.UID_CCCTicket_Event = e.UID_CCCTicket_Event inner join DialogWatchOperation o on e.CCC_GenProcID = o.GenProcID where o.OperationLevel < 2 and x.ROW_NUM <= 50 ) select CCC_ObjectTable as "Event Object-Table", CCC_Event as "EVENT", CCC_AccountName as "Event Account-Name", CCC_TimeStamp as "Event TimeStamp", OperationDate as "GenProcID Date", OperationLevel as "GenProcID Operation Level", ObjectKeyOfRow as "GenProcID Table" from rpt order by CCC_ObjectTable, CCC_EVENT, CCC_TIMESTAMP desc, OPERATIONDATE desc;

WITH ad_info as ( select p.InternalName + ' (' + p.CentralAccount + ')' as Employee, a.UserPrincipalName, p.IsInActive, p.IsTemporaryDeactivated, p.CCC_Retain_O365, case when exists (select top 1 1 from DialogDeferredOperation oo where oo.ObjectKey = a.XObjectKey and oo.TargetDate > GETUTCDATE() and oo.Operation = 'Update') then 1 else 0 end as HasDeferredDeletion, case when p.ExitDate is null or p.ExitDate > GETUTCDATE() then 0 else DATEDIFF(day, p.ExitDate, GETUTCDATE()) end As OffboardedDaysAgo, c.CanonicalName as CurrentAdContainer, cc.CanonicalName as DesiredAdContainer from Person p inner join ADSAccount a on a.UID_Person = p.UID_Person AND a.UID_TSBBehavior = 'TSB-FullManaged' --on a.UID_ADSAccount = p.CCC_UID_ADSAccount inner join ADSContainer c on a.UID_ADSContainer = c.UID_ADSContainer left outer join Locality l on p.UID_Locality = l.UID_Locality left outer join TSBITData t on p.UID_Locality = t.UID_Org left outer join ADSContainer cc on t.ObjectKeyValue = cc.XObjectKey where (cc.UID_ADSContainer is not null) or (t.UID_Org is null) ), rpt as ( select Employee, UserPrincipalName, IsInActive, IsTemporaryDeactivated, CCC_Retain_O365, OffboardedDaysAgo, HasDeferredDeletion, CurrentAdContainer, case when DesiredAdContainer is null then '???' else case when IsInActive = 1 then case when CCC_Retain_O365 = 1 And HasDeferredDeletion = 1 then LEFT(DesiredAdContainer, LEN(DesiredAdContainer) - CHARINDEX('/', REVERSE(DesiredAdContainer))) + '/Exchange/Shared Mailbox' else LEFT(DesiredAdContainer, LEN(DesiredAdContainer) - CHARINDEX('/', REVERSE(DesiredAdContainer))) + '/Disabled' end else DesiredAdContainer end end as DesiredAdContainer from ad_info ) select Employee, UserPrincipalName as "Employee Login", IsInActive as "Employee Permanently Disabled", IsTemporaryDeactivated as "Employee Temporarily Disabled", CCC_Retain_O365 as "Convert to Shared Mailbox", OffboardedDaysAgo as "Offboarded Days Ago", HasDeferredDeletion as "Has Deferred Move Operation", CurrentAdContainer as "Current AD-Container", DesiredAdContainer as "Desired AD-Container" from rpt where 1=1 --AND CCC_Retain_O365 = 1 and OffboardedDaysAgo <= 90 AND CurrentAdContainer <> DesiredAdContainer order by Employee;

with accts as ( select a.ObjectGUID, p.InternalName, p.CentralAccount, a.XObjectKey from UNSAccountB a left outer join Person p on a.UID_Person = p.UID_Person where a.CanonicalName like 'JDE/ADDR/%' ), ops as ( select a.XObjectKey, o.UID_DialogWatchOperation, o.OperationDate, p.ContentShort from accts a inner join DialogWatchOperation o on a.XObjectKey = o.ObjectKeyOfRow inner join DialogWatchProperty p on p.UID_DialogWatchOperation = o.UID_DialogWatchOperation inner join DialogColumn c on p.UID_DialogColumn = c.UID_DialogColumn and c.ColumnName = 'CCC_EMail' where o.OperationDate > '2026-08-03' ), chgs as ( select a.ObjectGUID as AddrNum, a.InternalName + ' (' + isnull(a.CentralAccount,'--') + ')' as Employee, o.OperationDate, o.ContentShort as OldEMail from accts a left outer join ops o on a.XObjectKey = o.XObjectKey ) select AddrNum, Employee, OldEMail from chgs where OperationDate is not null and Employee is not null order by Employee, OPERATIONDATE desc;

SELECTX(<SQL:AWIAMSQL01.IMCD.NL/OneIM>,OneIM,,V7) CCC_UID_UNSRootB, CCC_ObjectTable, CCC_AccountName, CCC_Event FROM dbo.CCCTicket_Event ORDER BY XDateInserted DESC JOIN_ON CCC_PersonWantsOrg=UID_PersonWantsOrg SELECTX(<SQL:AWIAMSQL01.IMCD.NL/OneIM>,OneIM,,V7) DisplayOrg, OrderState FROM dbo.PersonWantsOrg;

with rpt as ( select * from ( select convert(nvarchar(255), null) as Approver, convert(datetime, null) as AttestationRunDate, convert(nvarchar(110), null) as CentralAccount, convert(nvarchar(1024), null) as Company, convert(datetime, null) as DateDescision, convert(datetime, null) as DateDescisionHistory, convert(int, null) as DecisionLevel, convert(nvarchar(16), null) as DecisionTypeApprover, convert(nvarchar(256), null) as DepartmentName, convert(nvarchar(255), null) as DisplayName, convert(nvarchar(255), null) as DisplayPersonHead, convert(nvarchar(1024), null) as Employee, convert(nvarchar(max), null) as FinalComment, convert(nvarchar(64), null) as Ident_AttestationPolicy, convert(nvarchar(128), null) as InternalName, convert(bit, null) as IsClosed, convert(bit, null) as IsCrossFunctional, convert(bit, null) as IsGranted, convert(bit, null) as IsNotApprovedBefore, convert(bit, null) as IsReserved, convert(bit, null) as IsUnderConstruction, convert(nvarchar(256), null) as JDE_Role, convert(nvarchar(1024), null) as JDERole_OR_AccountType, convert(varchar(138), null) as ObjectKey1, convert(varchar(138), null) as ObjectKey2, convert(varchar(138), null) as ObjectKey3, convert(varchar(138), null) as ObjectKeyBase, convert(float, null) as PeerGroupFactor, convert(nvarchar(1024), null) as PropertyInfo1, convert(nvarchar(1024), null) as PropertyInfo2, convert(nvarchar(1024), null) as PropertyInfo4, convert(nvarchar(max), null) as ReasonApprover, convert(varchar(2), null) as ReportContent, convert(varchar(2), null) as ReportType, convert(nvarchar(128), null) as SelectedStandardReason, convert(varchar(9), null) as Status, convert(nvarchar(1024), null) as StructureDisplay3, convert(datetime, null) as ToSolveTill, convert(varchar(38), null) as UID_AttestationCase, convert(varchar(38), null) as UID_AttestationPolicy, convert(varchar(38), null) as UID_AttestationRun, convert(varchar(38), null) as UID_Department, convert(varchar(38), null) as UID_ESet, convert(varchar(38), null) as UID_Person, convert(varchar(38), null) as UID_PersonHead, convert(varchar(38), null) as UID_QERJustification, convert(varchar(38), null) as UID_QERWorkingMethod where 1=0 union all -- part from CCC_JDEAttestationOverv2 select xxTab.Approver, xxTab.AttestationRunDate, xxTab.CentralAccount, xxTab.Company, xxTab.DateDescision, xxTab.DateDescisionHistory, xxTab.DecisionLevel, xxTab.DecisionTypeApprover, xxTab.DepartmentName, xxTab.DisplayName, xxTab.DisplayPersonHead, xxTab.Employee, xxTab.FinalComment, xxTab.Ident_AttestationPolicy, xxTab.InternalName, xxTab.IsClosed, xxTab.IsCrossFunctional, xxTab.IsGranted, xxTab.IsNotApprovedBefore, xxTab.IsReserved, xxTab.IsUnderConstruction, xxTab.JDE_Role, xxTab.JDERole_OR_AccountType, xxTab.ObjectKey1, xxTab.ObjectKey2, xxTab.ObjectKey3, xxTab.ObjectKeyBase, xxTab.PeerGroupFactor, xxTab.PropertyInfo1, xxTab.PropertyInfo2, xxTab.PropertyInfo4, xxTab.ReasonApprover, xxTab.ReportContent, xxTab.ReportType, xxTab.SelectedStandardReason, xxTab.Status, xxTab.StructureDisplay3, xxTab.ToSolveTill, xxTab.UID_AttestationCase, xxTab.UID_AttestationPolicy, xxTab.UID_AttestationRun, xxTab.UID_Department, xxTab.UID_ESet, xxTab.UID_Person, xxTab.UID_PersonHead, xxTab.UID_QERJustification, xxTab.UID_QERWorkingMethod from ( SELECT AttestationCase.UID_AttestationCase, AttestationPolicy.Ident_AttestationPolicy, AttestationCase.DisplayName, AttestationCase.StructureDisplay1 AS Employee, AttestationCase.StructureDisplay2 AS JDERole_OR_AccountType, AttestationCase.IsGranted, AttestationCase.IsClosed, CASE WHEN AttestationCase.IsClosed = 0 THEN 'Pending' WHEN AttestationCase.IsGranted = 1 THEN 'Approved' WHEN AttestationHistory_ManualDecision.DecisionType = 'Dismiss' THEN 'Denied' ELSE 'Canceled ' END AS Status, AttestationCase.PropertyInfo3 AS Company, AttestationHistory_ManualDecision.DisplayPersonHead AS Approver, AttestationCase.DisplayPersonHead, AttestationHistory_ManualDecision.DateHead AS DateDescisionHistory, AttestationCase.DateHead AS DateDescision, AttestationHistory_ManualDecision.ReasonHead AS ReasonApprover, AttestationHistory_ManualDecision.Ident_QERJustification AS SelectedStandardReason, AttestationCase.ReasonHead AS FinalComment, AttestationHistory_ManualDecision.DecisionType AS DecisionTypeApprover, AttestationRun.PolicyProcessed AS AttestationRunDate, AttestationCase.DecisionLevel, Person.CentralAccount, Person.InternalName, Department.DepartmentName, ESet.Ident_ESet AS [JDE_Role], AttestationCase.UID_QERJustification, AttestationCase.UID_AttestationPolicy, AttestationCase.UID_PersonHead, 'NA' as ReportContent, 'NA' as ReportType, AttestationCase.ToSolveTill, AttestationCase.StructureDisplay3, AttestationCase.PropertyInfo1, AttestationCase.PropertyInfo2, AttestationCase.PropertyInfo4, AttestationCase.IsReserved, AttestationCase.ObjectKey1, AttestationCase.ObjectKey2, AttestationCase.ObjectKey3, AttestationCase.IsNotApprovedBefore, AttestationCase.UID_AttestationRun, AttestationCase.UID_QERWorkingMethod, AttestationCase.PeerGroupFactor, AttestationCase.IsCrossFunctional, AttestationCase.IsUnderConstruction, PersonHasESet.UID_Person, PersonHasESet.UID_ESet, Department.UID_Department, AttestationCase.ObjectKeyBase FROM AttestationPolicy INNER JOIN AttestationCase ON AttestationPolicy.UID_AttestationPolicy = AttestationCase.UID_AttestationPolicy INNER JOIN AttestationRun ON AttestationCase.UID_AttestationRun = AttestationRun.UID_AttestationRun LEFT OUTER JOIN ESet INNER JOIN PersonHasESet ON ESet.UID_ESet = PersonHasESet.UID_ESet INNER JOIN Person ON PersonHasESet.UID_Person = Person.UID_Person INNER JOIN Department ON Person.UID_Department = Department.UID_Department ON AttestationCase.ObjectKeyBase = PersonHasESet.XObjectKey LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT AttestationHistory.UID_AttestationHistory, AttestationHistory.UID_QERJustification, AttestationHistory.UID_AttestationCase, AttestationHistory.UID_PersonHead, AttestationHistory.DisplayPersonHead, AttestationHistory.ReasonHead, AttestationHistory.DateHead, AttestationHistory.DecisionLevel, AttestationHistory.XDateInserted, AttestationHistory.XDateUpdated, AttestationHistory.XUserUpdated, AttestationHistory.XUserInserted, AttestationHistory.XTouched, AttestationHistory.XObjectKey, AttestationHistory.DecisionType, AttestationHistory.IsDecisionBySystem, AttestationHistory.Ident_PWODecisionStep, AttestationHistory.IsToHideInHistory, AttestationHistory.UID_PersonRelated, AttestationHistory.XMarkedForDeletion, AttestationHistory.UID_PWODecisionRule, AttestationHistory.RulerLevel, QERJustification.Ident_QERJustification FROM AttestationHistory LEFT OUTER JOIN QERJustification ON AttestationHistory.UID_QERJustification = QERJustification.UID_QERJustification WHERE (AttestationHistory.IsDecisionBySystem = 0) AND (AttestationHistory.DecisionType <> N'create')) AS AttestationHistory_ManualDecision ON AttestationCase.UID_AttestationCase = AttestationHistory_ManualDecision.UID_AttestationCase WHERE (AttestationPolicy.Ident_AttestationPolicy = 'IMCD - JDE role membership attestation') AND (ISNULL(AttestationHistory_ManualDecision.DecisionType, '') <> 'Prolongate' OR AttestationCase.IsClosed = 0) AND (AttestationRun.PolicyProcessed > DATEADD(month, - 3, GETDATE())) ) as xxTab ) as x ) select Company, DisplayName, Employee, JDERole_OR_AccountType, [Status], Approver, DateDescision, ReasonApprover, SelectedStandardReason, FinalComment, AttestationRunDate, ToSolveTill from rpt;

SELECTX(<SQL:AWIAMSQL01.IMCD.NL/OneIM>,OneIM,,V7) Ident_AERole FROM dbo.AERole WHERE FullPath LIKE 'Identity Management\Employees\IMCD - HR\%' JOIN_ON UID_AERole SELECTX(<SQL:AWIAMSQL01.IMCD.NL/OneIM>,OneIM,,V7) <NONE> FROM dbo.PersonInAERole JOIN_ON UID_Person SELECTX(<SQL:AWIAMSQL01.IMCD.NL/OneIM>,OneIM,,V7) InternalName, CentralAccount, <DBLOOKUP(<SQL:IMCD>) "dbo.PersonInAERole" "<DBLOOKUP(<SQL:IMCD>) \"dbo.AERole\" \"FullPath\" \"\" \"\" \"UID_AERole\">" "" "" "UID_Person"> FROM dbo.Person;

WITH chgs AS ( select o.ObjectKeyOfRow AS ObjectKey, dc.Caption AS ColumnName, COUNT(*) AS cnt from [dbo].DialogWatchProperty d INNER JOIN [dbo].DialogWatchOperation o ON o.UID_DialogWatchOperation = d.UID_DialogWatchOperation INNER JOIN [dbo].[DialogColumn] dc ON d.UID_DialogColumn = dc.UID_DialogColumn INNER JOIN [dbo].[Person] a1 ON o.ObjectKeyOfRow = a1.XObjectKey WHERE d.UID_DialogColumn in (SELECT UID_DialogColumn FROM [dbo].[DialogColumn] c INNER JOIN DialogTable t ON t.UID_DialogTable = c.UID_DialogTable WHERE t.TableName = 'Person' And (c.ColumnName in ('ExitDate','IsInActive'))) -- AND a1.SAMAccountName in ('PonceletM','VochtenS','AldingerT') -- AND ((a1.CanonicalName like '%rabt%') or (a1.CanonicalName like '%rabp%') or (a1.CanonicalName like '%rabx%')) -- AND a1.CanonicalName in ('Wibowo, A (Ardi)','Widjaja, N (Nanny)','Darmaji, D (Didit)','Andridina, A (Abhimata)') -- AND o.OperationDate > '2016-11-04 18:00:00' GROUP BY o.ObjectKeyOfRow, dc.Caption HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ), accts AS ( SELECT distinct a.InternalName + ' (' + a.CentralAccount + ')' as Person, a.UID_DialogCountry as CurrCountryID, d.CountryName as CurrCountry, a.ExitDate as CurrExitDate, a.IsInActive as CurrIsInactive, a.ApprovalState as CurrApprovalState, a.Gender as CurrGender, a.XObjectKey as XObjectKey FROM chgs c INNER JOIN [dbo].[Person] a ON c.ObjectKey = a.XObjectKey LEFT OUTER JOIN DialogCountry d ON d.UID_DialogCountry = a.UID_DialogCountry ), pers as ( SELECT Person As "Identity", CurrCountry as "Current Country", CurrExitDate as "Current Exit Date", CurrIsInactive as "Current IsInactive", CurrApprovalState as "Current Approval State", CurrGender as "Current Gender", XObjectKey FROM accts --ORDER BY Person ), chg_records AS ( select p2.XObjectKey, dc2.Caption as COL, Row_Number() OVER (PARTITION BY dc2.Caption ORDER BY o2.OperationDate ASC) AS ROW_NUM, CASE (Row_Number() OVER (PARTITION BY dc2.Caption ORDER BY o2.OperationDate ASC)) WHEN 1 THEN 'Initial Value' ELSE 'Change' END AS CHG_TYPE, o2.OperationDate AS OPERATION_DATE, o2.OperationUser AS OPERATION_USER, CASE (Row_Number() OVER (PARTITION BY dc2.Caption ORDER BY o2.OperationDate ASC)) WHEN 1 THEN '---' ELSE CASE dc2.ColumnName WHEN 'UID_DialogCountry' THEN cast(dd.CountryName as nvarchar(1024)) ELSE cast(d2.ContentShort as nvarchar(1024)) END END AS PREV_VAL, CASE (Row_Number() OVER (PARTITION BY dc2.Caption ORDER BY o2.OperationDate DESC)) WHEN 1 THEN CASE dc2.ColumnName WHEN 'UID_DialogCountry' THEN cast(ddd.CountryName as nvarchar(1024)) WHEN 'ExitDate' THEN cast(p2.ExitDate as nvarchar(1024)) WHEN 'IsInActive' THEN cast(p2.IsInActive as nvarchar(1024)) WHEN 'ApprovalState' THEN cast(p2.ApprovalState as nvarchar(1024)) WHEN 'Gender' THEN cast(p2.Gender as nvarchar(1024)) END ELSE CASE dc2.ColumnName WHEN 'UID_DialogCountry' THEN cast((LAG(dd.CountryName) OVER (PARTITION BY dc2.Caption ORDER BY o2.OperationDate DESC)) as nvarchar(1024)) ELSE cast((LAG(d2.ContentShort) OVER (PARTITION BY dc2.Caption ORDER BY o2.OperationDate DESC)) as nvarchar(1024)) END END AS NEXT_VAL from [dbo].DialogWatchProperty d2 LEFT OUTER JOIN DialogCountry dd ON d2.ContentShort = dd.UID_DialogCountry INNER JOIN [dbo].DialogWatchOperation o2 ON o2.UID_DialogWatchOperation = d2.UID_DialogWatchOperation INNER JOIN [dbo].[Person] p2 ON o2.ObjectKeyOfRow = p2.XObjectKey LEFT OUTER JOIN DialogCountry ddd ON p2.UID_DialogCountry = ddd.UID_DialogCountry INNER JOIN [dbo].[DialogColumn] dc2 ON d2.UID_DialogColumn = dc2.UID_DialogColumn WHERE d2.UID_DialogColumn in (SELECT UID_DialogColumn FROM [dbo].[DialogColumn] c INNER JOIN DialogTable t ON t.UID_DialogTable = c.UID_DialogTable WHERE t.TableName = 'Person' And (c.ColumnName in ('ExitDate','IsInActive'))) -- AND rq.XObjectKey = o2.ObjectKeyOfRow -- ORDER BY o2.OperationDate DESC ), RPT as ( select p.Person, p.CurrCountry, Format(p.CurrExitDate, 'dd-MMM-yy') as CurrExitDate, p.CurrIsInactive, c.OPERATION_DATE, Format(c.OPERATION_DATE, 'dd-MMM-yy') as SDATE, c.COL, --c.CHG_TYPE AS "Type of Change", --c.OPERATION_USER AS "Changed By", c.PREV_VAL, c.NEXT_VAL from accts p inner join chg_records c on p.XObjectKey = c.XObjectKey ) select Person As "Identity", CurrCountry as "Current Country", CurrExitDate as "Current Exit Date", CurrIsInactive as "Current IsInactive", SDATE AS "Change Date", COL AS "Column", --c.CHG_TYPE AS "Type of Change", --c.OPERATION_USER AS "Changed By", PREV_VAL AS "Old Value", NEXT_VAL AS "New Value" from RPT order by Person, OPERATION_DATE DESC;
